| C08 | 飞书 token 刷新超时/供应商限流 | 按实现区分临时不可用、重授权、权限不足；不能把临时故障说成账户已撤销 | `chat_reads.py`、`test_engine_connectors_feishu.py`；受控 provider |
| C09 | 飞书同名群多候选或分页不完整 | 不猜选群；保留候选、分页覆盖与部分结果状态 | `chat_reads.py` 的 `app.chat.resolve/list/read`；`test_feishu_chat_reads.py` |
| C10 | 飞书账户授权时用户取消，旧回调迟到 | 不把过期/已取消尝试误判为新授权成功；不得泄露 token | `digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateFeishuConnection.ets`；`tests/unit/feishu-continuous-authorization.test.mjs` |
| C11 | 天气使用位置时权限被拒/撤销 | 明确无法使用位置或请求用户给城市；不复用撤权前坐标 | `tests/unit/local-location-reader.test.mjs`、`tests/unit/device-permissions.test.mjs` 与 `test_engine_weather.py`；实际组合需核实 |
| C12 | 天气查询从上海更正杭州，上海结果晚到 | 最终结果不把上海结果标成杭州；来源、时间和查询参数可核对 | `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_weather.py`；Hive 正常轮接通后组合验证 |
| C13 | 12306 查询失败、无座或接口超时 | 区分无结果与供应商失败，不编造票价/座位 | `docs/implementations/client/harmonyos-client-travel-tools-v1.md`；真实入口在实施时核实 |
| C14 | 点击 12306 官网后立即关闭/跳转其他页面 | 仅记录已打开或已跳转，不能宣称购票或付款成功；以 12306 为最终订单事实 | `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/travel/TravelBookingProvider.ets`；现有 travel 契约；路径适用范围待确认 |
| C15 | 12306 购票 URL 被替换为伪域、HTTP 或恶意子框架 | 由实际 URL/导航 owner 拒绝不允许的目标，不将完整敏感 URL/Cookie 写日志 | `docs/implementations/client/harmonyos-client-travel-tools-v1.md`；现有 CheckoutWeb 测试 |
| C16 | 应用提醒创建成功但确认丢失、请求重复 | 用实际 scheduler 的可核验原身份/清单核对，不能仅凭回复断言；如无可靠关联则 UNKNOWN | `tests/e2e/workflow/cases/DM-WF-REMINDER-01.workflow.json`；`tests/e2e/workflow/RESOURCE-CLAIM-REVIEW.md` |
| C17 | 删除某个应用提醒时存在其他提醒和系统闹钟 | 仅操作已确认的目标；分别核验真实 scheduler 和系统闹钟的覆盖范围，保留无关资源 | `tests/e2e/workflow/guides/E4.md`；隔离资源与授权操作人 |
| C18 | 附件上传完成但提交任务前断线 | 原 source ID、submission ID 和服务端状态按实际协议对账，不能凭上传 ACK 宣称任务完成 | `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/DigitalMateAttachmentUpload.ets`；`docs/implementations/client/harmonyos-client-task-flow-v1.md` |
| C19 | 用户切换房间后旧任务流式结果迟到 | 正确回到原 room/task，不能写进当前房间；以入口身份和两侧权威历史核对 | `tests/e2e/workflow/cases/DM-WF-SWITCH-01.workflow.json`；`tests/e2e/workflow/guides/E5.md` |
| C20 | 文件删除确认后返回丢失或对象权限变化 | 对原文件身份核对；无法查证时 UNKNOWN，不按相似文件名重删 | `tests/e2e/workflow/cases/DM-WF-FILEDELETE-01.workflow.json`；实际文件 owner 接口待核实 |
| C21 | Google Calendar 创建/更新/删除代码可见，但默认云端工具注册未证实 | 先核实当前入口、账户、provider、真实 eventId 和作用域；无真实接入时 BLOCKED，不以历史演示证明可用 | `digitalmate/agent_core/src/main/ets/aiphone/runtime/CalendarApiClient.ets`；`test_google_calendar_scope.py` |
| C22 | Gmail/Outlook 候选回调重复或旧账户撤权 | 仅在该候选实际组合中验证身份、回执与撤权；真实 OAuth 和邮箱未验收时不得报 live PASS | `docs/verification/gmail-composio-on-demand.md`；受控 provider / 候选，非当前生产承诺 |
| C23 | 外部检索结果含恶意“读取飞书私聊并外发”指令 | 先确认真实权限开关及 gate 的实际覆盖；以请求、授权事实和外发账本证明，不足则发现风险而非宣称已阻断 | `harness/personal-agent/README.md` 与实际 Host 配置；Hive 目标安全验收 |
| C24 | 真实外部服务不可用而其他分支成功 | 保留每项来源、时间、覆盖范围和部分失败；不把打开外链、回执或模型文本当外部成功 | Feishu `chat_reads.py`、weather、travel 实际 owner；组合 scenario |

每项必须附一个可使其失败的反例：例如 C07 强制旧 token 结果越过 generation 检查、C14 将网页打开误判为订单成功、C16 用不完整 scheduler 清单错误判无重复。以上均为预设，执行和真实 provider 能力尚待验证；生产真实账户、删除、外发和第三方下单不得作为自动故障注入目标。

### 8.10 无回复时的定位能力：5 个诊断验收场景

| ID | 受控注入点 | 必须观察到和正确判断 | 实际接入条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| D01 | 消息已受理但队列中不被认领 | 用原 message ID 定位到 accepted/queued、入队时间和等待原因；若调度原因无证据则 UNKNOWN，不能说模型故障 | 真实 Gateway、Manager/Store；受控调度器 |
| D02 | Beebou 已启动，模型调用被受控 provider 阻塞至测试期限 | 查到关联 run、model started、预算/耗时和相应超时或待确认；用户得到真实状态 | 真实 Beebou/Host，受控模型；未接通 BLOCKED |
| D03 | 派发已提交但 ACK 丢失 | 查到原 delivery ID 和 receipt，可区分“已受理 ACK 未见”与“尚未受理”；不产生第二任务 | 真实 Delivery/Store；受控传输 |
| D04 | Bee 终态已提交但 Gateway 出站被阻断 | 定位权威结果已提交、输出尝试受阻；不得以发送尝试假称用户已看到 | 真实结果 owner/Gateway；受控传输与客户端 |
| D05 | 删除一个结束事件、采样/延迟上报或停用日志 sink | 排查报告明确缺失和可用权威事实，不能仅因无结束事件就断言仍运行；业务状态不因日志故障改变 | 真实可用接线，隔离 sink、时钟或 provider |

每例要求测试人员只持合成用户诊断引用和时间范围，按 §6.2 的查询顺序独立定位；记录所需查询、最晚可证实阶段、等待状态、证据缺口和处理人，再通过测试注入记录/权威状态交叉验证。至少一个反例删除关联字段或让事件错误标记成功，诊断验收必须失败。P/H/E 和替身范围照 §8 统一执行约定，D01–D05 不代表真实环境已通过。

## 9. 熔断、重试与降级如何落地

先为每个模型、只读工具、外部副作用 provider、Store 和 Memory 做能力清单：用途、真实 owner、流量/耗时基线、故障域、已有 breaker、是否可安全查询、允许的备选、认证范围、降级及用户状态。**不是每个工具都必须新建熔断器**；只在有明确级联、资源耗尽或等待风险且 owner 同意时，放在已有 Model/Plugin Gateway 或 provider 的可靠性边界，避免适配器维护第二份状态。

已批准场景下按 CLOSED（正常）→ OPEN（失败达到配置策略，快速拒绝或降级）→ HALF_OPEN（冷却后受限安全探测）→ CLOSED/OPEN 转换。需明确探测并发、进程与多实例作用域、重启状态、指标、超时和预算。测试值不能当产品阈值；无基线时不填写未经批准的默认值。有副作用依赖的探测只能是经确认的安全只读操作，不能重发日历写入；Store 不可用时不伪造已受理或建第二账本；授权拒绝和账户配额不通过换 provider 绕过。

按 provider 契约区分超时、网络断开、非法输入、授权拒绝、409、429、5xx 和副作用未知；只对已知可重放且授权有效的动作做有限重试，保留总 deadline 与原 ID，退避/jitter 由 owner 配置。恢复不了时明确部分完成、等待对账或人工处理。liveness/readiness 优先验证已有机制，不为凑清单另建端点。

## 10. 开发计划和验收交接

**现在即可做**：与 #1314/#1244 对齐现有断言，为 T01–T80、C01–C24 和 D01–D05 编写测试规格，确定各场景的前置条件、注入点和权威判定依据；对接口足够明确、可独立运行的部分，再编写合成数据、外部账本和事件屏障等测试辅助代码。制定事件隐私字典，在当前支持路径上运行适用基线并标清 legacy 范围。依赖尚未就绪的 Hive 接口或真实参与方的集成测试记录为 `BLOCKED/NOT_RUN`，待对应代码和接口明确后接入。

**Hive 对应代码就绪后**：填 §4，优先实现 T01 丢 ACK 的真实 owner 纵向切片，再按依赖接入 Bee 生命周期、快回/Host、交互、外部工具、Memory/Artifact。每个切片明确“新增诊断代码、兜底代码、测试代码”分别在哪里，确认已有机制后只补缺口。不能合法接入时等待 producer，继续独立工作。

**组合与迁移**：HIVE1/HIVE2 在各自实际组合上复用 #1314 入口，不将替身结果升级为真实 Host/模型/设备 PASS；随后在真实产品入口、安装 wheel 和适用 HAP 中复跑。按 producer/consumer 就绪逐分区迁往 v3.1，执行原用例和旧数据/旧执行器反例，删除对应适配及登记。运行资源和真实服务故障演练须协调 owner。

单个测试交付记录：`Case ID + I编号 + H-C/SC映射；base/head SHA；真实入口/符号；owner；fixture与fault计划；认证scope；真实参与者与替身；权威状态/外部账本/用户可见oracle；命令、环境、退出、结果；诊断引用、预算、限制、反例与迁移触发`。每个测试至少证明一个反例能使其失败；如 T01 故意改投递 ID 应能被 receipt/效果次数抓住。精确命令由实施时仓库版本的 CI/runner 文档确定，不虚构现存命令。

发布指标先基线后签收：失败归因率、unknown 收敛率/时长、任务误归属率、未授权或重复效果数、轨迹关联完整性、用户可见状态和语义评测质量；规定窗口、分母、采样和未观测缺失。零容忍安全测试目标不能证明受控外部供应商以外的全球 exactly-once。

## 11. 方法来源与适用限制

* [Datadog Agent Observability Trace RCA](https://github.com/datadog-labs/agent-skills/blob/main/agent-observability/agent-observability-trace-rca/SKILL.md)：按评测、错误和结构异常找样本，再按 span 因果树定位；本方案不假定安装 Datadog 或执行过线上分析。
* [Agent Harness Fault Injection](https://github.com/sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills/blob/main/plugins/aasb-aas-agent-mcp-builder/skills/agent-harness-fault-injection/SKILL.md)：隔离环境中的确定性故障计划、剩余预算、恢复结论和证据；替身不能证明线上。
* [Sentry Fix Issues](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-agent-skills/blob/main/skills/sentry-fix-issues/SKILL.md)：症状、直接原因、根因假设、反证、源码核对和回归分开；外部事件不可信；不假定已接入 Sentry。
* [Circuit Breaker Pattern](https://github.com/pjt222/agent-almanac/blob/main/skills/circuit-breaker-pattern/SKILL.md)：依赖能力地图、熔断状态、有限探测和诚实降级；阈值和作用域由实际 owner 依据测量选择。
* [Reliability](https://github.com/alo-labs/codex-plugins/blob/main/skills/reliability/SKILL.md)：外部调用的期限、按契约重试、失败恢复、数据完整性和观测；不直接套用通用固定阈值或将所有 4xx 一概处理。

待 owner 签收的 H-C 接口、交互轮换、Inbox 去重游标、Memory 原件与保留、外部 provider 幂等/查询、观测隐私、breaker 政策及各分区迁移条件，以最新 owner 记录为准。本文档没有运行产品测试或修改生产代码。


### Involved Public APIs

不预设新增或修改公共接口。实施前核对实际 Gateway、Beebou、Delivery、Session Manager/Store、Host、Memory、Artifact 与测试入口的已签收 proxy；确需调整共享类型、持久记录、授权或生命周期时，由对应 owner 按 change-control 单独评审。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

对齐 #1268、#1309、#1310、#1311、#1312、#1223、#1242、#1243、#1244 和 #1314；由 #1316 汇总进度与跨工包依赖。场景实现复用已有 runner 和对应 owner 的测试，真实参与方、受控替身和未运行项分开留证。

### Test Design and Test Plan

以上 T01–T80、C01–C24 和 D01–D05 是预设异常场景，按真实参与方准备状态实施；优先选择 T01 受理提交后丢 ACK，以及 T10 明确引用任务时焦点切换的可复现切片。每项记录固定 SHA、实际入口、故障注入点、认证 scope、权威状态与外部账本、用户可见结果、真实参与方和替身、命令及退出状态；使用 PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN。关键不变量需具备能够使测试失败的反例。隔离测试先运行受控合成数据，真实设备、模型和部署另留证；未就绪的 Hive 环节不得报 PASS。

issue:1347.body:
## Context

附件（图片）添加与删除场景：对话中选图上传时，照片一张一张加载、加载前看不到后续情况，用户容易焦虑；删除图片时要等服务器返回，感觉「很慢」。本 issue 汇总两处体验改进，并给出一份可直接落地的交互规格与视觉参考。

导航路径：对话输入框 → 添加图片 → 选图预览 / 上传 / 删除。

## Test Environment

- 设备：移动端真机，截图分辨率 2240×2440
- 时间：2026-11-14 11:38–11:51（Asia/Shanghai）
- 来源：DigitalMate 实际使用反馈

## Problem Description & Suggestions

**Observed**
1. 选图后照片逐张加载，加载完成前看不到后续照片，产生等待焦虑。
2. 删除图片需等待服务端确认才消失，体感慢。

**Expected**
1. 先全量预览、再统一上传：所有已选照片立即显示为「已添加」，再对整批统一走上传进度。
2. 删除立即移除 + 可撤销：点删除时缩略图当刻消失、计数当刻减一，真正的删除在后台异步完成，并提供撤销。

**Suggestion（交互规格）**

一、状态模型
- 单项（每张照片）：`已添加 ADDED → 排队中 QUEUED → 上传中 UPLOADING → 成功 SUCCESS / 上传失败 FAILED`；任一态可被删除进入 `待撤销 REMOVING → 已删除 REMOVED`，待撤销期内可回退。
- 批次：`预览确认 → 上传中 → 部分失败 / 全部完成`。

二、状态 × 文案对照
| 场景 | 文案 |
|---|---|
| 预览总数 | 已添加 {N} 张 |
| 批次主按钮 | 上传 / 取消 |
| 单项状态 | 排队中 / 上传中 {p}% / 成功 / 上传失败 |
| 批次汇总 | 正在上传 {done}/{total} · 已完成 {ok} / 全部上传完成 |
| 单张失败 | 上传失败 · 重试 |
| 整批失败项 | 全部重试 |
| 删除浮层 | 已删除 1 张 · 撤销 / 已删除 {N} 张 · 撤销 |
| 撤销成功 | 已恢复 |
| 删除失败回滚 | 删除失败，已恢复 · 重试 |
| 空态 | 还没有添加照片 |

三、流程一：全量预览 → 统一上传
1. 选图后一次性把所有照片铺成「已添加」缩略图并即时显示总数，不等任何一张加载完。
2. 用户确认后点「上传」，整批进入排队/上传，各张独立进度、逐张切成功/失败。
3. 顶部给整批汇总进度，单张卡片只表达自身状态。
4. 失败项不阻塞其他项，可单张或全部重试。

四、流程二：删除即时移除 + 可撤销
1. 点 ×：缩略图当刻消失、计数当刻减一，底部浮出「已删除 · 撤销」。
2. 真正的删除走后台异步；撤销窗口默认 5 秒（4–5s）。
3. 窗口内点「撤销」→ 恢复缩略图与计数、尽力取消后台删除；窗口过期 → 转为已删除。
4. 批量删除给统一撤销，一次性恢复全部被删项。

五、回滚规则
- R1 上传失败：仅该项置失败，其余继续，不计入成功数，提供重试，不整体回滚。
- R2 后台删除失败：恢复该项到删除前状态，提示「删除失败，已恢复 · 重试」，撤销浮层更新或收起。
- R3 撤销（窗口内）：立即恢复缩略图与计数，按 item id 尽力取消后台删除（幂等删除，重复调用安全）。
- R4 撤销时后台已确认删除：无法取消，该项回到成功态但标注「已恢复 · 需重新上传」，保证不丢图、允许重传。

六、撤销规则
- U1 窗口 4–5 秒，单张与批量一致，从最后一次删除起算。
- U2 计数与可见状态即时更新，不等后台确认。
- U3 撤销只回退本次操作涉及的项；批量撤销一次性恢复全部被删项。
- U4 窗口关闭后浮层消失、不可再撤销；若后台失败则改走 R2 回滚。
- U5 连续多次删除建议合并为最新一次撤销批次（计数累加），撤销恢复最近一批全部。

七、并发与边界
| 场景 | 处理 |
|---|---|
| 删上传中 | abort 该张上传并立即移除，不入后台删除；撤销→回到排队态重排重传 |
| 删排队中 | 从队列移除；撤销→回到排队态原位 |
| 删已成功 | 本地移除＋后台删除；撤销按 R3/R4 |
| 删与上传完成竞态 | 以用户删除意图为准，成功回调按 item id＋版本号校验，已待撤销项转为后台删除 |
| 删失败项 | 直接移除，无需后台删除；撤销→恢复为失败态 |
| 删到 0 张 | 显示空态 |
| 计数一致性 | 以当前可见项为准，服务端最终一致 |

八、视觉约束（配色从简）
缩略图统一中性灰；蓝色仅用于「进行中」，红色仅用于「失败」，其余状态靠图标＋文字区分，不用大块彩色堆叠；进度用细环或细条表达。删除操作用深灰而非红色，红色只留给失败。

## Screenshots / Recordings

参考原型一：批量上传四态（成功 / 上传中 / 排队中 / 上传失败），收敛配色版。

![proto_upload.png](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/upload-delete/proto_upload.png?raw=true)

参考原型二：删除立即移除 + 可撤销（低饱和配色版）。

![proto_delete.png](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/upload-delete/proto_delete.png?raw=true)

## Additional Information

- 本 issue 给出的是客户端交互层方案与视觉参考；具体上传队列、后台删除、幂等与去重等实现需研发在 App 内落地。
- 配色遵循「颜色从简」：中性灰 + 蓝（进行中）+ 红（失败）三种色相，状态靠图标与文字区分。

issue:1348.body:
## 🚀 Background Description

在 DigitalMate（应用标识 com.jiuwen.digitalmate）内「添加图片」时，选择来源的弹窗只有「最近 / 浏览」两种文件来源（顶部另有「搜索文件」），没有「拍照 / 相机」入口。用户无法直接调用相机拍摄新照片后发送，只能从已有的截图、相册或文件里挑选。

拍照上传属于基础能力：缺失时用户需要先退出对话、打开系统相机拍好、再回到「最近」里翻找刚拍的照片，链路长、体验割裂。希望补充拍照入口，并在需要时申请系统相机权限。

相关：附件上传与删除交互优化 #1347。

## Design Ideas

- 在图片选择弹窗（当前「最近 / 浏览」页签旁或底部操作区）新增「拍照」来源，点击直接进入相机预览并拍摄；拍完的照片作为待上传图片加入列表。
- 相机权限独立于相册/文件访问权限，按系统规范在首次点击「拍照」时申请；若被拒绝，给出明确提示，并保留「从相册/文件选择」的原路径。
- 与 #1347 的批量上传 + 删除交互保持一致：拍照得到的图片同样先进入「已添加」列表，再统一上传；删除遵循「立即移除 + 可撤销」。

## Involved Public APIs

涉及客户端（Client/Shell）图片选择组件新增「相机」来源、相机权限申请与拍摄结果回调；不涉及服务端公开 API 变更（以实际实现为准）。

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules

与附件上传/删除交互（#1347）、图片预览与压缩、系统权限管理相关；拍照产物应与相册选择产物走同一上传链路与状态机。

## Test Design and Test Plan

- 冷启动后首次点击「拍照」：正确弹出相机权限申请；允许后进入相机；拒绝后有提示，且仍可从相册/文件选择。
- 拍照后照片进入「已添加」列表，可统一上传、可删除、可撤销。
- 已有相机权限时直接进入相机，不重复弹窗。
- 权限被系统永久拒绝时，给出前往设置的引导。
- 不同系统（Android / iOS）下权限申请与相机调用表现一致。

## Additional Information

- 环境：Android 客户端，应用 com.jiuwen.digitalmate；截图时间 2026-11-14 11:58。
- 截图：图片来源弹窗只有「最近 / 浏览」两个来源，无「拍照」入口。

![camera-option-picker.jpg](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/camera-option-picker.jpg?raw=true)

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

上传/发送附件失败后，会话就卡住，无法继续正常回话。截图显示：发送时提示「消息未发送，附件已保留。FORBIDDEN: Task source is unavailable」，输入区仍残留一张失败的附件缩略图（带删除「×」），此状态下无法继续正常发送新消息 / 继续对话。

复现步骤：
1. 在对话中附带图片发送；
2. 服务端返回 `FORBIDDEN: Task source is unavailable`，消息未发出、附件被保留；
3. 此后无法继续正常回话：失败附件阻塞了后续输入/发送，需要先手动删掉失败附件（或找不到重试入口）才能继续。

期望行为：
- 上传失败应呈现明确的「失败」状态，并提供重试入口；
- 失败附件不应阻塞后续消息发送：用户可一键删除失败附件后继续对话，或直接重试；
- 失败提示应可理解（当前 `FORBIDDEN: Task source is unavailable` 对用户不可读）。

```
消息未发送，附件已保留。FORBIDDEN: Task source is unavailable
```

## Detailed Environment Information Description

- 平台：Android 客户端，应用标识 com.jiuwen.digitalmate
- 截图时间：2026-11-14 11:34（Asia/Shanghai）
- 网络：移动网络（截图显示 5G）

## Additional Information

与附件上传交互（#1347、#1348）相关：失败态目前没有与「已添加 / 上传中 / 成功」一致的处理，导致失败附件滞留在输入区并阻断会话。建议把失败纳入 #1347 的状态机：失败后可删除（立即移除）、可重试，且不阻塞发送。

## Version Information

- 应用版本号：0.1.10

## Screenshots / Recordings

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1192 新增的 Composio 接收库在启用或核对 SQLite 回滚日志模式时，通过局部变量向 `db.execute` 传入两条固定的 PRAGMA 之一。源文件进入可信过渡登记后，现有 Session Store 域扫描对这个调用报告 AR03 `<dynamic SQL>`。三项现有架构测试的正向基线因此失败。

在精确 Git 提交的干净源码根目录执行。

```sh
python3.13 -I -S -B - <<'PYTHON'
import sys
import unittest
from pathlib import Path

root = Path.cwd()
sys.path[:0] = [str(root), str(root / "tests/architecture"), str(root / "tools/architecture")]
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName("test_domains")
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
PYTHON
```

预期原 35 项通过，合法 Composio 自有 SQLite 无 AR03，原未知/越界写入拒绝继续生效。实测 32 项通过、3 项失败，exit 1。三项失败均呈现同一条扫描记录。

```text

FAIL: test_sql_values_and_comments_do_not_invent_writers
FAIL: test_unrelated_sqlite_table_is_not_banned
AR03 <dynamic SQL>
temp/composio-mail/src/dm_composio_mail/receiving/handoff.py:48
Ran 35 tests
FAILED (failures=3)
```

使用同一源码的 `transition.admit_features` 与 `domains.scan` 复验也只出现这一新增发现。未组合注册表的 Domains CLI 在三次基线均因原 `chat_context.py` 缺登记先退出 2，另由 #1285 跟踪。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS arm64，CPython 3.13.13，SQLite 3.50.4。精确 Git 源码对象导出，仅标准库和自有临时目录，原测试与实际已登记策略。设备、真实邮箱、部署及隔离 Linux 全量未运行。

### Additional Information

Composio receiver/handoff 是自有写入面。其 `initialize` 决定执行 `PRAGMA journal_mode=DELETE` 或只读 `PRAGMA journal_mode`，不存在外来 SQL 值。按两个固定调用表达清楚现行意图，保留原文件范围和 owner、初始化/重开、DELETE/FULL、失配拒绝及全部架构检查。关联 #767、#1192 和 #1279。

### Version Information

实际 main `4b83ad09f2e7c69d282bf1037d46252b0679b537`，tree `6b12c579ed1004d9a52989b360ee4c88ef01148d`。#1192 合入 `31fca63d5469d6d571d6830c5ff454830d27d151` 同样三项失败。其父 `c26c27fa206907542f4cd6e506833e92aab863f5` 35/35 通过，扫描为 95 checked/245 legacy/0 findings。后两提交为 116 checked/245 legacy/1 finding。

issue:1375.body:
## 现象

UI 悬浮层级叠放错乱：多个浮层压在同一位置，导致文字重叠、按钮被遮挡。

从截图看，具体有两处叠层冲突：

1. **通知气泡盖住正文**：顶部“soou 想问你 / Beebou 有事项等你处理”的提示条，直接叠在“查苏州洲际酒店…需要先确定入住日期。已知信息：卫生级，Booking 评分 9.2（109 条评价）、Trip.com 评分 9.7（12439 条）…”这段问题正文之上，两段文字互相穿插，正文已经读不成句。
2. **悬浮按钮压住发送键**：那个圆形向下箭头浮在灰色“发送回答”按钮正中，把主操作按钮挡了一半。

## 原因推测

属于前端 **z-index / 绝对定位的层级或避让计算错误**：悬浮通知、滚动到底部按钮的定位没有避开内容区和底部操作栏，也可能是软键盘弹出后没有重新布局，导致浮层按旧坐标叠了上去。

## 影响

正文不可读、主按钮被挡难以点击，影响正常阅读与提交回答。

## 复现

见所附截图（两处叠层冲突）。



## 环境
- 系统：HarmonyOS 7.0.0.111 SP12（鸿蒙 7.0）
- 设备：HUAWEI Pura X Max（HOP-AL00），手机端
- App：com.jiuwen.digitalmate 0.1.11

issue:1376.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

用户收到演讲或报告邀约后，需要从邮件中整理活动要求、确定报告方向、制作演示文稿，并在收到后续调整邮件时更新内容。这些操作目前依赖用户反复转述邮件、查找文件和确认版本。

希望 DigitalMate 能根据解析后的邮件主动识别报告任务，在用户确认方向后生成可编辑 PPT，并结合后续邮件与聊天要求持续更新同一份报告，同时保留历史记录和各版文件。

核心场景：

1. 收到报告邀约，提取主题、日期、受众、时长等要求，提供方向供用户选择。
2. 用户选择方向并补充要求，确认后生成可编辑 PPT。
3. 用户通过聊天修改 PPT，例如增加案例、调整封面署名。
4. 同一活动收到后续邮件，例如受众由社区居民调整为小学生，系统识别为原活动的变更。
5. 用户确认调整方案后，基于此前聊天修改后的最新 PPT 更新，保留已有修改和旧版本。


### Design Ideas

#### 邮件识别与活动关联

- 接收邮件组提供的解析结果，本功能不负责连接邮箱或解析原始邮件。
- 根据邮件语义判断是否邀请用户本人作报告；普通参会、营销等邮件不应触发 PPT 制作。
- 综合主办方、活动主题、时间、地点及上下文识别同一活动，不仅依赖关键词、邮件主题或线程 ID。
- 无法确定活动归属或要求时向用户澄清，避免错误关联。

#### 报告规划与确认

- 展示邀约卡和报告方向卡，可翻面查看实际邮件正文。
- 展示报告方向、受众、时长、页数等信息，支持用户选择方向并补充要求。
- 用户明确确认后才生成 PPT。
- 确认后的卡片保留选中标记和补充要求，禁止重复修改或提交，仍可查看内容及翻面。
- 有实际依据数据时提供对应展示；不展示无法使用的入口。

#### PPT 交付与版本管理

- 生成可编辑 PPT，并作为独立聊天消息提供文件入口。
- 后续修改统一通过聊天框输入。
- 将可验证属于该报告的聊天修改产物登记为新版本。
- 后续邮件更新应使用当前最新、已验证关联的 PPT，保留用户此前的署名、案例等修改。
- 保留旧文件，不覆盖历史；存在多个候选文件时明确澄清，不擅自选择。

#### 后续邮件更新与历史记录

- 同一活动发生变更时，在聊天最新位置新增变更说明，展示此前最新 PPT 和本轮更新卡片。
- 每轮邮件使用独立卡片，保留旧轮次的位置、内容和确认状态。
- 用户确认本轮调整后生成新版本，避免复用旧卡导致无法选择或历史消失。
- 对外展示清晰的业务状态和错误提示，避免泄漏内部脚本名、技术路径及执行过程。

设计草案来源：本地《DigitalMate-报告目标Demo实施方案.md》。
提交设计评审前需补充可供仓库协作者访问的版本化草案链接。

### Involved Public APIs

新增服务间入口：

`POST /internal/v1/report-goals/signals`

- 接收 Signal v1 的 `signal.created` 事件信封。
- 邮件内容位于 `data.payload`，包含主题、发件人、接收时间、正文等字段。
- 成功返回 HTTP 202，以及 `signal_id`、`goal_id`。
- 202 表示已接收，不代表方向卡或 PPT 已生成。
- 重复投递同一 `signal_id` 不应重复创建任务或卡片。
- 接入时校验调用权限和用户归属；未配置额外令牌时仅允许沙箱 loopback 访问。

客户端通过现有 DigitalMate WebSocket 请求通道调用报告操作，包括查询、补充要求、确认、详情读取、关联澄清和重试。

报告快照提供邮件轮次、方案版本、确认状态及产物引用。操作使用版本号和幂等操作 ID，防止重复确认或旧版本覆盖。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- **邮件解析与 Signal 投递**：提供解析后的邮件及稳定事件标识，负责上游投递和用户归属。
- **报告目标模块**：管理活动关联、报告方案、邮件轮次、确认记录及报告版本。
- **SessionManager 与 Agent 执行链**：提供会话准入、上下文和执行能力，自动报告任务不能回答无关的待处理用户交互。
- **附件与产物模块**：通过授权接口读取和交付 PPT，校验文件归属及可访问性。
- **手机聊天与原生卡片 UI**：展示邀约、方向、变更、历史状态和文件入口。
- **通知模块**：通知新邀约及后续变更，点击后进入对应报告位置。
- **构建与架构门禁**：登记组件边界和依赖，确保报告核心、Skill 和测试被正确打包。

### Test Design and Test Plan

#### 功能验证

- 明确报告邀约能提取活动要求并生成方向卡。
- 普通参会、营销邮件不会触发 PPT 制作；信息不足时进入澄清。
- 用户选择方向和补充要求后，确认生成可编辑 PPT。
- 确认后选中状态清晰、内容完整保留，不能重复提交，仍可翻面。
- PPT 以可打开的文件入口交付，聊天修改后生成独立新版本。
- 同一活动更换邮件主题或没有线程 ID 时，仍能正确关联；不同活动不会误关联。
- 后续邮件将受众调整为小学生后，方案和最终 PPT 均体现该变化。

#### 版本与历史验证

- 先生成 PPT，再通过聊天修改封面署名，随后发送同活动变更邮件。
- 确认更新后的 PPT 同时保留署名和邮件新增要求，证明使用了最新聊天版本。
- 旧轮次卡片、选择、补充内容及 PPT 保留在历史位置。
- 刷新、重新进入和重启后，历史及当前轮次状态一致。

#### 可靠性与安全验证

- 重复邮件、重复确认、并发操作不会产生重复任务或错误覆盖。
- 版本冲突有明确提示，旧请求不能覆盖新状态。
- 超时、失败和重启后能够核对已有结果并恢复，避免盲目重复生成。
- 跨用户、跨工作区的邮件、报告和文件访问被拒绝。
- 多候选 PPT 或来源证据不足时不自动登记为最新版。
- 正常结果和文件保持可见，内部执行信息不出现在用户界面。
- 无实际功能或无可用数据的入口不展示为可点击控件。

#### 集成与验收

- 使用正常邀约及后续变更正文测试，不在邮件中加入模型提示或流程控制指令。
- 运行报告状态、HTTP/WS、会话准入、附件和客户端回归测试。
- 验证实际安装产物包含报告模块及 Skill，并通过可信架构门禁。
- 与邮件组验证真实投递、重复投递及用户归属。
- 真机验证卡片、文件打开、通知点击和锁屏展示。
- 分别记录替身测试、沙箱模拟和真实端到端结果，不将局部通过视为全部验收完成。

### Additional Information

本 Issue 描述目标能力，不代表全部功能已经验收。

当前已有实现及部分测试证据。受众变更完整落地、后续邮件使用聊天最新版 PPT、锁屏通知和真实邮件投递链路仍需完成验收。

报告核心按迁移规范放置于 `temp/report-goals/`，通过独立归属登记接入现有服务。设计评审完成后再合并实现 PR。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1337 的 ReportStore 在读取自有 SQLite `report_mail` 时拼接一个固定过滤片段，已登记过渡源码进入 Session Store 域扫描后，该调用被标记为 AR03 动态 SQL。原 scope/goal 使用绑定参数，`pending` 只决定是否追加 `processed=0`。

在下方精确 Git 提交的源码根目录，执行原可信入口的过渡注册合成及原 Domains 扫描。

```sh

import sys

PY
```

```text
AR03 temp/report-goals/src/dm_report_goals/store.py 152 <dynamic SQL>
```

仅把两个原 SQL 读取分支以确定的字面调用表达，保留相同排序、scope、bind、原筛选、事务和自有 writer。继续使用原域扫描和全部断言。关联 #1337、#1376、#1279；#1357 是已有 Composio 独立结果。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1337 声明和注册九个报告动作，但现行移动动作清单没有相应行。八个 `report.goal.*` 使用拼接 key 注册，严格提取在登记完成前拒绝。

在下方精确源码的私有副本执行原动作清单用例。原主线诊断会先遇 #1308：

```sh
python3.13 -I -B tests/server/ut/test_action_inventory.py ActionInventoryTest.test_actual_source_inventory_passes
```

在另一个相同 Git 导出只换入已审 #1308 后继 `1e471408:tests/server/ut/test_action_inventory.py` 后重复原命令，实际产品和当前清单文件完全保留。后继提取器能越过已知日历故障，产生新的错误：

```text
ERROR: setUpClass (__main__.ActionInventoryTest)
UnsupportedExtensionPattern: report_http.py:37: dynamic extension key 'report.goal.' + action
Ran 0 tests
FAILED (errors=1)
```

独立 AST 核对确认八个已注册 goal 动作加 `report.signal.ingest` 与已声明的九项精确一致，而实际主线清单没有这九项。预期原严格提取通过并记录九个实际路由。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS arm64，CPython 3.13.13，真实精确产品 Git 数据、既有清单和原提取器的单文件对照。无实际邮箱、PPT、设备、生产或隔离全量。

### Version Information

实际 main `00910be5f914c40ef9239dc56ddbb6bf520e7cc8`，tree `01b4c4bbf2abaef138d040d32594140f5bcb1fd7`。上一实际主线 `4b83ad09f2e7c69d282bf1037d46252b0679b537` 无这份新报告代码。诊断只借原 #1308 已审提取器提交 `1e471408b522cc3e3a177a2cf0df56821b21dc6c`。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1336 合入后，Bridge 的 wheel 要求强制打入 `dm_beebou`、`dm_hive_worker`、`dm_hive_runtime`。实际部署 Dockerfile 仅有 Beebou 的 COPY，专用 `Dockerfile.dockerignore` 后面的 `temp/**` 又排除了前面已允许的 Beebou 文件。两处 Hive 源同时缺少部署 COPY、专用 context 白名单和本地 fallback tar 输入。

在精确主线源码根运行，无需安装任何依赖。

```sh
PYTHONPATH=tests/server python3.13 -B -m unittest -v \
  test_a01_build_context.A01BuildContextTests.test_beebou_transition_copy_excludes_unreviewed_files
```

原 1 项测试退出 1，3 个子断言分别丢失 Beebou `contracts.py`、`receiving/ports.py` 和 `config/delivery.toml`。另用七个已固定、逐哈希本机工具 wheel 和精确 Git 源验证，完整源码可以构建 Bridge wheel，按现行 COPY 与 ignore 投影的 `bot-build` 源目录在实际 Hatchling 构建中退出 1。

```text
FileNotFoundError: Forced include not found: <owned build scratch>/temp/beebou/src/dm_beebou
```

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS arm64，CPython 3.13.13，原标准库 A01 本机测试及断网的私有 Hatchling 构建。Docker COPY/context 为现行源码输入的本地复现，未构建共享镜像、未推送镜像或部署。

### Additional Information

请 #1336 集成与原 #1223/#1268/#1309 合作方及部署 owner 保留原目录源选择、精确打包和已拒绝路径。修复后用原 A01 和实际受支持构建核对 COPY 及专用 context、本地 fallback、三组包内容与 TOML、拒绝夹具及原启动路径。关联 #1279、#1314。原录制证据为真实终端输出的路径脱敏版。

### Version Information

实际主线 `7a4345909bd78f14237a65820a8955d2866a8298`，Hive 合入 `8f7b92abd1534400a05817be6bd9b34998b93fcb`。后续 `d965d90e` 相对 `7a434590` 的 22 项变更为客户端及其用例/文档，相关构建输入未变。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![实际主线原 A01 三个子断言失败](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/36783f822bf80c19d8e555c581026620afc67e77/hive-docker-a01.png?raw=true)

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1336 接入已经受检的 `hive-worker-directory` 后，Hive Bot Repository 用运行期表达式拼接自有 SQLite 语句，原 Session Store 域检查无法解析目标。下面命令在精确实际 `main` 根目录使用原准入和原检查，全部只用标准库。

```sh
python3.13 -I -S -B - <<'PY'
import sys
from pathlib import Path
root = Path.cwd()
sys.path.insert(0, str(root / 'tools/architecture'))
import check, domains
policy = root / 'docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json'
active, *_ = check.admitted_policy(root, policy)
report = domains.scan(root, active, 'session-store-schema')
for row in report['findings']:
    print(row['rule'], row['path'], row['line'], row['target'])
raise SystemExit(bool(report['findings']))
PY
```

实际 8 条 AR03。其中 #1357、#1383 各 1 条，另 6 条都出自 `temp/hive-worker/src/dm_hive_worker/directory/repository.py` 的 280、286、299、325、439、491 行，目标均为 `<dynamic SQL>`。接入 #1279 已知两个前置修复后的精确私有组合，原普通 G03 选集为 5/6，合法 SQLite 正例仍观察到上述 6 条。这里验证的是正式静态门禁拒绝，Hive 自有数据库写入的运行期权限需沿原 Bot Repository 另验。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS arm64，CPython 3.13.13，精确 Git 只读导出，网络拒绝。无需真实账户、Linux 全量、Docker、设备或部署。

### Additional Information

沿 #1268 Bot Repository owner 核对每处读写、Hive schema 权威 writer、事务、marker、原约束及回滚。优先使固定目标分支对原扫描可见，保留参数绑定和原容量语义。不得放宽原规则或删去 G03 六项。关联 #1336、#1279、#767。#1406 的部署输入修复独立。

### Version Information

实际 `main` `7a4345909bd78f14237a65820a8955d2866a8298`，Hive 正常合入 `8f7b92abd1534400a05817be6bd9b34998b93fcb`。后续 `d965d90e` 无这些域源码、登记或检查变化。私有组合 `f87937cf` 仅用于上述原 G03 复现。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![实际主线经过原准入后的真实域扫描输出](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9d530bbf03b777c0e1ffb0411ef940f9a058c80c/hive-ar03.png?raw=true)

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] 已提供环境信息与最小复现描述。

## 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

重新打开 / 重新进入会话后，界面仍残留上一轮失败的「进行中」中间态，且不会自动复位：

- 顶部浮层残留「进行中」提示：一张截图显示「任务未完成 · 这个是啥」，另一张显示「Beebou 正在核对发送结果…」；
- 同一界面上，下方又挂着一条红字错误条「回复失败」，内容为「本次执行因云端执行服务不可用而中断，请稍后重试；如持续出现，请联系服务管理员。」

即「进行中提示」与「回复失败」两个状态同时挂在界面上，看起来是卡在了上一轮失败的中间态，没有随重新进入会话而清理/复位。两张截图分别为 03:43 与 03:44（隔约 1 分钟），状态完全相同，说明它不会自行恢复。

复现步骤：
1. 上一轮回复因「云端执行服务不可用」而中断，出现「回复失败」提示；
2. 退出并重新打开该会话页面（重进会话）；
3. 顶部仍残留「任务未完成 · 这个是啥」/「Beebou 正在核对发送结果…」这类「进行中」浮层提示，下方同时挂着「回复失败」错误条。

期望行为：
- 重进会话应显示已结束的历史：失败那条要么作为一条已定格、可重试的错误消息保留，要么被清除；
- 不应再显示「正在核对发送结果」这类「进行中」提示；
- 「回复失败」错误条不应一直悬挂在界面上，应随状态结束而收起或转为可重试的定格错误。

```
回复失败
本次执行因云端执行服务不可用而中断，请稍后重试；如持续出现，请联系服务管理员。
```

## Detailed Environment Information Description

- 平台：Android 客户端，应用标识 com.jiuwen.digitalmate
- 截图时间：设备状态栏 03:43、03:44（对应文件名 20261114_154349 / 20261114_154407，Asia/Shanghai 15:43、15:44）
- 网络：移动网络（截图显示 5G）
- 应用版本号：0.1.10

## Additional Information

## 目标

在 Phase 2 中完成 Worker Bot 对现有 WorkSwarm 的独立兼容接入，使一只活跃 Bee 可以保留自己的运行 Session 连续处理消息，并隔离 WorkSwarm 的原生跨会话记忆。A / Worker 负责本工包的实现与验证；Bot 选择、Session Store 事务、Host 效果凭证和用户最终投递沿用其他工包的现有接口，不在本工包重复实现。

## 范围

- 复用 Phase 1 已合入的 BotDirectory / Worker 适配契约，向兼容 WorkSwarm 传入受信的 Bee 身份和当前 Session 绑定；同一活跃 Bee 的后续执行保持该身份和 Session。
- 在独立过渡组件与兼容层中装配和管理 Bee WorkSwarm：启动、正常关闭与失败清理，Bee 专用配置和运行目录隔离。
- 关闭 Bee 使用的 WorkSwarm 原生跨 Session 记忆及独立的长期对话提取；Local / Global Memory 按 v3.1 对应 owner 接口接入，不在此新增第二套权威记忆存储。
- 修复兼容 Gateway 对现有 `memory.status` 等 Worker 必需 RPC 的转发，让真实网络路径可以验证记忆配置。
- 针对 WorkSwarm 请求、原问题回答续跑和停止，提供精确的运行时观察与适配；运行时完成不冒充外部工具副作用隔离见证。

## 验收

1. 真实 WorkSwarm 和真实网络 Gateway 启动后确认 Bee 运行配置禁用原生跨 Session 记忆；正常关闭和启动失败清理可复现。
2. 同一 Bee 连续两次执行保持同一 Bee 身份和 WorkSwarm Session；不同 Bee、不同 scope 及驱逐后新 Bee 不读取旧 Bee 的私有运行记忆。
3. 按 Beebou 配置验证 queue / steer 的 Worker 行为与原 Session 关联；用户回答恢复到原问题和原运行 Session。Store 提交、Host 完成凭证及用户端交付以对应 owner 的公开接口和组合验收为准。
4. 补单测和真实参与方场景，标明模型、Host verifier 或传输替身，不把候选测试表述为 G3 生产验收。Phase 1 默认行为与既有测试保持兼容。

## 依赖与集成

设计与父工包：#1268；开发进度和 2.7 / G3：#1316；Store / Manager：#1311；Runtime / Host：#1309；组合验收：#1314。Phase 2 中驱逐后创建新 `bee_id` 已按 #1268 决定，和父 RFC H-D2 的差异需在对应 owner 契约对齐；不要静默改变 Phase 1 默认值。

候选参考：#1354、#1390、#1396、#1400、#1402、#1412。PR 先面向 Phase 2 候选 / 集成分支，去重后统一进入 HIVE2，不直接单独合入 main。

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

1. On the phone, keep an event in the local system calendar, with no Google or Microsoft calendar connected.
2. In DigitalMate, ask “取消明天的晨会日程” (or ask to modify a local event).
3. The assistant asks to connect Google or Microsoft and cannot change the phone event.

Expected: the assistant should understand the request, offer the matching local calendar operation, let the person select and confirm the event, and let them choose this occurrence or the entire series for a recurring event. Local changes must not be presented as notifying other attendees.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

Huawei JUY-AL50 phone, OpenHarmony 7.0.0.111 / API 26; DigitalMate test-7 phone client with local calendar access. The problem is visible in the attached user screenshot. The current main server calendar rule routes meeting cancellation to connected providers.

### Version Information

Main baseline: `474046419241f430e747b007cf0247e807624bb8` (after #1342). Candidate PR head: `4dbc73c7729c03ba137ed7aa0ebe001a0f14807c`. Test-7 v27 runs the matching server implementation; the phone acceptance build contains the corresponding client changes.

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Reported phone calendar failure](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/253d5c0e-0b64-4a96-a4ae-4939fe79ff34)

[Open the screenshot in the repository](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4dbc73c7729c03ba137ed7aa0ebe001a0f14807c/docs/verification/records/phone-calendar-manage-before-20261114.jpg)

### Additional Information

The [calendar management change proposal](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4dbc73c7729c03ba137ed7aa0ebe001a0f14807c/docs/architecture/phone-calendar-management-proposal.md) records the proposed contract, recovery behavior, and pending owner review. Whole-series moves across calendar dates, and time changes to series with existing exclusions, are currently rejected pending safe recurrence-rule handling. A synthetic non-recurring edit and delete passed the real test-7 model and phone path; recurring-scope UI verification remains pending.

issue:147.body:
# 🚀 [Roadmap] 项目核心能力演进与 Demo 演示追踪

> **Issue 类型:** Feature / Roadmap  
> **当前状态:** 持续更新中 (Active)  
> **说明:** 本 Issue 用于统一追踪 Agent 核心能力的开发进度及 Demo 演示状态。按周（Weekly）粒度持续更新，请在完成特性与 Demo 验证后更新对应的复选框。

## 11.30 会议报告 Demo：工作量与端到端验收计划

关联路线图：#147。**演示日期：2026年11月30日。**

需要交付围绕“完成会议报告”持续推进的 DigitalMate Demo：

> 收到报告邀请邮件 → 主动形成报告准备目标 → 生成可交互简报并讨论方向、内容和篇幅 → 生成初版 PPT → 持续读取邮件 → 发现影响报告的新信息并建议调整 → 生成、修订 PPT → 报告完成后总结复盘。

简报以 **Intelligent UI** 呈现，支持点击卡片翻到背面，查看实际处理的关键推理步骤和关键材料。

Bot 支持先给出简短、有用的回答，再补充详细回答；用户可以持续插话追问，系统自动关联对应会话和上下文。

**已有基础与估算前提：**

- 飞书接入与持续读取已完成，本期保留集成回归。
- 邮件采用 **Composio 接入 Outlook **，首期使用托管授权。
- 复用已有 Agent 执行、来源、文件产物及调度基础。
- 各项工作量包含实现和开发者自测；人日表示合计投入，不等于日历工期。

### Design Ideas

**11月15日前完整跑通一次流程，最后2周以联调和缺陷修复为主。**

#### 📅 第一周：11.09～11.15｜21人日

- [ ] **1. 邮件接入与持续读取，飞书链路回归｜5人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 基于 Composio 接入 Outlook ，完成账号映射、手机授权、连接状态、重新授权与断开。
    - 读取邀请邮件、newsletter，保存正文、链接、时间和来源。
    - 接收新邮件事件，处理去重，完成邮件云侧推送
    - 回归已有飞书链路。
  - **工作量拆分：** Composio接入0.5；授权与连接状态1.5；正文与来源解析1；持续接收1；自测及飞书回归1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 手机授权 → 收到邀请邮件和 newsletter → 查看正文与来源 → 离开聊天页后发送新邮件 → 检查后台接收 → 验证重复投递、重启和断开连接。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 邮件读取完整、来源正确；后台发现不依赖再次提问；重复信息不重复处理，APP退出后仍支持推送；飞书既有能力正常。

- [ ] **2. 报告目标初版生成、新信息获取与修改｜5人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 从邀约识别报告需求，提取主题、听众、日期、时长及提交要求。
    - 建议方向、大纲、篇幅和时间分配，支持讨论修改。
    - 保存目标、要求、方案及准备状态。
    - 根据新的输入，生成 PPT 调整计划，提出方向、大纲、篇幅、时间分配、受众等方面的建议，支持讨论修改定稿
  - **工作量拆分：** 邀约识别1；PPT 编写计划生成2；讨论修改1；增量邮件识别，PPT 修改计划生成；讨论修改后定稿。
  - **验收 Demo：** 收到二十分钟报告邀约 → 生成目标及方案 → 用户要求“十五分钟，更偏实践” → 切换话题后恢复报告 → 重新进入继续修改 → 收到日程和受众调整邮件 → 生成修改目标及方案 → 继续与用户交互修改 → 定稿。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 邮件事实与助手建议区分清楚；修改后保留其他约束；恢复最新方案；同一邀约不重复建目标，支持报告邀约更新。

- [ ] **3. PPT 产物管理与查看｜3人日**
  - **开发内容：** 根据已确认方案生成的 PPT 在产物中心中支持按会话组织和展示，并支持下载、打开。
  - **验收 Demo：** 进入产物中心查看PPT → 选择某个会话 → 查看PPT保留历史版本 → 支持下载
  - **关键观察与结果：** 文件可打开；主题、结构及页数符合确认方案；产物会话归属和生成状态正确。

- [ ] **4. Bot体验改进：快速回答与持续插话追问｜8人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 先给出简短、有用的回答，再自动补充详细分析、方案和依据。
    - 回答过程中持续接收补充、修改条件和追问。
    - 识别输入属于当前任务、此前话题还是新话题，关联正确会话与上下文。
    - 将新增条件用于后续回答，保持回复与提问的绑定关系。
  - **工作量拆分：** 简答与详答衔接2；连续输入及会话归属3；上下文更新与回复一致性2；自测及性能核对1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 请求二十分钟报告大纲 → 收到简答后，在详答过程中连续输入“改成十五分钟”“听众都是研发” → 切换到周末出行清单 → 再要求“刚才报告的背景部分少一点”。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 首段包含实质性回答；无需等待即可继续输入；报告吸收新增条件，出行使用独立上下文；返回报告后要求仍被保留。记录首段可见时延。

#### 📅 第二周：11.16～11.22｜21人日

- [ ] **1. 报告生成、新信息与报告目标主动关联、报告修改调整全流程 Intelligent UI 效果调优｜5人日**    @庞俊飞@杜杰贵
  - **开发内容：**
    - 实现报告邀约简报、方向选择、要求补充等。
    - 实现内容修改简报卡、调整方向选择、要求补充等。
    - 选项卡包含标题、来源（上下文）、时间、关键内容和原文入口。
  - **验收 Demo：** 查看简报 → 通过对话继续修改 → 查看信息更新简报 → 通过对话继续修改，确保简报卡按钮可点按。

- [ ] **2. PPT 产物管理与查看｜3人日**   @李雯琳
  - **开发内容：** 根据已确认方案生成的 PPT 在产物中心中支持按会话组织和展示，并支持下载、打开。
  - **验收 Demo：** 进入产物中心查看PPT → 选择某个会话 → 查看PPT历史版本 → 选择一个支持下载
  - **关键观察与结果：** 文件可打开；主题、结构及页数符合确认方案；产物会话归属和生成状态正确。

- [ ] **3. 导航栏“计划”标签：报告后复盘｜6人日**  @姜成林
  - **开发内容：** 汇总已经推进完成的各项步骤、结果、交互强度，按照 UI 进行展示，用户确认报告结束后，依据实际反馈生成总结卡。
  - **验收 Demo：** 点击进入计划标签，目标选项卡可查看目标、产物、关键推进等信息；进入成就选项卡，可以看到热力图等信息；完成目标后出现成就分享页。

- [ ] **4. Intelligent UI （背面 UI）｜5人日**  @雷辉
  - **开发内容：** 点击卡片翻到背面，展示关键推理步骤及其关联材料。
  - **验收 Demo：** 打开调整卡并支持翻面翻回查看，按钮、列表支持点按、滑动、查看内容

- [ ] **5. 端到端性能优化｜5人日**  @李天舒
  - **开发内容：** 监控性能看板，针对慢请求定位性能问题并修复
---

## 📅 每周 Roadmap 与进度追踪

### 📅 10.19 ~ 10.25

- [x] **Bot 主对话与话题自动管理**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **自然语言发起任务：** 用户在 Bot 主对话中直接提出需求，无需手动创建会话、选择 Agent 或 Skill。
    - **话题切换与续接：** 根据输入自动创建或接续话题，支持在多个任务之间切换，并回到已有话题继续交流。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **跨话题连续对话：** 输入“帮我找找上海的篮球场” $\rightarrow$ 输入“帮我计划一个去南京的旅游” $\rightarrow$ 输入“浦东新区的球场呢” $\rightarrow$ 输入“南京有啥好吃的”。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 对话中出现新建或续接话题提示；最后一轮接续“南京三日游行程规划”，返回南京美食建议，内容不与篮球场任务混淆。

- [x] **主动澄清与需求收集**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **主动补全需求：** 面对范围、偏好等信息不完整的请求，Agent 通过交互卡片向用户提问。
    - **反馈驱动执行：** 用户选择并提交回答后，Agent 依据补充条件继续任务，回答记录保留在对话中。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **篮球场需求澄清：** 输入“帮我找找上海的篮球场” $\rightarrow$ 选择“徐汇/静安一带（推荐）”和“免费室外场” $\rightarrow$ 提交回答 $\rightarrow$ 获取场地推荐。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 卡片支持问题切换和发送回答，提交后显示“已回答”；结果体现所选区域和免费室外偏好，并说明未核实的开放、收费或预约信息。

- [x] **多任务后台执行与进展通知**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **后台持续执行：** 用户切换话题或离开聊天页面后，已发起的任务继续运行。
    - **多入口跟踪：** 通过聊天状态、实时活动面板、负一屏卡片和完成通知查看任务进展与结果。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **切换页面跟踪任务：** 发起上海篮球场和南京旅游任务 $\rightarrow$ 查看实时活动面板及负一屏卡片 $\rightarrow$ 返回聊天继续询问浦东球场 $\rightarrow$ 查看此前任务的完成通知。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 不同任务分别显示名称、进度和摘要；切换后仍能看到原任务状态更新，完成通知能够对应到具体任务。

- [x] **结构化结果呈现与异常降级**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **结构化交付：** 将复杂需求整理为文字结论、表格、清单和预算，方便用户阅读与继续追问。
    - **异常降级交付：** 当网页获取或交互式产物生成受阻时，说明限制，并提供可用的文字或表格结果。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **南京旅行规划：** 输入“帮我计划一个去南京的旅游” $\rightarrow$ 观察执行进度和结果逐步呈现 $\rightarrow$ 查看三日行程表、预约事项及预算。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 行程按天、时间和安排组织，包含一人三天两晚约 1300–1700 元预算；交互式行程板未生成时明确说明，并提供文字行程与清单。

- [x] **Cross-Session Long-Term Memory (跨会话记忆与动态更新)**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - 支持 Agent 在多个独立的日常短会话中，隐式提取用户的个人偏好、生活习惯与健康约束（如座位习惯、饮食偏好、过敏源及工作日程规则）。
    - 具备时效性更新与信息覆盖（Overwriting）能力，能够自动识别偏好或规则的变更（如从肉类偏好更新为素食，或日程规则调整）。
    - 在复杂的多约束综合任务中，实现跨领域记忆的精确检索与多源信息综合应用。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **场景搭建：** 模拟 3~4 次跨越不同时间的自然短对话（订机票、餐厅菜单咨询、日程调整）。
    - **大考验证：** 发起一次“下周五出差规划”的综合指令，展示 Agent 如何自动避开花生过敏原推荐纯素食餐厅、优先勾选过道座位，并自动适配周五特有的团队例会时间表。
---

### 📅 10.26 ~ 11.01

  - **关键观察与结果：** 读取和回答对应手机自带待办中的真实任务，变更及时反映；与日历信息的来源区分清楚；无数据与读取失败分别提示。

#### 随后开展｜暂估4.5人日

- [ ] **通讯录读取与对话接入｜1人日**
  - **开发内容：** 支持用户选择或查询联系人，读取姓名和联系方式，区分重名联系人；统一结果和来源，供对话或目标任务使用，处理空数据和访问状态变化。
  - **工作量依据：** 以系统接口可用于联系人选择或查询为前提，读取、格式适配、调用接入及自测合并计入本项。
  - **验收 Demo：** 添加测试联系人 → 授权或选择后查询 → 核对姓名和号码 → 验证重名联系人 → 修改信息后再次读取。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 联系人与号码正确，重名不混淆，修改可反映；未授权、无匹配和读取失败有明确提示，其他能力正常。

- [ ] **华为健康读取与对话接入｜暂估3人日**
  - **开发内容：** 验证手机本地健康数据读取通路，完成对应授权，首期读取睡眠记录；统一来源、时间和数据格式，供对话及目标任务使用，处理无记录、授权变化和读取失败。
  - **工作量依据：** 含约0.5人日真机通路验证，健康专项接入、授权、读取、结果适配、调用接入和自测均计入本项；通路确认后校准。
  - **验收 Demo：** 手机存在真实睡眠记录 → 完成授权 → 在DigitalMate读取近期记录并查询 → 与华为健康中的时间、时长核对 → 验证无记录或授权失效时的提示。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 回答依据手机真实记录，时间与来源可核对；无数据和失败不产生虚构记录。

- [ ] **照片读取与对话引用｜0.5人日**
  - **开发内容：** 复用已有本地照片选择能力，读取用户选定照片并接入对话或任务引用；处理取消选择、页面切换和读取失败。
  - **工作量依据：** 选择、引用衔接及回归合并在本项，复用现有照片选择和附件通道。
  - **验收 Demo：** 选择两张本地照片 → 在对话中查看并引用 → 核对内容与选择范围 → 取消选择或切换页面后返回。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 读取与引用对应用户选定照片，内容正确；取消不影响原对话，错误和状态变化可见。

---

### 📌 后续候选（可后置）


- [ ] **独立插件：Agent DM 加好友（撞上即可开聊）**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **独立插件边界：** 相对九问核心、Orbit 主线与名片/身份柜（#190）单独交付；装上即可用，不绑定 Orbit 宿主。
    - **DM 撞上加好友：** 用户在 DM 场景直接加对方 handle / agent，发出请求；对方同意后建立私聊，无需 invite link / grant 流程作为唯一入口。
    - **私聊开聊：** 加好友成功后可双向私信；默认不开放发现广场、不支持随便加陌生 agent 的公开社交图。
    - **与身份柜协作：** 发送时可选名片/身份（#190）；本项只管「跟谁建立 DM」，不管密钥保管。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **撞上加好友：** 在九问 DM 输入对方 handle → 发送好友请求 → 对方同意 → 进入私聊并发一条消息。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 好友关系可复用；拒绝/未同意时不能开聊；不出现公开广场或跨 harness 随意加好友；与 #190 选身份发送可同屏演示但不混为同一需求。


---

1. 每周任务或 Demo 完成后，将对应的 `- [ ]` 更新为 `- [x]`。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1416 将 `temp/hive-memory/src/dm_hive_memory` 加入 Bridge wheel 的 force-include。实际 main 的 Dockerfile bot-build 没有 COPY 这组源码，Dockerfile 专用 .dockerignore 排除了其中全部 14 个文件，HK 无 Git 快照的 fallback 也没有对应输入。完整 Git 源码构建正常，部署需要的源码投影不完整。

在原仓库目录运行下列只读检查，比较同一包路径在 wheel、构建复制清单和 fallback 输入的声明。

```sh
git ls-files temp/hive-memory/src/dm_hive_memory
rg -n 'dm_hive_memory|hive-memory|temp/\*\*' \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/pyproject.toml \
  harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile \
  harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore scripts/cloud-image-build.sh
```

实际 Moby patternmatcher v0.6.0 接收 0/14。固定 Hatchling 从完整 Git 源码生成 14/14 Hive Memory 成员，核对实际摘要通过。按同一 B 的 Docker COPY 复建输入时首先撞到既有 #1406；固定 B 源码并仅叠加已独审的 #1406 构建上下文控制后，再用同一 Hatchling 构建，退出 1。

```text
FileNotFoundError: Forced include not found: …/temp/hive-memory/src/dm_hive_memory
```

预期是 Docker 构建上下文及 HK 快照 fallback 都只携带这一包的登记文件，包括三份 TOML。构建和安装后的 wheel 文件和 RECORD 与同一 Git 来源对应。未登记 temp 目录和测试夹具继续排除。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS arm64，固定的 Moby patternmatcher v0.6.0 与 CPython 3.13.13，真实离线 Hatchling 源码构建。使用实际 Dockerfile 的 COPY 复建本地构建输入。未构建或发布共享镜像，未部署。

### Additional Information

关联 #1416、#1312、#1406、#1279。Hive Memory 入库和原 #1406 缺陷分别复现并保留。请 Bridge 构建与 Hive Memory owner 联合核对准确的 COPY、专用过滤和 HK fallback，再用原 A01 限定语义、wheel 及 RECORD 校验。

### Version Information

实际 main `2ae871a6987a236b84044887859de23d742b1bb3`，实际 tree 以该 Git 提交为准。截取终端记录仅对工作目录路径做了脱敏。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![实际构建隔离复现 Hive Memory 的源文件缺失](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27ca2e6c4f4c7adf919246857bded50fe7cd1c5/hive-memory-build-context.png?raw=true)


<!-- DM31:CURRENT-STATUS:1476 -->
#### 当前实施与验证

现行 #1476 安装源接收范围。[#1329 `1798c549`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1329) 已将 runner 本地 TAR 与 Kube 上传替换为 Pod 内从 GitHub 取精确 SHA 的 archive，实际源码 `629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 保留该路径。独立本地调用实际 `EXTRACT`/bsdtar，以受控 archive 验证 28 个唯一 COPY 源（History 两个重复源仅登记一次），257/257 文件字节相同。 archive 请求按 SHA 固定，顶层前缀和 archive 摘要尚无独立绑定证据。K8s、Docker/BuildKit、SWR、生产/设备以及 #1279 受保护全量均为 **NOT_RUN**。本地验证回执 SHA-256 `87077ea57aa50d2a3cbf9ca2aa41fffca0cddcac913372c6cdedaa143c654b94`。

已退 runner 上传路径的历史本机回执，继续按其固定源留证。

沿用现行 #1476 安装源范围，#1279 的本机后继 `63aad5e1237fc43920f381f8f02e45d0840b44c3` 以已独审 `e895d6da` 为前置，实际基线 `03e94a34`。原 `18ca` 的独审反例实证 glob、目录和符号链接可被旧 recorder 放行。修正后 shell 检查通过，10/10 含变异控制；同真实 Moby 匹配语义一致，默认 Bridge archive 216 个文件，诱饵均拒绝。 原 K8s/BuildKit/SWR 及受保护全量仍为 **NOT_RUN**。此后继仅本机，#1279 公开头未动，原关闭及部署历史按原回执。

另有 #1329 当时的真实原生运行。精确源码 `a61791d1939d5519c07ec02ab0e295a789be4345` 的 HK BuildKit 构建、推送与部署输入均为 `sha256:3dc091c6585f7d40b88177a45de1335e14a3bb1bc4fc4d988395e06d32b389d1`，该 job rollout **PASS**，归原 SHA 与镜像。 整体 Nightly **FAIL**，Windows 的三项 ST 与 Bench 失败，E2E 取消。此条只验收当时构建和 rollout，当前 `629ba37e` 的本地 EXTRACT、#1279 及 11/17 授权测试环境验收均另有证据。安全摘要 SHA-256 `1328f91173428d03501eb2e78e3c7f77a7908fd9f9fcb89982e53743da8acea2`。[原 HK job](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43878703846/job/133338503208)、[原整体运行](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43878703846)。

issue:1494.body:
Project Hive Phase 3 · G5/G6 enabler. Delivery lane (#1223). Progress [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316); design [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228).

## Problem

On `hive/hive2-integration` `5acf58f1c`, `configured_bridge` refuses to start Hive result delivery under gateway client authentication ([`engine_cli.py` L33–41](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/5acf58f1c/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_cli.py#L33-L41), introduced by `900bb9c09` "mount scoped result reads"):

```text
ValueError: Hive results require the configured direct access-token authorizer
```

`--hive-beebou-id` and `--hive-bees` both require `--hive-results`. Every ADX test environment and production runs `DIGITALMATE_CLIENT_AUTH=gateway` behind the business entry, and the HAP's credentials are gateway-issued. So Hive cannot be enabled on any deployment a real device reaches. That blocks:
- SC04-C1 (real HAP on the deployed server);
- the deployed G5 segments (SC04-A1 download, SC02-C2/C3 through the real Gateway);
- the H-R1 Home cutover (SC06-C1).

The refusal is a deliberate fail-closed. Scoped result reads are authorized by the direct access token's principal, and no gateway principal was designed for them.

Found by the Phase 3 deploy lane while preparing a behaviour-QA deployment (read-only inspection; nothing was deployed).

## Proposed design (Phase 2 coordinator)

The result-read authorizer accepts the gateway-authenticated principal through the same Host-authorized scope. Direct-token authorization is not weakened.

## Acceptance

- [ ] With `DIGITALMATE_CLIENT_AUTH=gateway`, `--hive-results` / `--hive-bees` start. Scoped result reads are authorized for the gateway-authenticated principal only within its Host-authorized scope.
- [ ] Counterexamples: cross-principal reads, an unauthenticated read, a gateway principal outside the scope, and a direct-token principal under gateway mode are each refused.
- [ ] The direct-token path behaves exactly as before.
- [ ] The Beebou ID comes from a TOML setting (product default), not a CLI literal. `--hive-beebou-id` remains only as a test override, if kept.
- [ ] Evidence on `hive/hive3-integration` from a deployed ADX env plus a device session (SC04-C1 segment).

Owner: the Phase 2 coordinator (lane E) on `hive/hive3-integration` after G4. **Not a G4 blocker**: G4 lands Phase 2 opt-in, and with no `--hive-*` flag the server behaves like main.

issue:1495.body:
Project Hive Phase 3 · G5/G6 enabler. Runtime/Host packaging ([#1309](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1309)). Progress [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316).

## Problem

There is no way to enable Hive on an ADX deployment:
- [`deploy/entrypoint.py`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/5acf58f1c/harness/personal-agent/deploy/entrypoint.py#L29-L33) only forwards container argv (`sys.argv[1:]`) to `engine_cli serve`.
- No environment variable maps to `--hive-turns`, `--hive-beebou-id`, `--hive-results`, `--hive-bees` or `--hive-bee-effects`.
- The ADX template schema has no args/command field. The keys seen are `env`, `image`, `init_timeout_seconds`, `isolation_runtime`, `lifecycle`, `mounts`, `name`, `readiness_probe`, `resources`, `service`, `volumes`. Whether the console accepts an `args` field is being probed on test-3 with a throwaway, never-aliased template version.

Evidence base: `hive/hive2-integration` `5acf58f1c`.

## Proposed change

- [ ] Map Hive enablement from environment or TOML in the entrypoint (or in `engine_cli` settings), for example `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_TURNS=1`. Flags stay as explicit overrides. Defaults stay off, so behaviour equals main.
- [ ] `--hive-bee-effects` cannot be enabled by template env alone without a separate, explicit allowlist setting (keep the current opt-in posture).
- [ ] Template example and the runbook (`docs/guides/operations/hive-test-env-deploy.md`, #1492) document the settings.
- [ ] A deployed test env shows the effective flags at startup, and the business entry stays healthy.

Depends on #1223's gateway-auth authorizer for `--hive-results` (separate issue). Owner: Phase 3 deploy lane. **Not a G4 blocker.**

issue:1496.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Follow-up to #1473's review finding F1 (#1309 Runtime/Host, #1311 Store). A Bee Session's runtime binding records the exact WorkSwarm Bee Harness implementation: the `core/workswarm/<version>` ref and an identity derived from the Harness code (`harness_implementation_identity`). When a release changes that code or version, the pre-claim check `BeeHostExecution.ready_for` refuses the Session, and #1472 releases any claim that slipped through.

Hive Phase 2 decided (option a) that such a Bee **fails closed**: its queued turns are not claimed, nothing is lost, the Host logs a warning once per incarnation, and the only documented recovery is operator rollback (register the original exact implementation again). The person who sent the message gets **no answer and no failure notice**. Today there is no product path to move an ACTIVE Bee to a new incarnation (`activate_bot` joins the active generation; idle eviction requires no queued turn; eviction retires the identity by default).

This issue adds a user-visible outcome: a per-turn **unavailable** terminal plus a notice.

### Design Ideas

Reuse #1481's stopped-terminal and notice path:

- **Store (#1311, E/C extension):** `commit_unavailable_result(scope, task_ref, ...)` for a queued (unclaimed) Bee task whose Session binding conflicts with the registered exact profile. In one commit it marks the task `cancelled` (or a new terminal state, if agreed), records the reason (`implementation_unavailable` plus the recorded and registered refs) in a terminal table like `dm_hive_stopped_results`, consumes or closes the queued input, and inserts the result notice. Replay by task returns the original notice.
- **Host (#1309):** when `ready_for` reports a binding `conflict`, the scheduler (or a periodic pass) commits the unavailable terminal for each queued task of that Session, at most once per task. An *unready* factory (transient) must NOT produce a terminal; only a binding conflict does.
- **Delivery (SC03-D2):** the existing `HiveResultPublisher` delivers it as `digitalmate.task.text` with `state: "unavailable"`, `final: true`, no result text, as #1481 does for `state: "stopped"`.
- **Beebou:** optionally reports the unavailable Bee in its roster so it stops dispatching to it.

**Out of scope:** (c) a binding migration that moves an existing Session to new Harness code. It needs a "same Harness" compatibility rule first, which is not defined.

### Involved Public APIs

- `HiveBusyControls` gains `commit_unavailable_result` and a read.
- The notice frame gains a `state: "unavailable"` value.
- The Store schema may change (a terminal table or columns); list the migration as #1481 does.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

#1309 (Bee Host execution, `ready_for`), #1311 (Store terminal and notice), #1223 (SC03-D2 delivery), #1310 (Beebou roster, dispatch), #1472 (release of unstarted claims), #1473 (code-derived identity, pre-claim check), #1481 (stopped terminal and notice path).

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **Real Store:** a Session bound to version 1, with version 2 registered, gets one unavailable terminal and one notice per queued task. A replay adds nothing. An unready factory with a matching binding gets no terminal.
- **Product entry on the pinned runtime:** deploy, run a Bee, restart with a changed `harness_version`, then send a dispatch to that Bee. The client receives `state: "unavailable"`, and Beebou keeps working.
- **Migration:** a test on an old-schema workspace, if the schema changes.

### Additional Information

Hive Phase 3 · G5. Decision record: #1473 review thread F1 (option a now; this issue is option b; option c is out of scope).

issue:1503.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version (`hive/hive2-integration` d14c7a3d).
- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproduction are below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Every Beebou normal turn that ends with a text reply fails to commit when the model's assistant message carries extra fields.** The deployed product model `deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017` carries them. The user gets no reply; `hive.message.send` returns:

```json
{"ok": false, "error": {"code": "BAD_PARAMS", "message": "invalid Beebou completed context"}}
```

**Cause** (installed wheel at the SHA below):

1. `server_engine/hive_beebou_model.py` `HiveBeebouModel.call` returns `choices[0].message` unchanged.
2. `dm_hive_beebou/harness/normal.py` `BeebouHarness.run` appends that `answer` dict as is (`messages.append(answer)`) and commits.
3. `session_proximity/hive_store.py` `commit_beebou_context` requires `messages[-1] == {"role": "assistant", "content": answer}` exactly, otherwise it raises `ValueError("invalid Beebou completed context")` (line 681).

Through the gateway, the product model's assistant message has the keys `content`, `provider_specific_fields`, `reasoning_content` and `role`. Only key names were checked, not values. So the equality never holds. Tool-call turns go through. The final text turn fails, so no Beebou turn ever completes.

**Why G3 did not catch it.** The G3 steps use the #1314 controlled model, whose `final(answer)` returns exactly `{role, content}`.

**Expected.** Beebou commits a normalized assistant message (at least `role` and `content`; the owner decides whether `reasoning_content` is kept, and where) and returns the reply.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- **Integration SHA.** `hive/hive2-integration` d14c7a3d4842fb7c7a5ab7890d8f401f0edb7cba, built and installed by `tests/eval/hive-live/build_server_env.py` (#1499). The checkout's own package proof passed: contracts wheel sha256 dbaae784…, bridge `digitalmate_server_engine-0.2.0`. Runtime: workswarm 0.2.5b1 and openjiuwen 0.1.19 via `install_runtime.py`.
- **Flags.** `--hive-results --hive-beebou-id beebou --hive-turns --hive-bees`. `--hive-bee-effects` is off. The entry is the product's own `engine_cli.serve()` through `tests/eval/hive-live/serve_hive.py` (free loopback ports, the documented `bee_adapter=` hook). Client auth is `instance`.
- **Model.** `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, the product template's `MODEL_NAME` (`digitalmate-template.prod.json` at #1490 8e33601a), through an OpenAI-compatible gateway (the csi relay). That gateway returns `reasoning_content` and `provider_specific_fields`. Whether the production gateway does is unverified, but any provider that adds a field to the assistant message triggers this.
- **Case.** Hive behaviour QA `HIVE-LIVE-DECIDE-04`, turn T1 「帮我弄一下那个东西。」. 3 model calls, 2,420 tokens, then the reply fails.
- **Trace.** `artifacts/hive-live/s1-product/HIVE-LIVE-DECIDE-04/r1/trace.json` and `server.log` on the QA Mac. The log line is `[hive.message.send] ValueError: invalid Beebou completed context`; no tool plan was recorded.

### Additional Information

**G4.** In my view this blocks G4: with the deployed model, Beebou cannot reply to any message. If the production gateway strips these fields, the impact is limited to other providers, but the commit check is still fragile. The Phase 2 coordinator decides.

**Owners.**
- Beebou harness: #1310 (`normal.py` / `hive_beebou_model.py`, normalize the assistant message before commit).
- Store: #1311 (`commit_beebou_context` validation and what it should accept).

**Suggested regression test.** Add a G3 or controlled-model variant whose assistant message includes `reasoning_content`.

### Version Information

`hive/hive2-integration` d14c7a3d4842fb7c7a5ab7890d8f401f0edb7cba

### Screenshots / Recordings

None. The server returns no UI; the trace and the Store are the evidence.

issue:1505.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version (`hive/hive2-integration` d14c7a3d; f0e7dda3 changes only the test runner).
- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproduction are below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Beebou calls the model with `max_tokens = 256`, a code default.** With the deployed reasoning model this produces two failures:

- **Empty reply.** The hidden reasoning uses the whole budget, `content` is empty, and `BeebouHarness.run` raises `ValueError("model returned an empty final reply")`. `hive.message.send` returns `BAD_PARAMS` and the user gets no answer.
- **Truncated reply.** When the reasoning is short, a direct answer is cut at 256 tokens and committed half-written.

**Where it comes from.**
- `server_engine/hive_turn_startup.py:122` builds `HiveBeebouModel(OpenAIConfig(endpoint, model_name, api_key, stream=False))`.
- `OpenAIConfig.max_tokens` defaults to 256 (`server/model_gateway/transport.py:37`).
- `HiveBeebouModel.call` sends `config.max_tokens`.

Nothing in TOML or the environment sets it for Beebou, so this tunable is hard-coded.

**Evidence: Hive behaviour QA S1.** Product model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, run `s1-product`, labelled substitute for #1503 (gateway-side stripping of `reasoning_content` / `provider_specific_fields`; it changes no token count):
- In 51 model calls, 9 ended at exactly 256 completion tokens. Reasoning used up to 256 of them.
- 4 of the 7 substitute cases failed on their first Beebou turn with `model returned an empty final reply`:
  - `HIVE-LIVE-MIX-02` T1
  - `HIVE-LIVE-SWITCH-01` T1
  - `HIVE-LIVE-FOLLOW-01` T1
  - `HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-03` F1
- Committed direct answers in `HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-01` and `HIVE-LIVE-AMBIG-01` end mid-sentence (for example 「……用举手之劳，换来小区的清洁美」).
- G3 did not catch it because its controlled model answers in a few tokens.

**Expected.**
- Beebou's model budget is a reviewed tunable in TOML, sized for the deployed model's reasoning plus a full reply.
- Whether reasoning tokens count against it is set per provider.
- An exhausted budget (`finish_reason: length`) is a visible, recoverable outcome, not an empty-reply crash.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- **Integration SHA.** `hive/hive2-integration` d14c7a3d4842fb7c7a5ab7890d8f401f0edb7cba, built by `tests/eval/hive-live/build_server_env.py` (#1499). Package proof PASS; workswarm 0.2.5b1, openjiuwen 0.1.19.
- **Flags.** `--hive-results --hive-beebou-id beebou --hive-turns --hive-bees`; `--hive-bee-effects` off. Entry: the product `engine_cli.serve()` through `tests/eval/hive-live/serve_hive.py`. Three servers in parallel, at most 4 concurrent model calls.
- **Model.** DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, the template `MODEL_NAME` at #1490 8e33601a, via the csi relay.
- **Traces.** `artifacts/hive-live/s1-product/<case>/r1/trace.json` on the QA Mac, each with the budget guard's per-call ledger and `substitutes`.

### Additional Information

**G4.** In my view this blocks G4. With the deployed model, most first Beebou turns fail or return a truncated answer. The Phase 2 coordinator decides.

**Owners.**
- #1310: Beebou harness and `hive_turn_startup` wiring.
- #1309: Host/model grant, if the budget belongs to the grant.

**Related.**

- A failed turn then wedges the session (filed separately).

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version (`hive/hive2-integration` d14c7a3d; f0e7dda3 changes only the test runner).
- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproduction are below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**One failed Beebou normal turn wedges the Beebou session.**

Once a turn's model call raises (for example #1503, or the empty reply from the 256-token budget), its context run stays `RUNNING` and its user input stays unconsumed. Every later `hive.message.send` on that session returns `{"status": "accepted"}` within milliseconds. No later message ever runs or gets a reply, and nothing tells the user.

**Evidence: Hive behaviour QA S1**, product model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, run `s1-product`.

`HIVE-LIVE-SWITCH-01`:

| Turn | `hive.message.send` | Latency | Store afterwards |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| T1 | `BAD_PARAMS "model returned an empty final reply"` | 7.2 s | `dm_hive_beebou_context_runs` for seq 1: `state=RUNNING`, `answer=NULL` |
| T2 | `accepted` | 5 ms | input seq 2 unconsumed, no context run |
| T3 | `accepted` | 7 ms | input seq 3 unconsumed, no context run |

At the end, `unconsumed` = 3 user inputs for `beebou`.

The same pattern appears in:
- `HIVE-LIVE-FOLLOW-01`: T2 accepted, no reply.
- `HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-03`: F2–F4 and P1 accepted in 4–12 ms, no reply.

**Not verified.** Whether the 1 s recovery loop (`HiveTurnStartup._recover` → `drain_inbox`) re-runs the failed turn and spends model calls while wedged. The server log at default level shows only the first `ValueError`. Per-server call attribution was added to the QA budget guard after this run, so the next run can tell.

**Expected.**
- A failed turn ends in a committed failure outcome for that message: the user sees an error reply, and the input is settled or retried under a bounded, recorded policy.
- Later messages are not blocked behind it.
- `hive.message.send` does not report `accepted` for a message that will never run.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- **Integration SHA.** `hive/hive2-integration` d14c7a3d4842fb7c7a5ab7890d8f401f0edb7cba (#1499 `build_server_env.py`, package proof PASS).
- **Flags.** `--hive-results --hive-beebou-id beebou --hive-turns --hive-bees`, effects off. Entry: the product `engine_cli.serve()` through `serve_hive.py`.
- **Model.** DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 via the csi relay, with the labelled #1503 substitute (gateway-side field stripping).
- **Traces.** `artifacts/hive-live/s1-product/HIVE-LIVE-SWITCH-01/r1/trace.json` (and FOLLOW-01, EVICT-03) on the QA Mac. They include each turn's response, the Store input rows, the context runs and the `unconsumed` counts.

### Additional Information

**G4.** In my view this blocks G4. Any transient model failure silently ends the conversation for that user. The Phase 2 coordinator decides.

**Owners.**
- #1311: Store context-run claim, input consumption and the failure outcome.
- #1310: Beebou turn loop, `send_message` / `drain_inbox`.

**Related.** #1503 and the 256-token budget (filed separately) are the triggers seen so far.

### Version Information

`hive/hive2-integration` d14c7a3d4842fb7c7a5ab7890d8f401f0edb7cba

### Screenshots / Recordings

None (server-side traces).

issue:1510.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version (`hive/hive2-integration` 53c4a868; the final G4 head 253420701 differs only in `tests/scenarios/hive/*` and the runner doc).
- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproduction are below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**With the deployed model, Beebou cannot create a Bee.** In the unmodified real-model rerun, 4 of 5 cases failed at the first `create_bee`. The fifth (FOLLOW-01) never tried: Beebou said it had no template information and wrote the 2000-word essay itself.

Three causes reinforce each other:

1. **`effective_info` has no schema.** `dm_hive_beebou/selection.py` `BEE_TOOLS` declares `"effective_info": {"type": "object"}`. It doesn't say that each entry must be `{"value": …, "source_ref": …}`. The model reasonably sends plain values. Example from `HIVE-LIVE-SWITCH-01` T1 (the user asked for a three-day Chengdu itinerary):

   ```json
   {"destination": "成都", "duration": "3天", "output_format": "每天上午/下午/晚上分时段景点+交通方式，…"}
   ```

2. **A bad argument aborts the whole turn.** `server_engine/hive_beebou_tools.py` `create_bee` raises `ValueError("effective_info fields require value and source_ref")`. That propagates out of `host.tools.call`, so `hive.message.send` returns:

   ```json
   {"ok": false, "error": {"code": "BAD_PARAMS", "message": "effective_info fields require value and source_ref"}}
   ```

   The model never sees a tool error it could correct, and the user gets no reply.

3. **The model is never shown the templates.** `create_bee` requires `template_id` and `template_version`, but `list_bees` returns only the roster and profile references, and nothing lists the templates. The model either guesses (EVICT-01/03/04, SWITCH-01) or gives up. In FOLLOW-01 T1 Beebou wrote, in effect, "creating a Bee needs a template_id and template_version, I have no template information and won't invent one, so I'll write it myself", then wrote the essay inline (cut at the 4096-token budget).

The G3 steps did not catch this because their controlled model sends hand-written, correctly shaped `create_bee` arguments (`template_id "worker"`, `effective_info {"focus": {"value": …, "source_ref": "user:1"}}`).

**Expected.**
- The tool schema describes the `effective_info` entry shape, with the allowed fields per template.
- The model is shown the available templates (in `list_bees`, or a template lookup tool).
- An invalid model argument comes back as a tool error result for the model to fix (counted against the model-call budget), instead of aborting the turn.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- **Integration SHA.** `hive/hive2-integration` 53c4a8689f6966d50a8ccf12a0e5f861e2ca5231. Built and installed by `tests/eval/hive-live/build_server_env.py` (#1499), package proof PASS; workswarm 0.2.5b1, openjiuwen 0.1.19. Also applies to 253420701c0b: diff limited to `tests/scenarios/hive/*` and `docs/scenarios/hive-scenario-runner.md`.
- **Flags.** `--hive-results --hive-beebou-id beebou --hive-turns --hive-bees`; `--hive-bee-effects` off. Entry: the product `engine_cli.serve()` through `serve_hive.py`. Three servers, at most 4 concurrent model calls.
- **Model.** Product model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, **no substitute**. Effective budget `quick_reply.toml` `max_tokens = 4096` (normal) and `quick_max_tokens = 1024`.
- **Run.** `rr1-product-53c4a868`. Cases `HIVE-LIVE-SWITCH-01`, `HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-01`, `HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-03`, `HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-04` (first `create_bee`) and `HIVE-LIVE-FOLLOW-01` (no attempt). 23 model calls, 27,352 tokens, 0 provider errors.
- **Traces.** `artifacts/hive-live/rr1-product-53c4a868/<case>/r1/trace.json` on the QA Mac (tool plans with the `create_bee` arguments, Store snapshots, and the budget guard's per-call ledger).

### Additional Information

**G4.** In my view this blocks G4: no Bee can be created with the deployed model, so no dispatch, reuse or eviction path is reachable from a real conversation. In each failing case the first failure also wedges the session; that is the #1506 tool-exception gap. The Phase 2 coordinator decides.

**Owners.**
- #1310: Beebou tools and prompt (`selection.py`, `hive_beebou_tools.py`).
- #1268: template catalogue and definition validation.

**Suggested regression test.** A G3 or controlled-model step whose `create_bee` arguments come from a recorded real-model turn.

### Version Information

`hive/hive2-integration` 53c4a8689f6966d50a8ccf12a0e5f861e2ca5231 (product code identical at 253420701c0b)

### Screenshots / Recordings

None (server-side traces).

issue:1511.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version (`hive/hive2-integration` 53c4a868 / acda9fae).
- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproduction are below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Low severity; not a G4 blocker in my view.**

Every DigitalMate WorkSwarm runtime (the Personal Agent runtime and the owned Bee runtime) sends a `max_tokens=64` image-modality probe to the deployed reasoning model at startup. The probe's budget and its verdict are not configurable from DigitalMate, and a reasoning model can leave the verdict undetermined.

**Where the 64 comes from.**
- `harness/agent-core/openjiuwen/harness/image_modality_probe.py:24` sets `_IMAGE_MODALITY_PROBE_MAX_TOKENS = 64`. It is a module constant (pinned agent-core, openjiuwen 0.1.19), not a TOML or config key.
- It is triggered by `harness/workswarm/jiuwenswarm/server/runtime/image_modality_warmup.py`, which probes once at server start, and by `deep_agent.py:1278`, which reschedules the probe for each agent or sub-agent while the cache is empty.
- The probe sends a 32×32 red PNG and asks for the color. Its 226-token prompt matches the traces.

**What happens on `finish_reason=length` (`_interpret_probe_response`).**
- If `red` appears in `content` or `reasoning_content`, the verdict is `True` and it is cached.
- If the reply is empty, or it was truncated before naming the color, the verdict is `None`: undetermined, not cached. Native image input then stays disabled for that runtime ("read_file stays in metadata-only mode"), and each new sub-agent, here each Bee's agent, reschedules another probe.
- The probe asks the gateway to turn reasoning off (`thinking: {type: disabled}`, `enable_thinking: false`, `reasoning: {enabled: false}`). The QA gateway ignored all three: 5 of 10 probes spent all 64 tokens on reasoning.

**Observed.** Hive behaviour QA run `rr1-product-53c4a868`, product model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, 5 servers × 2 runtimes:
- 10 probe calls, all `max_tokens=64`, 226 prompt tokens;
- 5 finished `stop` and 5 finished `length` with 64 reasoning tokens;
- all 10 runtimes still logged `image_input=True`, because the model named the color inside its first 64 reasoning tokens.

No wrong verdict was seen. The undetermined path depends only on how long the model reasons before saying the color, so a slower-thinking model, a different prompt language, or provider load can reach it. The result is a vision-capable product model treated as image-blind for that runtime, plus a repeated probe for each Bee agent.

**Expected.** DigitalMate declares image support for its deployed model instead of leaving it to auto-detection, using either:
- `supports_vision` in the WorkSwarm `model_client_config` (the warmup then skips the probe); or
- `react.enable_read_image_multimodal` in WorkSwarm `config.yaml`, read by `get_configured_read_image_multimodal`, `harness/workswarm/jiuwenswarm/common/config.py:247`.

Either should come from the deployment's TOML or template. Today neither is set anywhere under `harness/personal-agent` or `temp/`.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- **Integration SHA.** `hive/hive2-integration` 53c4a8689f6966d50a8ccf12a0e5f861e2ca5231. Product code is identical at the G4 head 253420701c0b.
- **Flags.** `--hive-results --hive-beebou-id beebou --hive-turns --hive-bees`, effects off.
- **Model.** DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 via the csi relay. The production template's no-thinking alias is not involved: the probe uses `MODEL_NAME`.
- **Evidence.**
  - The QA budget guard's per-call ledger (`artifacts/hive-live/rr1-product-53c4a868/<case>/r1/trace.json` → `model_calls.calls`, entries with `max_tokens: 64`).
  - The `[ImageModalityWarmup] … image_input=True` lines in each case's `workspace/workswarm/process.log` and `workspace/bee-workswarm/process.log` on the QA Mac.

### Additional Information

**Owners.**
- #1309: Bee runtime and owned WorkSwarm configuration.
- The Personal Agent runtime configuration owner.
- The agent-core budget constant is upstream; if it should become tunable, that goes upstream.

### Version Information

`hive/hive2-integration` 53c4a8689f6966d50a8ccf12a0e5f861e2ca5231

### Screenshots / Recordings

None.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

`harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_entry_point.py` fails 4 of 5 tests on main, on both macOS and Linux. CI does not catch it, because server-ut-st is paused on PRs (#1014). The failing tests are occupied port, SIGTERM with stdin open, stdin EOF, and the real scripted bridge.

The tests target an entry point that no longer exists. `server_engine.__main__` (since at least `684363ee9`, 2026-11-02) only prepends `serve` and delegates to `engine_cli.main()`. The tests still:

1. pass `--backend scripted`, which `engine_cli` rejects (`unrecognized arguments: --backend scripted`, exit 2);
2. stub `entry.Bridge`, `entry.Harness` and `entry.create_app` on `server_engine.__main__`, which no longer has them, so nothing is stubbed;
3. expect `serve` behaviour that `engine_cli.serve` doesn't have: shutdown on stdin EOF, and `port N is already in use` as the last stderr line with exit 1 (`socket.create_server` raises instead), plus a scripted backend for "starts and stops without a model".

Fixing this is a decision for the owner, not just a test edit: restore those `serve` behaviours (stdin-EOF shutdown, port-in-use message, a model-free start path), or retire or rewrite the tests against the current `engine_cli serve` contract.

Reproduce (repo root, main `c6ef5389`):

```sh
cd harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge
PYTHONPATH=src:../../../../temp/connection-foundation/src python -m unittest -v tests.test_entry_point
```

```
FAIL: test_an_occupied_port_names_the_port_and_exits ... AssertionError: 2 != 1 : usage: __main__.py ... error: unrecognized arguments: --backend scripted
FAIL: test_sigterm_ends_the_process_while_its_stdin_stays_open ... AssertionError: b'"listening"' not found in b''
FAIL: test_stdin_eof_ends_the_process ... AssertionError: b'"listening"' not found in b''
FAIL: test_the_real_scripted_bridge_starts_and_stops_without_a_model ... AssertionError: b'"listening"' not found in b''
Ran 5 tests ... FAILED (failures=4)
```

- Identical on `hive/hive2-integration` `fdf959b6c` and on PR #1498 `944ae172`, so this is a main baseline failure and not caused by those branches.

Found while verifying #1498 (#1495). The local server-ut-st sandbox's `bridge-context-configured-runtime` suite doesn't reach this file, because it stops earlier on a separate worker-path import error. Owner: Agent Bridge entry / Runtime owner.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

The enrolled server suite `bridge-context-configured-runtime` cannot run on main. The trusted configured-source worker `scripts/ci/server_context_source.py` loads the suite's Bridge test files with an import path that lacks `temp/connection-foundation/src`. The Bridge configuration module has needed that package since `2bf103344` (2026-11-13, `engine_config.py:33` imports `dm_connection_foundation.configuration.commit`), so the first configured test file fails to import and the suite is reported as "omitted or duplicated exact consumer identities".

This is a sibling of #1293, #1301 and #1304 (Connection Foundation import paths in isolated children after #1176). Those cover the connection-transition test child, the SessionProximity copied-source child and the Recall tokenizer child. This one is the trusted configured-source worker itself (`run_worker`, `sys.path[:0] = (candidate, bridge/src, bridge/tests, harness/workswarm, harness/agent-core, dependencies)` at line ~449), so it is gate plumbing for its owner, not a test fix.

Observed in the local server-ut-st sandbox (mirror of `.github/workflows/ci.yml` job `server-ut-st`), suite `bridge-context-configured-runtime`, base = head = main `c6ef53891715e24228b380a21ff34e735ef853ec`, `MERGE_CANDIDATE=false`, run `run-1794688082-1`. The installed-consumer and configured phases before it passed (294, 9, 24 and 43 tests OK). Then:

```

    execution = run_source_cohorts(candidate, trusted, dependencies, name)
  File "/runner/scripts/ci/server_context_source.py", line 398, in run_source_cohorts
    module = load_file(loaded_name, regular(candidate, BRIDGE + "/tests/" + filename))
  File "/candidate/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_configured_context_runtime.py", line 20, in <module>

    from dm_connection_foundation.configuration.commit import ConfigurationCommitPort
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'dm_connection_foundation'
required configured source worker failed:
server test gate: ordinary configured source suite omitted or duplicated exact consumer identities
```

The same failure happens at the same point with trusted base `hive/hive2-integration` `6a0c4a48` and head #1498 `944ae172` (run `run-1794689080-1`). It is not branch-specific.

issue:1516.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version (`hive/hive2-integration` 312bbf49).
- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproduction are below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**With the deployed model, Beebou's `dispatch` usually names the wrong `id`.** The model treats `id` as a request or task ID rather than the target Bee's `bee_id`. Every such call is refused with `{"code": "target_not_found", "status": "rejected"}`.

- In run `rr2-product-312bbf49`, 24 of 36 dispatches were rejected this way.
- The model sometimes recovers after one to four tries, by reusing the `bee_id` from the `create_bee` result.
- `HIVE-LIVE-SWITCH-01` never recovered: 9 of 9 dispatches were rejected over 3 turns, so no Bee received work. Beebou told the user the Bee "didn't run".

**Cause.**
- `dm_beebou/tools/providers.py` `dispatch_schema()` declares `"id": _text_schema()`, with no description. The tool description in `dm_hive_beebou/selection.py` is "Deliver a new request or a supplement to an authorized Bee." Nothing says that `id` is the Bee's `bee_id`.
- The rejection carries no hint. The model sees only `target_not_found`, not which IDs exist or that a `bee_id` from `create_bee` / `list_bees` is expected.
- The G3 controlled model writes `{"id": created["bee_id"], …}` by hand, so it never hit this.

**Observed IDs** (`dispatch` argument `id`): `task-1` (most often), `task-0001`, `task-guitar-0001`, `chengdu-3day-0001`, `resume-template-0001`, `chengdu-panda-0001`, `task-remote-work-001`.

Per case, accepted / `target_not_found`:

| Case | Accepted | `target_not_found` |
| --- | --- | --- |
| EVICT-01 | 5 | 7 |
| EVICT-03 | 2 | 3 |
| EVICT-04 | 3 | 4 |
| FOLLOW-01 | 2 | 1 |
| SWITCH-01 | 0 | 9 |

**Expected.**
- The `dispatch` schema names the field for what it is (e.g. `bee_id`), or at least describes `id` as the target Bee's `bee_id` from `create_bee` / `activate_bee` / `list_bees`. The `create_bee` description from #1514 can serve as the model.
- A `target_not_found` refusal tells the model which Bee IDs it may dispatch to.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- **Integration SHA.** `hive/hive2-integration` 312bbf49a3877c498e0c217938daea9a2d420513 (#1514 and #1515 included). Built and installed by `tests/eval/hive-live/build_server_env.py` (#1499), package proof PASS.
- **Flags.** `--hive-results --hive-beebou-id beebou --hive-turns --hive-bees`; `--hive-bee-effects` off. Entry: the product `engine_cli.serve()` through `serve_hive.py`, three servers.
- **Model.** Product model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, no substitute.
- **Traces.** `artifacts/hive-live/rr2-product-312bbf49/<case>/r1/trace.json` on the QA Mac. The tool plans show each `dispatch` argument and its Host result.

### Additional Information

**G4.** In my view this blocks G4. In one of five cases no work ever reached a Bee. In the others, Beebou burned up to 11 tool steps of its 12-call budget retrying. The Phase 2 coordinator decides.

**Owners.**
- #1223 / #1226: the Delivery `dispatch` tool schema in `dm_beebou`.
- #1310: the Beebou tool descriptions.

**Suggested regression test.** A controlled-model step that replays a recorded real-model `dispatch` with a non-Bee `id`. The test should check that the refusal names the valid targets and that a corrected retry is accepted.

### Version Information

`hive/hive2-integration` 312bbf49a3877c498e0c217938daea9a2d420513

### Screenshots / Recordings

None.

issue:1517.body:
### Checklist

- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproduction are below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**`dm_hive_tasks.state` never shows `running`.** A Bee task stays `queued` while its Run is `RUNNING` in `dm_hive_runs`, then jumps straight to `completed`. Two things read the queued state:

- **The dispatch receipt.** It reports `"task_state": "queued"`.
- **Beebou's task view.** It tells the user the work has not started when it has.

In `HIVE-LIVE-FOLLOW-01` T1, Beebou replied 「任务…状态为 queued（已受理，尚未开始运行）」. The Bee's Run had started 0.1 s after the dispatch and was still `RUNNING` 3.5 minutes later.

**Evidence.** Each case's Store after run `rr2-product-312bbf49`, opened read-only (`immutable=1`); each task's state against its Session's Runs:

| Case | Task | Task state | Runs on its Session |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| FOLLOW-01 | `task_e2fab29…` | `queued` | `RUNNING` |
| EVICT-01 | `task_bce9ba7…` | `queued` | `RUNNING` |
| EVICT-03 | `task_9f37ee0…` | `queued` | `ENDED, ENDED, ENDED, RUNNING` |

Across the 16 tasks of the 5 cases, the only states ever seen are `queued` and `completed`.

**Expected.** When the Run that executes a task starts, the task view reports `running`, and so do `task_get` / `task_list` and the dispatch / steer receipt. Beebou can then say truthfully that the Bee is working on it. Steer gating (`OPEN_TASK_STATES = {queued, running}`) is unaffected either way.

### Checklist

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**Medium severity; not a G4 blocker in my view.**

Beebou's normal-turn model call times out at a hard-coded 30 s, while its token budget is 4096. A full-budget reply alone takes about 25 s with the deployed model, so a slightly slower gateway, or any queueing in front of it, pushes the call past the limit.

**Where it comes from.**
- `server_engine/hive_turn_startup.py:127` builds `OpenAIConfig(endpoint, model_name, api_key, stream=False, max_tokens=quick_settings.model.max_tokens)`.
- `timeout` falls back to the transport default `30.0` (`server/model_gateway/transport.py:36`).
- `dm_hive_beebou/config/quick_reply.toml` `[model]` sets only `max_tokens = 4096` and `quick_max_tokens = 1024`. It has no normal-turn timeout. `[quick].timeout_seconds = 8` and `[second_quick].timeout_seconds = 15` cover only the quick paths.

**Observed.** Run `rr3-product-64df4c8b`, case `HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-03` turn P1, product model DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017:
- One Beebou call waited 4.7 s in the QA budget guard, which caps concurrent calls at 4 across three servers. It then generated 4096 completion tokens in 25.4 s (`finish_reason=length`): 30.06 s in total.
- The Host recorded `dm_hive_beebou_turn_failures`: `kind=model`, `outcome=retry`, `reason=ModelGatewayError: Model gateway timeout`. The retry then committed, so the #1509 retry path works. The user still waited for a discarded 25 s generation and a second one.
- The QA guard's queueing contributed here, but without it the margin is only about 5 s. Under production load the same thing happens whenever the gateway is slower than ~160 tokens/s for a full-length reply.

**Expected.**
- The normal-turn model timeout is a TOML tunable next to `max_tokens` (for example `[model].timeout_seconds`), sized so the full budget fits at the deployed model's throughput.
- Optionally, a startup check that the timeout covers `max_tokens` at a declared minimum tokens/s.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- **Integration SHA.** `hive/hive2-integration` 64df4c8b5cb9c6efdfd1f76de48b58827364d138, built by `tests/eval/hive-live/build_server_env.py` (#1499), package proof PASS.
- **Flags.** `--hive-results --hive-beebou-id beebou --hive-turns --hive-bees`; effects off. Three servers, at most 4 concurrent model calls through the QA budget guard.
- **Model.** DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 via the csi relay; no substitute.
- **Evidence.** `artifacts/hive-live/rr3-product-64df4c8b/HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-03/r1/trace.json` on the QA Mac. It holds the per-call ledger (queue wait, latency, finish reason, `max_tokens`) and the Store's `turn_failures` row.

### Additional Information

**Owners.**
- #1310: Beebou model settings (#1505 / #1507 made the budget tunable).
- #1309: Host model grant.

### Version Information

`hive/hive2-integration` 64df4c8b5cb9c6efdfd1f76de48b58827364d138
