issue:1806.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

先把 DigitalMate / Beebou 的**新用户 vs 老用户意图识别离线回归**接进 CI。用同一批输入验证：相关历史让用户少重讲、少被追问；无关历史不应引入串话；旧授权不能随历史恢复。首版不等待线上招募、真机、模型供应商或真实第三方账号。

核对主线 `e8073b35311b08662b72630547d76adf44c9e89c`：[Eval workflow](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e8073b35311b08662b72630547d76adf44c9e89c/.github/workflows/eval.yml#L19-L91) 的 PR 渠道执行 `--suite contract`；仓库另有 [Hive 离线回放 / grader gate](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/e8073b35311b08662b72630547d76adf44c9e89c/tests/eval/run-evals.mjs#L7-L11)，但没接上这组用户历史对照。现有 50 个 Hive Live 场景的默认 local_cli 是每例、每次重复独立建 workspace、在例内跑短期 setup，不是带数周历史的常规离线门禁。单独的模拟器 Eval live 需开关，不是合 PR 前的这项验收。

用例来源：[#1644 短消息与换题](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1644#issuecomment-6937631602)、[#1197 长期 SOP 与失效权限](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1197#issuecomment-6937631608)、历史复现 #216、#971。本 issue 负责 fixture、断言和 CI 接线，不重复实现产品能力。

### Design Ideas

- 复用现有 Eval workflow / Hive replay grader；把独立、可重复的少量关键对照接成**明确的一项 CI 检查**。变更 Beebou 路由、Home、相关记忆/权限或测试文件时执行，不只在改 eval 文件时跑。复用受控时钟、已录制响应和无网络替身，不使用真实用户材料。
- 同一个输入分别跑：新用户空状态、老用户只有无关历史、老用户有相关历史（含相似任务、旧偏好、后台通知）。固定同一测试条件，并验证通过真实 Store/Host 边界读到预期上下文，再检查首条可见回复、实际任务/工具回执与副作用；不只把预先写好的正确最终答案交给评分器。
- CI 报告标明 commit、fixture 版本、场景、分组、实际运行数及 FAIL / NOT_RUN。契约回放只证明时序、上下文接入和安全断言没有回退，**不把录制回放分数称为真实模型的意图识别准确率**。有预算后可把固定模型的批量评测独立接入 Nightly；线上老用户实验另跟踪。

### Involved Public APIs

首版无需新增公开 API；通过现有 Home、Store 和可审计工具边界验证。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

涉及 Hive / Beebou QA、Home、Memory/Store、Host 权限与 CI。#1644、#1197 保留功能与验收责任。

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. 固定首条酒店请求尚未派单，比较连发「两个人」「800 以内」跟同间隔换到 PR。前者只更新一个任务并保留原条件；后者另开，不串任务；快回不能声称已更新。
2. 「照之前查一下」：新用户只问必要问题；有相关历史且授权有效的老用户恢复 SOP，不重复问；同样历史但已撤权/确认过期时，不执行外部动作。加隔天无引用「可以」不得触发旧动作的负例。SOP 尚未实现的正例明确标记 NOT_RUN 或预期失败，不计通过，也不因依赖未就绪挡住其他回归。
3. 分组输出首答意图正确数、串话、无谓追问、重复派发、误执行；确定性回归对误执行零容忍。给一条正常通过的 CI 运行链接，再用故意错路由或强行消费旧确认的负控证明检查会红；缺 fixture 或未执行不能显示通过。

### Additional Information

阶段顺序：先让离线关键回归稳定入 CI，再扩到完整模型评测和真实用户环境。

issue:223.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**

正常对话的首 token 时延（从点击发送到界面出现第一个可见字符）约 **5s**；一旦涉及联网搜索或工具调用，首次可见反馈常常超过 **20s**，期间界面基本空白，用户容易误以为卡住或失败。

**复现步骤**

1. 手机端 Digital Mate 打开与 Beebou 的对话。
2. 发送一个普通问题，例如「现在从公司回小区，地铁和打车哪个快」。
3. 从点击发送开始计时，到出现第一个可见文本 / 流式片段：约 5s。
4. 再发送一个需要联网搜索或工具调用的问题。
5. 首次可见反馈：>20s，等待期间没有进度或状态提示。

**预期行为**

- 首 token 目标：<1s；业界主流 agent 约 **500ms** 量级。
- 如果必须先做路由 / 分类 / 搜索 / 工具调用，应立即输出可见状态（如「正在检索…」），不要整段空白。
- 最终答案应流式增量输出，而不是全部生成完再一次性显示。

**实际行为**

- 普通对话 TTFT ≈ 5s；
- 含搜索 / 工具调用 ≈ 20s+；
- 等待期间缺少即时反馈，容易被误判为失败。

**可能原因（供参考）**

- 首 token 之前的串行链路过长：route → classify → brief → 工具调用 → 联网搜索，全部完成才开始输出；
- 响应不是增量流式，或流式片段被缓冲到完成后才渲染；
- 云端执行服务（Orbit Cloud）与客户端之间存在额外重连 / 轮询等待；
- 客户端与云端之间的状态同步延迟。

**建议**

- 设定 TTFT 预算：普通对话 p50 < 1s、p90 < 2s；工具类任务先出状态、再出结果。
- 在首 token 之前先发一条轻量状态消息（流式占位），不要空白等待。
- 搜索 / 工具调用尽量并行化，或先把「正在检索」回传给客户端。
- Orbit 已记录每轮 `Run.first_text_ms` 和 step 耗时瀑布，可直接用来量化 route / brief / execute 各阶段并作为回归指标。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 设备：手机（型号未记录）
- 系统：HarmonyOS / Android（具体版本待补充）
- 客户端：Digital Mate 测试包（版本号未记录）
- 服务端：Orbit Cloud
- 网络：正常 Wi-Fi / 运营商网络
- 复现时间：约 03:48（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 同类问题参考：业界主流 agent 在同类问答中约 500ms 量级开始输出，并会先给出「搜索 3 个关键词，参考 14 篇资料」这类过程反馈。
- 度量说明：当前 TTFT 为人工目测估计，建议后续用客户端埋点或 Orbit 的 `first_text_ms` 量化。
- 影响：等待感强，用户容易重复发送或退出；含工具调用时体验接近「卡死」。

### Version Information

- 仓库：openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate
- 分支：fix/foreground-reconnect-recovery
- commit：68a25a3f
- 上游基线：main

issue:377.body:
### Checklist

- [x] 已搜索仓库内相关 issue，未找到同一问题（相近 issue 已在正文中注明区别）。
- [x] 已在 2026-10-30 内测群反馈中复现/收集到现场证据。
- [x] 已提供截图与可复现步骤。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象**：让助手设闹钟，回复「闹钟已经设置成功」，但手机系统闹钟 App 里看不到这条闹钟；同时助手给出的提醒卡片写着 `Zone: UTC（你的本地时间）`，时区标注自相矛盾。

群内原始反馈（2026-10-30 20:19，木稀）：「闹钟里圈看不到」。同学追问时，胡犇回复「目前还不具备操作手机 app 能力」。同一时段另一张截图里，助手明确说明：

> 闹钟已经设置成功。
> 目前系统允许创建闹钟提醒，但不会把这些闹钟展示到闹钟 App 的列表中。你可以在 WorkBuddy 内向我询问、取消或重新设置这个闹钟。

复现步骤：
1. 对话输入「帮我定一个明天早上 7:03 的闹钟。」
2. 在底部弹窗点「确认」。
3. 打开系统闹钟 App 查看；并查看助手返回的提醒卡片。

实际结果：
- 助手提示设置成功，但系统闹钟列表中没有该闹钟。
- 提醒卡片显示 `Zone: UTC（你的本地时间）`、`Host: 需在该时间设备保持在线`。
- 用户无法区分「应用内提醒」和「系统闹钟」，只能去系统闹钟里核对然后发现没有。

预期结果：
- 要么真正创建系统闹钟（或系统级定时通知），要么在确认前就把「仅应用内提醒、不进系统闹钟」讲清楚。
- 时区只显示一种且为用户本地时区（如 `Asia/Shanghai`），不要 `UTC` 与「你的本地时间」并列。
- 「设备需保持在线才触发」属于关键限制，应在设置前确认，而不是设置成功后再说。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

- 应用：DigitalMate（Beebou）手机端 / WorkBuddy 客户端
- 系统：HarmonyOS，截图为 4G/5G 移动网络
- 云端：ADX 测试云 `wss://1.94.211.46/orbit/ws`，Orbit 模板 `v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- 设备型号与 App 版本：截图未显示，待报告人补充
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群（29 人），2026-10-30（Asia/Shanghai）

### Additional Information

- 即使最终确认「不写入系统闹钟」是产品取舍，也建议在确认弹窗上直接标注「仅在应用内提醒」，避免用户去系统闹钟 App 核对后认为功能失效。
- 关联讨论：胡犇「目前还不具备操作手机 app 能力😅」；Leo「只支持系统功能，比如定闹钟这些?」；hsliu「现在一个不支持」。

- 云端：ADX 测试云 Orbit 模板 `v15-workspace-20261028-a974262d1-8ed6d181-no-split`
- 反馈时间：2026-10-30 20:19（Asia/Shanghai）

issue:464.body:
## 现象
刚列出若干 PR，并说明 #9713 未加 `frontend`、问要不要加；用户回「加上」后，助手追问是购物清单/待办/提醒还是给 GitHub 加 label，选定「加 label」后又弹出「要给哪个 PR」选择卡（含刚列过的 #9715–#9712）。

## 预期
短指令应绑定上一轮明确对象：默认给刚提到的 #9713 加 `frontend`，最多一次确认，勿清空近上下文重问。

## 实际
「加上」近指丢失；领域歧义 + 目标 PR 均需用户重选。

## 决策门禁
- **Where:** 云端回合对上一助手气泡中「提议动作 + 具体 PR/label」的指代解析；客户端选择卡是否应在已有唯一候选时跳过。
- **Problem:** ① 短确认词（加上/好/发吧）默认绑定最近提议；② 多 PR 列表时唯一「未完成建议」是否优先。
- **Conditions:** 未定则工作流反复澄清，像「没记忆」。
- **Impact:** GitHub 操作链路体验差。相关：#457（选择卡脱节）、#339（连发绑定）。
- **Fix:** 建议「加上」优先落在上一轮明确的 #PR+label 提议；仅在多候选冲突时再出选择卡。

## 备注
版本：Beebou/DigitalMate；场景：vllm-omni PR 列表后短回复「加上」。证据截图见评论。

### Current disposition — superseded planning RFC (2026-11-16)

The current v3.1 refactoring authority is #737, with milestones and forecast in #963, based on Hive main `498bc351` (#1605). This older parallel master RFC is closed as **not_planned / superseded**, not delivered. PR #509 is closed and unmerged, so its proposed tree and branch-specific tests are not the current-main baseline.

The continuing modularization obligations are explicitly retained: source/class/state/lock mapping and directory convergence → #845; Runtime/ingress/lifecycle → #759/#763/#769; Host/model/tool boundaries → #754/#758/#799; source/artifact/connector ownership → #777/#781/#784/#833/#834; memory transactions and provenance → #791/#810; sole scheduler → #795/#836/#837; unchanged-client, production and independent QA → #827/#828. Documentation authority and historical dispositions → #848. Existing product Team removals are not reversed by this closure; any opt-in Harness proposal in #737 remains explicitly separate and must be reconciled against supported behavior before implementation.

No whole-branch merge, fixed old directory layout, blanket no-schema-change restriction or obsolete execution architecture from this RFC governs new v3.1 work. Supported behavior, data, privacy, compatibility and useful old evidence retain their original scope and must be accounted for by the receiving owners. #1665 product follow-ups remain a separate delivery line.


<details>
<summary>Original RFC and branch-specific plan — retained historical record</summary>

### Background and Goal Description

DigitalMate 后端模块化重构的最新范围是：每个业务任务选择一个主 Agent，保留执行器内部子 Agent；删除产品 Team、独立 Agent 委托、跨 Agent 评审和自动交接。App 连接、普通房间、人工 Pair、用户问答、工具审批、记忆与来源治理继续保留。

本 RFC 继续作为重构总跟踪项。首阶段代码已在 PR #509 提交，尚未合并；后续工作是类、方法、状态和依赖的拆分。先完成模块化，再单独讨论 DigitalMate 插件化；本轮不接入 JiuwenSwarm 插件机制、不改前端为插件、不新增进程、不改数据库 schema，也不恢复已退出的进程内 TeamBackend/DeepAgentBackend。

**基线：** 原 RFC 的分析基线为 `2336d5b2`。首阶段 PR 从 `8cc7213926f0553577476a5fe64c1061f3e944b6` 开发，当前 head 为 `f9b04e4783df277e1dc5d4ec02c355ebff41f693`。2026-11-04 核对到上游 main 为 `1432414e63f97f6510a34b096722a05de286c1b7`；该提交不是当前重构代码基线。后续开始拆分前先审查两者差异、确定需要纳入的改动，并更新映射所用 SHA，不将“最新 main”与已测试的 PR head 混用。

### Proposed Solution

#### 1. 范围与工程布局

当前生产执行经 WorkSwarm WebSocket 接入，`ScriptedBackend` 作为测试替身保留。vendor 内的 WorkSwarm、agent-core 固定源码保持完整，不因为删除 DigitalMate 产品 Team 而裁剪平台内部 Team/子 Agent 实现。

下列列出收敛后的模块、必要子目录及本次拆分涉及的职责文件，每个文件均注明用途，不使用通配符占位。现有代码已迁移到主干目录；“拟新增”表示待提取的文件，“过渡”表示仍需拆分或调整归属的现有文件，其余文件继续承担所注明的职责。包初始化文件和未展开子目录中的完整文件清单见后文索引，不因未展开而删除。

减少只有一个职责文件的子目录；memory/source 不机械复制 application/domain/ports 多层结构。harness 不再单列 routing、turns、conversations、policies、delivery、skills、artifacts 等重复层级。仍存在的 `harness/native/context_budget.py` 在后续依据调用关系迁入 context 或作为无调用遗留删除，不保留一个原生执行器子系统。

#### 2. 模块和依赖边界

| 模块 | 职责与对外能力 | 边界理由 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| server | 外部协议、可信身份上下文、连接/推送、依赖装配和关闭 | 统一 Gateway 后仍需要协议和生命周期处理；业务授权由对应业务模块执行 |
| application | 请求受理、幂等、跨域查询、任务用例、结果提交、恢复和失效协调 | 跨模块操作有统一入口；避免继续把所有业务堆入 Bridge/EngineService |
| harness | 意图到任务完成的业务执行策略 | 使用平台执行能力；不复制 agent-core loop，不把子 Agent 变成独立业务委托 |
| workspace | 房间、消息、待办、人工协作和结果资产 | 长期产品状态不随一次 Agent 执行结束 |
| memory | 新业务记忆的统一治理入口和访问规则 | SQL/Mem2 更换不改变授权、纠错、遗忘和 Undo 语义；历史手机记忆保留，导入规则另定 |
| source | 来源权威记录、连接授权、修订、附件与入站治理 | 收到外部事件与允许启动任务分开；供应商 API 实现不决定业务准入 |
| contracts/shared | 跨域稳定契约 / 领域无关基础 | 外部 Request、领域实体、SQL 实现不全部堆入 general；不允许反向依赖 server/具体服务/adapter |
| adapters | 平台、数据库、供应商和 OS 具体实现 | 通过消费方需要的小接口注入，防止业务层直接持有全部基础设施 |

目标调用关系：server 将外部请求转换为用例输入 → application 协调 harness/workspace/memory/source → 业务模块使用窄接口 → server 装配并注入 adapters。跨模块协作优先由 application 编排；必要直接调用使用已声明接口，不传入整个 EngineService。

外部 `EngineRequest`/`ClientContext` 保留协议入口归属和兼容解析。内部执行结果、事件和异常从 server 类型中抽出；内部命令按动作组逐步收窄。compat re-export 只用于过渡，记录调用方、删除条件和唯一实现，不能靠把所有类搬进 contracts 规避依赖问题。领域 Binding 与跨平台 DTO 的所有权须明确，消除当前 `contracts/execution.py → adapters/storage/workspace.py` 的反向依赖，不引入两份可写会话状态。

产品 Gate 与 WorkSwarm 工具权限分别说明执行点、状态所有者和手机端交互。保持既有默认策略，分别验证受管运行时权限开/关以及外部运行时；不把产品审批通过视作平台所有工具已经受控。

#### 3. 核心拆分清单（当前路径 → 目标职责）

所有 Python 路径相对 `backend/src/digitalmate_backend/`；目标文件名为本轮建议，允许在保持所有权清晰的前提下微调。

| 当前类/方法 | 拆分方向 | 理由与需要一起迁移的状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `server/api/bridge.py::Bridge.__init__/start/stop` | server/bootstrap.py、lifecycle.py；Bridge 保留协议入口 | 创建、注册、关闭归同一装配边界；连接、后台任务和关闭顺序一并记录 |
| `Bridge._digitalmate_execute/_execute_jiuwen/_attach/_backend_for` | harness/execution 的协调器、会话与事件组件 | 去掉 application 回调 WS Bridge 的执行链；平台 RPC 仍归 jiuwenswarm adapter；映射、等待和取消状态唯一 |
| `Bridge._execute_jiuwen` 内 prompt 和回复处理 | harness/context、harness/replies | 先提取不持有会话/事务的规则，再迁移有状态执行；子 Agent final 不作为主答完成 |
| `application/service.py::EngineService.snapshot/_message_window/_earlier_messages` | application/queries.py 调用 workspace/memory 查询接口 | 跨域快照属于用例查询；避免引入第二份缓存或权限判断 |
| `EngineService._handle_request/_turn` | 按动作组的应用用例；任务、记忆、来源逻辑回所属模块 | request/apply 的幂等受理保留统一包装，不能每个 handler 再做一遍 |
| `EngineService._turn` 的 publish、错误与超时提交 | application/task_results.py 协调 harness/workspace/memory | 结果生成与业务提交分离；有效性检查、锁、事务、最终事件顺序作为一组迁移 |
| `harness/tasks/router.py::EngineRouter/JevClient` | 业务路由留 tasks；模型 HTTP/重试/解析归 adapters/models | 不把业务 thread 选择与供应商协议绑在同一个对象中 |
| `adapters/storage/workspace.py` 内 Task/Question/Signal、Room/Message、Source/Connection 等 | 记录模型回 harness/workspace/source 等所属模块；SQLite 实现留 adapter | 模型不能为了通用而放入 shared；持久化字段和旧记录读取格式保持兼容 |
| `EngineStore.recover_submissions/recover_submission` 及构造期业务恢复 | application/recovery.py | 打开数据库和决定业务如何恢复分开；原连接、事务、after_commit 和写锁保留统一核心 |
| `adapters/storage/memory_catalog.py::EngineMemory` 及记忆模型 | 模型、访问和治理回 memory；SQL 留 storage；内容库接口由 memory 定义 | 按方法内业务判断和 SQL 分块，避免把混合类整搬到另一个目录 |
| `memory/step.py::MemoryStep`、`_LOCKS/_HELD` | memory 内轮次/变更/撤销组件和显式注入的共享协调对象 | 学习、更正、遗忘、Undo、恢复共用同一 workspace 的锁和 pending 状态 |
| `source/connections/registry.py::ConnectionRegistry.build/build_items` | 连接业务留 source；客户端构造与缓存进入 adapters/connectors/factory.py | 保留全部 App；将业务授权与供应商实例生命周期分开 |
| `source/inbound/events.py::EventLoopManager` | source 入站/历史同步；供应商监听归 adapter；任务准入经 application/harness | 历史补拉不应意外启动新任务；关闭、重启和去重责任明确 |
| `source/attachments.py::Attachments` | source 用户附件治理、filesystem 字节存储、harness 执行产物和平台产物适配 | 用户文件与运行产物的授权及生命周期不同 |
| `contracts/records.py` 中 Todo/Screen/View/Pair/Trigger/Grant 等 | 按实际拥有者回 workspace/harness | contracts 保留稳定跨域协作类型；旧 Team 记录只支持读取和清理，不能重新获得执行入口 |

每一项同时维护正向与反向映射，至少包含：源 SHA/文件/类/方法、目标模块/接口、拆分理由、字段/锁/缓存/任务/关闭所有者、调用方、兼容入口及移除条件、实施批次和验收项。现有文件级 CSV 是起点，不代表方法级映射已完成。

**文件索引维护方式：**

- 索引与代码一起进入仓库，作为重构映射台账；本 issue 维护入口链接及阶段进度，不再复制另一份逐文件清单。
- 当前已提交的文件级索引是 `docs/developer_guide/backend-module-map.csv`。后续每个重构 PR 同步更新；P1 补充类/方法双向映射与状态所有权，不能把文件搬迁完成等同于类拆分完成。
- 审视基线使用固定 commit 链接。首阶段 PR 合入 `refactor/backend` 后，补充该分支的“最新进度索引”入口，同时保留基线链接；合入前使用下文当前 PR head 的可访问链接。
- GitHub 不会自动同步源码与索引。每个 PR 检查新增、拆分、合并、删除和兼容项的映射；目标文件存在性等可做轻量自动检查，职责和状态归属仍需评审。
- 重构完成后索引归档保留，用于定位旧代码和追溯迁移；长期架构文档描述最终目录及职责，不要求历史映射追踪以后所有普通代码修改。

#### 4. 分阶段开发计划

| 阶段 | 工作与交付 | 验收/退出条件 | 当前状态 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P0 范围收敛与迁根目录 | 删除产品 Team/peer 流程；backend/packages/vendor 归位；基础协议拆包 | 当前 PR 描述的聚焦测试、vendor 身份、打包与路径检查；保留原协议及历史记录读取 | PR #509 已提交，未合并；仍有真实部署验收待补 |
| P1 同步设计和基线 | 更新本 RFC；审查 upstream 差异；刷新双向映射、状态所有者和路径耦合清单；建立可复放事件基线 | 清单不再迁移不存在的 native/Ambient Team 派发实现；可由仓库固定 SHA 链接复核 | RFC 范围、目录及阶段计划已更新；映射刷新等工作待实施 |
| P2 基础模型与依赖边界 | 领域记录回所属域；内部执行契约抽出 server；外部请求按动作组转换；保留临时兼容导出 | 存储/协议格式兼容；contracts 不依赖 storage；已迁组件无 server 反向依赖 | 待实施 |
| P3 入口装配与跨域用例 | 拆 Bridge 装配/生命周期；先抽查询，再逐组抽命令；幂等与快照仍由 application 包装 | 重复请求只执行一次；单次快照与通知顺序稳定；启动失败可清理，正常关闭无任务泄漏 | 待实施 |
| P4 单 Agent 主执行链 | 先抽纯规则，再迁会话/流式/等待/取消；EngineService 使用执行端口；拆结果提交与恢复 | 会话隔离、问答续跑、取消确认、清除后晚到结果、子 Agent 边界、重启恢复和产物交付通过 | 待实施 |
| P5 记忆及存储职责 | 拆 EngineMemory 业务/SQL；显式共享写协调状态；恢复编排离开 EngineStore；保留事务核心 | 权限、纠错/遗忘/Undo、异常回滚、结果未知、迟到写和崩溃恢复各有明确预期 | 待实施 |
| P6 来源与工作区职责 | 拆 ConnectorFactory、入站/历史同步、附件/产物；收拢房间/待办/人工协作；业务动作回所属域 | 全部 App 注册及能力保留；凭证更新/撤销、listener 关闭、入站去重及人工协作回归通过 | 待实施 |
| P7 收尾及交付验收 | 处理无调用遗留；清除不再需要的兼容导出；收紧依赖规则；补镜像/真实启动/MCP/文件交付与升级回退 | 所有映射项有明确去向；不靠旧大类完成实际业务；目标部署环境端到端与回退证据齐全 | 待实施 |

阶段是依赖顺序，不要求一个阶段只提交一个大 PR。同一状态/事务一致性单元一起迁移；其他职责拆成可独立评审、验证和回退的小 PR。P2/P3 的必要接口稳定后，P5 与 P6 可分别推进，涉及来源撤销和记忆失效的接口变更必须协调。后续分支从已审查的集成基线建立，PR 继续指向 `refactor/backend`；不默认合入 main。

#### 5. 保持的事务、权限和生命周期语义

- 不复制两份可写 session 映射、共享记忆锁、pending 写集合或恢复状态；字段和方法一同明确所有者。
- 来源由 source 保存权威状态；memory 保存需要的引用/授权投影。撤销先落实不可访问，application 协调后续失效；结果提交前复核来源及会话有效性。
- Task/Run/Message 与相关记忆变更继续使用既有可协调事务；外部操作不在持有数据库事务时无限等待。
- 分别定义可捕获异常回滚、提交结果未知、远端超时后迟到完成、进程崩溃后恢复。保留既有 unknown/冻结/对账语义，不承诺原实现没有的跨库崩溃原子性。
- 现有 `memory/reviewed.py::MemoryStore` 有独立业务调用方，保留其明确身份，不与历史手机记忆混为一库。
- 路径耦合清单覆盖 `.dockerignore`、`.gitattributes`、vendor manifest、Dockerfile COPY、Python 包名与资源、CLI/MCP 启动、受管 runtime 识别、独立 Python 环境、CI 安装和缓存路径。首阶段已做的修改继续验证，不重复迁根目录。

### Involved Public APIs

明确的行为删除已经由 P0 承担：Team/独立委托/跨 Agent 评审/交接不再执行，旧记录仍可读取；`user.ask` 询问当前用户，旧 `agent.ask` 仅兼容用户接收方。其余外部请求、响应、事件、错误码和数据格式保持兼容。后续模块拆分不改变已有 App 接入能力、thread/session 关联、业务权限策略或进程数量。

### Test Verification

使用项目支持的 Python 3.12 环境及已安装依赖。在仓库根运行以下已有入口；本次 RFC 更新没有重新执行测试。

```sh
python tests/cases/run-server-regressions.py
python -B vendor/verify_sources.py
lint-imports --config backend/.importlinter
npm run typecheck
npm run test:core
python -m pytest backend/tests/test_memory_action_transaction.py
python -m pytest backend/tests/test_single_primary_bridge.py backend/tests/test_single_primary_config.py
python -m pytest backend/tests/test_runtime_wheels.py
```

每个 PR 只补充其行为/边界所需的有意义测试，并运行对应原有回归；不以文件数量或搬迁覆盖率替代行为验收。

- 用临时数据库和固定 fake Gateway 输入保存/复放事件，比较事件类型、业务关联、顺序、终态与错误码；只归一化随机 ID、时间戳等非语义字段。Team 场景改为旧记录可读但执行/恢复被拒绝；内部子 Agent 完成不能结束主流。
- 跨批次检查单 Agent 完成、问答续跑、取消、clear/来源撤销后的晚到结果、重启恢复、审批和 unknown delivery；按受管权限开/关及外部 runtime 分类验证。
- 交付验收必须包含脱离源码目录安装 wheel、实际 CLI/MCP 启动、受管 runtime 识别、搜索、生成并读取文件、新镜像部署以及旧部署升级/回退。
- 当前 PR 已记录聚焦回归和打包通过；继承的完整 Python 套件并非全绿，已有问题与本次新增回归分开记录。CI 的实时状态以 PR 检查页面为准，SKIPPED、QUEUED 不计为通过。
- 2026-11-03 当前 head 的 HarmonyOS 包编译、独立模拟器安装和登录页启动已完成；工作流契约 14/14、驱动单测 51/51 通过。真实 14 项 Nightly 用例未运行，当前暂停，模拟器已关闭。未验证云端重构后端或真实模型端到端；恢复该项需另行启动验证安排。

### Additional Supplementary Information

实施与设计材料：

- 首阶段 PR：#509，head `f9b04e47`，目标分支 `refactor/backend`。其范围是删除与初始模块迁移，不表示完整 RFC 已完成。
- [当前模块边界说明](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f9b04e4783df277e1dc5d4ec02c355ebff41f693/docs/developer_guide/backend-modules.md)。
- [现有文件迁移映射](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f9b04e4783df277e1dc5d4ec02c355ebff41f693/docs/developer_guide/backend-module-map.csv)。方法/字段/锁的补充映射在 P1 进入可访问的仓库文档，不以仅存在本机的材料作为验收依据。
- 相关讨论 #271：本轮按先模块化、后插件化的顺序推进。已有 `register()` 作为过渡装配机制保留，不将其宣称为插件框架。
- PR 用 `Refs #505` 建立总跟踪关联，issue 逐阶段记录 PR。P0 不使用 `Closes #505`，总 issue 在完整范围和交付验收完成后再关闭。

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents


</details>

issue:525.body:
### Context

v0.1.6 发布到应用市场后，内测同学在日常使用中对比其它 AI 产品，对输入区的语音交互提出优化建议。同一时段另一位同学用一段录屏（0:07）展示了「这款 AI 产品是这样的」，作为交互参照。

### Test Environment

- 应用：DigitalMate / Beebou 手机端
- 版本：v0.1.6（当日发布到鸿蒙应用市场，报告人截图中的「版本更新 0.1.6」可核对）
- 系统：HarmonyOS
- 反馈来源：DigitalMate 内测群（30 人），2026-11-03（Asia/Shanghai）

### Problem Description & Suggestions

**现象**：输入框的提示语是「发消息或者按住说」，但按住说话的入口与手感跟用户已经习惯的主流 AI 产品不一致，用户明确要求优化。

群内原始反馈（2026-11-03 18:17，王守玉）：

> 输入区的「发消息或者按住说」，建议搞搞，现在用其他 AI 产品，习惯住说了😅

（「习惯住说了」应为「习惯按住说了」——即从其它产品迁移过来后，原有肌肉记忆在这里不成立。）

**建议**（供讨论，最终方案需与提出人对齐）：

1. 明确按住说话的完整手势契约：按下开始录音 → 松手发送 → 上滑取消 → 录音过短给出提示。当前提示语只说了「按住说」，没说松手/取消怎么处理。
2. 让提示语与真实行为一致：如果按住说话只是次要入口，就不要把它写进占位提示；如果它是主入口，麦克风按钮的可点区域与视觉权重应与之匹配。
3. 录音状态要有明确反馈：波形/计时/「松手发送」文案，避免用户不知道自己处于录音态。
4. 与语音识别质量分开跟踪（识别准确率见 #328），本条只谈交互与提示。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![王守玉在群内提出输入区按住说话的优化建议](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/test-evidence-20261028/test-evidence/20261103/20261103_1817_voice_hold_to_talk.jpg?raw=true)

### Additional Information (optional)

- 关联：姜成林随后贴出的 0:07 录屏（群内 2026-11-03 18:2x）用来说明「这款 AI 产品是这样的」，本次未对该录屏做逐帧转写；如需要精确对齐手势细节，建议向王守玉/姜成林确认参照产品与期望行为。
- 与 #328（语音输入识别准确率）互补：那条关注识别质量，本条关注入口与手势反馈。

issue:565.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Establish E2E coverage for **16 DigitalMate cases: 7 in E4 (artifacts and system integration), 7 in E5 (lifecycle and recovery), and 2 in E6 (installation, release, and compliance)**.

Reuse existing workflows, complete deterministic criteria, and collect actual local execution with traceable evidence. #533 retains the original scenarios and historical records. This issue tracks their migration and re-acceptance under the tiered specification; historical passes do not count as stable passes of the current case version.

### Design Ideas

- Criteria are defined in `tests/cases`; workflows, drivers, assertions, and evidence entry points are in `tests/e2e`.
- #585, #586, and #587 retain the original definitions and partial results. Replacement delivery consists of one PR per E tier, linked to this issue, with the cases, execution entry points, actual results, and screenshots.
- Track specification, implementation, execution, stability, PR, and merge status separately by case version. JSON validation, mocks, historical passes, and CI success do not establish current business acceptance.
- Complete each current case once and retain all required assertions. Repeat only after a relevant change or a new failure; report repeated-run stability separately.

### Involved Public APIs

Use the actual App and normal cloud protocol to verify files, attachments, tasks, interactions, and system resources. Fault controls must be restricted to isolated resources owned by the current run. Server success receipts, login state, and assertions must not be fabricated or bypassed.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

Coverage includes `tests/e2e/workflow`, file and attachment operations, task recovery, permissions, reminders, first launch, and upgrades. Tier groups share assertion support. This issue does not expand the separate E0–E3 or ST supplementation scope.

### Test Design and Test Plan

E4 checks external file contents and hashes, artifact versions, attachment ownership, permissions, and system resource differences. E5 checks the in-flight state before interruption, actual device controls, task uniqueness, drafts/cards, and terminal state after recovery. E6 checks clean installation, agreement state, package signing/version/release configuration, and retained upgrade data.

<!-- e4-e6-progress:start -->

| Tier | Cases | Cases with local execution records | Complete local passes | Replacement PR | Original definition PR |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---|
| E4: Artifacts and system integration | 7 | 7 | 6 | [#670](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/670) (OPEN) | [#585](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/585) (MERGED) |
| E5: Lifecycle and recovery | 7 | 7 | 5 | [#713](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/713) (MERGED) | [#586](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/586) (MERGED) |
| E6: Installation, release, and compliance | 2 | 2 | 2 | [#714](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/714) (MERGED) | [#587](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/587) (MERGED) |
| **Total** | **16** | **16** | **13** | | |

Local execution records include partial and failed runs. A complete local pass requires all business criteria and GPT-6 Astra screenshot review. Repeat execution is reserved for failures or changes that require verification. Definitions, framework regressions, and CI success do not add to business completion counts.

Local testing uses the available emulator, installed packages, and test service. Unknown cloud deployment and model versions are recorded as unknown and do not block local business execution. GPT-6 Astra reviews the relevant screenshots and records. Replacement cases are grouped into one PR each for E4, E5, and E6, with manual merging.

Documentation PR: #566 (MERGED).

English criteria update: [#667](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/667) (MERGED); reviewed by GPT-6 Astra.

| Tier | Case | Coverage | Local result and remaining checks | Case PR | Execution and review evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| E4 | `ATTACH-01` | Attachment ownership during room switching | PASS in one linked execution with a 256 KiB attachment. The switch tap and guard screenshot preceded the upload response. The original room and fixture matched the removed source. One plain control reached the target room without an attachment. A separate 1 MiB upload showed the guard after the switch tap, which ended 8.50 seconds before the response. The original room stayed selected and neither room gained a message. | #670 | [Record 1](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4ff4c9cf57f8bee89a65dad05a1e22838a2fdefb/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/README.md); [Record 2](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4ff4c9cf57f8bee89a65dad05a1e22838a2fdefb/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/verification.json); [Record 3](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4ff4c9cf57f8bee89a65dad05a1e22838a2fdefb/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/attachment-guard-1m.png); [Record 4](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4ff4c9cf57f8bee89a65dad05a1e22838a2fdefb/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/attachment-control-sent.png) |
| E4 | `FILE-02` | Same-path overwrite, single artifact card, and preview recovery | Local emulator PASS with the isolated WorkSwarm bridge. #### Final objectives, acceptance criteria and benefit reporting (confirmed 2026-11-09)

<!-- DM31:ACCEPTANCE-ENVIRONMENT:20261117 -->
**Acceptance environment (2026-11-17 maintainer clarification).** When a work package requires end-to-end deployment or client acceptance, deploy the exact candidate to an authorized test environment and run the applicable scenarios on the emulator using the original client/unchanged HAP where required. Validate the real default assembly, startup, Gateway/owner paths, persistence, compatibility and rollback there as applicable. References to production assembly mean the actual supported deployment path and configuration exercised in the test environment. Deploying into the production environment, moving the production alias, and switching live user traffic belong to separate release operations and are not conditions for closing this refactor. All other applicable acceptance assertions, CI, independent QA, A/B and repeat requirements, hard dependencies, and the original 103-work-package closeout accounting remain in force. If deployment/emulator is the only remaining acceptance item, run and record it in the test environment and close the work package once its actual remaining assertions pass.

**Overall objective:** Preserve supported functionality, client compatibility and data semantics while migrating the server to components with clear responsibilities, a single writer for each authoritative state domain, and collaboration through public contracts. Complete source-directory and documentation-governance convergence, make common feature changes and component substitutions local in scope, and demonstrate through actual execution that critical paths have no significant performance regression.

This section consolidates maintainer-confirmed final deliverables and reporting requirements for this master tracker and Q11 #828. **Accepted requirements do not establish completed implementation or verification.** The existing frozen baselines, supported scope, contracts, client acceptance and stricter gates below remain binding. This section authorizes no new product semantics, relaxes no existing gate, reopens no accepted task, and does not accumulate all final acceptance under a single foundation component such as A02. Each child task closes against its original, explicit deliverable boundary; its owning task retains any outstanding final integration obligation, summarized here.

**1. Required deliverables and evidence-based acceptance**

| Objective | Observable acceptance criteria | Primary evidence and ownership |
|---|---|---|
| Clear component responsibilities and dependency boundaries, independently verifiable and replaceable through contracts | Components in migration scope have named owners, public interfaces and declared acyclic dependencies. Each authoritative state domain has one writer. Cross-component calls use public proxies, without accessing another component's private objects or authoritative tables. The actual default production entry reaches the new owner; migrated capabilities have no duplicate authority, silent legacy-executor fallback or reconnectable bypass. Representative implementation substitutions use established extension interfaces without modifying callers' internal logic. Independent deployment of every component and zero dependencies are not required. | Ownership/interface inventory, real call and write traces, boundary counterexamples, substitution and component tests; existing architecture, component and G05/G10 gates apply. Transitional legacy deviations still require an owner, cleanup task and bounded exit condition; they do not establish final migration completion. |
| Remove duplicate responsibilities and retired execution paths; converge the source layout | Every affected old path has an explicit migrate, retain or retire disposition. Server layout converges on the accepted architecture-foundation target while preserving unrelated `digitalmate/` client code, business code and dependencies with pinned provenance. Entry points, builds, imports, tests and deployment use the correct paths. Deletions require reference, call-path and functional evidence. Do not remove functionality to meet a line-count target or mechanically copy an entire branch. | D01 #845 path dispositions, entry mapping, clean installation/build and execution verification; code measurements are reported separately under the rules below. |
| Bounded impact and verification cost for common changes | Compare 3–5 representative changes before and after migration, such as model/tool adaptation, implementation substitution and an internal component-rule change. Internal changes stay with their owner; adapter changes use the adapter and necessary registration without modifying unrelated core code. Genuine shared-contract changes still require owner coordination; there is no promise that every request changes only one component. Developers can locate owners, contracts, entries and verification commands from documentation. | For each case, record baseline/candidate implementations or a reproducible change exercise, affected components/owners/files, unrelated core changes, verification environment/steps/time and component-level testability. Directory counts alone do not establish development efficiency. |
| Preserve functionality, client compatibility and data semantics | Retain the original frozen-baseline, supported configuration/API, full default Harness and unchanged-HAP A/B acceptance obligations, including files/artifacts, history, answer/retry/continue/cancel and the other established capabilities. Preserve persisted records and identities. Simplified probes, fake owners and component tests cannot replace actual client acceptance. | Existing Q04–Q10, capability matrix, identical HAP/driver/assertions, real production participants and deployment evidence; retain original failures and disposition differences individually. |
| Explainable and traceable failure, cancellation and recovery behavior | Verify duplicate requests, lost post-commit receipts, concurrency, Stop and unknown-outcome handling under existing contracts. Execution authority cannot resume after Stop. Correlate requests with M/S/R, attempts/actual implementations, commits and outcomes to identify the responsible component. Prove only the accepted recovery and bounded history-retention scope, without extending it to automatic continuation after arbitrary crashes. | Normal and fault evidence through real owners/persistence, Q03 tracing, existing lifecycle/Store contracts and negative cases; identify controlled substitutes and their scope. |
| Reproducible delivery and authoritative contributor guidance | Trace source, dependencies, build configuration, images and actual installed/runtime identities; verify clean deployment and existing rollback boundaries. AGENTS.md contains stable principles and protocol entry points while retaining effective constraints. Documentation establishes authoritative sources, navigation, old-document dispositions and repaired links under `protocols/specs/adr/procedures/lessons/verification/updates`, distinguishing proposed, accepted, implemented and verified status. | Existing build/deployment and G05 verification, D02 #847, D03 #848 and D01 final reference reconciliation; historical evidence proves only its named revision and scope. |
| No significant critical-path performance regression | Measure server overhead under comparable environments and workloads, reporting actual end-to-end behavior separately. Meet existing stricter service objectives and deadlines. Freeze baselines, measurement methods and tolerances before the final comparison; do not infer performance from architecture or widen thresholds after observing failures. | Comparative report under the performance rules below, included in Q11's final verdict; no unmeasured claim of “no regression.” |

**2. Required factual benefit reporting, without promised improvement percentages**

- **Code reduction:** Fix start/end SHAs and the first-party production-code counting scope. Separately report (1) evidenced removal of duplicate, unreachable or retired code, (2) added contract, adapter and reliability code, and (3) net production-code change. Report changes outside the first two categories separately so totals reconcile. Moves, copying followed by deletion, and formatting-only changes do not count as deduplication benefits. Count tests, documentation, generated code and third-party code with pinned provenance separately. Supply the counting tool, configuration, exclusions and representative deletion evidence. No reduction of N lines or N% is promised; a net increase does not automatically fail acceptance.
- **Development cost:** For the representative cases above, report change impact, environment preparation, required verification steps and elapsed time. Distinguish human work, tool waiting and test execution, and state sample limitations. Do not directly translate agent concurrency, model differences or one exercise into developer-productivity gains. Report measured improvement, no improvement or trade-offs without promising a productivity percentage.
- **Performance:** Keep hardware/resource limits, data volume, concurrency, workload and warm-up strategy comparable for server measurements. Use fixed model/tool responses to isolate external variability. Cover applicable queuing/submission, history reads, cancellation acknowledgement and execution-scheduling overhead. Report p50/p95, applicable throughput under fixed-load and saturation conditions, peak memory, and success/error/timeout rates so dropped work cannot appear as a speed gain. Separately report real end-to-end time using the same client and scenarios, explicitly identifying model/network and other external effects instead of combining the two into one conclusion. Record sample counts, repetitions, variability, commands and raw results.
- **Performance tolerances for baseline calibration only:** Evaluation may start from “p95 latency and peak memory increase by no more than 10% relative to baseline; throughput remains at least 95% of baseline.” These are **candidate tolerances, not active gates, passing results or exemptions from existing stricter objectives**. First measure baseline noise and applicable service objectives. The responsible owner then specifies absolute deadlines, applicable metrics and final thresholds, freezes them, and runs the candidate comparison. Record and disposition every unmet condition. Test-scanning/CI speed improvements count only toward verification cost, not product runtime performance.

**3. Consistent acceptance and progress reporting**

1. Trace every conclusion through “requirement/objective → owner and task → exact baseline/candidate SHA → actual entry and participants → commands, environment, results and evidence → outstanding work/blocker and next responsible owner.” Label evidence as source, component, integration, deployment or unchanged-HAP scope; these scopes are not interchangeable. Retain initial failures and subsequent runs without overwriting history.
2. Keep `proposed / accepted / implemented / verified` distinct, and keep execution outcomes `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN / INVALID` distinct. Completed documentation, a merged PR, increased test counts, reachable infrastructure or a successfully built image does not automatically establish production migration or client acceptance.
3. Close child tasks against their original acceptance criteria and backfill post-merge evidence, residual work and downstream dependencies. Do not expand a foundation package merely to close the master tracker. Report overall task counts, source integration, deployment and client acceptance separately. Without new formally tracked tasks, this section changes no denominator and manufactures no completion count.
4. The final #737 / Q11 #828 report consolidates the required deliverables, measured benefits and unresolved differences above. No minimum positive reduction in net code, development effort or additional runtime cost is promised, but the corresponding measurements and reproducible reports are required. Outstanding unrun, invalid or blocked mandatory acceptance prevents an unconditional refactor-completion claim. Existing difference-disposition and authorization rules continue to apply; retain visible limitations and their scope.

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A10 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A10`.

**Owner:** Router owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch

**与 Project Hive #1228 的边界：** 会话与执行 selection 继续归 #760（A10 / `server/router`）；#1223 的 Delivery 只向已指定的 Bot 投递，目标为 `temp/beebou/src/dm_beebou/delivery/` → `server/agent_service/delivery/`，由 #1226 的实施方接续。

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Rule-first continuity, scoped BGE and ambiguous judge, distinct execution selection and one shared ten-second deadline, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py::ConversationRouter.route` into `server/router/proxy.py; server/router/policy.py; server/router/gateway_classifier.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/router/proxy.py; server/router/policy.py; server/router/gateway_classifier.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py) — `ConversationRouter.route`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/router/proxy.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/router/proxy.py) — `RouterProxy.submit_routed, _route`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/router/proximity.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/router/proximity.py) — `ProximityClassifier`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/adr/0002-server-runtime.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/adr/0002-server-runtime.md) — `routing clarification`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Existing explicit/reply intent
- Scoped history
- Tool-free AgentCall
- Unknown admission semantics

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Old runtime routing authority
- Renewing deadlines on retries
- Timing out a potentially committed admission as unaccepted

**Writable boundary:**
- server/router/proxy.py
- server/router/policy.py
- server/router/gateway_classifier.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a10.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755), [DM31-A31](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/757)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763), [DM31-A24](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/794), [DM31-A11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/812), [DM31-A16](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/815)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/756), [DM31-A32](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758), [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-A21](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/761)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-G07`.

**Outcome:** The first actual normal-loop ModelCall/AgentCall vertical traverses public Router/AS/Host/Store with the real default factory; subsequent child/media/skill suites are registered as they migrate.

**Owner:** Runtime owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 1 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `.github/ci-gates.json::gate catalog` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

- Frozen main [.github/ci-gates.json](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/.github/ci-gates.json) — `gate catalog`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

- Architecture reference [tests/server/st/test_composed_turn.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/tests/server/st/test_composed_turn.py) — `ComposedTurnTest`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

- Actual default provider/profile selection and tool pairing

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Fake replacement evidence presented as default path

**Writable boundary:**
- tests/server/st/test_default_runtime.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763), [DM31-M03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/764), [DM31-M04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/765), [DM31-M05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/766), [DM31-G09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/745) (**FULFILLED/CLOSED**; retained dependency history)

**Blocks:** [DM31-G08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/771), [DM31-Q03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/772)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-G03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/767), [DM31-G05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/768), [DM31-G06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/769)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- ModelCall has zero Harness dispatch
- AgentCall loads actual full default loop with controlled model/tool gateway
- M/S/R, host call IDs, paired results and Store revision correlate
- Bypass injection through mutated assembly fails
- Persisted answer reopens through public inspection

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite default-runtime --require-tests --fail-on-skip

**Assertions:** - server-tests.py --suite default-runtime --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** full-main-harness-adapter, integrated-default-composition. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR08, AR03, AR04.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

**2026-11-16 post-Hive 重定基。** 基线 [498bc351](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/commit/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4)，#1605 已合入，#1313 / #1316 已关闭。架构重构的当前总计划为 #737，里程碑为 #963。本段取代下方与旧 Router/Hosted 默认执行装配相冲突的实施指令，历史来源、原通过/失败和未运行证据仍归原 SHA。

保留本 Issue 原 owner、支持行为、单 writer、真实调用、权限/Stop/ACK/UNKNOWN 及独立 QA 要求。Hive 合入不代表本项原范围完成。#1665 的具体缺陷、新增能力与体验改进由原产品工作线交付，本任务不复制修复，也不把 #1665 整单关闭作为依赖。若其缺陷阻断本项原验收，记录精确场景及 owner，保持该项 FAIL/BLOCKED，其他独立切片继续。

**当前实施与验收方向**

保留 scoped M 的 pending 排他、preflight/consent、物理 paid attempt 和 UNKNOWN 记账。A10 前置替换为 A07 #755，A15 #814 / A26 #790 保留。先盘点当前 Hive 是否仍有合法的 pre-R paid 调用。存在则经 Agent Service submission-scoped port → Model Gateway 并由 Store 记账；不存在则证明所有推理都在合法 R/Host 下，并证明 pre-R 直接 provider 路径被拒。不得为满足旧 BGE 测试重建 Router、伪造 R 或删除费用/重复派发断言。最终以实际支持路径和独立 QA 逐项验收，未授权取消 pending/费用责任。

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A16 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A16`.

**Outcome:** Enforce preflight, paid attempts, target consent and admission with one pending dispatch owner per scoped M.

**Owner:** Agent Service admission owner. **Batch:** P3: policy, accounting, concurrency and recovery. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Enforce preflight, paid attempts, target consent and admission with one pending dispatch owner per scoped M, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/embeddings.py::embedding provider boundary` into `server/agent_service/routing_operations.py; server/router/gateway_classifier.py; server/router/embeddings.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/agent_service/routing_operations.py; server/router/gateway_classifier.py; server/router/embeddings.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/embeddings.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/embeddings.py) — `embedding provider boundary`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Candidate evidence only [server/agent_service/routing_operations.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/3019f9ab/server/agent_service/routing_operations.py) — `HostRoutingClassifier`; SHA `3019f9ab`.
- Independent local evidence: `/Users/jianyulong/.codex/worktrees/dm-nov9-control/pre-r-attempt-review.md` — `Gaps and stopping boundary`. Supporting evidence only; summarized in the published research report, not a production dependency.
- Architecture reference [docs/specs/general-capability-contracts.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/general-capability-contracts.md) — `C3 boundary table`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Default Proximity algorithm
- Shared deadline
- No fake run
- Original failed live evidence

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Direct paid Router model/BGE bypass
- Admitted-duplicate proof substituted for pending exclusion

**Writable boundary:**
- server/agent_service/routing_operations.py
- server/router/gateway_classifier.py
- server/router/embeddings.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a16.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755), [DM31-A15](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/814), [DM31-A26](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/790)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/820)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A30](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/774), [DM31-A17](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/792), [DM31-A24](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/794), [DM31-A29](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/801)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Define pending lease and consent-generation acceptance ordering without creating another authentication service

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Denied preflight causes zero routing provider calls
- Concurrent identical pending M does not duplicate paid attempts
- Stop/shutdown fences pre-R without fake admission
- Routing failure costs remain inspectable under M

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a16

**Cases:** - Real components with controlled embeddings/models
- Pending duplicate and conflicting intent
- Preflight Ask parked outside classifier deadline

**Participants:** Real Proximity/Router/AS submission ports/Store/Model Gateway; controlled BGE/model HTTP responses and same-M pending barriers. Run actual provider evidence separately with exact authenticated scope.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** C3, C4. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0008, GC13, GC15–16.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

#### 当前实施与验证

M25 **OPEN，源码与原生依赖阻塞**。实际 `629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 的默认 Docker→entrypoint→`engine_cli serve`→`configured_bridge`→Hive 启动仍装配 `EngineService(legacy_execution=False)`；A09 `server/runtime.py`、`server/__main__.py`、通用 `server/assembly.py` 和原 M25/G07 默认运行测试尚未落地。当前 Plugin Gateway 只有内部源码引用，未读到支持的 Bridge/Hive caller。20 个原生前置中 19 个 OPEN。 当前源码在私有本地验证 45 项和 28 个子测试，覆盖启动/配置、退役 token、真实 loopback ModelGateway/Host/Harness/SQLite、CLI 端口占用与 SIGTERM；模型/部分 Bridge 或 provider 用各自 fixture，未启动真实 Bee scheduler 或目标默认部署。首次 archive 缺 fixture 的运行保留，补精确 tracked fixture 后执行。 Server Runtime owner 是原职责，此 Issue 未具名指派；`Jianyu010` 是 A09 原协调，历史 HK 转介与运行不构成本轮交接。授权测试环境实际安装、默认装配、D8 绑定条件与适用 unchanged HAP/emulator/A/B/独审待验；生产发布、alias 和用户流量另行。[#759](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759)、[#773](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/773)。

默认路径迁移基线。`git ls-tree` 的 tracked 路径在 `498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4`→`629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 为 `server/` **31→31**、`temp/` **332→375**。同区间 `server/` 仅 `agent_service/session_store/proxy.py` 修改；`temp/` 有 43 新增、66 修改、零删除。 该计数包含源码、测试和文档。 实际 Dockerfile/Bridge 打包源码仍从 `temp/` 取共同 owner 输入，Bridge wheel 有 12 个 `force-include`；默认 `configured_bridge` 组装如前。 本次为精确源码及映射核对。各切片要求真实默认 caller 使用承接 owner，wheel/包映射及启动入口一致，适用授权测试环境和原门禁各有精确证据。查明获权消费者已迁移后才退旧 adapter/manifest。当前四个优先项的已验收 owner 转移为 **0**。 [#759](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759)、[实际 Dockerfile](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e/harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile#L53-L54)、[Bridge wheel 映射](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/pyproject.toml#L73-L88)。

**Completion checklist:**

- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.

- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** artifact-retention-before-release, run-workspace-release-control, phone-PPT-viewer, service-restart-capability. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR03, AR04, AR08.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

**Owner:** Independent QA reviewer. **Batch:** P4: independent integration and cutover evidence. **Size:** 0.5 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

### Improvement and Fix Suggestions

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `architecture@f7dd:docs/procedures/verification.md::Architecture review before merging an implementation` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** docs/verification/v31-migration-independent-verdict.md (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Architecture reference [docs/procedures/verification.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/procedures/verification.md) — `Architecture review before merging an implementation`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Original attempts, failures, metadata and independent scoring

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Fake/component/history evidence substituted for device acceptance

**Writable boundary:**
- docs/verification/v31-migration-independent-verdict.md

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-Q10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/827), [DM31-G10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/746)

**Blocks:** No direct implementation blocker; consumed by the final integration gate.

**May proceed in parallel:** Disjoint owner modules and fixture preparation once their public contracts exist; no concurrent edit to this task’s writable files.

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

**Verification and evidence**

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Review exact main/candidate SHA, HAP and case hashes, deployment/model bindings
- Recheck M/S/R/Host/Store trace and durable PPT release/open proof
- All differences passed or explicitly accepted by authorized owner
- Unrun or unresolved gates named; no unconditional parity claim

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Checks:** - Existing evidence integrity and provenance checks
- Manual independent review of actual phone evidence and failure disposition

**Participants:** Independent QA, same frozen HAP and original driver/assertions; actual old/new backend builds. Controlled input/fault fixture is named per case; it cannot replace actual phone or new production owner. Exclusive resource lease needed for execution.

**Evidence:** A/B backend identity and M/S/R/Host/Store trace; PASS/FAIL/environment-BLOCKED/NOT-RUN separately; retain baseline failures.

**Command:** node tests/e2e/workflow/migration/check-manifest.mjs --results tests/e2e/results/v31-migration/coverage.json


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** independent-reviewer, complete-evidence-or-explicit-disposition. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR10.

issue:868.body:
### Checklist

- [x] Searched for related issues.
- [x] Included reproduction steps, the tested build and screenshots.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

When a Files request is denied at submission after agent read access has been revoked, DigitalMate displays a generic retry message. The Bridge returns FORBIDDEN before creating a task.

1. In the isolated Files provider, grant agent read access and read a file from the App.
2. Revoke access and ask the App to read the same file again.

**Actual.** The request is denied and the App displays “这次操作未完成，请稍后重试”.

**Expected.** The request remains denied. The App explains that file access was revoked and tells the user how to restore it before retrying.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

HarmonyOS API 23 emulator with OpenHarmony 6.1.0.115. Native App connected to an isolated Files/MCP fixture.

### Additional Information

E2E case PERM-01 in PR #670. Validation tracker #565.

A later run exercised denial at the tool layer and showed recovery guidance. After reauthorization, the file content and revision matched the original read. Provider UI revocation and the ordinary WorkSwarm path were outside that run. See the [execution record](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/9f4ea7b1833cc6ef11a460a8a552cd71d36b1503/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/verification.json). Related error guidance discussion in #359.

### Version Information

DigitalMate 0.1.0, build 10008 (debug).

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Generic App error after the Bridge denied the revoked request](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/a7706055f99faa70e6ff72249b31c49bf62f3d16/tests/e2e/results/e4-565-20261106/perm01-denied.png)

issue:900.body:
### Context
对话进行中、助手正在调用工具时的「当前进展」浮层/消息气泡。
路径：对话页 → 发送一条会触发工具调用的消息（本次为「你分析一下现在的session机制是怎样的」）→ 等待回复时弹出的「当前进展」。

### Test Environment
- App：DigitalMate（com.jiuwen.digitalmate）
- 设备：Android 手机（截图状态栏：5G、电量 69%）
- 时间：2026-11-08 11:03（Asia/Shanghai）
- App 版本：0.1.9

### Problem Description & Suggestions
**Observed（现象）**：「当前进展」面板与上方消息气泡都只显示「正在使用工具… · 已用时 33 秒」，不显示正在调用的具体工具名称（如 bash、web_search、read_file 等）。用户只能看到笼统的「正在使用工具…」，无法判断助手此刻具体在做什么。

**Expected（预期）**：「当前进展」中展示当前正在执行的具体工具名称（必要时附一句该工具在做什么），例如「正在使用 bash（执行命令）… · 已用时 33 秒」，让执行过程可观测。

**Suggestion（建议）**：
- 进度文案由「正在使用工具…」改为「正在使用 {工具名}…」，工具名映射为易懂的说法（如 bash→执行命令、web_search→搜索网页）。
- 同一轮调用多个工具时，展示当前工具，并可保留已完成工具列表。
- 与本仓 #896（工具执行缺少超时/进度）方向一致，可一并完善工具级进度展示。

### Screenshots / Recordings
（截图见报告随附：screenshot_20261108_110357_com.jiuwen.digitalmate.jpg）

「当前进展」弹窗原文：
```
当前进展
正在使用工具... · 已用时 33 秒 · 你分析一下现在的session机制是怎样的
```
上方消息气泡原文：
```
Beebou 正在使用工具... · 已用时 ...
```

### Additional Information
- 关联：#896 单条 bash 命令耗时可达 66s 且无超时/进度。
- 归类：过程可观测性——已有进度提示，但缺少「工具粒度」信息。

issue:918.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

关联路线图：#147。**演示日期：2026年11月30日。**

需要交付围绕“完成会议报告”持续推进的 DigitalMate Demo：

> 收到报告邀请邮件 → 主动形成报告准备目标 → 生成可交互简报并讨论方向、内容和篇幅 → 持续读取飞书分享或邮件 newsletter → 发现影响报告的新材料并建议调整 → 生成、修订 PPT → 临期提醒 → 报告完成后总结复盘。

简报以 **Intelligent UI** 呈现，支持点击卡片翻到背面，查看实际处理的关键推理步骤和关键材料。

Bot 支持先给出简短、有用的回答，再补充详细回答；用户可以持续插话追问，系统自动关联对应会话和上下文。

**已有基础与估算前提：**

- 飞书接入与持续读取已完成，本期保留集成回归。
- 邮件采用 **Composio 接入 Outlook／Microsoft 365**，首期使用托管授权。
- 复用已有 Agent 执行、来源、文件产物及调度基础。
- 各项工作量包含实现和开发者自测；人日表示合计投入，不等于日历工期。

### Design Ideas

#### 三周计划与工作量

| 周次 | 日期 | 重点 | 估算工作量 |
|---|---|---|---:|
| 第一周 | 11.09～11.15 | 邮件接入、报告目标、基础交互、初版 PPT、Bot体验 | **25人日** |
| 第二周 | 11.16～11.22 | 新材料关联、调整交互、PPT修订、提醒与复盘 | **25人日** |
| 第三周 | 11.23～11.25 | 端到端联调、异常回归、修复与排练 | **10人日** |
| **合计** | | 功能开发及自测50人日，联调回归排练10人日 | **60人日** |

**11月22日前完整跑通一次流程，最后一周以联调和缺陷修复为主。**

#### 📅 第一周：11.09～11.15｜25人日

- [ ] **1. 邮件接入与持续读取，飞书链路回归｜5人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 基于 Composio 接入 Outlook／Microsoft 365，完成账号映射、手机授权、连接状态、重新授权与断开。
    - 读取邀请邮件、线程及 newsletter，保存正文、链接、时间和来源。
    - 接收新邮件事件，处理去重、恢复及连接停用，并回归已有飞书链路。
  - **工作量拆分：** Composio接入0.5；授权与连接状态1.5；正文与来源解析1；持续接收1；恢复、自测及飞书回归1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 手机授权 → 收到邀请邮件和 newsletter → 查看正文与来源 → 离开聊天页后发送新邮件 → 检查后台接收 → 验证重复投递、重启和断开连接。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 邮件读取完整、来源正确；后台发现不依赖再次提问；重复信息不重复处理，中断可恢复，断开后停止读取；飞书既有能力正常。

- [ ] **2. 报告目标形成与基础管理｜5人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 从邀约识别报告需求，提取主题、听众、日期、时长及提交要求。
    - 建议方向、大纲、篇幅和时间分配，支持讨论修改。
    - 保存目标、要求、方案及准备状态，支持恢复与去重。
  - **工作量拆分：** 邀约识别1；目标与状态保存2；讨论修改1；恢复、去重及自测1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 收到二十分钟报告邀约 → 生成目标及方案 → 用户要求“十五分钟，更偏实践” → 切换话题后恢复报告 → 重新进入继续修改。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 邮件事实与助手建议区分清楚；修改后保留其他约束；恢复最新方案；同一邀约不重复建目标。

- [ ] **3. Intelligent UI基础交互与简报卡翻面｜4人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 实现邀约简报、方向选择、要求补充和方案编辑。
    - 点击卡片翻到背面，展示关键推理步骤及其关联材料。
    - 材料包含标题、来源、时间、关键内容和原文入口；界面与对话状态同步。
  - **工作量拆分：** 简报与方案编辑2；翻面及材料查看1；状态同步、恢复及自测1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 查看简报 → 修改方向与篇幅 → 翻面查看步骤和材料 → 打开原邮件 → 返回正面 → 通过对话继续修改并重新进入。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 操作实际更新方案；正反面内容与当前版本一致；依据来自实际处理记录；返回和重新进入后状态保留。

- [ ] **4. 初版PPT生成｜3人日**
  - **开发内容：** 根据已确认方案生成真实 `.pptx`，支持下载、打开，并关联报告目标。
  - **工作量拆分：** 生成工具与模板接入2；产物关联、下载及实际打开验证1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 确认方案 → 生成PPT → 下载并在演示软件中打开 → 从目标中再次找到文件。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 文件可打开、可编辑；主题、结构及页数符合确认方案；产物归属和生成状态正确。

- [ ] **5. Bot体验改进：快速回答与持续插话追问｜8人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 先给出简短、有用的回答，再自动补充详细分析、方案和依据。
    - 回答过程中持续接收补充、修改条件和追问。
    - 识别输入属于当前任务、此前话题还是新话题，关联正确会话与上下文。
    - 将新增条件用于后续回答，保持回复与提问的绑定关系。
  - **工作量拆分：** 简答与详答衔接2；连续输入及会话归属3；上下文更新与回复一致性2；自测及性能核对1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 请求二十分钟报告大纲 → 收到简答后，在详答过程中连续输入“改成十五分钟”“听众都是研发” → 切换到周末出行清单 → 再要求“刚才报告的背景部分少一点”。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 首段包含实质性回答；无需等待即可继续输入；报告吸收新增条件，出行使用独立上下文；返回报告后要求仍被保留。记录首段可见时延。

#### 📅 第二周：11.16～11.22｜15人日

- [ ] **6. 新信息与报告目标主动关联｜5人日**
  - **开发内容：** 获取飞书、newsletter及链接内容，判断相关性和新增价值，定位受影响章节、观点或数据，提出调整建议并记录采纳结果。
  - **工作量拆分：** 材料获取1；相关性与影响分析2；采纳、忽略及方案更新1；素材自测1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 方案确认后发送相关新材料 → 查看主动调整提示 → 再发送无关、重复材料和失效链接 → 追问“为什么影响报告，具体改哪里？”
  - **关键观察与结果：** 建议具体、有依据；无关和重复内容不反复提示；不可读或待核实内容明确说明；采纳后方案正确更新。

- [ ] **7. 调整建议的Intelligent UI （背面 UI）｜2人日**
  - **开发内容：** 展示材料、影响原因和修改建议，支持采用、忽略、继续讨论及背面依据查看；处理状态恢复和旧版本操作。
  - **工作量拆分：** 卡片及操作1；翻面、版本保护、恢复及自测1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 打开调整卡并支持翻面翻回查看 → 调整卡讨论后采纳一项建议、忽略另一项 → 进入继续修改。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 采用、忽略结果与方案一致；状态可恢复；旧版本不静默覆盖新方案；失败不显示采用成功。

- [ ] **8. PPT修订、预览与版本管理｜3人日**
  - **开发内容：** 将采纳资料和用户修改落实到具体页面，支持预览、版本保存及失败重试。
  - **工作量拆分：** 定向修改与版本管理2；预览、重试及版式自测1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 生成修订版并与初版对比 → 要求“压缩背景介绍，保留实践部分” → 再次生成 → 模拟失败后重试并查看各版本。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 修改落实、其他约束保留；预览与文件一致；无明显溢出、遮挡或乱码；版本清楚，失败不标记交付完成。

- [ ] **9. 导航栏“计划”标签：临期提醒与会后复盘｜5人日**
  - **开发内容：** 根据日期和准备状态提醒，支持改期、稍后提醒、关闭、免打扰及去重；用户确认报告结束后，依据实际反馈生成复盘和后续事项。
  - **工作量拆分：** 提醒触发2；反馈总结1；（更改日期提醒去重2）。
  - **验收 Demo：** 推进测试时间 → 收到提醒并打开最新PPT → （改期及调整提醒配置） → 用户确认报告结束并补充反馈 → 生成复盘。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 提醒时间、目标及文件版本正确；完成后停止准备提醒；复盘关键步骤有实际依据且可查询。

**第二周结束验收：从邀请邮件到会后复盘，完整实际运行一次。**

#### 📅 第三周：11.23～11.29｜19人日

- [ ] **10. 完整流程联调｜8人日**
  - **工作内容：** 在实际演示环境串联手机、邮件、飞书、Bot、目标管理、Intelligent UI、PPT、提醒和复盘。
  - **工作量拆分：** 接口与状态联调3；两条增量材料流程验证3；归属、版本及接口问题修复2。
  - **验收 Demo：** 从新邀请邮件开始跑完整流程，分别使用飞书消息和邮件newsletter作为新增材料，并穿插修改要求和话题切换。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 全流程围绕同一报告目标；信息、界面、方案、产物和提醒一致；真实接口串联正常，Bot插话不影响任务归属。

- [ ] **11. 异常与性能回归｜8人日**
  - **工作内容：** 验证故障恢复、重复处理和业务异常，测量响应性能并修复瓶颈，记录成本。
  - **工作量拆分：** 异常回归与修复5；时延测量、瓶颈处理及回归3。
  - **验收 Demo：** 在完整流程中插入授权失效、断网、重启、重复消息、链接失败和PPT生成失败 → 恢复后继续原目标；固定用例重复运行并记录时延。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 异常可识别、可恢复；进展不丢失，目标和提醒不重复；提供性能对比及调用次数、Token、费用记录。

- [ ] **12. 版本固定与演示排练｜3人日**
  - **工作内容：** 固定版本、账号、素材、时间配置和操作步骤，完成排练及证据保存。
  - **工作量拆分：** 版本与状态复位1；完整排练及产物核对1；证据和脚本整理1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 从初始演示状态连续跑两遍完整流程，覆盖快速回答、插话追问、卡片翻面、来源查看、实际打开PPT、提醒和复盘。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 两遍结果符合预期；状态可重置、流程可重复；测试结果、截图、录屏和已知限制齐全。

**11月30日：使用已完成验收的固定版本正式演示。**

### Involved Public APIs

实施时需对齐以下契约：

- **连接与读取：** Composio账号映射、连接状态、新邮件事件、正文及来源、错误和恢复状态。
- **Bot交互：** 简答与详答归属、连续输入、会话与上下文关联、回复绑定和状态更新。
- **报告目标：** 邀约要求、用户确认约束、方案版本、材料、进度及产物关联。
- **Intelligent UI：** 正反面数据、关键步骤与材料、编辑及采纳操作、旧版本处理。
- **PPT产物：** 生成状态、预览、下载、版本及最新有效文件。
- **提醒与复盘：** 日期、配置、取消与完成状态、用户反馈和复盘结果。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

| 关联事项 | 本期关系 |
|---|---|
| #147 核心能力路线图 | 对齐接入、上下文连续、汇总、待办与提醒，补充报告场景验收。 |
| #221 账号连接、#325 飞书群聊 | 复用已完成的飞书和连接基础，新增Outlook邮件接入并回归来源兼容性。 |
| #833、#834 连接与读取迁移 | 对齐账号映射、读取及来源契约；真实账号和完整Demo单独验收。 |
| #200 今日资讯简报 | 复用材料筛选、去重及来源能力，补充报告影响分析。 |
| #180 办公套件文件编辑 | PPT作为必验格式，覆盖生成、修订、预览和版本管理。 |
| #178 主动提醒 | 复用触发及不打扰策略，补充报告状态联动与复盘。 |

### Test Design and Test Plan

1. 各开发事项包含实现、自测和对应验收Demo，完成后保留结果及版本证据。
2. 邮件使用真实Outlook／Microsoft 365账号，飞书使用已有真实连接；业务素材可预置。
3. 检查实际后台接收记录、目标与版本关系、卡片正反面、材料原文及真实PPT文件。
4. 提醒通过可控测试时间验证；会后复盘依据用户确认及实际提供的反馈。
5. 性能记录覆盖信息发现时延、首段有效回答时延、模型TTFT、调整建议与PPT生成耗时、提醒偏差。
6. 成本记录模型调用次数、输入输出Token及估算费用，成本仅记录。
7. 完成后补充PR、精确版本、测试脚本与结果、截图或录屏及已知限制，再更新复选框。

### Additional Information

- 首个工作日验证演示邮箱授权、正文读取和新邮件触发；如需Microsoft 365租户审批，等待时间影响日历排期，不计入开发人日。
- 工作量为基准估算，合计约59人日。
- 最后一周以端到端联调、异常回归、缺陷修复和演示排练为主。
