### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

On HarmonyOS, enable location in 本地能力连接 and grant system access. A current-location card asks for one-time consent repeatedly, while the location receipt and standalone card expose collection time and system-reported accuracy.

Expected: choose approximate or precise access when enabling location and show the effective precision in settings without an additional upgrade row. Reuse an adequate current grant. When a foreground task such as nearby food requires precise location but the effective grant is approximate, ask for permission; if the user accepts and the OS grants it, update the global choice to precise. A refusal keeps approximate access. Respect app opt-out and OS revocation. Show the resolved place without collection time or reported accuracy in either location presentation.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

HarmonyOS DigitalMate client; reported on a phone with location globally authorized. Exact phone and OS versions were not supplied.

### Additional Information

Keep existing calendar behavior, location freshness/accuracy validation, stale-request protection, and task payload format. Verify both precision choices, task-driven escalation and refusal, reuse, revocation, and non-sensitive presentation in an isolated emulator. No cloud change or new manifest permission is intended.

### Version Information

Source checked on `main` at `e5ac5d1588d6f4950be11458d60bbb3a9688a3fa`.

### Screenshots / Recordings

The reporter provided a phone screenshot privately. It includes a real location, so it is not attached to this public issue.

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1416 将 `temp/hive-memory/src/dm_hive_memory` 加入 Bridge wheel 的 force-include。实际 main 的 Dockerfile bot-build 没有 COPY 这组源码，Dockerfile 专用 .dockerignore 排除了其中全部 14 个文件，HK 无 Git 快照的 fallback 也没有对应输入。完整 Git 源码构建正常，部署需要的源码投影不完整。

在原仓库目录运行下列只读检查，比较同一包路径在 wheel、构建复制清单和 fallback 输入的声明。

```sh
git ls-files temp/hive-memory/src/dm_hive_memory
rg -n 'dm_hive_memory|hive-memory|temp/\*\*' \
  harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/pyproject.toml \
  harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile \
  harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile.dockerignore scripts/cloud-image-build.sh
```

实际 Moby patternmatcher v0.6.0 接收 0/14。固定 Hatchling 从完整 Git 源码生成 14/14 Hive Memory 成员，核对实际摘要通过。按同一 B 的 Docker COPY 复建输入时首先撞到既有 #1406；固定 B 源码并仅叠加已独审的 #1406 构建上下文控制后，再用同一 Hatchling 构建，退出 1。

```text
FileNotFoundError: Forced include not found: …/temp/hive-memory/src/dm_hive_memory
```

预期是 Docker 构建上下文及 HK 快照 fallback 都只携带这一包的登记文件，包括三份 TOML。构建和安装后的 wheel 文件和 RECORD 与同一 Git 来源对应。未登记 temp 目录和测试夹具继续排除。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS arm64，固定的 Moby patternmatcher v0.6.0 与 CPython 3.13.13，真实离线 Hatchling 源码构建。使用实际 Dockerfile 的 COPY 复建本地构建输入。未构建或发布共享镜像，未部署。

### Additional Information

关联 #1416、#1312、#1406、#1279。Hive Memory 入库和原 #1406 缺陷分别复现并保留。请 Bridge 构建与 Hive Memory owner 联合核对准确的 COPY、专用过滤和 HK fallback，再用原 A01 限定语义、wheel 及 RECORD 校验。

### Version Information

实际 main `2ae871a6987a236b84044887859de23d742b1bb3`，实际 tree 以该 Git 提交为准。截取终端记录仅对工作目录路径做了脱敏。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![实际构建隔离复现 Hive Memory 的源文件缺失](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27ca2e6c4f4c7adf919246857bded50fe7cd1c5/hive-memory-build-context.png?raw=true)


<!-- DM31:CURRENT-STATUS:1476 -->
#### 当前实施与验证

现行 #1476 安装源接收范围。[#1329 `1798c549`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1329) 已将 runner 本地 TAR 与 Kube 上传替换为 Pod 内从 GitHub 取精确 SHA 的 archive，实际源码 `629ba37e998364881d577a21a65345b55d1db26e` 保留该路径。独立本地调用实际 `EXTRACT`/bsdtar，以受控 archive 验证 28 个唯一 COPY 源（History 两个重复源仅登记一次），257/257 文件字节相同。 archive 请求按 SHA 固定，顶层前缀和 archive 摘要尚无独立绑定证据。K8s、Docker/BuildKit、SWR、生产/设备以及 #1279 受保护全量均为 **NOT_RUN**。本地验证回执 SHA-256 `87077ea57aa50d2a3cbf9ca2aa41fffca0cddcac913372c6cdedaa143c654b94`。

已退 runner 上传路径的历史本机回执，继续按其固定源留证。

沿用现行 #1476 安装源范围，#1279 的本机后继 `63aad5e1237fc43920f381f8f02e45d0840b44c3` 以已独审 `e895d6da` 为前置，实际基线 `03e94a34`。原 `18ca` 的独审反例实证 glob、目录和符号链接可被旧 recorder 放行。修正后 shell 检查通过，10/10 含变异控制；同真实 Moby 匹配语义一致，默认 Bridge archive 216 个文件，诱饵均拒绝。 原 K8s/BuildKit/SWR 及受保护全量仍为 **NOT_RUN**。此后继仅本机，#1279 公开头未动，原关闭及部署历史按原回执。

另有 #1329 当时的真实原生运行。精确源码 `a61791d1939d5519c07ec02ab0e295a789be4345` 的 HK BuildKit 构建、推送与部署输入均为 `sha256:3dc091c6585f7d40b88177a45de1335e14a3bb1bc4fc4d988395e06d32b389d1`，该 job rollout **PASS**，归原 SHA 与镜像。 整体 Nightly **FAIL**，Windows 的三项 ST 与 Bench 失败，E2E 取消。此条只验收当时构建和 rollout，当前 `629ba37e` 的本地 EXTRACT、#1279 及 11/17 授权测试环境验收均另有证据。安全摘要 SHA-256 `1328f91173428d03501eb2e78e3c7f77a7908fd9f9fcb89982e53743da8acea2`。[原 HK job](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43878703846/job/133338503208)、[原整体运行](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/actions/runs/43878703846)。

Follow-up to #1533 (Hive Phase 3), from the hive3 Router-leftover test sweep.

8e7879416 ("fix(hive): fence legacy receipt IDs through scoped owners") added a **synchronous** `legacy_submission_id_present(key)` to the `ConversationRepository` port. That breaks the session_proximity contract that every IO protocol method is a coroutine (`tests/session_proximity/test_contracts.py::AsyncPortTests::test_all_io_protocol_methods_are_coroutines`).

The call path:
- `server_engine/engine_service.py` `EngineService.require_fresh_hive_submission_id`: a sync engine fence that reads inside a synchronous `store.transaction()` (called from `HiveTurnStartup` via `require_fresh_submission_id`)
- → `dm_sessions/service.py` `SessionManager.legacy_submission_id_present`
- → `server_engine/session_proximity/repository.py` (907/919)
- → `server/agent_service/session_store/proxy.py` `HostedSessionStoreProxy.legacy_submission_id_present`

The caller cannot await inside that sync transaction, so for cutover the test carries a named exemption for this one method, with this reason: a bounded single-row SQLite read in a sync engine fence.

**To do after cutover:** make the fence read async end to end (the Protocol, SessionManager, the repository and the hosted proxy). Move `require_fresh_hive_submission_id`'s check out of the sync transaction, or make the fence async in `HiveTurnStartup`. Update the `tests/test_hive_startup_fence.py` monkeypatches. Then remove `SYNC_IO_EXEMPTIONS` from test_contracts.py; the test fails if the exemption goes stale.
closed_recent.title: dm_sessions: make the legacy receipt fence read (legacy_submission_id_present) async after cutover

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### Background and Goal Description

Commander 是常驻的观察和发现进程。用户没有打开会话时，它也能观察记忆变化与时间，决定何时检查、有没有一件值得做且能够完成的事。DM 通过插件注册接入进程生命周期、数据通道和执行入口。

1. **DM 为工作区启用插件。** DM 装配受限接口并启动常驻 Commander。Commander 自己订阅 Memory 的变更流，保存观察条件和下一次检查时间，平时等待事件或时钟。
2. **Commander 识别激活现象。** 例如进入会前窗口，或窗口内的相关证据发生变化。Commander 复查当前证据，确认还有未完成的工作，而且 DM 能交付明确的产物，再把候选发布给 DM 展示。
3. **用户点开始，DM 才提交任务。** 首版由用户接纳候选。DM 重新校验证据，通过统一任务入口提交。Router 决定用哪个会话，Agent 在后台执行，用户可以在 Activity 查看进度和结果。

例如，Commander 从变更流读到用户的周会要求和 Calendar 时间，记下一次会前检查。到时它自行检查，发现 Gmail 里的预算仍未确认，提出「整理一页会前清单」。用户点开始后，DM 在后台生成草稿，Activity 链回原话题。

DM 自行实现候选和唤醒逻辑，PPMA 与 Linkie 可独立演进。

### Proposed Solution

#### 周会示例时序图

图中是目标流程。Commander 启动后自己观察记忆变更和时间，识别值得行动的情况。用户确认后，DM 才提交任务。

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    autonumber
    actor U as 用户／DM UI
    participant S as 会话与 App 来源
    participant H as DM 宿主
    participant M as Memory／Ingestor
    participant C as Proactivity／Commander
    participant A as Router／Session Manager
    participant R as Agent Service
    Note over H,C: DM 按配置启用插件并装配通道
    H->>C: 启动常驻 Commander，提供受限接口
    C->>H: 订阅 Memory 变更，从持久游标续读
    U->>S: 会话 A 交代「周会前整理未决项」
    S->>H: Session Store 持久保存后发出会话事件
    S->>H: 连接层交付已核实的 Gmail 和 Calendar 事件
    H->>M: 经 Memory 事件处理器交付上述来源事件
    M-->>H: 回执确认已持久接收
    Note over M: 异步分类、裁定与发布，推进 surface revision
    M-->>H: 发布带 revision 的 surface 变更
    H-->>C: 经订阅通道交付变更事实
    C->>H: 按引用读取会议时间和用户要求
    H-->>C: 经 Memory Provider 返回当前依据
    C->>C: 更新周会观察条件并保存会前检查时间
    alt 会前窗口内有相关证据变化
        C->>C: 评估该周会是否值得行动
    else 到了自己设定的会前检查时间
        C->>C: 从时钟等待恢复并评估
    end
    C->>H: 请求当前有效证据
    H->>M: 通过 Memory Provider 查询
    M-->>H: 返回会话要求、预算和会议时间
    H-->>C: 返回 surface revision 和有效证据版本
    C->>C: 确认预算仍未决，保存候选
    C-->>H: 发布候选「整理一页会前清单」
    H-->>U: 展示候选
    U->>H: 点开始，确认这个候选版本
    H->>A: 宿主提交任务、证据版本、提交 ID 和事项键
    Note over A: Router 选 Session，Store 复核证据并按事项键去重
    A-->>H: 返回接纳回执及 Run ID
    A->>R: Agent Service 接管已接纳的 Run
    R-->>H: 发布进度，提交清单草稿后报告完成
    H-->>U: Activity 显示进度和结果
```

#### 最终架构与接入点

Proactivity 包声明一个**按工作区启用的后台观察进程**，以及所需的证据通道和宿主能力。Profile 为工作区选择精确版本，Runtime 装配适配器并协调启动、就绪和停止。Commander 持有订阅游标、观察条件、检查时间和候选状态。进程启用后持续运行，按需等待和评估。其推理仍使用宿主授权的数据范围和预算。

| 插件声明或宿主接入点 | 谁调用 | 交接内容 |
|---|---|---|
| **进程生命周期** | Runtime 根据 Profile 装配插件并连接 Commander。 | 注册版本、作用域、依赖与就绪状态。停用时停止观察和新接纳，保留已接纳 Run 的状态读取和控制。 |
| **事实通道** | Commander 使用宿主授予的接口订阅并续读 Memory Retrieval。 | 已提交的 surface 变更、`surface_rev` 和游标。需要更多上下文时，Commander 按引用读取当前证据和条目版本。首版可由回放数据走相同接口。 |
| **观察与检查时间** | Commander 更新观察条件，决定何时再次检查。 | 持久化观察状态和下一次检查时间。首版由进程内时钟等待，到期后评估。若后续复用宿主的定时设施，由 Commander 决定要检查的对象和时间。 |
| **候选读取与处理** | 产品入口按当前用户授权读取候选，接收用户对特定版本的接纳或忽略。 | 候选正文、证据和状态。接纳时由宿主适配器持久化提交意图与 `M`，再走标准应用提交。 |

**Commander 发布候选，宿主执行获准任务。** 用户接纳后，宿主适配器以受认证的应用身份调用 Router → Session Manager／Store → Agent Service，获得 `M / S / R` 关联。将来有授权的自动规则也走这条路径。UI 读取候选投影和 DM 的 Activity，Run 内获准的工具由 Plugin Gateway 派发。 [应用提交与关联契约](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/general-capability-contracts.md#c4--application-turns-streaming-and-accounting)

当前 V3.1 参考 Registry 支持 `core`、`model`、`tool`、`skill` 的精确绑定。工作区后台插件的注册和生命周期、受限订阅与 IPC 属于**本稿提议的宿主扩展点**。Commander 的检查时间属于观察状态，DM 的任务调度与接纳继续由现有所有者负责。M24／M46 可提供定时基础设施，首版常驻观察可独立用时钟验证。 [Registry 参考实现](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/registry/README.md) · [V3.1 Server Runtime](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/adr/0002-server-runtime.md) · [M24 #795](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/795) · [M46 #836](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/836)

#### 激活现象和输入通道

**激活现象是 Commander 从当前事实中识别出的、值得重新判断是否行动的情况。** 原始输入可以是 Memory 新增、修订或失效，或者时间到达某个检查点。一次输入可以只更新观察状态，也可以触发评估。评估再判断是否有证据、有可用能力、工作尚未完成，以及能交付什么。

周会首例中，Commander 观察的是「这次周会临近，用户曾要求会前整理，仍有待跟进项」。读到会议安排时，它记下检查时间。进入会前窗口时主动检查。窗口内收到相关邮件更新时，再判断是更新候选还是撤回。它用 surface revision 识别已经观察过的输入，用会议实例和交付目标识别同一个事项。首版用这条观察逻辑验证通道和恢复，后续发现策略可在 Commander 内细化。

首版通道提供按游标续读的 Memory 变更。事件包含可复核的事实引用、身份、版本、作用域和补录标记，Commander 按需读取当前证据。传输可用订阅或可等待的续读调用。Commander 持久化观察状态、检查时间和消费进度，重启后继续读并复核到期项。历史补录和游标过期后的基线重建只更新观察基线。正常的后续检查可以使用仍有效的证据。因中断而尚未完成的实时评估按原身份恢复。

#### 从观察到任务结果

1. **持续观察。** Commander 读取变更或等待自己记录的检查时间，按工作区合并重复输入和限流。候选、进度和结果带明确来源类型，避免工作产物被重新识别为用户承诺。
2. **发现。** Commander 在授权范围内读取有限证据，判断是否有明确目标、产物或完成条件，所需能力是否可用，以及事项是否已完成或正在执行。可以选择保持沉默。后台推理使用宿主批准的调用身份、数据范围和预算。发现阶段产出候选，没有 Run。
3. **保存候选。** 按事项键 `work_key` 维护候选，记录候选版本、所读 `surface_rev` 和实际依赖的条目及来源版本。定时和事件同时发现同一事项时更新同一候选。发布和展示时校验当前证据，修订后用新的候选版本供用户确认。
4. **接纳。** 宿主适配器绑定用户所见的候选版本，持久保存不可变提交意图、稳定提交 ID `M` 和事项键，再走统一应用提交。默认建议 `New + AgentCall`，并关联原话题。用户明确要求在原话题做时请求 `Continue(S)`，由 Session Manager 处理忙态。只有语义相似且没有可靠事项身份时，首版交给用户判断。
5. **跟进。** 收到接纳回执后按 DM 返回的 R 更新 Activity。丢回执时查同一个 M，恢复关联后再更新 UI。前台的「已开始」可以对应仍在运行的 R。若先提交了一轮最终答复，再开展后台工作，两轮各有 R，可关联到同一个产品任务。确认、停止、结果和产物跟随实际执行的 R。

#### 证据失效与接纳幂等

Revision 负责证据新鲜度，幂等负责同一事项只接纳一次。拟由 Store 在**写接纳回执的同一事务**里校验候选证据并占用事项键，和来源失效共享提交顺序。

| 检查 | 约定 |
|---|---|
| **证据版本** | 复核候选绑定的 `memory_id + memory_rev` 及 `source_refs`。来源更新、删除、撤权或记忆修订导致实际依赖失效时，旧候选被拒绝。无关条目推进整个 surface revision 时，仍可复用有效候选。 |
| **提交 ID `M`** | 相同作用域和相同意图的重试恢复原接纳回执。接纳不确定时继续查原 M。提交 ID 在首次提交前持久化，沿用 V3.1 的冲突和重放语义。 |
| **事项键 `work_key`** | 同一接纳作用域内，为同一会议实例的「整理会前清单」使用稳定键。会议时间、记忆 revision 或候选版本更新时沿用该键。即使两次提交用了不同 M，Store 也只允许一个 Run 占用该键。其余请求在授权下关联已有 Activity。 |

- **失效先提交。** 旧候选无法产生新 Run。重新评估时仅使用仍有效的证据。
- **接纳先提交。** 保留原 Run 和回执。后续证据读取与派发继续检查当前授权。已派发操作沿用 V3.1 的结果与回执语义。重放原 M 恢复原关联。

V3.1 已有同 M 重放语义。证据条件接纳和跨 M 的事项键占用是新增提案，保证范围是 DM 的 Run 接纳。第三方操作继续使用各自的效果回执和幂等契约。后续有授权的自动规则与人工接纳共用此路径。 [V3.1 Store 接纳契约](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/specs/session-store-admission.md) · [Host 当前权限与派发顺序](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/general-capability-contracts.md#c2--run-configuration-and-current-authority)

#### 当前重构阶段的交付方式

当前首页普通输入已经走 Session Affinity。DM UI 已区分提交回执和后台 Task 的进度、等待及最终结果。现有定时触发可以创建或继续旧 Task，但带触发来源的请求绕过首页的托管 Session 路由。目标 `server/plugin_gateway/` 和 `plugins/` 装配在本基线尚未接通。现有定时触发可用来刻画用户可见行为，Commander 的目标接纳走 V3.1 应用接口。 [当前任务流](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/architecture/task-flow.md) · [托管入口的范围](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/session_proximity/ingress.py#L21) · [当前定时触发](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/automation/triggers.py#L362)

| 阶段 | 开发与验证范围 |
|---|---|
| **现在** | 在独立进程中实现 Commander 的观察循环，用可续读的 DM Session 和 Gmail／Calendar 回放以及可控时钟做验证。先覆盖观察恢复、激活条件、候选、去重、静默和撤回。以受控提交端验证宿主适配器丢回执时复用 M。 |
| **迁移过渡** | Memory 有实际公开读接口时，可在受控范围运行影子发现。临时适配器限定在已登记所有者与已发布入口。候选实际接纳取决于已接通的授权入口和条件接纳。 |
| **目标切换** | Runtime 按工作区装配和启停 Commander，接通 Memory 变更通道与受认证的应用提交。先开放用户接纳并生成 DM 内草稿。回退时暂停观察和新提交，保留已接纳 Run 的查询、停止及结算。 |

[并行开发与临时适配器规则](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f27cd2630f3ebd77c8cf49f9353796408872e346/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md)

#### 开发前需要厘清的核心细节

| 负责方 | 需要做出的决定 |
|---|---|
| **Proactivity／产品／UI** | 定首个可完成事项、完成条件和候选呈现。明确用户接纳、忽略、过期、版本更新和后台结果各显示在哪里，哪些状态可以通知。 |
| **Proactivity／Memory** | 定工作区读权限、订阅／续读接口、游标保留与补录静默。明确变更粒度、时间与来源版本、候选证据范围，以及如何识别工作已在进行或已结束。 |
| **Proactivity／Router／Session Manager** | 定后台提交的认证身份、`New / Continue(S)` 选择、关联字段、同事项身份及容量策略。明确忙态时等候、拒绝或重试如何投影，提交未知如何按 M 复核。 |
| **Proactivity／Store／Agent Service** | 定条件接纳及事项键占用的事务边界。定首批事项键如何生成、保留、关联手动任务，以及失败或取消后何时允许显式再做。明确候选更新、撤权或回执丢失后的结果。 |
| **Proactivity／Registry／Runtime／调度** | 定常驻插件的版本、生命周期、依赖和 IPC。定观察条件、时间和游标如何持久化以及重启时如何补查。区分 Commander 自己的检查时间和 DM 的任务调度，明确无会话时的推理授权、预算与限流。 |

### Involved Public APIs

需要定稿的是常驻插件的注册、启停和受限通道，以及接纳时的证据校验和事项键占用。同 M 重放沿用 V3.1，跨 M 的同事项接纳幂等为新增提案。

### Test Verification

以下为计划验收。

Session A 有用户的周会承诺，Calendar 给出会议时间，Gmail 给出预算与报价。Commander 在没有活跃会话时生成「整理一页会前清单」。邮件更新后候选只剩预算。删除邮件后撤下旧候选。另一封邮件产生新候选后撤销 Gmail 授权，旧卡刷新被过滤，点击被拒绝。Calendar 与用户独立承诺仍可用。

验证停掉变更消费者时旧卡仍然无法接纳，同时一条无关记忆推进 revision 时，有效候选仍可接纳。让接纳与撤权分别先提交，核对回执和 Run 数量。让同一候选重复点击、回执丢失并重启，核对同 M 仍指向原 R。再并发提交两个不同 M、相同事项键的有效候选，只产生一个 Run。最终通过真实 Router、Store 和 Agent Service 验证前台会话可继续，后台草稿和 Stop 均归原 R。

插件装配验收用同一宿主切换工作区的启用配置。启用后让 Commander 订阅变更，推进可控时钟，在无活跃会话时观察它自行完成会前评估。另在到期前重启，验证它从游标和保存的检查时间恢复。无关事件、重复交付和补录保持静默。关闭后停止观察与新接纳，已接纳 Run 的结果与控制仍可通过 DM 查询。

### Additional Supplementary Information

配套提案见 [Memory RFC](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/999)。

本提案沿用既有后端重构方向，并和 V3.1 迁移任务协调。 [后端模块化重构 #505](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/505) · [V3.1 迁移 #737](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737)

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

### Context

邮件邀约流程中的第二张卡片「请选择选题方向」。



### Test Environment

- 源码基线：03e94a347
- 验证提交：ba6a0bb98
- 构建环境：Windows、DevEco Studio
- 设备：Pura 80 Pro 模拟器
- 系统：HarmonyOS 6.1.0（API 23）


### Problem Description & Suggestions

当前卡片与 UCD 存在以下差异：

1. 三个选题方向之后还展示多选和“补充你的想法”输入区域。
2. 选项圆角和选中样式不符合设计要求。
3. 选中对勾占据文字布局空间，导致文字宽度和换行变化。
4. 标题与正文之间留白过大，正文行高和段间距与设计不一致。

期望行为：

- 正面只保留最初三个选题方向和“确定方向”按钮，移除后续多选及补充入口。
- 选项使用 8 vp 圆角；选中后显示橙色描边、浅黄色背景和右上角对勾。
- 对勾独立叠加，切换选中状态时不改变文字位置和换行。
- 标题与正文间距为 6 vp，正文行高为 20 vp，正文到选项间距为 12 vp。
- 正文高度随行数自然增长，三行正文不应发生裁切、重叠或间距压缩。


### Additional Information (optional)

设计依据：《邮件正反面卡片+交互规则》中的选题确认画板

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**The client drops a failed Bee terminal in Home and never reads its `reason`.** Split out of #1655 (F4) under #1665. The server side is complete. This issue covers only the client presentation and its device evidence.

The server sends one frame per failed Bee terminal. It is replayed once per `event_id`:

```json
{"event": "digitalmate.task.text", "task_id": "<task_ref>", "execution_id": "<run_id>", "event_id": "<id>",
 "version": 1, "committed_message_id": "<id>", "state": "failed", "text": "", "earlier": "", "final": true,
 "reason": "context_commit_failed | empty_final | interrupted"}
```

`reason` names the cause:
- `context_commit_failed` (#1547): the turn's context never reached the Session Store.
- `empty_final` (#1652): the runtime ended the turn without reply text.
- `interrupted` (#1655): the Host lost the turn after a restart or a missing terminal.

The task view state is `failed`.

What the client does with it today (code reading on `main` at 498bc351):
- `DigitalMateConversation.ets` `DigitalMateHiveNotices.accept` checks only `event.state === 'stopped'`. A `failed` frame becomes an ordinary result notice with empty text, titled `Bee 已完成`.
- `hiveNoticeRows()` turns it into an assistant row with empty text. The Home page drops empty rows (`Index.ets`, `.filter((row) => !!row.text)`). So the Home stream shows no line for the failure.
- `reason` is not read anywhere in `digitalmate/`.
- Where the task itself is shown as `failed`, the client uses the generic `digitalmateStatusText` default, 本轮任务执行失败，暂时无法确认具体原因…, and the notification 任务未完成 · <title>. Nobody has yet shown on a device whether Home displays that failed task state for a Bee task (see #1650: Home does not project Bee relays).

**Expected:** the client renders a failed Bee terminal as a failure, never as a completed or empty result. It uses `reason` to word the line: for example, the Bee gave no reply (`empty_final`), or the Bee's run was interrupted (`interrupted`). It keeps a phrase the device e2e detector matches (`任务执行失败` / `联系服务管理员`). The client owns the wording.

**Done when:** a device receipt on a deployed candidate shows a failed Bee task in Home (or in the Bee/Activity view, if that is where Bee terminals belong), with the reason-specific wording. The server can produce each reason on demand with the owner tests listed below.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

Code reading only, no device run yet. Server: `main` @ 498bc351 plus #1655. Client: `digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateConversation.ets` (`DigitalMateHiveNotices`, `hiveNoticeRows`), `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets` (empty-row filter), `DigitalMateStatus.ets` (`digitalmateStatusText`).

### Additional Information

The server reproduces each reason in these owner tests: `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase3_bee_empty_final.py` (`empty_final`, including a queued supplement) and `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase3_bee_orphan_recovery.py` (`interrupted`). The contract is in `docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-hive-phase3-delivery.md` §7c.

### Version Information

v3.1 after the Hive cutover (#1605); target v3.5 with #1655.

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### 🐞 Problem

**Beebou's relay of a finished Bee does not show in Home live.** The `hive.beebou.reply` push reaches the device, but the relay bubble appears only after the app is reloaded. While Home is open, it shows the Bee's raw result text instead, and that bubble disappears on reload.

This is the live half of #1650; the reload half now passes. Found in the device acceptance run for #1650 on main `14a95298b3d8d017c27e027cb6060f068aa3c0f7` (includes #1689 `1351fbf6`).

### Run

| Item | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Server | `digitalmate@sha256:1c73c5d0e8a17c45c253a3bff909407488968b9f57286f7c18db06ec4f83ee45`, direct Pod `dm-hive-direct-qa-14a95298` in adx-jiuwen-test-0, real model; torn down |
| Client | `com.jiuwen.digitalmate.hivedirectqa` 0.1.0 (10006), HAP sha256 `a51e9885…5b36455` |
| Device | DevEco emulator Pura 90, OpenHarmony-6.1.1.125, API 24 |
| Receipt | `hk-longjianyu:~/oc-out/hive-device-receipts/14a95298-issue-1650-1658/issue-receipt-1650-1658.json`, sha256 `69a6f91cc160a31945415af2573b5d4d9c485f99b761c4f3ea5b3436f528570c`; screenshots, text dumps and Store snapshots in `evidence/` next to it |

### Evidence

There were two rounds in Home, each asking for two different Bees (Alpha and Beta). Both rounds had `dm_hive_beebou_turn_failures` = 0.

| Round | Store | Live Home | After reload (force-stop + start) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| R1 | `done` seq 4 (Beta), 5 (Alpha); `beebou_context_runs` 4 and 5 `COMPLETED` | The run-4 relay showed once. **The run-5 relay never showed** (watched for more than 5 min). Two copy-only bubbles held the raw Bee texts | Runs 4 and 5 showed once each, in Store order. The raw Bee bubbles were gone |
| R2 | `done` seq 9 (Beta), 10 (Alpha); runs 9 and 10 `COMPLETED` | **Neither relay showed** (watched for about 3 min). Only the two raw Bee result bubbles | Runs 9 and 10 showed once each, in Store order. The raw Bee bubbles were gone |

In R2, the QA relay recorded the frames it forwarded to the device. Each frame below is `hive.beebou.reply`, `trigger=bee_done`, `outcome=committed`, `final=true`, `bot_id=beebou`, `session_ref=hive-session-beebou-g1-71ac1845dcef`:

| source_seq | bee_id | text_len |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 9 | `bee-1526db17…` | 163 |
| 10 | `bee-7a958fdf…` | 413 |

The device therefore got a push that passes every field check in `acceptHiveRelay`. Even so, no row with ID `hive-home:<session>:9:reply` or `hive-home:<session>:10:reply` appeared until the reload.

Evidence files: `03-home-live-end.jpeg` (R1 live), `04-reload.jpeg`, `06-home-live2.jpeg` and `06-home-live2-texts.txt` (R2 live), `06-relay-beebou-reply-witness.jsonl`, `07-reload2*.{jpeg,txt}`, `07-store.json`.

### Not yet known

The cause has not been diagnosed. Things to check:
- `acceptHiveRelay` returns false on the device. A likely spot is the `home.id !== this.roomId` guard: the unit test uses room id `home`, but the device's Home room id may differ.
- The relay is accepted but then dropped or hidden when `apply()` rebuilds rows.
- The follow-up `scheduleRefresh()` snapshot does not replace the live revision, so the projected row from the server is not applied until the next load.

Two more points:
- The raw Bee result bubbles in live Home (`digitalmate.task.text` final frames of Bee tasks, event IDs `hive-result-…`) are live-only and disappear on reload. Whether Home should show them at all belongs to the same fix.
- Server-side projection is correct: after a reload, every relay appears once, in position.

### Done when

On a device run, each relay of a finished Bee:
- appears in Home while it is open, within a few seconds of its `hive.beebou.reply` push, as exactly one bubble;
- stays in the same position after a reload;
- leaves no extra live-only bubble.

Device acceptance needs a receipt, so reference this issue with `Refs`, not an auto-close keyword.

Refs #1650 · parent #1665

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### 🐞 Problem

**Home never shows Beebou's relays of Bee results.** When a Bee finishes, Beebou relays the result, but the relay never appears in the Home transcript, neither live nor after a reload.

Found on the SC04-C1 device run against `hive/hive3-integration` @ `6cac213b` (direct instance in adx-jiuwen-test-0, emulator, real model). Diagnosis from the client lane:

- A relay is a Beebou turn on a `kind='done'` input. `hive_store.list_beebou_home_submissions`, used by `HiveHomeTrial.project`, selects only `i.kind='user'`. So relay replies never reach Home `messages`, on load or in history.
- The only live signal is the broadcast `hive.beebou.reply {trigger:'bee_done', bee_id, text, final}`. The client uses it only as an Activity refresh trigger (`DigitalMateHiveActivity.ets:34`).
- Rendering only the push would make relays disappear on reload.

### Expected

Done-triggered Beebou replies are projected into the Home transcript, with position and page queries, so they survive a reload. The client renders them in Home.

### Scope

- Server: the projection of `kind='done'` Beebou turns into Home messages and pages.
- Client: render them, and dedupe them against the live `hive.beebou.reply` push.
- Not in the Router-retirement cutover #1605. It's listed there as a known limit. Bee results stay visible in the Bee/Activity view. Tracked under #1533.
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: Home transcript never shows Beebou's relays of Bee results (done-triggered turns not projected)

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
## What happens

When a setup turn's dispatch has been accepted, Beebou keeps making tool-call rounds until it runs out of its 12-call normal-turn budget (`max_model_calls`). The harness then raises `RuntimeError: Beebou exceeded its normal-turn model call budget`, and the Store settles the turn as `harness` / `settled`. The user sees the generic failure notice "抱歉，这条消息没能处理完成，其中一个操作可能已经执行。请先查看结果，再决定是否重试。", even though the Bee was created and its task was accepted and queued.

This is the same budget-exhaustion path as #1616, with a different trigger: no slot is busy here, and create and dispatch both succeed.

## Evidence (hive3 `6cac213b`, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, run `pf-6cac213b`, 2 of 42 repeats)

| Trace | Turn | Tool plans committed | Normal-turn model calls |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `artifacts/hive-live/pf-6cac213b/HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-04/r2/trace.json` | F1 (first turn, empty slots) | `create_bee` ACTIVE, `dispatch` accepted (`task_0e4fcfac…`, queued) | 12 calls, every one `finish_reason=tool_calls`; prompt grows by about 300 tokens a round |
| `artifacts/hive-live/pf-6cac213b/HIVE-LIVE-EVICT-06/r3/trace.json` | F1 | `create_bee` ACTIVE, two `dispatch` accepted | 12 with `tool_calls`, then 1 `stop` |

- `dm_hive_beebou_turn_failures`: `kind=harness`, `reason=RuntimeError: Beebou exceeded its normal-turn model call budget`, `outcome=settled`.
- The extra rounds left no row in `dm_hive_beebou_tool_plans`, so they are read-only calls (the proxy records counts, not names).
- In both traces the gateway shows no error during the turn.

## Expected

After a dispatch has been accepted, running out of the budget should not settle the turn as a failure. `normal.py` already has a receipt reply for the empty-content case (`accepted_dispatch` → "已将任务交给 Bee 处理。"). Use it, or a configured receipt, when the loop reaches `max_model_calls` with `accepted_dispatch` true. Also consider stopping repeated read-only calls once a dispatch has been accepted, for example with a per-turn read-only call cap set in TOML.

## Owner

Beebou harness: `dm_hive_beebou/harness/normal.py`, the `run()` loop end, plus the read-only call policy. This is the #1616 lane.

Found by the Hive behaviour QA post-fix pass (#1244 SC04-E2, Phase 3 tracker #1533).

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Found while reviewing #1557 (for #1496), decision 6. **Low priority: no product path triggers this today.**

`publish_bot_definition(..., retire=False)` (`session_proximity/hive_store.py`, `repository.py`, port `dm_hive_worker.directory.ports`) gives a Bee's bot binding a new revision while the Bee stays ACTIVE in the same Session and generation. The Session's runtime binding (`dm_hive_runtime_bindings`) is keyed by Session. It is never replaced and keeps the old `binding_revision`, which never becomes ACTIVE again.

After such a bump:
- `BeeHostExecution.ready_for` sees a runtime binding recorded under an earlier revision. Since #1557 (`read_runtime_binding_revision`) it returns a plain `False` with a one-time warning, so `run_next` returns UNSTARTED.
- The Store refuses `commit_unavailable_result` for that case. No unavailable terminal is written, which is correct: the Harness did not change.
- The Bee's queued turns therefore **wait indefinitely**. Nothing claims them, ends them, or notifies the user. This is the same as Phase 2 before #1557.

Today the only product caller is `dm_hive_worker.directory.roster.retire_bee`, and it passes `retire=True`, which retires the Session. Eviction (EVICTING → ARCHIVED) also leaves the Bee not ACTIVE, so `ready_for` returns `False` before the binding check. The bump is therefore reachable only by a direct, non-product call.

### Design Ideas

The guard is already in #1557 (`RetireFalseGuardTests`, commit `ae20fc860`): a test fails if any non-test call of `publish_bot_definition` does not pass `retire=True` explicitly. A new caller therefore has to come here first.

**When a product path needs a non-retire bump:** choose one of the following.
   - **(c) Binding migration:** move the Session's runtime binding to the new revision when the exact Harness is unchanged, so the queued turns run. This needs the "same Harness" compatibility rule that #1496 left undefined (out of scope there).
   - **Bounded wait:** after a configured bound, end such turns with a terminal and a notice through the #1481 / #1557 terminal path, using a distinct reason (not `implementation_unavailable`).
   - **Refuse the bump:** have the Store refuse `retire=False` while the Bee has queued or claimed turns.

### Involved Public APIs

- `HiveStore.publish_bot_definition` / `SQLiteSessionRepository.publish_bot_definition`: the meaning of `retire=False`.
- Possibly the runtime-binding migration (option c).

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- #1496 / #1557 (unavailable terminal, `read_runtime_binding_revision`).
- #1309 Host (`ready_for`), #1311 Store (bindings), #1268 / #1478 (eviction, scheme two).
- #1559 covers Beebou roster state and is deliberately separate.

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **When a design is chosen:**
  - a real Store test with an ACTIVE Bee and queued turns, then a `retire=False` bump;
  - the chosen outcome holds: turns run (c), end with a notice after the bound, or the bump is refused;
  - replay is idempotent.

### Additional Information

Hive Phase 3 follow-up, low priority. Requested by the Phase 3 coordinator when accepting #1557. Links: #1496, #1557.
closed_recent.title: [Hive] queued Bee turns wait indefinitely after a retire=False definition bump

## Problem
#1714 (fix for #1710) added "Warn if upload ... failed" steps to `.github/workflows/ci.yml` (lines ~521, 542, 684, 703 on main) with `shell: pwsh`. The self-hosted runners `dm-hk-ci-03`, `digitalmate-win-st-02` and `digitalmate-win-st-03` have no `pwsh`, so while the Actions artifact quota is hit these steps fail with `pwsh: command not found`. That fails node-ut, hypium-ut and st, then gate-report. The uploads themselves no longer fail the job, but the warning steps do.

Seen on PR #1723 head 6c9792a6; it blocks every open PR until the quota renews.

## Fix
Write the warning steps so they run on every runner (for example bash `echo "::warning ..."` plus `>> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"` on Linux and the shell matching each runner OS), and/or give them `continue-on-error: true` so a warning can never fail a job. If the steps are generated, change the generator, not just ci.yml.

## Done when
On a PR while the quota is still hit, node-ut, hypium-ut, st and gate-report pass, and the warning shows in the job summary.

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### What happens

In `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase2_owned_bee_process.py::test_owned_bee_process_starts_and_stops[crash]`, the test passes, but the Bee-owned WorkSwarm processes outlive it. They are left re-parented to PID 1:
- `jiuwenswarm.server.app_agentserver`
- `jiuwenswarm.gateway.app_gateway`
- their `server_engine.search_mcp` child

All of them run with `--dotenv <basetemp>/test_owned_bee_process_starts_1/bee-workswarm/.jiuwenswarm/config/.env`.

Seen in the Phase 3 runtime-gated sweep on `hive/hive3-integration` 64e691b6: installed-wheel env, workswarm 0.2.5b1, serial runs, private HOME and JIUWENSWARM_HOME. The processes had to be killed by hand afterwards. A similar leftover appeared once after `test_workswarm_network_stop` (launcher, agentserver, gateway, search_mcp).

### Why it matters

- **On a host:** when the owned launcher crashes, its runtime children keep running and hold their ports and model connections. Nothing reaps them.
- **On a shared Mac:** the leftovers belong to no session, so they confuse port checks and process checks.

### Expected

When the owned Bee launcher dies, its WorkSwarm children are stopped as well, either through a process group or session plus kill on parent death, or through a Host recovery sweep that finds and stops orphans for a retired generation. The `[crash]` case should then assert that no child of that dotenv is still alive once the test ends.

Not G5-blocking. Refs #1316.
closed_recent.title: hive: a crashed owned Bee launcher leaves its WorkSwarm agentserver, gateway and search_mcp running

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### Problem

The repository's GitHub Actions **artifact storage quota is full**. `architecture-conformance` fails in its "Upload trusted architecture evidence" step (`actions/upload-artifact@v4`, `if-no-files-found: error`):

> Failed to CreateArtifact: Artifact storage quota has been hit. Unable to upload any new artifacts. Usage is recalculated every 6-12 hours.

`gate-report` then fails too, because it reads `GATE_ARCHITECTURE_RESULT=failure`. The conformance scan itself passed; only the upload failed. So every PR is currently red for a reason unrelated to its code.

### Evidence

- PR #1703, run 43843436902: `architecture-conformance` job 133217554857 fails at the upload step, and `gate-report` job 133220344327 fails on the aggregate. #1703 was merged while these two checks were red, which breaks the merge rule (see the note on #1703).
- PR #1705 (#1701) is blocked by the same two checks.
- The #1659 bot review had already flagged that artifact storage usage and quota should be checked.

### Expected

- Short term: free or raise the quota. That needs the repository owner, because deleting old artifacts is an owner action.
- In repo: a quota or upload failure of evidence that no later job consumes should not turn a gate red. Use `continue-on-error` plus a visible warning on the upload, and keep the job's verdict tied to the scan result, as #1656 did for other uploads. If `gate-report` or another job downloads that evidence, record the evidence somewhere it can still be read, for example the job summary, instead.
- Give heavy uploads a short `retention-days`, so the quota doesn't fill up again.

Found while coordinating the post-HIVE lanes. Related: #1659, #1656.
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: Actions artifact quota full; architecture-conformance and gate-report fail on the evidence upload for every PR

Found in the Phase 3 Store schema review of #1484, at hive/hive3-integration bddb7973.

**Problem.** `UNIQUE(run_id, call_id)` on `dm_hive_bee_effect_plans` (`server_engine/session_proximity/hive_busy.py:69-70`) assumes the model's tool-call id is unique within a Run. `call_id` comes straight from the model (`deploy/runtime_patches/session_unload.py:377`), and `operation_id` is built from it (`temp/hive-runtime/src/dm_hive_runtime/assembly/bee_effects.py:189`).

**Failure scenario.** Some OpenAI-compatible gateways reuse ids such as `call_0` on every iteration. When that happens:
- an identical second call is "replayed" with the first result and never executed;
- a different second call is refused as a "conflict".

**Fix.** Have the Host mint a per-Run step ordinal and include it in the key and in `operation_id`. Migrate the existing rows. Add a test with a reused call_id.

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
**Target: v3.5.** Part of #1533; related to the Hive fold #1605. Owner task DM31-A07.

## Why
On the Router-free Bridge (#1313) the mail-report pipeline cannot generate anything. Its agent (`server_engine/report_runtime.py`) admitted every report turn through `SessionManager.submit_event` into the legacy task executor, and both are retired:
- `server.py:498` builds `EngineService(..., legacy_execution=False)` (b261db165).
- `engine_service.py:2089-2091`: `check_legacy_request` refuses every `_LEGACY_EXECUTION_ACTIONS` member, and `task.create` is one (`:275-277`), so `engine.apply(task.create, run=True)` gets FORBIDDEN "Legacy task execution is disabled".
- `engine_service.py:3832-3833`: `EngineService._run` calls `require_legacy_execution` first, so a direct run is fenced too. The flag is per engine instance, and re-enabling it would reopen the whole legacy executor that G6's fence guards.
- `dm_sessions/service.py:76-79`: `submit_event` always returns `Rejected(TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE)`.

Re-verified on main `1e194a86` (2026-11-16): every stage raises `ReportGenerationUnavailable`, a `ModelResultError` with code `REPORT_GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE` (c0689be50, #1649). `ReportGoals` records it as the goal's final `processing_error` / `processing_error_code`; nothing retries it. Ingest, goals, cards, detail and download keep working. That is a Phase 3 §7a known limit.

## Why not the person's Home conversation
Admitting report turns as Beebou Home inputs (`HiveTurnStartup.send_message`) works mechanically, but it was rejected:
- **It leaks.** The report prompts and the inlined mail evidence would become user turns in the person's Beebou conversation, and from there reach Global Memory, because live memory ingestion reads Beebou history (`server.py:1155-1160`).
- **No isolation exists.** Hive has exactly one Beebou per scope: `HiveTurnStartup` holds a single binding (`hive_turn_startup.py:313`), and the Store resolves "exactly one scoped Beebou" (`hive_store.py:1058-1061`). `accept(room_ref=...)` is only an origin label (`hive_turn_startup.py:325-332`).
- **Bees can't read the inputs.** Home inputs and Bees read one original PDF only (`hive_home_trial.py:231-239`, `engine_attachments.py:427-447`, `bee_input_pdf.py`). The report's text evidence and its prior .pptx cannot reach a Bee, and a PPTX deliverable needs a Bee with file tools.

## Decision (Phase 3 coordinator, 2026-11-16): Option 1, a report Bee with file inputs
Each report turn is one **Host-admitted NewTask** to a dedicated, **Host-only report Bee** of the principal. There is no Beebou model call. The evidence (and, for edit_ppt, the prior deck) travels as file input sources. Nothing enters the person's Home conversation, Beebou history or Global Memory ingestion.

**Option 2 (report-scoped Beebou Session) is rejected**: it breaks the Store's one-Beebou-per-scope invariant.

Spec: `docs/implementations/contracts/hive-report-bee-v1.md` (decisions RB-D1..D11, scenarios RB-S1..S8). Recorded in `beebou-hive-phase3-delivery.md` §7a ("Mail-report generation on Hive").

### Module ownership
| Module | Owner | Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `temp/report-goals` (`dm_report_goals.hive`, `config/report_bee.toml`) | Report goal owner (DM31-A07) | Turn text, identities (`message_id`, `conversation_ref`), evidence file, result parsing, error codes, tunables |
| `server_engine/report_runtime.py`, `report_http.py` | Report goal owner | Provision the report Bee, upload evidence (Attachment owner), admit, drive the report Bee's lane, map errors; `mount_reports(..., hive=bridge.report_hive)` |
| `session_proximity/hive_store.py`, `hive_busy.py` | Hive Store owner | `activate_host_bee` (slotless, purpose fixed), `admit_host_task` / `read_host_task` (dispatcher `host:<purpose>`, replay by message ID), refuse bot deliveries to Host Bees, never push notices of Host tasks |
| `temp/hive-worker` | Bot Repository owner | `host_only` template `report`: not offered to Beebou, outside the roster, `register(host=True)` |

### Delivery
- Part 1 (#1695): Host admission plus the JSON stages (correlate, brief, revise, mail_update). ppt/edit_ppt end with `REPORT_DECK_UNAVAILABLE` (final).
- Part 2 (#1696, stacked on #1695, `Fixes` this issue): ppt/edit_ppt. The report Bee returns slide JSON; the Host renders the PPTX (`office_documents`) and stores it through the Hive document byte owner (`HiveDocumentBytes`), so no Bee document grant is needed (Bee document tools stay an effects-mode trial). The prior deck travels as an input with its Host-extracted slide text. Artifact provenance: `artifact_ref`, `task_id` (the `host:report` task), the byte receipt `document`, and `source_artifact_ref`. Download and the prior-deck read go through the byte owner. A missing or unreadable prior deck is `REPORT_PRIOR_DECK_UNAVAILABLE`. Spec RB-D12/D13.

## Done when
- [ ] Owner tests on the real Store/Host path run every stage (correlate, brief, revise, mail_update, ppt, edit_ppt) with a controlled model. Part 1 covers the four JSON stages.
- [ ] Nothing reaches the Home conversation, Beebou inputs, memory ingestion or a pushed notice. Beebou cannot list, reuse or dispatch to the report Bee.
- [ ] Replay is idempotent on `turn.request_id`. The error mapping holds: retryable admission states raise RuntimeError (the operation stays pending); a refused admission, a failed or stopped task, or an unusable result raises `ModelResultError` (ValueError, final).
- [ ] edit_ppt keeps the prior-deck input, and artifact provenance is preserved (part 2).
- [ ] With a Bee runtime, the fail-closed owner tests are replaced by working-flow tests (`temp/report-goals/tests/test_report_bee.py`). A Bridge without a Bee runtime still fails every stage closed with `REPORT_GENERATION_UNAVAILABLE`, tested in `test_report_runtime.py`, `test_report_http.py` and `test_report_ws.py`.
- [ ] Related suites pass locally, and test names match the enrolled suite patterns (`test_report*.py`, `test_hive_worker_*.py`).

A patch of the rejected Home-conversation prototype follows in a comment. It shows the Beebou admission mechanics.
closed_recent.title: Report generation on Hive: Bee with file inputs or report-scoped Beebou session (DM31-A07)

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
## What happens

In one normal turn, Beebou dispatches a `new` task to a Bee and then steers that same new task, sending almost the same text a second time. The Host accepts both calls, so the Bee gets the request twice.

## Evidence (hive3 `6cac213b`, DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017, run `pf-6cac213b`)

`artifacts/hive-live/pf-6cac213b/HIVE-LIVE-STEER-04/r2/trace.json`, turn T2. The user said "再补充一点：开业前三天全场八折。" after T1's task had finished.

1. `dispatch {id: bee-9571…, mode: new, text: "用户补充了一条关键信息，请据此更新上一版…"}` returned `accepted`, `task_0125535a…`, queued. This alone is the expected `new:reuse`.
2. `dispatch {id: bee-9571…, mode: steer, task_ref: task_0125535a…, text: "再次确认：上一个任务请直接作废，改用本条要求。用户补充的是：开业前三天全场八折…"}` returned `accepted`, delivery pending.

The grader recorded the decision `new:reuse+steer` against the allowed set `new:reuse | answer`, so FAIL. It happened in 1 of 3 repeats; r1 and r3, and p3's 3 repeats on be000e5e, did not.

## Expected

A turn should not steer a task that it created itself in the same turn. Options:
- The Host refuses a steer whose `task_ref` came from a `new` dispatch earlier in the same turn, returning a clear status the model can read.
- Or the Beebou prompt or skill says so.

## Owner

Beebou prompt or skill, and the Host dispatch guard (Hive Host tools).

Found by the Hive behaviour QA post-fix pass (#1244 SC04-E2, Phase 3 tracker #1533).
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: Beebou steers the task it just created in the same turn (new + steer of its own task_ref); the Bee gets the request twice

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### 🐞 Problem

**Beebou tells the user a steer/addition was already added or delivered while the steer receipt is still `delivery_state=pending` and has not been consumed.**

`HIVE-LIVE-STEER-01` (real DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 + pinned WorkSwarm, installed wheels from `hive/hive3-integration` @ `780c7402`; application sources identical at `6cac213b`):

- r1 and r2 each record one original NewTask, then a steer receipt to the same Bee and `task_ref` with `delivery_state=pending`. Each Store contains only one task, so there is no duplicate NewTask.
- At the end of the observation window, both steer inputs still had `consumed_at_ms = NULL`.
- The normal reply nevertheless described the addition as already added/delivered.

This is evidence of an overstatement before consumption. It does not prove anything about consumption after the observation window.

### Expected

When the steer receipt is `pending` (admitted, not consumed), the reply says it was accepted or queued for the running task (e.g. "I've passed that on; it will be picked up by the running task"). It does not say it was applied. A consumption witness (`consumed_at_ms`) is required before saying it was added or applied.

### Scope

- Same family as #1618 (quick-reply state claims) and #1537, but on the normal-turn reply wording after a steer admission.
- Not a G5 gate blocker. Deferred until after the Router-retirement cutover (#1605). Tracked under #1533.

### Evidence (QA Mac)

Traces: `/private/tmp/dm1618/live/cand-780c7402/HIVE-LIVE-STEER-01/` and summary `/private/tmp/dm1618/receipt.md` (Codex targeted regression).
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: reply says a steer was added while its receipt is still pending and unconsumed (STEER-01)

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### Problem

A question card raised by a Bee's `ask_user` doesn't name the asking Bee. On the SC04-C1 device run against `hive/hive3-integration` @ `6cac213b`, Beta's card read "Beebou 想问你". #1651 changes Hive cards to a generic "Bee 想问你", but the Bee's name still isn't shown.

### Cause (client lane)

- `question_card()` (`server_engine/hive_bee_execution.py:411`) carries no Bee label.
- The snapshot's `hive_tasks` row has only `bee_id`.
- Bee names live only in `hive.activity.get` lanes, which Home reads only while Activity is open.

### Expected

The card shows "{Bee label} 想问你". A display label is added to the `hive.result.get` interaction, or to `hive_tasks` rows, and the client renders it for `hive:` cards.

### Scope

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### Problem

**A Bee-targeted attachment is stored and bound to the Bee's input, but never reaches the Bee runtime or workspace.**

SC04-C1 device run two on `hive/hive3-integration` @ `b02c2ef6` (tree identical to #1605's head `47e5a102`). Direct instance, emulator, real model, client from #1651:

- The per-Bee composer's 添加附件 uploaded `c1s1-alpha-attach.txt`. The device, the relay upload and Pod storage (`digitalmate/attachments/attachment-d934…/`) all show sha256 `e5dc0836…`, 1277 bytes.
- `hive.message.send` carried `source_ids=[attachment-d934…]` with Alpha's `target_session_ref`, and the send settled ("已提交给 Bee").
- Store input seq 7 (`new` → Alpha) carries `source_ids [message_id, attachment-d934…]`. Alpha's run ended normally, and its reply returned to Alpha's lane.
- **But Alpha's runtime turn received only the text**: no file content or path. No copy of the file exists in the Bee workspace. Alpha said it couldn't read the file, because its tools are limited to `ask_user`.
- In beebou, `delivery/messages.py` raises "a native queue cannot carry an attachment or quote".

Bytes match all the way from the device to the Bee's input row, but not at the Bee.

### Expected

Sources bound to a Bee input are materialized into that Bee's workspace, or otherwise given to its runtime turn, under its grants. The Bee can read the file.

### Scope

- Server: the Bee input → runtime/workspace materialization.
- Possibly the Bee's read grant for attached sources.

This was never available before: there was no Bee-targeted attachment path on main. It fails the attachment part of SC04-C1 S1, and is recorded in the post-merge device receipt on #1533. Follow-up after cutover #1605.

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
## What fails

On `hive/hive3-integration`, the Home busy scenarios fail. The runs below were on HK Linux with installed wheels, the pinned WorkSwarm `0.2.5b1`, `WORKSWARM_RUNTIME_TESTS=1` and a private TMPDIR, one file at a time.

| File | Router-free `cfff8368` (no #1604) | hive3 `faf4aaab` | #1651 `e4aedb19` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `tests/scenarios/hive/test_home_busy_steer.py` (3) | 3 passed | 3 failed | 3 failed |
| `tests/scenarios/hive/test_home_busy_preempt.py` (4) | 4 passed | 4 failed | 4 failed |
| `tests/scenarios/hive/test_home_busy_queue_owner.py` (3) | 3 passed | 3 failed | 3 failed |
| `tests/scenarios/hive/test_phase3_busy_gateway.py` (12) | — | — | 12 passed |

First failing assertions, identical on `faf4aaab` and `e4aedb19`:

- **steer:** `AssertionError: 'busy_controls' unexpectedly found in {...snapshot...}`. Affects `test_home_steer_reconciles_original_operation_and_applies_once`, `test_raw_home_replay_does_not_upgrade_the_original_room_authority` and `test_uncertain_commit_reconciles_without_redispatching_a_supplement`.
- **preempt:** `{'id': 'preempt', 'ok': False, 'error': {'code': 'BUSY_CONTROL_UNSUPPORTED', 'message': 'the server has not declared t…', 'details': {..., 'field': 'action', 'reason': 'not_declared'}}}`. Affects all 4 tests.
- **queue_owner:** `'BUSY_CONTROL_UNSUPPORTED' != 'BAD_PARAMS'`. Affects all 3 tests.

## Which change introduced it

- **Not #1651.** The failures are the same with and without it (`e4aedb19` vs `faf4aaab`).
- **The merge of #1596 (Router-free) with #1604** brought them in: the tests pass on Router-free `cfff8368`, which lacks #1604, and fail once both are in hive3 (`3124edca` onward).
  - **preempt and queue** look like a **product regression**. On Router-free, `HiveHomeTrial` handled Home queue and preempt natively. In the merged build, #1604's `HiveBusyGateway` declares only steer, answer and stop (queue and preempt wait for #1597) and answers first. So Home preempt and queue that worked on Router-free are now refused `BUSY_CONTROL_UNSUPPORTED`.
  - **steer** fails on the snapshot shape: #1604 publishes `busy_controls`, and the test expects it absent. This looks like a stale expectation. It overlaps #1666, which hits the same `'busy_controls'` expectation in the trial-composition tests.

## Scope

- These files are not owner tests of any G5/G6 row and are not in CI. The G5/G6 verdicts on `6cac213b`/`faf4aaab` are unchanged.
- Home preempt and queue are user-facing on the merged build. Decide whether HiveBusyGateway should delegate queue and preempt to HiveHomeTrial until #1597, or whether the Router-free native controls should be declared through it.

Reports on HK: `~/oc-out/hive-focused-cfff83680575/`, `~/oc-out/hive-focused-e4aedb190963/`, and `~/oc-out/hive-official-faf4aaab87d4/test_home_busy_*.log`.

## Ruling and fix (G5 coordinator, 2026-11-16)

- **Not a merge blocker for #1605.** On the merged build, Home preempt and queue are refused cleanly with `BUSY_CONTROL_UNSUPPORTED` (`not_declared`): no hang, no data loss. Since #1651 the HAP offers only the controls listed in `busy_controls`, so users see no preempt or queue button while they are undeclared.
- **Cause.** The Router-free native Home preempt and queue path (`HiveHomeTrial`) was shadowed by #1604's `HiveBusyGateway` when #1596 was merged into hive3.
- **Fix: #1597.** Either declare preempt and queue in the gateway and route them to the native path, or delegate them to `HiveHomeTrial`.
- **Acceptance tests.** The three Home busy scenarios above: `test_home_busy_steer.py`, `test_home_busy_preempt.py` and `test_home_busy_queue_owner.py`, run with the pinned WorkSwarm runtime.
- **Steer.** The steer failure is the snapshot-shape assertion (`'busy_controls' unexpectedly found`), the same as #1666.

Related: #1597 (declare queue and preempt), #1604 (H-C8 busy gateway), #1596 (Router-free build), #1666.
closed_recent.title: test(hive): Home busy scenarios (steer/preempt/queue_owner) fail on hive3 — stale busy_controls / BUSY_CONTROL_UNSUPPORTED expectations

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
Follow-up from #1243 SC02-C2 (Gateway entry for the H-C8 busy-time controls). *Updated 2026-11-16 after #1605 folded Project Hive into main (498bc351).*

## What is missing on main

The Host executor now exists: the native Router-free Home path admits a real queued task (`submit_home_queue`, `finish_queue_delivery`) and runs the preempt (`bee_stop.py`, stop original, then successor). What is missing is the routing: #1604's `HiveBusyGateway` is consulted before `HiveHomeTrial.control` and refuses `session.queue`/`session.preempt` with `BUSY_CONTROL_UNSUPPORTED` (`not_declared`), so the configured Home controls are unreachable. `operation.get` of a Home-admitted operation returns the gateway's receipt shape (no `replayed`, `BAD_PARAMS` instead of `SESSION_TARGET_UNKNOWN`, no Home authorization), and a read-only Home still publishes the gateway's `busy_controls`. Same root cause as #1669 and #1666.

## Done when

- A Bridge with the Home queue/preempt trials routes `session.queue`/`session.preempt` and the `operation.get` of Home-admitted operations to the Home control manager, and declares `queue`/`preempt` in `busy_controls`. Steer/answer/stop stay on the gateway where the Home does not own them; with no Home controls configured the refusal stays.
- A read-only Home publishes no `busy_controls`.
- Acceptance: the three Home busy files (`test_home_busy_steer.py`, `test_home_busy_preempt.py`, `test_home_busy_queue_owner.py`, run with the pinned WorkSwarm runtime) and a CI-collected Bridge-level regression in `test_phase3_busy_gateway.py` (no WorkSwarm).
- G5 rows are unchanged: SC02-C3 E24/E34 stay `NOT_RUN` (two-device contention deferred to v3.5, 2026-11-16 design §7a decision). The runtime-gated Home files are not enrolled in CI.
closed_recent.title: [Hive Phase 3] Host executor for H-C8 queue and preempt turns (SC02-C2 E11/E12, SC02-C3 E24/E34)

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
Follow-up to [#1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533) and PR [#1652](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1652). Target: v3.5.

## Problem
A Bee Run that has entered the Harness can be left RUNNING with no terminal, and nothing ever settles it. Seen as run_9ce80c4f on candidate 6cac213b (an empty `chat.final`; #1652 fixes that one cause). Other ways to the same state exist: the runtime cannot show a fresh COMPLETED proof (stream error, restart, evicted Session, UNKNOWN/BUSY/FAILED/STALE), or the process restarts after a claim was entered.

Today `resume_running` returns `unresolved` for an entered claim with no durable queue head. #1611's unavailable terminal covers only queued, never-claimed tasks. There is no timeout or restart reconciliation. The Run stays RUNNING, the input stays unconsumed, the Bee lane is blocked, and the device shows "发送结果待确认" / "Bee 正在处理" indefinitely.

## Scope
1. Recover orphaned RUNNING Bee Runs after a restart or a missing terminal. Settle each one through the existing failed-turn commit (Run ended, task failed with a notice, inputs settled after the Store commit). The isolation witness must come from Host evidence (the runtime's fresh proof, or proof that the runtime Session is gone), never from a timer alone. Thresholds and timeouts go in config.
2. Add the missing test: an empty final on a queued supplement (`queue:<seq>` turn) ends the task failed once. #1652 shares the code path but has no dedicated test.
3. State what the client shows for a failed task with `reason: empty_final` and empty text. The client wording belongs to the client side.

## Done when
An enrolled owner test shows an orphaned RUNNING Run reaches a terminal state with its input consumed exactly once and the Bee lane free, on the real Store, after a simulated restart and with an unproven runtime.
closed_recent.title: Recover orphaned RUNNING Bee Runs after restart or a missing terminal (e.g. run_9ce80c4f)

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### Problem

#1670's fix (PR #1677, merged as c5a4f30b) makes the Host copy each attachment of a Bee input into the Bee's per-Task folder, `<Bee runtime home>/hive-inputs/<sha256(task_ref)>/<source_id>/<name>`. That lets the ask-only Bee read it.

When the Attachment owner later erases or revokes that source (`engine_attachments.py`), the Host copy under `hive-inputs/` stays on disk. Nothing ties the copy's lifetime to the source's or the Task's. The PR lists this as a known limit.

### Evidence

- `temp/hive-runtime/src/dm_hive_runtime/assembly/bee_input_sources.py` (`BeeInputSources._place`) writes the copy. No code path removes it.
- The revoke check happens only at the next turn's start (`Attachments.read_bee_input_source`), so later turns are fenced. The bytes already copied are not removed.

### Expected

- Erasing or revoking an attachment removes every Host copy of it under `hive-inputs/`.
- Ending a Task (or retiring or evicting the Bee) removes that Task's input folder, after a configured retention.
- Retention values go in config.
- Text already delivered into a Bee Session stays there, as #1602 already accepts.

### Done when

Tests on the real Attachment owner and Bee runtime home show that the copy is gone after erasure and after Task retention, and that no other Task's folder is touched.

Follow-up of #1670, under #1665.
closed_recent.title: [Bug]: Host copies of Bee input attachments under hive-inputs/ survive attachment erasure and Task end

closed_recent.author: niuypei
closed_recent.body:
### Current disposition — superseded planning RFC (2026-11-16)

The current v3.1 refactoring authority is #737, with milestones and forecast in #963, based on Hive main `498bc351` (#1605). This older parallel master RFC is closed as **not_planned / superseded**, not delivered. PR #509 is closed and unmerged, so its proposed tree and branch-specific tests are not the current-main baseline.

The continuing modularization obligations are explicitly retained: source/class/state/lock mapping and directory convergence → #845; Runtime/ingress/lifecycle → #759/#763/#769; Host/model/tool boundaries → #754/#758/#799; source/artifact/connector ownership → #777/#781/#784/#833/#834; memory transactions and provenance → #791/#810; sole scheduler → #795/#836/#837; unchanged-client, production and independent QA → #827/#828. Documentation authority and historical dispositions → #848. Existing product Team removals are not reversed by this closure; any opt-in Harness proposal in #737 remains explicitly separate and must be reconciled against supported behavior before implementation.

No whole-branch merge, fixed old directory layout, blanket no-schema-change restriction or obsolete execution architecture from this RFC governs new v3.1 work. Supported behavior, data, privacy, compatibility and useful old evidence retain their original scope and must be accounted for by the receiving owners. #1665 product follow-ups remain a separate delivery line.


<details>
<summary>Original RFC and branch-specific plan — retained historical record</summary>

### Background and Goal Description

DigitalMate 后端模块化重构的最新范围是：每个业务任务选择一个主 Agent，保留执行器内部子 Agent；删除产品 Team、独立 Agent 委托、跨 Agent 评审和自动交接。App 连接、普通房间、人工 Pair、用户问答、工具审批、记忆与来源治理继续保留。

本 RFC 继续作为重构总跟踪项。首阶段代码已在 PR #509 提交，尚未合并；后续工作是类、方法、状态和依赖的拆分。先完成模块化，再单独讨论 DigitalMate 插件化；本轮不接入 JiuwenSwarm 插件机制、不改前端为插件、不新增进程、不改数据库 schema，也不恢复已退出的进程内 TeamBackend/DeepAgentBackend。

**基线：** 原 RFC 的分析基线为 `2336d5b2`。首阶段 PR 从 `8cc7213926f0553577476a5fe64c1061f3e944b6` 开发，当前 head 为 `f9b04e4783df277e1dc5d4ec02c355ebff41f693`。2026-11-04 核对到上游 main 为 `1432414e63f97f6510a34b096722a05de286c1b7`；该提交不是当前重构代码基线。后续开始拆分前先审查两者差异、确定需要纳入的改动，并更新映射所用 SHA，不将“最新 main”与已测试的 PR head 混用。

### Proposed Solution

#### 1. 范围与工程布局

当前生产执行经 WorkSwarm WebSocket 接入，`ScriptedBackend` 作为测试替身保留。vendor 内的 WorkSwarm、agent-core 固定源码保持完整，不因为删除 DigitalMate 产品 Team 而裁剪平台内部 Team/子 Agent 实现。

下列列出收敛后的模块、必要子目录及本次拆分涉及的职责文件，每个文件均注明用途，不使用通配符占位。现有代码已迁移到主干目录；“拟新增”表示待提取的文件，“过渡”表示仍需拆分或调整归属的现有文件，其余文件继续承担所注明的职责。包初始化文件和未展开子目录中的完整文件清单见后文索引，不因未展开而删除。

│   │       ├── jiuwenswarm/        # 平台会话、事件、产物和受管启动
│   │       ├── connectors/         # 各 App API、OAuth 和监听实现
│   │       ├── models/             # 模型协议、HTTP、错误与重试
│   │       ├── storage/            # SQLite、事务、迁移和存储实现
│   │       ├── filesystem/         # 文件、工作目录与路径约束
│   │       ├── mandate/            # 账本和 Host 集成
│   │       ├── process/            # 子进程启动和退出监控
│   │       ├── mem2.py             # Mem2 内容存储适配
│   │       ├── mem2_migration.py   # Mem2 命名、元数据与索引别名迁移
│   │       ├── human_runtime.py    # 人工提问/回答的运行接口适配，非新增主 Agent 路径
│   │       ├── model_profile.py    # 模型调用耗时等无正文诊断元数据
│   │       ├── office.py           # OfficeCLI 渲染与结构化编辑
│   │       ├── office_documents.py # Office 文档生成与发布校验
│   │       ├── system_proxy.py     # 宿主代理到子进程环境的转换
│   │       └── web_push.py         # Web Push 订阅、签名与加密发送
│   ├── tests/
│   └── deploy/
├── packages/
│   ├── protocol/                   # 端云通信类型和共享资源
│   └── core/                       # 客户端辅助能力，单向依赖 protocol
└── vendor/
    ├── workswarm/
    ├── agent-core/
    └── manifests/
```

减少只有一个职责文件的子目录；memory/source 不机械复制 application/domain/ports 多层结构。harness 不再单列 routing、turns、conversations、policies、delivery、skills、artifacts 等重复层级。仍存在的 `harness/native/context_budget.py` 在后续依据调用关系迁入 context 或作为无调用遗留删除，不保留一个原生执行器子系统。

#### 2. 模块和依赖边界

| 模块 | 职责与对外能力 | 边界理由 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| server | 外部协议、可信身份上下文、连接/推送、依赖装配和关闭 | 统一 Gateway 后仍需要协议和生命周期处理；业务授权由对应业务模块执行 |
| application | 请求受理、幂等、跨域查询、任务用例、结果提交、恢复和失效协调 | 跨模块操作有统一入口；避免继续把所有业务堆入 Bridge/EngineService |
| harness | 意图到任务完成的业务执行策略 | 使用平台执行能力；不复制 agent-core loop，不把子 Agent 变成独立业务委托 |
| workspace | 房间、消息、待办、人工协作和结果资产 | 长期产品状态不随一次 Agent 执行结束 |
| memory | 新业务记忆的统一治理入口和访问规则 | SQL/Mem2 更换不改变授权、纠错、遗忘和 Undo 语义；历史手机记忆保留，导入规则另定 |
| source | 来源权威记录、连接授权、修订、附件与入站治理 | 收到外部事件与允许启动任务分开；供应商 API 实现不决定业务准入 |
| contracts/shared | 跨域稳定契约 / 领域无关基础 | 外部 Request、领域实体、SQL 实现不全部堆入 general；不允许反向依赖 server/具体服务/adapter |
| adapters | 平台、数据库、供应商和 OS 具体实现 | 通过消费方需要的小接口注入，防止业务层直接持有全部基础设施 |

目标调用关系：server 将外部请求转换为用例输入 → application 协调 harness/workspace/memory/source → 业务模块使用窄接口 → server 装配并注入 adapters。跨模块协作优先由 application 编排；必要直接调用使用已声明接口，不传入整个 EngineService。

外部 `EngineRequest`/`ClientContext` 保留协议入口归属和兼容解析。内部执行结果、事件和异常从 server 类型中抽出；内部命令按动作组逐步收窄。compat re-export 只用于过渡，记录调用方、删除条件和唯一实现，不能靠把所有类搬进 contracts 规避依赖问题。领域 Binding 与跨平台 DTO 的所有权须明确，消除当前 `contracts/execution.py → adapters/storage/workspace.py` 的反向依赖，不引入两份可写会话状态。

产品 Gate 与 WorkSwarm 工具权限分别说明执行点、状态所有者和手机端交互。保持既有默认策略，分别验证受管运行时权限开/关以及外部运行时；不把产品审批通过视作平台所有工具已经受控。

#### 3. 核心拆分清单（当前路径 → 目标职责）

所有 Python 路径相对 `backend/src/digitalmate_backend/`；目标文件名为本轮建议，允许在保持所有权清晰的前提下微调。

| 当前类/方法 | 拆分方向 | 理由与需要一起迁移的状态 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `server/api/bridge.py::Bridge.__init__/start/stop` | server/bootstrap.py、lifecycle.py；Bridge 保留协议入口 | 创建、注册、关闭归同一装配边界；连接、后台任务和关闭顺序一并记录 |
| `Bridge._digitalmate_execute/_execute_jiuwen/_attach/_backend_for` | harness/execution 的协调器、会话与事件组件 | 去掉 application 回调 WS Bridge 的执行链；平台 RPC 仍归 jiuwenswarm adapter；映射、等待和取消状态唯一 |
| `Bridge._execute_jiuwen` 内 prompt 和回复处理 | harness/context、harness/replies | 先提取不持有会话/事务的规则，再迁移有状态执行；子 Agent final 不作为主答完成 |
| `application/service.py::EngineService.snapshot/_message_window/_earlier_messages` | application/queries.py 调用 workspace/memory 查询接口 | 跨域快照属于用例查询；避免引入第二份缓存或权限判断 |
| `EngineService._handle_request/_turn` | 按动作组的应用用例；任务、记忆、来源逻辑回所属模块 | request/apply 的幂等受理保留统一包装，不能每个 handler 再做一遍 |
| `EngineService._turn` 的 publish、错误与超时提交 | application/task_results.py 协调 harness/workspace/memory | 结果生成与业务提交分离；有效性检查、锁、事务、最终事件顺序作为一组迁移 |
| `harness/tasks/router.py::EngineRouter/JevClient` | 业务路由留 tasks；模型 HTTP/重试/解析归 adapters/models | 不把业务 thread 选择与供应商协议绑在同一个对象中 |
| `adapters/storage/workspace.py` 内 Task/Question/Signal、Room/Message、Source/Connection 等 | 记录模型回 harness/workspace/source 等所属模块；SQLite 实现留 adapter | 模型不能为了通用而放入 shared；持久化字段和旧记录读取格式保持兼容 |
| `EngineStore.recover_submissions/recover_submission` 及构造期业务恢复 | application/recovery.py | 打开数据库和决定业务如何恢复分开；原连接、事务、after_commit 和写锁保留统一核心 |
| `adapters/storage/memory_catalog.py::EngineMemory` 及记忆模型 | 模型、访问和治理回 memory；SQL 留 storage；内容库接口由 memory 定义 | 按方法内业务判断和 SQL 分块，避免把混合类整搬到另一个目录 |
| `memory/step.py::MemoryStep`、`_LOCKS/_HELD` | memory 内轮次/变更/撤销组件和显式注入的共享协调对象 | 学习、更正、遗忘、Undo、恢复共用同一 workspace 的锁和 pending 状态 |
| `source/connections/registry.py::ConnectionRegistry.build/build_items` | 连接业务留 source；客户端构造与缓存进入 adapters/connectors/factory.py | 保留全部 App；将业务授权与供应商实例生命周期分开 |
| `source/inbound/events.py::EventLoopManager` | source 入站/历史同步；供应商监听归 adapter；任务准入经 application/harness | 历史补拉不应意外启动新任务；关闭、重启和去重责任明确 |
| `source/attachments.py::Attachments` | source 用户附件治理、filesystem 字节存储、harness 执行产物和平台产物适配 | 用户文件与运行产物的授权及生命周期不同 |
| `contracts/records.py` 中 Todo/Screen/View/Pair/Trigger/Grant 等 | 按实际拥有者回 workspace/harness | contracts 保留稳定跨域协作类型；旧 Team 记录只支持读取和清理，不能重新获得执行入口 |

每一项同时维护正向与反向映射，至少包含：源 SHA/文件/类/方法、目标模块/接口、拆分理由、字段/锁/缓存/任务/关闭所有者、调用方、兼容入口及移除条件、实施批次和验收项。现有文件级 CSV 是起点，不代表方法级映射已完成。

**文件索引维护方式：**

- 索引与代码一起进入仓库，作为重构映射台账；本 issue 维护入口链接及阶段进度，不再复制另一份逐文件清单。
- 当前已提交的文件级索引是 `docs/developer_guide/backend-module-map.csv`。后续每个重构 PR 同步更新；P1 补充类/方法双向映射与状态所有权，不能把文件搬迁完成等同于类拆分完成。
- 审视基线使用固定 commit 链接。首阶段 PR 合入 `refactor/backend` 后，补充该分支的“最新进度索引”入口，同时保留基线链接；合入前使用下文当前 PR head 的可访问链接。
- GitHub 不会自动同步源码与索引。每个 PR 检查新增、拆分、合并、删除和兼容项的映射；目标文件存在性等可做轻量自动检查，职责和状态归属仍需评审。
- 重构完成后索引归档保留，用于定位旧代码和追溯迁移；长期架构文档描述最终目录及职责，不要求历史映射追踪以后所有普通代码修改。

#### 4. 分阶段开发计划

| 阶段 | 工作与交付 | 验收/退出条件 | 当前状态 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P0 范围收敛与迁根目录 | 删除产品 Team/peer 流程；backend/packages/vendor 归位；基础协议拆包 | 当前 PR 描述的聚焦测试、vendor 身份、打包与路径检查；保留原协议及历史记录读取 | PR #509 已提交，未合并；仍有真实部署验收待补 |
| P1 同步设计和基线 | 更新本 RFC；审查 upstream 差异；刷新双向映射、状态所有者和路径耦合清单；建立可复放事件基线 | 清单不再迁移不存在的 native/Ambient Team 派发实现；可由仓库固定 SHA 链接复核 | RFC 范围、目录及阶段计划已更新；映射刷新等工作待实施 |
| P2 基础模型与依赖边界 | 领域记录回所属域；内部执行契约抽出 server；外部请求按动作组转换；保留临时兼容导出 | 存储/协议格式兼容；contracts 不依赖 storage；已迁组件无 server 反向依赖 | 待实施 |
| P3 入口装配与跨域用例 | 拆 Bridge 装配/生命周期；先抽查询，再逐组抽命令；幂等与快照仍由 application 包装 | 重复请求只执行一次；单次快照与通知顺序稳定；启动失败可清理，正常关闭无任务泄漏 | 待实施 |
| P4 单 Agent 主执行链 | 先抽纯规则，再迁会话/流式/等待/取消；EngineService 使用执行端口；拆结果提交与恢复 | 会话隔离、问答续跑、取消确认、清除后晚到结果、子 Agent 边界、重启恢复和产物交付通过 | 待实施 |
| P5 记忆及存储职责 | 拆 EngineMemory 业务/SQL；显式共享写协调状态；恢复编排离开 EngineStore；保留事务核心 | 权限、纠错/遗忘/Undo、异常回滚、结果未知、迟到写和崩溃恢复各有明确预期 | 待实施 |
| P6 来源与工作区职责 | 拆 ConnectorFactory、入站/历史同步、附件/产物；收拢房间/待办/人工协作；业务动作回所属域 | 全部 App 注册及能力保留；凭证更新/撤销、listener 关闭、入站去重及人工协作回归通过 | 待实施 |
| P7 收尾及交付验收 | 处理无调用遗留；清除不再需要的兼容导出；收紧依赖规则；补镜像/真实启动/MCP/文件交付与升级回退 | 所有映射项有明确去向；不靠旧大类完成实际业务；目标部署环境端到端与回退证据齐全 | 待实施 |

阶段是依赖顺序，不要求一个阶段只提交一个大 PR。同一状态/事务一致性单元一起迁移；其他职责拆成可独立评审、验证和回退的小 PR。P2/P3 的必要接口稳定后，P5 与 P6 可分别推进，涉及来源撤销和记忆失效的接口变更必须协调。后续分支从已审查的集成基线建立，PR 继续指向 `refactor/backend`；不默认合入 main。

#### 5. 保持的事务、权限和生命周期语义

- 不复制两份可写 session 映射、共享记忆锁、pending 写集合或恢复状态；字段和方法一同明确所有者。
- 来源由 source 保存权威状态；memory 保存需要的引用/授权投影。撤销先落实不可访问，application 协调后续失效；结果提交前复核来源及会话有效性。
- Task/Run/Message 与相关记忆变更继续使用既有可协调事务；外部操作不在持有数据库事务时无限等待。
- 分别定义可捕获异常回滚、提交结果未知、远端超时后迟到完成、进程崩溃后恢复。保留既有 unknown/冻结/对账语义，不承诺原实现没有的跨库崩溃原子性。
- 现有 `memory/reviewed.py::MemoryStore` 有独立业务调用方，保留其明确身份，不与历史手机记忆混为一库。
- 路径耦合清单覆盖 `.dockerignore`、`.gitattributes`、vendor manifest、Dockerfile COPY、Python 包名与资源、CLI/MCP 启动、受管 runtime 识别、独立 Python 环境、CI 安装和缓存路径。首阶段已做的修改继续验证，不重复迁根目录。

### Involved Public APIs

明确的行为删除已经由 P0 承担：Team/独立委托/跨 Agent 评审/交接不再执行，旧记录仍可读取；`user.ask` 询问当前用户，旧 `agent.ask` 仅兼容用户接收方。其余外部请求、响应、事件、错误码和数据格式保持兼容。后续模块拆分不改变已有 App 接入能力、thread/session 关联、业务权限策略或进程数量。

### Test Verification

使用项目支持的 Python 3.12 环境及已安装依赖。在仓库根运行以下已有入口；本次 RFC 更新没有重新执行测试。

```sh
python tests/cases/run-server-regressions.py
python -B vendor/verify_sources.py
lint-imports --config backend/.importlinter
npm run typecheck
npm run test:core
python -m pytest backend/tests/test_memory_action_transaction.py
python -m pytest backend/tests/test_single_primary_bridge.py backend/tests/test_single_primary_config.py
python -m pytest backend/tests/test_runtime_wheels.py
```

每个 PR 只补充其行为/边界所需的有意义测试，并运行对应原有回归；不以文件数量或搬迁覆盖率替代行为验收。

- 用临时数据库和固定 fake Gateway 输入保存/复放事件，比较事件类型、业务关联、顺序、终态与错误码；只归一化随机 ID、时间戳等非语义字段。Team 场景改为旧记录可读但执行/恢复被拒绝；内部子 Agent 完成不能结束主流。
- 跨批次检查单 Agent 完成、问答续跑、取消、clear/来源撤销后的晚到结果、重启恢复、审批和 unknown delivery；按受管权限开/关及外部 runtime 分类验证。
- 交付验收必须包含脱离源码目录安装 wheel、实际 CLI/MCP 启动、受管 runtime 识别、搜索、生成并读取文件、新镜像部署以及旧部署升级/回退。
- 当前 PR 已记录聚焦回归和打包通过；继承的完整 Python 套件并非全绿，已有问题与本次新增回归分开记录。CI 的实时状态以 PR 检查页面为准，SKIPPED、QUEUED 不计为通过。
- 2026-11-03 当前 head 的 HarmonyOS 包编译、独立模拟器安装和登录页启动已完成；工作流契约 14/14、驱动单测 51/51 通过。真实 14 项 Nightly 用例未运行，当前暂停，模拟器已关闭。未验证云端重构后端或真实模型端到端；恢复该项需另行启动验证安排。

### Additional Supplementary Information

实施与设计材料：

- 首阶段 PR：#509，head `f9b04e47`，目标分支 `refactor/backend`。其范围是删除与初始模块迁移，不表示完整 RFC 已完成。
- [当前模块边界说明](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f9b04e4783df277e1dc5d4ec02c355ebff41f693/docs/developer_guide/backend-modules.md)。
- [现有文件迁移映射](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f9b04e4783df277e1dc5d4ec02c355ebff41f693/docs/developer_guide/backend-module-map.csv)。方法/字段/锁的补充映射在 P1 进入可访问的仓库文档，不以仅存在本机的材料作为验收依据。
- 相关讨论 #271：本轮按先模块化、后插件化的顺序推进。已有 `register()` 作为过渡装配机制保留，不将其宣称为插件框架。
- PR 用 `Refs #505` 建立总跟踪关联，issue 逐阶段记录 PR。P0 不使用 `Closes #505`，总 issue 在完整范围和交付验收完成后再关闭。

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents
