closed_recent.body:
### Background and Goal Description

<!-- DM31:A10 -->
**2026-11-16 disposition — SUPERSEDED / NOT_PLANNED.** #1605 merged as `498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4`. #1313 retired Router and #1316 records the accepted Hive cutover. The old implementation plan to recreate `server/router`, continuity BGE/judge selection and a Router ten-second deadline is no longer planned. This closure does not claim original-scope implementation or verification and does not increase #737's completed count.

### Responsibility handoff

| Original obligation | Continuing owner / acceptance |
| --- | --- |
| Ordinary Home target and Bee selection | Existing Hive design #1228 / cutover #1313. New routing quality, continuation and queue/preempt behavior remains in #1665's product issues. No new implementation is assigned here. |
| Trusted target values, scope, revision, unknown admission and duplicate reconciliation | A01/A14 contracts plus A07 #755; A11 #812 validates configuration before admission; A12 #811 retains bound selection. Current values are in `server/agent_service/contracts.py`, not `server/router`. |
| Mobile and application callers | M02 #763 and A24 #794 use public Agent Service admission/control. Their native A10 prerequisite is replaced by A07 #755. |
| Policy and paid/pending admission | A11 #812 and A16 #815 replace their native A10 prerequisite with A07 #755. A12, A15 and A26 existing prerequisites remain. Actual caller budgets and pre-R applicability require explicit design, without inventing a Router. |
| Historical codec, read-only legacy history, no revived executor | G06 #769, A13 #813 and D01 #845 retain original compatibility/fence obligations. No old in-flight Router cross-version continuation. |

Current master plan #737 and milestone #963 record all four edge substitutions. The old A07/A31 incoming dependencies remain historical on this retired issue. Re-rendering old plan-branch artifacts must not restore this task or its outgoing edges; D03 #848 tracks reconciliation. No tests, CI, deployment or device jobs were run for this planning update.

### Historical design and receipts

The following original body is preserved for provenance. Its implementation paths, classifier algorithm and Router acceptance are superseded as above. Untransferred safety, data and permission guarantees remain with the named owners.

<details>
<summary>Original A10 proposal — historical, not an active implementation task</summary>

### 🚀 Background Description

<!-- DM31:A10 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-A10`.

**Outcome:** Rule-first continuity, scoped BGE and ambiguous judge, distinct execution selection and one shared ten-second deadline.

**Owner:** Router owner. **Batch:** P1: authoritative spine and first phone vertical. **Size:** 4–8 hours.

**Not responsible for:**
- Do not merge an entire candidate branch
- Only the named owning module/interface and listed tests are delivered here; downstream feature migration and final traffic activation are separate tasks. When this module is selected, the production composition must use its public owner path without fallback.

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

**与 Project Hive #1228 的边界：** 会话与执行 selection 继续归 #760（A10 / `server/router`）；#1223 的 Delivery 只向已指定的 Bot 投递，目标为 `temp/beebou/src/dm_beebou/delivery/` → `server/agent_service/delivery/`，由 #1226 的实施方接续。

**Hive 完全退场（H-D3，2026-11-13 已确认方向）：** 上述承接只适用于过渡期。普通 Home 将由可信入口定向到 Beebou，Bee 选择在 Beebou Harness 内完成。[#1313](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1313) 按 H-R1–H-R16 迁走全部真实调用方后删除旧选路与 `server/router`；其中 H-R15 要求在本 Issue 改定 A10 目标，把仍需的话题连续判断迁入 Beebou 候选决策，RoutingInput / RouteSelection / ExecutionPath 值契约交 A01/A14 与 Agent Service 提交 owner。该迁移的接口待签收，见 [#1228 决策登记](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#user-content-hive-decisions)。

### Design Ideas

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** To achieve Rule-first continuity, scoped BGE and ambiguous judge, distinct execution selection and one shared ten-second deadline, adapt `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py::ConversationRouter.route` into `server/router/proxy.py; server/router/policy.py; server/router/gateway_classifier.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.`. Preserve the stated algorithms/behavior and align the named public contracts; remove the listed old authority and I/O.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** server/router/proxy.py; server/router/policy.py; server/router/gateway_classifier.py — public owner operations described below; new paths are proposed, not existing implementation claims.

**Source evidence:**
- Frozen main [harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/dm_sessions/routing.py) — `ConversationRouter.route`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.
- Architecture reference [server/router/proxy.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/router/proxy.py) — `RouterProxy.submit_routed, _route`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/router/proximity.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/router/proximity.py) — `ProximityClassifier`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/adr/0002-server-runtime.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/adr/0002-server-runtime.md) — `routing clarification`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Existing explicit/reply intent
- Scoped history
- Tool-free AgentCall
- Unknown admission semantics

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Old runtime routing authority
- Renewing deadlines on retries
- Timing out a potentially committed admission as unaccepted

**Writable boundary:**
- server/router/proxy.py
- server/router/policy.py
- server/router/gateway_classifier.py
- tests/server/st/test_dm31_a10.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-A07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/755), [DM31-A31](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/757)

**Blocks:** [DM31-M02](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/763), [DM31-A24](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/794), [DM31-A11](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/812), [DM31-A16](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/815)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-A08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/756), [DM31-A32](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/758), [DM31-A09](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/759), [DM31-A21](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/761)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** - Do not silently restore greeting EPHEMERAL/capacity or pending-focus semantics

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Reconcile duplicate before fresh classification
- Timeout or swallowed cancellation prevents subsequent stages/admission
- Unavailable capabilities return a precise error rather than arbitrary fallback

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 -B -m unittest -v tests.server.st.test_dm31_a10

**Cases:** - Delayed metadata/embedding and swallowed cancellation
- Shared stale-retry budget
- Slow committed receipt recovery
- Stable large/small finite vector ranking

**Participants:** Real Router/Manager/Store and default policy; captured main routing fixtures and controlled embedding/judge/path providers. A live classifier quality sample is separate, not implied.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** foundation, C1. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR0002, ADR0006.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).



</details>

## Project Hive 开发进度

**一句话状态 · Project Hive 已全部合入 main（G5 + G6，[#1605](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1605) merge `498bc351`，2026-11-16 14:55 CST）。Hive 路径成为主线，旧 Router 已退场；本 RFC 关闭，后续非阻塞事项统一在 [#1665](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1665)。**

**总体关口** `▓▓▓▓▓▓` **6/6**。每格对应下表一个关口。只有可核验的验收结果或 main 合入回执才点亮。G5 按 2026-11-16 范围冻结带已知限制收口（见下表）。  
**核对时间** 2026-11-16 15:40（Asia/Shanghai） · **HIVE3 集成分支** [`hive/hive3-integration`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/tree/hive/hive3-integration) `47e5a102` · **base** main `aba4e4df` · **合入** main `498bc351`  
**HIVE3 组成** 见 [#1605](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1605) 正文与 [#1533](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533)：Router-free 主体 #1596（含 #1598 Bee 复用工作区）、客户端 #1297、产物 #1296、评估 #1295、记忆 #1487、忙时 #1604、G6 #1613 / #1639、#1615（#1623）、#1616（#1619）、#1618（#1641）、报告失败关闭 #1649、空终态 #1652、Bee 附件与 Stop #1651，及 G4 后的 Phase 2 修复（#1424、#1439、#1526、#1527、#1528、#1538、#1565）。#1601 在冻结后误入 hive3，已回退（`47e5a102`），由作者另行向 main 提交。  
**下一步** 无阻塞项。已知限制与后续工作见 [#1665](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1665)：#1670 Bee 附件未送达运行时（C1-S1）、#1640 报告生成失败关闭、#1597 / #1669 忙时排队与抢占、#1655 孤儿 RUNNING、#1653 / #1654 行为 QA P2 等。多设备场景（SC02-C3、SC04-C1/C2 双设备部分）与 V4-Pro SC04-E3 延后到 v3.5。  
**当前阻塞** 无。

**Phase 3 交付（随 #1605 进入 main `498bc351`）**
- **Router 完全退场（#1313，G6）**：Router-free 主体（#1596），旧 Router 模块与接线删除，26 个过时 Router 测试退役或改为拒绝断言（#1613、#1639）；架构策略同步移除 `server/router` 行（合入时 base 策略自举，见 [#1605 说明](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1605#issuecomment-6909634196)）。
- **客户端（#1243）**：H-C8 fixtures 与原生 Hive Home（#1297）、Bee 附件入口、`busy_controls.stop`、问题卡「Bee 想问你」（#1651）；忙时 steer、操作查询、丢 ACK 重试（#1604）。
- **产物（#1242）**：版本发布与读取（#1296）、SC04-A1/A3/A5。
- **评估（#1244）**：SC04-E1 标签与回放（#1295）、真实模型行为 QA（#1499 驱动与评分）。
- **记忆（#1312）**：SC05-M2 与旧库升级（#1487）。
- **Beebou 修复**：快回缺席与任务状态守卫（#1641，修 #1618）、完成回报时序（#1623，修 #1615）、满槽诚实 CAPACITY_BUSY（#1619，修 #1616）、空终态 `empty_final`（#1652）、Bee 复用工作区（#1598，修 #1595）。

**Phase 2 交付（随 #1421 进入 main `be000e5e`）**
- **双 Harness 装配与 Host 边界（#1309）**：CLI Bee 运行时与 Host 完成校验（#1442）、Bee 实现身份与认领前绑定检查（#1473）、Bee Stop `hive.bee.stop`（#1481）、可产生效果的 Bee `--hive-bee-effects`（#1484）。
- **Beebou Harness（#1310）**：同语言快回与认领守卫（#1437，规则在 `quick_reply.toml`）、正常轮、派发循环、Bee 问答（#1395）；真实模型修复 #1507、#1508、#1509、#1514、#1515、#1518。
- **Store（#1311）**：方案二驱逐与 slot 释放（#1439、#1450、#1451）；Bee 输入仅在 Bee 上下文提交到 Session Store 后消费（#1491，`dm_hive_bee_contexts`）。
- **Delivery（#1223）**：真实投递与恢复链（#1345、#1353→#1374）、SC03-D2 终态通知（#1426）。
- **Memory（#1312）**：方案二下的 SC05-M5（#1478）。
- **验收工具（#1314）**：G3 runner（#1424）。所有 Phase 2 服务端路径均为 opt-in，未加 `--hive-*` 时行为同 main。

**Phase 1 交付（随 #1336 进入 main）**
- **Hive Store（#1311 / #1332）**：Bot 绑定与激活、定向受理与限额（`hive_store.toml`）、slot 认领/驱逐/释放；忙时控制（排队、steer、抢占、Stop 与 ACK 对账、问答定序，重复操作取原回执）；Bee 记忆交接账本（SEALED_PENDING → INGEST_ACCEPTED → PUBLISHED / SETTLED_NO_PUBLICATION → CLEANED）。
- **Bot Repository / BotDirectory（#1268 / #1333 + b1）**：Bot 定义、roster、原 `bee_id` 复活；Beebou 按 scope 预置为系统定义（v3.1 lead 已决定，F4）；目录由定义与 Store 实时绑定共同解析。
- **WorkSwarm 适配器（#1268 / #1333）**：同级 Harness 实例代次、旧代隔离、封存记忆迁移驱动（延迟摄取、丢 ACK、重启下只发布一次）、答复投递。
- **Beebou 定向投递接收端（#1223 / #1226）**：来源、状态与 provenance 校验。
- **Host 原问题答复边（#1309 H-A2 / #1341 + c1）**：`HostAnswerEdge` 等名称已由 #1309 owner 接受，经 Store 提交并投递给 Bee。
- **验收工具（#1314 / #1331）**：G1 场景 runner、安装态证明；单测（20 项）已登记为 `hive-scenarios` 服务器套件（#1422 + #1448，main `fa926ce6`）。
- **门禁（#1343，已在 main）**：`pendingSource` 允许 owner 行先于源文件登记。

**设计整合（2026-11-13）** 各工包正文已补组件/时序图、入口与回执、失败与并发、首版 PR 断言；断言 ID 汇总见 [#1314](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1314)。

| 关口 | 当前状态 | 证据与下一步 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| G1 HIVE1 验收 | **验收通过 · 22/22 PASS** | wheel 模式，组合 head `c2b995e1`：SC01-W1–W7、S1–S4、D1–D2，SC02-S1–S6，HIVE1-PKG-1–3 全部通过。真实参与方：BotRepository/BotDirectory、Store/SQLite、迁移账本、WorkSwarm 适配器、#1226 接收端、Host 答复边、安装态 wheel；标注替身：受控 Host 凭据/step、WorkSwarm 运行时进程、受控 Memory provider（真实 provider 为 #1312 SC05-M5，G5）。[#1314 回执](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1314#issuecomment-6866097111) |
| G2 HIVE1 合入 main | **已合入** · merge `8f7b92ab`（2026-11-14 07:33 UTC） | [#1336](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1336) merge commit；#1226、#1331、#1332、#1333、#1341 随之标记已合入。[合入记录](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1336#issuecomment-6873880689)（含 CI、runner 故障的本地替代、隔离运行部分结果与[更正](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1336#issuecomment-6873896430)、main 既有 5 个失败）|
| G3 HIVE2 验收 | **验收通过 · 17/17 PASS** | wheel 模式，组合 `321624c5`，可信 main `c6ef5389`：SC03-R1–R3、B1–B8、D1–D2 与 SC02-R1–R3、B1 全部通过，G1 22/22 同轮通过（[#1316 回执](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316#issuecomment-6885474740)）。最终 head `2de90c6b` 仅改快回守卫，快回 5 行重跑 5/5（[回执](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316#issuecomment-6885953632)）。14 行用受控模型，记为「QA allowance, owner confirmation pending」（#1424 评审 F4）。真实模型行为 QA rr2/rr3/S1 未发现 G4 阻塞 |
| G4 HIVE2 合入 main | **已合入** · merge `be000e5e`（2026-11-14 23:36 UTC） | [#1421](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1421) merge commit，父提交 `c6ef5389` + `2de90c6b`；各组成 PR 随之标记已合入。CI 全绿；`check.py` 0 findings。[合入回执](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316#issuecomment-6885990085) |

**下个版本发布决定（2026-11-15）**。先在 HarmonyOS 原生 Home 验证 Beebou 回复和 Bee 任务，并通过同一路径完成真实网页搜索、生成 PPTX 和 PDF 并在应用内预览和下载。全部通过后，彻底删除旧 Router 及其生产接线。发布时重启并从新的 Hive 执行状态开始，所有新的普通 Home 消息由 Beebou 受理。旧 Router 的在途任务、队列和待答在重启时终止，取消其跨版本迁移、续跑和回退演练。历史保留可读，获权历史的 Global Memory 回填按 #1312 继续。

**怎么判定步骤打通。**

1. 开工时在工包记录 Scenario ID、适用 Phase / Step、公开入口、前置、断言 ID 和运行命令。接口尚未可用时先写用例和受影响的边界，更新计划里的阻塞。
2. 候选就绪就执行对应段。确认本步的权威提交及下一段读到的身份一致。分线测试可并行，#1314 汇总候选 SHA 和单步结果。使用替身时列明验到哪条接缝。完整路径缺真实 owner 则为 `NOT_RUN` 或 `BLOCKED`。
3. G1、G3、G5、G6 分别在固定组合上重跑完整的适用场景。G2、G4 在合入的 main SHA 重跑受影响步骤。Phase / Step 的打通记录包含用例、命令、源码/环境、真实与替代参与者、断言结果和权威回执。用 `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN` 按实际范围记录。
4. 由 #1314 和场景 owner 把开发时已执行的同一 Scenario ID、断言和入口纳入 Nightly，并登记 job、选择参数、首个实际运行链接与报告。设备用现有 workflow runner，服务端用对应 suite。后续改动继续跑受影响场景，Nightly 保留回归历史。

**当前执行基线。** `main@b67218b3` 的现有 workflow 定义 31/31 及 daily baseline 1/1 校验通过。实际 Bridge/SQLite 用受控执行器跑容量排队、房间隔离、旧引用续接，3 项通过。2026-11-13 复核：同一 main 源码导出再次运行 `--validate`，31/31 与 1/1 通过。HIVE-SC-01–06 的专项实现、端到端运行及 Nightly 接入随对应候选交付，当前状态 `NOT_RUN`。 各 Scenario 的断言 ID 在所属工包正文定义，登记表见 [#1314](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1314)。


### Background and Goal Description

这里是 Project Hive 从开工、两批联调到产品验收和完全退场的开发总入口。顶部 Marker 给出可核验的状态和下一步。评论区是开发 AI 的实时交接日志，具体实现和评审在子 Issue/PR。

[设计 RFC #1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) 集中维护产品语义、模块边界、接口、时序与设计决策。开发依赖、组合、运行结果和放行记录汇总在本页。

### Proposed Solution

#### 工包和已存在的 WIP

| --- | --- | --- |
| #1268 Worker/B1 | 提供 BotDirectory 和 WorkSwarm adapter。Beebou 根据 Profile、在办任务摘要和状态复用活跃 Bee 或生成新 Bee。N 个 slot 内保持驻留，有空位就用空位。新建遇满槽时只驱逐空闲 LRU，均忙则返回容量忙，客户端弹窗提示稍等。**Worker 提案，待评审**：驱逐后旧 Profile 仅供参考，旧 ID 保留历史归属，新 Bee 取得新 `bee_id`、Session 和独立 Local Memory；与 #1228 H-D2 原 ID 复活有分歧。获准片段按 H-C5 异步进入 Global Memory，Beebou 和 Bee 均可按权限查询。旧材料保管及清理时机待相关 owner 确认。 | [Worker 设计与验收](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1268) · [父 RFC 决策登记](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#user-content-hive-decisions) |

#### 开发、验收、合入的顺序

1. **开工**。#1268 与 #1311 各用独立工作分支，PR 指向 `main`。在共享接口上写下 owner、输入、版本、原身份、预期回执和验收。#1309/#1310 可并行准备已明确的部分。
2. **HIVE1**。从当前记录的 main 建集成分支 `hive/hive1-integration`，按固定提交合入 #1268、#1311、#1226 与打包/QA 候选，以及只在组合中成立的改动（如新模块的 inventory 行）。在集成分支跑 G1。G2 时由集成分支经单个指向 main 的 PR（#1336）以 merge commit 整批合入，各组成 PR 随之标记为已合入并保留各自提交历史。
3. **HIVE2**。从 HIVE1 合入后的 main 建新的集成分支 `hive/hive2-integration`。接 #1309 的 Registry/Host、#1310 的 Beebou 和真实 #1226 Delivery。G3 验收后同样经单个集成 PR 整批合入。两批都记录确切 base/head、各 PR 的固定提交和集成 PR 合入 main 的 SHA。
4. **完整交付**。完成 G5 的 Hive 产品组合验收，再由 #1313 完全删除旧 Router，验证重启后的 Hive 执行和只读历史，满足 G6 后发布。

WIP PR 保持以 `main` 为 base，使各自的 CI 与 bot 评审照常运行（工作流只对指向 main 的 PR 触发）；其新提交由集成 owner 合入集成分支。集成分支按 SHA 组合实际批次，基线或参与方变化时重验受影响项。 [项目验收规则](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/b67218b31d244ebed12e1ea7fce39ee00737fc64/docs/protocols/verification.md#select-checks-once-per-integration-batch)

#### 开发 AI 的实时更新约定

- 每完成一个可验证步骤、首次发现阻塞、解除阻塞、提交候选、跑完验收或合入时，立即在**本 RFC 评论区**发一条更新，同时给所属子 Issue/PR 留证据链接。失败、待具名 owner 的问题及未运行项也要写明。
- 一条评论对应一个工包和本次变化。重跑用新评论引用前次结果。同一事件重试前查是否已发。每个开发 AI 可以直接评论自己的工包。
- 协调者根据评论中的已核实证据更新正文 `HIVE_PROGRESS_START/END` 区域中的一句话、关口、阻塞、下一步和时间。有正文编辑权的开发 AI 取得协调权后可更新。写入前重读正文，只改进度块，保留其他工包变化。权限不足时在评论标出建议更新的行，由协调者落表。
- 阶段状态使用「待实施、进行中、候选待验、验收通过、已合入、阻塞」。细分用例用 `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN`。只有对应范围、SHA 和真实参与方的结果可推进关口。

~~~markdown
[HIVE PROGRESS] Phase 1 · Step 1.2 · #1311 Store · 候选待验
- 完成：<这次交付了什么>
- 证据：<#Issue / PR / base SHA / head SHA / 日志或验收回执>
- 验证：<PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN，真实参与方与替身>
- Scenario：<ID / Step / 命令 / 断言结果 / 运行回执或未运行原因>
- 下一步：<owner + 可验证交付>
- 阻塞：<无，或依赖、影响、需要谁处理>
- 顶部更新：<影响哪个关口，建议一句话状态>
~~~

### Involved Public APIs

工作流用 GitHub 子 Issue、PR 和评论承载状态与证据。产品接口和设计变更按 [设计 RFC #1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228) 及 owner 的契约评审执行。

### Test Verification

| 关口 | 达标后才能推进 |
| --- | --- |
| G1 | 固定真实 BotDirectory、Session Manager/SQLite、安装包与各候选 SHA。验生成、按现行 H-D2 原 ID 复活（#1268 的新 ID 验收提案待评审）、同 ID 丢 ACK 对账、定向受理、跨用户/旧代次拒绝及 slot 竞争。验 FIFO、双设备抢占与问答竞态。steer 下一 step 和 Stop 使用替身时，只证明相应接口。现有包映射须经安装态证明 |
| G2 | 接口已获对应 owner 评审，适用 CI 通过，可识别已验提交及实际 merge SHA。批后复核受影响回归 |
| G3 | 实际 CLI 从安装包登记并启动双 Harness。真实入口跑 Home 直答和 Beebou → Delivery → WorkSwarm Bee → 持久终态 → 用户。补真实 steer/Stop/问题答复、并发、断线回执及历史。真实模型、HAP 和受控替身分别留证 |
| G4 | 实际组合 PR 获评审和适用 CI，核对合入 SHA 并复跑受影响验证 |
| G5 | #1242 产物版本、撤权和下载，#1243 客户端与三动作，#1244 真实决策和安全回放，#1312 旧库、历史及分类回填，均交实际结果和组合证据。用原生 Home 验证 Beebou 回复、Bee 任务、真实网页搜索，以及生成并预览和下载 PPTX、PDF。 |
| G6 | G5 的 Hive 路径通过后，按 H-R1–H-R16 替换或退役旧调用并彻底删除 Router。验证实际发布包重启后仅 Hive 接新任务、旧执行未恢复、旧历史可读，以及安装包、SDK、CI 和部署配置均已清理。 |

每个放行关口须附上面 Scenario 矩阵对应的实际执行结果。证据统一归 [#1314](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1314) 及相应工包。每项写 repo SHA、真实入口、参与方、替身、测试命令及结果。**Hive 完成条件为 G1–G6 全部举证**，各关口覆盖范围以各 owner 和评审方签收为准。

### Before submitting a new issue

- [x] Please confirm that you have searched the previous RFC documents

closed_recent.body:
**Target: v3.5.** Follow-up from the Phase 3 G5 sign-off (#1533; post-merge evidence in #1316).

## Problem

The scenario runner accepts an external device receipt (`run_hive.py --device-receipt`, `tests/scenarios/hive/device.py`, rules in `tests/scenarios/hive/device_receipt.toml`). It passes a device row such as SC04-C1 when every journey the receipt lists for that row is `PASS`.

The runner does not know which steps a row requires. A receipt that silently left a step out would still pass the row. For G5 this gap was closed outside the runner:
- the deploy lane's `device_receipt.py` refuses to publish a receipt without C1-S1, C1-S2 and C1-S3;
- QA ran a per-step checklist (`check-c1-receipt.py`) before each receipt rerun and recorded it beside the G5 report.

## Change

- `device_receipt.toml`: a required step list per assertion, by step ID. For SC04-C1: `C1-S1`, `C1-S2`, `C1-S3`. Optional extras such as `C1-X1` are reported but not required.
- `device.py`:
  - a missing required step gives BLOCKED, naming the missing step;
  - a required step that is `FAIL` gives FAIL;
  - unknown extra steps are reported as evidence only.
  - The receipt still has to match the run's head exactly (`source_sha`), come from a `direct` instance named `dm-hive-direct-qa-…`, and never come from test-3 (ADR-0023 D8).
- The report prints the per-step checklist beside the receipt sha256, which retires the external checklist script.
- Runner self-tests cover: a complete receipt, a missing step (BLOCKED), a failed step (FAIL), and an extra step (not required).

## Acceptance

- The runner self-tests pass.
- The G5 rerun with the b02c2ef6 receipt (`663f58ee…`) still reports SC04-C1 FAIL on C1-S1.
- A receipt with C1-S2 removed reports SC04-C1 BLOCKED, naming C1-S2.

Tracks Project Hive Phase 3 (steps 3.1–3.7) through gates G5 and G6, following #1316 (the overall Hive RFC, reopened after Phase 2 delivery) and #1314 (HIVE-INTEGRATION, closed). Design and decisions: [Phase 3 delivery](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/hive/hive3-integration/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-hive-phase3-delivery.md) and ADR-0023. These land with the hive3 PR.

## Next-release decision · 2026-11-15

- Complete G5 acceptance on the native HarmonyOS Home against the Hive candidate. Verify that Beebou replies, dispatches a real Bee, and delivers its result. Verify actual web search and PPTX/PDF generation, preview, and download through that same Bee path. Complete the legacy-harness tool comparison below.
- After G5 passes, remove the Router completely under [#1313](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1313). Replace or retire its remaining callers and remove the old selectors, fallback wiring, and package/configuration entries. Verify the installed release with the Router removed.
- The release restarts execution with Hive. Beebou handles every new ordinary Home turn. Old Router runs, queues, and pending questions end at restart. In-flight Router migration, cross-version execution resume, and Router rollback work are out of scope. Keep existing history readable and continue eligible Global Memory backfill under #1312. See the release decision in [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316).

## Integration
- `hive/hive3-integration` was cut at `be000e5e`, the G4 merge of #1421. Pinned for the current G5 iteration at `2162dc82`.
- Constituents keep base main and land together through one merge-commit PR after G5: #1488, #1492, #1487, #1295, #1499, #1297, #1497, #1439, #1526, #1527, #1498, #1296, #1500 and #1528.

## Status
| Step | State |
| --- | --- |
| 3.1 client fixtures (#1297) | in hive3; device/HAP coverage in progress |
| 3.2 artifacts (#1296, #1242) | in hive3; SC04-A1 engine-task notices integrated; Hive Bee half is #1529 |
| 3.3 offline graders (#1295) | in hive3 |
| 3.4 memory backfill / old DB (#1487) | in hive3; F2 needs the Runtime/Ops owner |
| 3.5 G5 (#1497) | wheel G5 currently 6 PASS / 8 BLOCKED / 0 FAIL; native Hive Home and end-to-end Bee tool coverage still need acceptance |
| 3.6 / 3.7 Router removal, G6 (#1313) | after G5; use H-R1–H-R16 to replace or retire remaining callers, then verify complete removal and fresh Hive execution after restart |

## Open owner decisions
- ADR-0023 D8 (gateway Hive results only where per-user isolation is evidenced) and #1500 F1 (rely on ingress trust for SC04-C1/H-R1).
- #1424 F4: controlled model on 14 G3 rows. #1509 F2. Store schema reviews for #1481, #1484 and #1491.

## Deferred from Phase 2, now Phase 3
#1495, #1496, #1511, #1512, #1513, #1517, #1519, #1520, #1521, #1522, #1523, #1524 and #1525. They're assigned to the Phase 3 lanes.

## G5 implementation lanes · 2026-11-15

Pinned integration revision: `2162dc822bb7a2baf41fe924ba9a64ddc12e55b5`. HK installed-wheel evidence at this exact head: G1 **22/22**, G3 **17/17** (controlled model for runtime mechanics), G5 **6 PASS / 8 BLOCKED / 0 FAIL**. SC04-A1 PASS covers WorkSwarm `task.run` only. The Hive Bee artifact and download path remains open. Record the exact candidate used for final G5 and the exact Router-free build verified for G6.

| Lane | Execution owner | First deliverable | Decision or dependency |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Bee artifact terminal and late versions (#1529, #1242) | Hive artifact implementation | Versioned contract draft plus real CLI regression for final text with a produced file. Then publish and download one real Hive Bee artifact. | Hive Store owns the terminal and notice. WorkSwarm owns bytes. Review immutable version identity, retry/ACK order and the Gateway download shape before adopting a persisted or public change. A4 follows with the original producer and version preserved. |
| Host artifact read and durable erasure (SC04-A3/A5, #1242) | Host Artifact read and Session Store | Bind the existing ArtifactReader behind the Host tool with relation and scope checks. Prepare the erasure-intent transition and replay tests. | Artifact/Host approve the relation used to grant read access. Store and Ops decide the durable intent/withdrawal transaction and what evidence permits the erased state. |
| Live Memory ingestion (SC05-M2, #1312) | Memory relay implementation with History / Session Store review | Versioned cursor proposal and cutoff/restart/correction boundary tests. | Store owns the visibility order and durable resume cursor. Existing startup and old-library backfill do not prove the live handoff. |
| H-C8 Gateway / Session Manager (SC02-C2/C3, #1243) | Busy operations implementation | Start with real Gateway operation lookup and the first clear command; test same-ID retry and stale run. Continue steer, queue, preempt and answer with concurrent preempt control. | Use the adopted wire fixtures and existing scoped Host/Store controls. Review outstanding receipt or authority rules before exposing them. |
| Explicit Bee target (SC04-C1/C2, #1243) | Bee targeting implementation | Real `hive.message.send` test for owned ACTIVE target, no effect on foreign/stale target, and restart/conflicting retry of durable target intent. | Preserve the accepted Host-mediated dispatch and Beebou context rule. Exercise ordinary `room.message` on Hive for G5. #1313 owns default Home routing and Router removal. Shared-Home reset refusal is already integrated through #1576. |
| Native Hive Home and Bee tools | Deployment, HarmonyOS acceptance, and Bee/Host tool owners | Run the actual Home UI against the pinned Hive candidate. Exercise a real Bee and complete the tool matrix below. Retain two-device targeting and artifact-download journeys. | Confirm the app reaches the exact candidate. Apply ADR-0023 D8 when using Gateway-authenticated Hive results. |
| Live product / reference behavior (SC04-E2/E3, #1244) | Behaviour QA | Begin bounded product and strong-reference runs against installed owners at the pinned revision, then rerun affected cases on final G5. | Full comparison and human grading remain open. Keep model judgments separate from controlled mechanics and offline replay. |

### G5 legacy harness inventory and Hive Bee acceptance

**Baseline.** Legacy DigitalMate Home on ADX test-3 v25, DM `2162dc82`, linux/amd64 image `sha256:025121e596046a207ea429c3b2b0cfad7da90019587cb12ea246f0c7b956867b`, Router enabled and Hive off. The image pins WorkSwarm `0d685750` and agent-core `8f9f1126`. The [v0.1.12 app release](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/releases/tag/v0.1.12) provides the public product scope. Its release source uses the same WorkSwarm and agent-core pins, six default skills, and both DigitalMate MCP registries. The v25 image is the baseline for server tool evidence. The [image recipe](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/2162dc822bb7a2baf41fe924ba9a64ddc12e55b5/harness/personal-agent/deploy/Dockerfile), [production template](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/2162dc822bb7a2baf41fe924ba9a64ddc12e55b5/harness/personal-agent/deploy/digitalmate-template.prod.json), and [turn assembly](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/2162dc822bb7a2baf41fe924ba9a64ddc12e55b5/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/workswarm_adapter.py#L1978) establish what the owned launcher packages and selects. Live results are identified below. Per-account grants, optional providers, workspace-installed tools, and the complete effective per-turn tool list were outside the retained v25 evidence.

#### Default skills and verified file workflows

| Legacy skill or workflow | Legacy evidence and Hive Bee check |
| --- | --- |
| `docx-pro` | Ships by default. Generate editable Word, convert Markdown and Word, and exercise representative read/edit behavior. Verify formatting and downloaded DOCX in Hive. |
| `xlsx` | Ships by default. Read, analyze, create, and update a workbook. Verify real XLSX values, formula results where applicable, and the downloaded file. |
| `pptx-generator` | Ships by default. Generate and edit a presentation. On v25 legacy Home, a real PPTX was generated, previewed, downloaded, and its slide content verified. Repeat from a Hive Bee. |
| `pdf-extraction` | Ships by default. Check text PDF reads, tables and metadata where supported. Cross-check native `read_pdf`. |
| `local-doc-ocr` | Ships by default. Stock SKL-02 documents optional OCR dependencies as missing, so scan/image OCR is a dependency-gated case. Probe the pinned image before claiming a legacy or Bee pass. |
| `financial-document-parser` | Ships by default. Check CSV statement parsing and exact totals. Check PDF statements and image input where dependencies are present. SKL-02 documents image statement dependencies as missing from the stock image. |
| PDF creation and delivery | Separate from PDF extraction. On v25 legacy Home a real single-page PDF was generated, previewed, downloaded, and its text verified. Repeat through a Bee. |
| General files and attachments | Upload and read supported text/document/image inputs, generate and deliver Markdown/CSV and any other format in the supported workflow, preview and download, update the same artifact, retry a failed publication, and verify delete/revocation. Use real bytes and the authorized Hive artifact owner. |

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Environment information and a minimal reproduction are below.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**A quick reply states roster or queue facts as final ("I don't have X", "the task list is empty") while the normal turn of the user's previous message is still running and is about to create exactly that task.** The user is first told the work does not exist; seconds later the work is dispatched and a later reply corrects itself. Same family as #1537: a quick reply asserting state that an in-flight normal turn can change.

`HIVE-LIVE-LANG-05`. T1 asks for a 2000-word coffee guide; T2 is sent 1.5 s later, while T1's normal turn is still running: "Is the coffee guide finished yet? Just tell me where it stands."

| Run | Quick reply to T2 shown | T1's dispatch input created | T1 reply | Quick reply text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `p3-be000e5e` r2 | +9.2 s | +16.7 s | +20.8 s | "I don't have a coffee guide anywhere in my current queue — no committed task, no reports back on one. So as far as I can see, nothing's in progress on it." |
| `qr-be000e5e` r1 | +7.6 s | +11.2 s | +21.0 s | "Nothing called a "coffee guide" is in my queue — the task list is empty right now, so there's no draft or progress on it from my side. It may have been under a different name, or never started." |

In `p3` r2 the normal turn for T2 then replied: *"I need to correct what I just said — I was wrong. There is a coffee guide task in flight …"*. The final state is correct, but the user saw a false negative first. The quick-reply claim guard (#1437) checks only positive completion claims, so negative statements about the queue pass it.

**Expected.** A quick reply must not state queue or roster facts that an in-flight normal turn can still change. While any normal turn of the same session is running (claimed, not committed), it either avoids such statements or hedges them ("I'm still setting that up — I'll confirm in a moment"). This could be prompt guidance plus a guard: refuse a quick reply that asserts absence of a task/Bee while an earlier normal turn is uncommitted. Add a replay test with an overlap message about the work the previous message requested.

### Environment
- Build: main `be000e5e85ed3ff86b1172049c3fb191823a95ad` (G4, #1421), installed wheels, effects off.
- Model: `DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017`, Hive behaviour QA driver (#1499).
- Traces: `artifacts/hive-live/{p3-be000e5e,qr-be000e5e}/HIVE-LIVE-LANG-05/` on the QA Mac.

**G4/G5 view:** not a gate blocker (the final reply is correct), but it is a user-visible honesty defect in the quick-reply path. Tracked under #1533 and #1244; related to #1537 and #1542.

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

Part of #1533 (Hive Phase 3, G5 single-device blocker).

On the Router-free QA build `916ad25a910cee1fd87ec2661d7aea80a0f0863e` (test-3), the exact Home workspace trial refused every workspace mutation (create / CAS replace of the owned `note.txt`) when Beebou reused an existing live Bee whose Session generation was 3. A fresh Bee could write. The saved-file outcome of that trial remains open. Evidence: https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1533#issuecomment-6901947054

**Root cause (from code on the pin).**

1. `temp/hive-runtime/src/dm_hive_runtime/assembly/bee_workspace_note.py`, `BeeWorkspaceNote.authorized`, refuses unless `task.generation == 1 and claim.run_generation == 1`. A reused Bee at Session generation 2 or later, or a Run reclaimed after a restart, is refused before the Home grant is checked. The rule was meant to stop a grant from showing an earlier Task's files. It does that by refusing every reuse.
2. The workspace owner, `server_engine/workswarm_files.py` (`_bound_workspace`), puts `note.txt` and its create and mutation receipts at the root of the runtime **Session**'s projectless task directory. The Bee lane key is `[workspace, principal, bee_id, session_ref, generation]`, so a second Task on the same generation reuses that root. It would then find the earlier Task's note and receipts and settle as `conflict`.

**Expected.** A live ACTIVE Bee reused by Beebou for a new authorized Task can create, read and CAS-replace the task-owned note, and the saved bytes land in that Task's workspace. This holds at any Session generation, and also after a restart between Tasks. An earlier Task's files stay invisible. A foreign Bee (not the authorized Home dispatch) or an evicted Bee still cannot write (scheme two: an evicted `bee_id` is never revived).

**Fix direction.** Scope the fixture to the Task: the owner resolves a per-Task directory (keyed by the Host-bound `task_ref`) inside the Session's projectless root, with receipts in that directory. Drop the generation-1 rule from the grant. Binding, eviction and foreign-Bee checks stay with the Host effect gate and the Home dispatch grant.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

test-3 direct-instance QA, image `sha256:d14a6b1fc84641266bddae4423e94c9771a7a2055e82966b5b053f7d654ea440`, build pin above (branch `codex/hive-1313-native-followup`, not yet in `hive/hive3-integration`).

### Additional Information

The rule is pinned by `temp/hive-runtime/tests/test_bee_workspace_note.py::test_reused_or_revived_session_is_refused_before_consulting_the_store`. That test must be replaced by one that covers reuse with per-Task isolation.

### Version Information

`916ad25a910cee1fd87ec2661d7aea80a0f0863e`

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

SC04-A1 (#1242, tracked in #1316): `done` arrives first and the terminal result is committed after it. Late artifacts are then delivered separately as their own committed versions, and a repeated notice must not wake anyone twice.

#1296 (in `hive/hive3-integration` at `2e0e1b9f`) ships the **core half**:
- artifact versions `(producer_task_id, artifact_id, digest)`;
- notices with a stable `event_id`;
- `pending_notices` / `acknowledge` called after delivery;
- replay of the same event without a second wake.

That core half is tested against the engine (WorkSwarm `task.run`) Store result transaction. The consumer is a FIXTURE for the SC03-D2 publisher.

The Hive wiring is missing because the Hive Bee path on main (`be000e5e`, G4) is text-only:
- `dm_hive_worker.workswarm.text_run` refuses an artifact as a terminal.
- A Hive Bee task (a `hive_busy` task_ref, not an engine `Task` row) therefore never produces an artifact.
- `HiveResultPublisher` has nothing late to deliver.

### Design Ideas

[Versioned Bee artifact terminal proposal](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/92810aa4/docs/implementations/contracts/beebou-hive-bee-artifact-terminal.md) is ready for owner review. The private controlled-runtime regression reproduces a final answer lost after a file event. The first isolated implementation proof is in progress. Review the scoped byte-owner interface, Store event identities and rollback, and the Gateway download contract before adoption.


Three pieces:

1. **Byte-owner delivery for `hive_busy` task_refs** (#1309 Runtime/Host, Artifact owner).
   - Let the Bee text run accept artifact deliveries and hand them to the DM byte owner (`WorkSwarmArtifacts` or a sibling), keyed by the Hive task_ref.
   - Keep content-id identity, quota, lease-until-commit, the post-commit sweep and erasure (`holds` / `erase_withdrawn`) as they are for engine tasks.
2. **Artifact refs in `_terminal_frame` and `dm_hive_user_results`** (#1311 Store, SC03-D2 delivery).
   - The committed terminal records its artifact refs in the same transaction as the text.
   - `_notice_frame` / `_terminal_frame` in `hive_bee_execution.py` carry the refs: bounded and active-only, as `Publication.terminal_refs` does.
3. **Late-version rows in `dm_hive_result_notices`** (#1311 Store).
   - An artifact version committed after the terminal gets its own notice row with its own `event_id`.
   - `HiveResultPublisher` delivers it once and marks it published only after the broadcast, the same as text terminals today.
   - **The #1309 (Runtime/Host) and #1311 (Store schema) owners must agree this schema before implementation.** The table's `UNIQUE(workspace_id, principal_id, task_ref, version)` and `version >= 1` model one terminal per task version. Late artifact rows need either a new version or kind column, or a sibling table, plus a schema migration for existing workspaces.

### Involved Public APIs

- `HiveBusyControls`: the result commit gains refs, and late-version notice writes are added.
- The notice frame: an artifact refs field and a late-artifact frame.
- `BeeArtifactSource` / `dm_bee_artifacts` ports gain a Hive task_ref adapter.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- #1242 (artifacts) and #1296 (core half).
- #1309 (Bee Host execution) and #1311 (Store terminal and notices).
- #1223 (SC03-D2 delivery) and #1481 (stopped terminal and notice path).
- #1316 (Phase 3 tracker).

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **Real Store:**
  - A Bee run commits text plus artifact A, then commits artifact B later. The client receives the terminal with A, then one late notice for B.
  - A crash between broadcast and mark re-sends the same `event_id`, and the receiver wakes once.
  - Revoked or deleted versions never appear in refs.
- **Migration:** an old-schema workspace if `dm_hive_result_notices` changes.
- **Product entry on the pinned runtime:** a Bee that writes a file shows it as a downloadable artifact. This needs coordinator approval before any Mac Bee-runtime or real-model run.

### Additional Information

Hive Phase 3 · G5. The Phase 3 coordinator decided after G4 to make this a follow-up, because the Hive Bee path is text-only on main.

Meanwhile, a separate #1242 PR makes SC04-A1 real for WorkSwarm `task.run` artifacts. It adds a persistent notified-versions table and broadcasts artifact notices by `event_id` over the same Gateway broadcast as `HiveResultPublisher`. The G5 report shows SC04-A1 as PASS for that scope only, and the Hive Bee artifact half as NOT_DONE pointing here.

Links: #1316, #1242, #1296.

closed_recent.author: Jianyu010
closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Follow-up to #1473's review finding F1 (#1309 Runtime/Host, #1311 Store). A Bee Session's runtime binding records the exact WorkSwarm Bee Harness implementation: the `core/workswarm/<version>` ref and an identity derived from the Harness code (`harness_implementation_identity`). When a release changes that code or version, the pre-claim check `BeeHostExecution.ready_for` refuses the Session, and #1472 releases any claim that slipped through.

Hive Phase 2 decided (option a) that such a Bee **fails closed**: its queued turns are not claimed, nothing is lost, the Host logs a warning once per incarnation, and the only documented recovery is operator rollback (register the original exact implementation again). The person who sent the message gets **no answer and no failure notice**. Today there is no product path to move an ACTIVE Bee to a new incarnation (`activate_bot` joins the active generation; idle eviction requires no queued turn; eviction retires the identity by default).

This issue adds a user-visible outcome: a per-turn **unavailable** terminal plus a notice.

### Design Ideas

Reuse #1481's stopped-terminal and notice path:

- **Store (#1311, E/C extension):** `commit_unavailable_result(scope, task_ref, ...)` for a queued (unclaimed) Bee task whose Session binding conflicts with the registered exact profile. In one commit it marks the task `cancelled` (or a new terminal state, if agreed), records the reason (`implementation_unavailable` plus the recorded and registered refs) in a terminal table like `dm_hive_stopped_results`, consumes or closes the queued input, and inserts the result notice. Replay by task returns the original notice.
- **Host (#1309):** when `ready_for` reports a binding `conflict`, the scheduler (or a periodic pass) commits the unavailable terminal for each queued task of that Session, at most once per task. An *unready* factory (transient) must NOT produce a terminal; only a binding conflict does.
- **Delivery (SC03-D2):** the existing `HiveResultPublisher` delivers it as `digitalmate.task.text` with `state: "unavailable"`, `final: true`, no result text, as #1481 does for `state: "stopped"`.
- **Beebou:** optionally reports the unavailable Bee in its roster so it stops dispatching to it.

**Out of scope:** (c) a binding migration that moves an existing Session to new Harness code. It needs a "same Harness" compatibility rule first, which is not defined.

### Involved Public APIs

- `HiveBusyControls` gains `commit_unavailable_result` and a read.
- The notice frame gains a `state: "unavailable"` value.
- The Store schema may change (a terminal table or columns); list the migration as #1481 does.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

#1309 (Bee Host execution, `ready_for`), #1311 (Store terminal and notice), #1223 (SC03-D2 delivery), #1310 (Beebou roster, dispatch), #1472 (release of unstarted claims), #1473 (code-derived identity, pre-claim check), #1481 (stopped terminal and notice path).

### Test Design and Test Plan

- **Real Store:** a Session bound to version 1, with version 2 registered, gets one unavailable terminal and one notice per queued task. A replay adds nothing. An unready factory with a matching binding gets no terminal.
- **Product entry on the pinned runtime:** deploy, run a Bee, restart with a changed `harness_version`, then send a dispatch to that Bee. The client receives `state: "unavailable"`, and Beebou keeps working.
- **Migration:** a test on an old-schema workspace, if the schema changes.

### Additional Information

Hive Phase 3 · G5. Decision record: #1473 review thread F1 (option a now; this issue is option b; option c is out of scope).

closed_recent.body:
Project Hive Phase 3 · G5/G6 enabler. Runtime/Host packaging ([#1309](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1309)). Progress [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316).

## Problem

There is no way to enable Hive on an ADX deployment:
- [`deploy/entrypoint.py`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/5acf58f1c/harness/personal-agent/deploy/entrypoint.py#L29-L33) only forwards container argv (`sys.argv[1:]`) to `engine_cli serve`.
- No environment variable maps to `--hive-turns`, `--hive-beebou-id`, `--hive-results`, `--hive-bees` or `--hive-bee-effects`.
- The ADX template schema has no args/command field. The keys seen are `env`, `image`, `init_timeout_seconds`, `isolation_runtime`, `lifecycle`, `mounts`, `name`, `readiness_probe`, `resources`, `service`, `volumes`. Whether the console accepts an `args` field is being probed on test-3 with a throwaway, never-aliased template version.

Evidence base: `hive/hive2-integration` `5acf58f1c`.

## Proposed change

- [ ] Map Hive enablement from environment or TOML in the entrypoint (or in `engine_cli` settings), for example `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_TURNS=1`. Flags stay as explicit overrides. Defaults stay off, so behaviour equals main.
- [ ] `--hive-bee-effects` cannot be enabled by template env alone without a separate, explicit allowlist setting (keep the current opt-in posture).
- [ ] Template example and the runbook (`docs/guides/operations/hive-test-env-deploy.md`, #1492) document the settings.
- [ ] A deployed test env shows the effective flags at startup, and the business entry stays healthy.

Depends on #1223's gateway-auth authorizer for `--hive-results` (separate issue). Owner: Phase 3 deploy lane. **Not a G4 blocker.**

closed_recent.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

Project Hive 将引入 Beebou、Bee、Delivery、Session Manager/Store 和 Host 等协作路径。除了开发过程中已有的 UT、ST 和 HIVE-SC-01–06 基本场景，还需要在任务错投、重复提交、授权变化、外部效果未知、重启恢复和迁移切流等条件下验证系统是否可信、能否定位和安全恢复。

关联开发和阶段验收总入口 #1316；产品语义以 #1228 和对应 owner 的最新签收为准，场景与评测分别对齐 #1314、#1244。此 Issue 提出可信测试及必要诊断/兜底的实施方案，不表示 Hive 已合入、任何接口已签收，或 109 个场景已经执行。

### Design Ideas

完整设计、过渡接入与测试矩阵如下。目标是按 v3.1 owner 分区开发，在可用公开接口接通前遵循仓库 `temp` 过渡规则；以真实权威 owner 和可删除的薄适配器连接当前入口，不引入第二状态写者或绕过 Host 授权。Hive 真实代码就绪后由实施者在固定实际 SHA 上核实文件、公开符号、owner、写者和迁移条件，再分别确定需要的诊断、兜底与测试代码。


# Project Hive 可信测试与可迁移开发方案

> 版本：整体重构讨论稿，2026-11-14。方案及所有场景为设计，**未实现、未执行、未验收**。适用于 Hive 相应代码就绪后的实际版本，不以某个当前候选代码路径为固定实现。记录过的历史参考：`origin/main@72416ff0d21195dace568c268eee069effb46d37`；开工必须重新获取 main、Hive 的合入与接口状态。
>
> 本方案面向后续开发 Agent 与 owner：先完成 §4 的真实接线表，再逐项实施；文中代码路径、事件名、时间和阈值均为提案或测试示意，不是现存 API，也不授权变更已接受边界。用户工作区已有未提交修改，实施使用隔离 checkout/worktree 并遵守该版本 AGENTS.md、temp 规则与 change-control。

## 1. 可信测试是什么

可信测试验证 Agent 在任务歧义、模型非确定性、外部工具故障、权限变化、网络中断、并发与重启等条件下，是否仍能**正确归属任务、遵循用户意图、不产生未经授权或重复的外部效果、诚实表达结果，并留下足够证据解释结果**。

例如用户确认创建手机日历事件后，写入结果在返回前中断：可信测试需要核查原操作、系统日历中是否已有事件及客户端可见状态，避免重复创建或虚报。必须先确认当前真实入口以及 provider 是否支持对账；读取、外链跳转、发送和外部写入需分别设计判定依据。

它补充 UT、ST、已有 Scenario 与 Agent 评测，不替换它们：确定性安全底线用权威事实断言；语义与表达用标注样本、模型评测和人工复核；故障恢复用固定注入、预算与状态证据验证。覆盖表是预设测试设计，不是运行成绩，也不表示穷尽所有故障。

## 2. 系统与可信责任

```mermaid
flowchart LR
 U[用户与客户端] --> G[Gateway]
 G --> M[Session Manager]
 M <--> S[(Session Store)]
 M --> H[Backend / Host]
 H --> B[Beebou Harness]
 B --> R[Bot 目录与激活]
 B --> D[Delivery]
 D --> M
 H --> W[Bee / WorkSwarm]
 W --> T[模型 / 工具 / 外部服务]
 W --> I[Host 交互与结果]
 I --> G
 T <--> MM[Memory / Artifact]
```

这是一张目标逻辑图，不表示 Hive 已在 main 完整实现。Beebou 理解决策，Bee 执行；Manager/Store 管任务和会话事实，Host 管运行和授权。Delivery 只投给指定对象；用户原问题答复按 interaction 身份处理。Bee 的 report、平台权威终态、用户看到结果是不同事实。H-D2 的方向是被驱逐 Bee 按原 `bee_id` 归档复活；等待问题的常规轮换等细节仍需 owner 签收。产品语义优先看 [#1228](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228)，进度看 [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316)，Worker 看 [#1268](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1268)，组合断言看 [#1314](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1314)，评测看 [#1244](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1244)。

核心身份：一条 Home 消息可以产生多个逻辑效果；每个效果须保留其独立稳定 operation/delivery ID。`task_ref` 指原任务，`interaction_ref` 指原问题，`generation` 区分 Bee 活跃代次，Run/attempt 区分执行尝试。`trace_id` 只用于诊断关联，不是授权或幂等键；跨异步与重启可通过授权范围内业务引用连接多个 trace。

### 2.1 不变量与失败处理原则

| 编号 | 不变量 / 可观测结果 |
|---|---|
| I1 归属 | 明确指定任务、Run 或交互的输入不得静默改投；跨用户/scope 不可访问。 |
| I2 受理 | 同 ID 同意图按契约对账原回执；同 ID 改意图冲突。受理、执行、消费、终态和用户看到分别可核对。 |
| I3 副作用 | 未经有效授权不执行；结果未知先按原身份查证。外部 at-most-once 只在供应商幂等/查单契约及证据支持的范围内宣称。 |
| I4 运行 | 旧 generation 和旧 attempt 不得越过隔离边界；slot 释放未确认不能双占。 |
| I5 交互 | 原答复作用于原 interaction，steer 不是答复；未送达与用户未答不同；授权不能转移到新的准备动作。 |
| I6 恢复 | 可恢复事实来自持久 owner；预算、原身份、权限与版本不能因重启被重置或编造。 |
| I7 诚实 | 用户能辨别已完成、部分完成、失败、排队、等待和未知；关键声明可追溯到事实。 |
| I8 可解释 | 诊断关联阶段、原因、动作、结果及安全证据；普通遥测不能作为业务账本。 |
| I9 隔离 | 外部内容、模型输出和日志都是不可信数据，不得通过提示注入提升权限；敏感数据按授权访问。 |
| I10 兼容 | 保持已提交回执、旧身份/历史及签收的客户端契约；回退与旧 writer 数据兼容分别验证。 |

## 3. 开发策略：现在准备，Hive 就绪后立即接线

采用“按最终 owner 分区的核心 + 使用当前公开接口的薄适配器 + 同一组不变量测试”。当最终 owner 已有可用公开接口时直接使用；当该生产接口尚不可用而仓库允许过渡时，遵照当前 main 的 `temp/AGENTS.md` 建立 `temp/<feature>/`，按职责分区、登记、打包和限期迁移。不要因目录叫 temp 就绕开权限、调用另一组件私有对象或新增第二个状态写者。

```mermaid
flowchart LR
 C[当前真实入口] --> A[薄转换与装配适配器]
 A --> P[已登记的过渡功能分区]
 P --> O[真实 owner 的已签收 proxy]
 O --> X[权威状态 / Host / Provider]
 P -.受控事件.-> L[现有观测能力]
```

薄适配器只翻译输入、身份和结果并委托；受理、授权、重试、持久化、取消和外部效果仍由对应 owner 控制。如果生产接口尚不存在且没有合法工作路径，只做独立夹具与设计，依赖切片标 `BLOCKED/NOT_RUN`；不能造生产 fake、双执行或静默退回旧 Router。跨 owner 合约、Store/schema 或生命周期改变需 owner 与 change-control。

迁移逐分区发生：目标 producer 已合入且真实 consumer 可调用 → 切换真实调用方 → 跑相同不变量、旧数据、故障及旧执行器反例 → 验证安装包/部署 → 删除该分区 temp 适配、登记及打包映射。每项在 issue/PR 明确目标 owner、producer 符号、consumer、迁移任务、删除触发和证据；“重构完成后”不是删除条件。

## 4. 后续 Agent 的开工前核查

1. 更新并记录 `main` SHA、Hive 实际 merge/组合 SHA、配置和工作区 dirty 状态；阅读当前仓库 AGENTS、协议、迁移 guide、temp 规则、最具体 owner inventory、当前 RFC/owner 决定及测试目录说明。不存在的设计目录不等于已接通的生产边界。
2. 追踪真实用户入口 → Beebou → Delivery → Manager/Store → Bee/Host → Gateway；记录实际文件、符号、公开接口、当前部署路径、唯一写者和真实测试。查 wheel/CLI 是否实际包含它们；仅有文档/fixture 标为不可用。
3. 补齐下表，与各 owner 对齐。找不到的标 `UNKNOWN/BLOCKED`，不猜函数名，不修改共享接口作为占位。

| 待接线能力 | 实际代码文件和调用符号 | owner / 公开 proxy | 状态与证据 | 待迁移/删除条件 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 认证入口、Home 与客户端显示 | 实施时填写 | Gateway/客户端 | 填写 | 填写 |
| 快回/次快回/正常轮、Host grant | 填写 | Beebou/Host/Store | 填写 | 填写 |
| Delivery、接收、receipt 和 task | 填写 | Delivery/Manager/Store | 填写 | 填写 |
| Bee 目录、绑定、代次、slot、释放 | 填写 | Bot/Manager/Backend | 填写 | 填写 |
| steer、queue、抢占、Stop、原答复 | 填写 | Gateway/Host/Manager | 填写 | 填写 |
| 模型、工具和外部操作 | 填写 | Host/provider | 填写 | 填写 |
| 记忆、产物、事件、恢复 | 填写 | Memory/Artifact/结果 owner | 填写 | 填写 |
| 场景 runner、评测、观测后端 | 填写 | #1314/#1244/运维 | 填写 | 填写 |

4. 选首条真实可走通的垂直切片：推荐“已受理后丢 ACK、原 ID 对账”，先让错误反例失败，再接真实 Store/接收 owner、诊断与用户状态；不能合法接入就只准备测试替身。使用 temp 时按当前 gate 登记 source、精确 legacy adapter imports/caller，按仓库要求显式打包并做已安装包证明；不可擅自修改 base-owned inventory 或新造接口。

## 5. 应写的代码：诊断、兜底和测试各归谁

| 代码类别 | 建议位置：实施时映射至 §4 已验证符号 | 添加内容 | 边界 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 入口诊断 | Gateway/认证 owner | 已认证 scope 的安全引用、消息身份、请求类型、拒绝与结果 | 不在 Gateway 自己做 Bee 业务决策 |
| 决策诊断 | Beebou/Host owner | 候选完整性、决策类别、版本、快回/正常轮认领与发布结果 | 不默认采集用户原文，不把模型理由当权威事实 |
| 受理与恢复 | Delivery/Manager/Store owner | 原 delivery ID、事务提交结果、receipt、重放/冲突/未知及对账 | 不在 temp 自建 receipt 或双写 |
| 运行与交互 | Backend/Host/交互 owner | 实际 generation、启动/释放见证、step 消费、原 Q 的送达/答复/Stop | steer 不替代答复；不以日志做权限或状态判断 |
| 工具可靠性 | Host/provider owner | 授权、超时、失败类别、原操作、可查状态、必要时有界重试/熔断 | 未知效果不盲重试；不绕 Host 切换工具 |
| 记忆/产物/通知 | 现有对应 owner | 来源 revision、摄取 ID、权限复核、产物版本、终态提交和出站 | 不另建业务真相或缓存未获权内容 |
| 测试夹具 | #1314/#1244 确认的 tests/runner | 事件屏障、隔离故障计划、合成数据、外部效果账本、断言和评测集 | 不把测试钩子加入生产装配或使用真实凭据 |

实际行为兜底是产品代码，不是日志：未知先对账、容量忙时明确拒绝或有界排队、授权失效不执行、材料过期后重查或澄清。先检查 Hive 已实现什么：已实现则复用并补测；缺失才与对应 owner 确认后实现。新共享类型、持久字段和 breaker 政策不能由本文直接授权。

## 6. 全链路打点与根因定位

### 6.1 建议统一事件字段

经 owner/隐私评审后使用版本化结构，按适用范围携带 `timestamp, component, stage, event, outcome, reason, trace/span, authenticated_scope_token, home_message_id, operation_id, delivery_id, bee_id, generation, session_ref, task_ref, attempt, interaction_ref, version, duration, retry_count, evidence_ref`。身份按访问权限伪名化；不要将高基数身份作为 metrics 标签。日志默认不含原始用户正文、凭据、支付信息和完整模型上下文。异步、重启、多次回答按业务身份和 span link 关联，不强行要求一个任务只有一个 trace。

| 位置 | 起止及证据 | 必须区分 |
|---|---|---|
| Gateway | 已认证接收、请求类型、受理回执、输出投影 | 发送、接收、拒绝、用户可见 |
| Beebou | 输入快照、候选完整性、决策、快回候选/提交/失效 | 已知事实与模型假设；正常轮先认领时迟到快回 |
| Delivery/Manager/Store | 原 ID 调用、权威提交、回执重放/冲突、状态版本 | 请求发出、已受理、ACK 丢失、结果未知 |
| Backend/Bee | 绑定、generation、认领、执行、step 消费、释放见证 | 未启动、启动未知、已执行、旧代迟到 |
| Host/工具 | grant、调用 ID、只读/副作用、超时、返回、对账 | 被拒绝、失败、未知、外部已发生 |
| 交互 | 创建、投递事实、原答复、授权版本和期限 | 未送达、未答、拒绝、过期、答复已提交 |
| Memory/Artifact | 源/版本/权限、摄取与发布、读取和发送尝试 | 已接受、已发布、可读取、撤权、部分发送 |
| 输出和恢复 | 已提交终态、通知/重连、对账及结果 | 模型 report、持久终态、用户看到、待人工确认 |

权威事务成功后再记录成功；日志失败不应伪造或回滚业务结果。必须持久化的恢复/审计事实由 owner 的持久机制负责。监测采样、截断、丢失和关联缺失；对安全拒绝及 unknown 的保留策略由 owner 决定，不把原始敏感数据复制进测试或报告。

### 6.2 用户一直没有回复：最少打点与查询路径

**目标**：由一条用户消息定位最后一个有证据完成的阶段、当前可证明的等待对象、已经等待多久、是否超出该阶段的配置预算，以及下一步由谁对账或处理。排查不是逐行记录函数，而是记录跨组件交接、状态转换、外部等待和结果提交；同一阶段的内部普通函数通常无需单独打点。

以下事件是逻辑名称，真实事件名、字段、保留期和接入位置由各 owner 对齐。对存在较长等待的动作记录 `started` 与 `finished/failed/timed_out/cancelled/unknown`；排队/等待用户等状态记录进入时间、条件或依赖、预算/到期时间及退出原因。不要为每个 token、轮询或内部循环记录一条 INFO 日志；同类高频进展使用指标、受控采样或聚合，保留状态变化和可归因错误。

| 检查顺序 / owner | 建议关键事件 | 最少记录什么 | 排查中可回答的问题 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1. Gateway 接入 | `message.received`、`admission.result` | 已认证 scope 安全标识、submission/message ID、入口、时间、accepted/rejected/unknown 和关联回执 | 后端是否收到？哪个请求？是否持久受理？ |
| 2. Inbox / Store | `message.enqueued`、`run.claimed` | 会话/队列安全引用、入队/认领时刻、状态版本、排队原因及已配置预算 | 受理后是否排队、是否已有合法执行认领？ |
| 3. Beebou / Host | `beebou.started`、`decision.result`、`quick_reply.result` | 原消息身份、attempt、候选完整性、决策类别、快回提交/拒绝及原因 | 是否开始处理？是直接答、澄清、补充原任务、派发，还是尚无决定？ |
| 4. Delivery / Manager | `dispatch.started`、`dispatch.receipt` | 每个逻辑效果的稳定 delivery ID、目标安全引用、new/steer、受理/冲突/unknown、原 task_ref 安全引用 | 派发是否已提交？ACK 丢失时用哪项原身份对账？ |
| 5. Backend / Bee | `activation.result`、`bee.run.started`、`bee.state.changed` | Bee/generation、排队/激活/运行/待答状态、claim、释放或就绪见证引用 | 在等 slot、启动、执行、安全点，还是等待用户？ |
| 6. 模型/工具/交互 | `model.started/result`、`tool.started/result`、`interaction.state` | provider/工具名、原操作、起止耗时、期限、attempt、错误类别；问题创建/送达/答复事实分别记录 | 哪个依赖仍在等待？是慢、拒绝、超时、结果未知还是用户尚未回答？ |
| 7. 结果与投影 | `result.committed`、`output.attempt/result` | 权威终态/回复版本、输出身份与阶段、发送尝试及可证明的投影或 ACK | 是没有生成结果，还是已提交但没有送出/确认？只有客户端展示证据才能说用户确实看到 |
| 8. 恢复/监控 | `reconcile.started/result`、`stuck.detected` | 原 ID、检测时间、最后事实来源、原因类别、自动动作、owner/下一步 | 系统是否已发现长期等待、是否正在对账、何时需要人工处理？ |

**检索路径**：客服或运维从用户提供的时间范围与客户端可见的安全诊断引用入手，经过授权查找对应 submission/message；如尚无引用，使用受控查询按认证 scope、时间和入口缩小范围，不公开原始账户或消息正文。以该身份查 Gateway 接收和权威 receipt → Store 的入队/认领事实 → Beebou 决策 → 每次 delivery ID 及目标 task_ref → Bee 与依赖等待 → 已提交输出、投影与重连状态。一次用户消息可有多个派发和多个 trace，分别展开每个子链，不能只查一个 span。

**如何判断卡点**：有 `started` 而没有终态事件只能表明“该阶段最后一次可见的动作是开始”，不能据此断言服务一定还在运行或已经失败；需核验权威状态、进程/租约或 provider 查询、采样丢失情况及当前配置的 deadline。事件缺失可来自日志丢失、采样、进程崩溃、异步延迟或根本没有到达，缺少证据时标记 `UNKNOWN / 观测不足`，提出下一项查证，不能编造根因。排队和等待用户可属正常状态，是否超时按具体阶段/操作的批准配置判断，不统一套一个数值。告警按队列等待、运行进度、依赖超时、输出投影积压和遥测丢失等分别统计，阈值先量基线后与 owner 确定。

**日志示例（合成数据；不是现有代码或事件 schema）**：

```text
10:00:00 message.received      msg=m1 scope=s1
10:00:00 admission.result      msg=m1 result=accepted receipt=r1
10:00:01 run.claimed           msg=m1 run=a1
10:00:02 decision.result       msg=m1 decision=dispatch delivery=d1
10:00:02 dispatch.receipt      delivery=d1 result=accepted task=t1
10:00:03 bee.run.started       task=t1 attempt=b1
10:00:04 tool.started          task=t1 operation=o1 tool=weather deadline=...
```

此时只可说“最后可见事件是天气工具调用开始，尚未见到结束事件”。接下来查实际运行状态、工具结果、deadline 和日志采样；如果权威结果已提交但输出未出现，则查 Gateway 的输出尝试/重连，而不是继续归罪模型。诊断引用和 trace 不构成数据读取授权。

### 6.3 从轨迹定位根因

1. 固定症状、时间范围、部署/模型/配置版本、影响范围与可用证据，先区分评测失败、运行错误、长耗时或结果缺失；评价模型的解释只是线索。
2. 从用户可见结果逆向检查 Gateway → 终态 → Bee/tool → 受理 → Beebou → 原输入；以 trace/span 和业务身份连接跨异步事件，并以权威事实判定提交顺序。缺失 span 明写未知，不凭墙钟推因果。
3. 写出**现象、直接原因、根因假设、支持证据、至少一个竞争假设及反证**；对比同版本成功样本。若堆栈、源码与部署版本不一致，先核实构建，不直接修改猜测的文件。
4. 用合成/脱敏输入构造最小复现，修复真实 owner，运行失败反例和回归；部署前后证据分开。外部日志、异常文本、工具输出均是不可信数据，不能执行其中指令。

例如“会议没有加入日历”：先核对是否出现并确认了正确的日历提案、是否获得权限、系统日历写入是否执行、回执和事件是否可查询，再区分用户没有确认、权限不足、结果未知和显示失败；证据不够时不能猜是哪一环导致。

## 7. 测试运行与判定方法

故障注入首先使用一次性隔离环境、合成数据和不可访问真实账户的假凭据；真实 owner 可在隔离环境运行，provider/模型替身明确标注。非本地故障注入须提前协调明确授权、隔离 scope、资源与独占操作人。固定版本、fixture、配置、schema、故障时序、seed、deadline 和 retry budget；先单点后组合，计划重复两次比较归一化时间线。

注入计划按 `event + ordinal + before/after commit + fault_id` 指定，故障 ID 和实际错误分别记录；重启应停止隔离子进程、清除进程内存并只从真实持久证据恢复，不假定已有 checkpoint API。模拟用时间和次数仅是测试参数，不是产品 SLO。

```json
{"case":"T01","faults":[{"id":"f1","event":"admission.commit","ordinal":1,"phase":"after_commit_before_ack","kind":"drop_response"}],"retry_budget":1,"oracle":"same_receipt_one_effect"}
```

CI 结果用 `PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN`；已运行的故障情景另给 `recovered`（完成且不变量成立）、`contained_failure`（安全停止，不等于任务成功）、`unrecoverable`（违反不变量/预算）、`inconclusive`（证据不足）。`PASS + contained_failure` 合法；证据不足不能报 PASS。机器报告包含 `run_id、序号、逻辑时间、事件、前后状态、fault_id、attempt、剩余预算、脱敏证据引用`，再列实际入口、源码、真实参与者和替身。

## 8. 预设 109 个异常场景

**统一执行约定**：表中“证据”均至少包含原业务身份、实际 owner 的权威回执/状态、用户可见结果和脱敏轨迹；涉及外部副作用时再核对受控外部账本。先通过 §4 确定真实入口，表中 owner 是责任角色而不是当前代码文件。`H` 是已存在 Hive owner/接口可用时执行；`E` 需组合后的真实入口/多个 owner；`P` 可先用隔离夹具准备但不能报真实 Hive PASS。这些是执行条件，**不是 PASS/FAIL 或 G1–G6 关口**；`I1–I10` 是 §2.1 的不变量编号。未签收的预期按 owner 决策落用例，不能自行确定产品契约。

| T80 | 消息恢复时既缺 continuation 又存在潜在已执行效果 | 阻止潜在重复效果，允许安全读取/对账，必要时人工介入 | Host/Store / E / I3,I6 |

### 8.9 补充：与现有产品功能对应的 24 个场景

**来源与范围（核对基线 main `4b83ad09f2e7c69d282bf1037d46252b0679b537`）**：默认首页通过 Gateway、Personal Agent 与 WorkSwarm 云端对话；本地 A2UI、设备源适配器与云端工具是不同入口，配置本地 provider 不等于云端自动注册。依据 [当前任务流](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4b83ad09f2e7c69d282bf1037d46252b0679b537/docs/implementations/client/harmonyos-client-task-flow-v1.md)。先在适用的真实现有入口建立基线，再在 Hive 接通后复用；**有源码/测试不代表在默认首页、当前部署、真机或第三方账户已跑通**。历史能力清单已归档，不能用其旧入口、Google Calendar 回归等级或演示结果证明当前产品支持；可查询的 `CalendarApiClient.ets` 等保留文件仅作为候选入口，不自动纳入当前默认能力。

主线程 WorkSwarm 的工具权限默认取决于 `DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_PERMISSIONS_ENABLED` 配置；目前默认配置不应被误报成已启用 Host 强制工具确认。涉及授权的用例需记录开关和真实实现，区分系统当前表现与 Hive 目标预期，不为获得 PASS 而虚构 gate。

| ID | 实际功能与异常注入 | 判定 oracle / 用户期望 | 现有代码或测试线索；实施阶段 |
|---|---|---|---|
| C01 | 手机日历读取过程中撤销权限 | 返回拒绝/取消，撤权后不发送已收集日程；确认实际平台权限与网络请求记录 | `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/model/LocalCalendarReader.ets`；`tests/unit/local-calendar-reader.test.mjs`；现有设备入口/Hive 接通后复验 |
| C02 | 查询日历过程中切换会话或离开页面 | 原读取取消或结果丢弃，不发送到新会话；以页面身份和 Gateway 请求为证 | `LocalCalendarReader.ets`、`tests/unit/device-calendar-read-flow.test.mjs` |
| C03 | 日历空结果、拒绝和系统 API 异常 | 三种状态按真实 wire 可区分；不编造日程 | `DeviceCalendarReadPayload.ets`；`tests/unit/local-calendar-read-request.test.mjs` |
| C04 | 同一事件跨日历重复、全天跨时区 | 去重及当地日期按当前实现定义；来源/时间范围正确 | `LocalCalendarQuery.ets`；`tests/unit/local-calendar-query.test.mjs` |
| C05 | 本地日历创建已发生但 ACK/客户端结果丢失 | 核对真实日历事件和现有 journal/receipt；仅在实际支持安全对账时复用原操作，否则标 UNKNOWN 并提示核查 | `LocalCalendarWriter.ets`；`tests/unit/local-calendar-write-journal.test.mjs`；不得声称所有 provider 幂等 |
| C06 | 日历确认卡展示后用户更改标题/时间或切换账户 | 原确认不得被用于变更后的写入；以实际提案 owner 契约和系统日历结果断言 | `LocalCalendarProposalCard.ets`；`tests/unit/local-calendar-proposal-lifecycle.test.mjs` |
| C07 | 飞书群读取中撤权、切换账户或任务取消，迟到结果返回 | 复核 task epoch、连接身份和授权代次；不得把旧数据输出或带入新任务 | `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_connectors/chat_reads.py` 的 `_admit_read/_recheck_read`；`test_feishu_chat_reads.py` |
| C08 | 飞书 token 刷新超时/供应商限流 | 按实现区分临时不可用、重授权、权限不足；不能把临时故障说成账户已撤销 | `chat_reads.py`、`test_engine_connectors_feishu.py`；受控 provider |
| C09 | 飞书同名群多候选或分页不完整 | 不猜选群；保留候选、分页覆盖与部分结果状态 | `chat_reads.py` 的 `app.chat.resolve/list/read`；`test_feishu_chat_reads.py` |
| C10 | 飞书账户授权时用户取消，旧回调迟到 | 不把过期/已取消尝试误判为新授权成功；不得泄露 token | `digitalmate/cloud-adapter/src/main/ets/digitalmate/DigitalMateFeishuConnection.ets`；`tests/unit/feishu-continuous-authorization.test.mjs` |
| C11 | 天气使用位置时权限被拒/撤销 | 明确无法使用位置或请求用户给城市；不复用撤权前坐标 | `tests/unit/local-location-reader.test.mjs`、`tests/unit/device-permissions.test.mjs` 与 `test_engine_weather.py`；实际组合需核实 |
| C12 | 天气查询从上海更正杭州，上海结果晚到 | 最终结果不把上海结果标成杭州；来源、时间和查询参数可核对 | `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/tests/test_engine_weather.py`；Hive 正常轮接通后组合验证 |
| C13 | 12306 查询失败、无座或接口超时 | 区分无结果与供应商失败，不编造票价/座位 | `docs/implementations/client/harmonyos-client-travel-tools-v1.md`；真实入口在实施时核实 |
| C14 | 点击 12306 官网后立即关闭/跳转其他页面 | 仅记录已打开或已跳转，不能宣称购票或付款成功；以 12306 为最终订单事实 | `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/A2uiHome/travel/TravelBookingProvider.ets`；现有 travel 契约；路径适用范围待确认 |
| C15 | 12306 购票 URL 被替换为伪域、HTTP 或恶意子框架 | 由实际 URL/导航 owner 拒绝不允许的目标，不将完整敏感 URL/Cookie 写日志 | `docs/implementations/client/harmonyos-client-travel-tools-v1.md`；现有 CheckoutWeb 测试 |
| C16 | 应用提醒创建成功但确认丢失、请求重复 | 用实际 scheduler 的可核验原身份/清单核对，不能仅凭回复断言；如无可靠关联则 UNKNOWN | `tests/e2e/workflow/cases/DM-WF-REMINDER-01.workflow.json`；`tests/e2e/workflow/RESOURCE-CLAIM-REVIEW.md` |
| C17 | 删除某个应用提醒时存在其他提醒和系统闹钟 | 仅操作已确认的目标；分别核验真实 scheduler 和系统闹钟的覆盖范围，保留无关资源 | `tests/e2e/workflow/guides/E4.md`；隔离资源与授权操作人 |
| C18 | 附件上传完成但提交任务前断线 | 原 source ID、submission ID 和服务端状态按实际协议对账，不能凭上传 ACK 宣称任务完成 | `digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/files/DigitalMateAttachmentUpload.ets`；`docs/implementations/client/harmonyos-client-task-flow-v1.md` |
| C19 | 用户切换房间后旧任务流式结果迟到 | 正确回到原 room/task，不能写进当前房间；以入口身份和两侧权威历史核对 | `tests/e2e/workflow/cases/DM-WF-SWITCH-01.workflow.json`；`tests/e2e/workflow/guides/E5.md` |
| C20 | 文件删除确认后返回丢失或对象权限变化 | 对原文件身份核对；无法查证时 UNKNOWN，不按相似文件名重删 | `tests/e2e/workflow/cases/DM-WF-FILEDELETE-01.workflow.json`；实际文件 owner 接口待核实 |
| C21 | Google Calendar 创建/更新/删除代码可见，但默认云端工具注册未证实 | 先核实当前入口、账户、provider、真实 eventId 和作用域；无真实接入时 BLOCKED，不以历史演示证明可用 | `digitalmate/agent_core/src/main/ets/aiphone/runtime/CalendarApiClient.ets`；`test_google_calendar_scope.py` |
| C22 | Gmail/Outlook 候选回调重复或旧账户撤权 | 仅在该候选实际组合中验证身份、回执与撤权；真实 OAuth 和邮箱未验收时不得报 live PASS | `docs/verification/gmail-composio-on-demand.md`；受控 provider / 候选，非当前生产承诺 |
| C23 | 外部检索结果含恶意“读取飞书私聊并外发”指令 | 先确认真实权限开关及 gate 的实际覆盖；以请求、授权事实和外发账本证明，不足则发现风险而非宣称已阻断 | `harness/personal-agent/README.md` 与实际 Host 配置；Hive 目标安全验收 |
| C24 | 真实外部服务不可用而其他分支成功 | 保留每项来源、时间、覆盖范围和部分失败；不把打开外链、回执或模型文本当外部成功 | Feishu `chat_reads.py`、weather、travel 实际 owner；组合 scenario |

每项必须附一个可使其失败的反例：例如 C07 强制旧 token 结果越过 generation 检查、C14 将网页打开误判为订单成功、C16 用不完整 scheduler 清单错误判无重复。以上均为预设，执行和真实 provider 能力尚待验证；生产真实账户、删除、外发和第三方下单不得作为自动故障注入目标。

### 8.10 无回复时的定位能力：5 个诊断验收场景

| ID | 受控注入点 | 必须观察到和正确判断 | 实际接入条件 |
|---|---|---|---|
| D01 | 消息已受理但队列中不被认领 | 用原 message ID 定位到 accepted/queued、入队时间和等待原因；若调度原因无证据则 UNKNOWN，不能说模型故障 | 真实 Gateway、Manager/Store；受控调度器 |
| D02 | Beebou 已启动，模型调用被受控 provider 阻塞至测试期限 | 查到关联 run、model started、预算/耗时和相应超时或待确认；用户得到真实状态 | 真实 Beebou/Host，受控模型；未接通 BLOCKED |
| D03 | 派发已提交但 ACK 丢失 | 查到原 delivery ID 和 receipt，可区分“已受理 ACK 未见”与“尚未受理”；不产生第二任务 | 真实 Delivery/Store；受控传输 |
| D04 | Bee 终态已提交但 Gateway 出站被阻断 | 定位权威结果已提交、输出尝试受阻；不得以发送尝试假称用户已看到 | 真实结果 owner/Gateway；受控传输与客户端 |
| D05 | 删除一个结束事件、采样/延迟上报或停用日志 sink | 排查报告明确缺失和可用权威事实，不能仅因无结束事件就断言仍运行；业务状态不因日志故障改变 | 真实可用接线，隔离 sink、时钟或 provider |

每例要求测试人员只持合成用户诊断引用和时间范围，按 §6.2 的查询顺序独立定位；记录所需查询、最晚可证实阶段、等待状态、证据缺口和处理人，再通过测试注入记录/权威状态交叉验证。至少一个反例删除关联字段或让事件错误标记成功，诊断验收必须失败。P/H/E 和替身范围照 §8 统一执行约定，D01–D05 不代表真实环境已通过。

## 9. 熔断、重试与降级如何落地

先为每个模型、只读工具、外部副作用 provider、Store 和 Memory 做能力清单：用途、真实 owner、流量/耗时基线、故障域、已有 breaker、是否可安全查询、允许的备选、认证范围、降级及用户状态。**不是每个工具都必须新建熔断器**；只在有明确级联、资源耗尽或等待风险且 owner 同意时，放在已有 Model/Plugin Gateway 或 provider 的可靠性边界，避免适配器维护第二份状态。

已批准场景下按 CLOSED（正常）→ OPEN（失败达到配置策略，快速拒绝或降级）→ HALF_OPEN（冷却后受限安全探测）→ CLOSED/OPEN 转换。需明确探测并发、进程与多实例作用域、重启状态、指标、超时和预算。测试值不能当产品阈值；无基线时不填写未经批准的默认值。有副作用依赖的探测只能是经确认的安全只读操作，不能重发日历写入；Store 不可用时不伪造已受理或建第二账本；授权拒绝和账户配额不通过换 provider 绕过。

按 provider 契约区分超时、网络断开、非法输入、授权拒绝、409、429、5xx 和副作用未知；只对已知可重放且授权有效的动作做有限重试，保留总 deadline 与原 ID，退避/jitter 由 owner 配置。恢复不了时明确部分完成、等待对账或人工处理。liveness/readiness 优先验证已有机制，不为凑清单另建端点。

## 10. 开发计划和验收交接

**现在即可做**：与 #1314/#1244 对齐现有断言，为 T01–T80、C01–C24 和 D01–D05 编写测试规格，确定各场景的前置条件、注入点和权威判定依据；对接口足够明确、可独立运行的部分，再编写合成数据、外部账本和事件屏障等测试辅助代码。制定事件隐私字典，在当前支持路径上运行适用基线并标清 legacy 范围。依赖尚未就绪的 Hive 接口或真实参与方的集成测试记录为 `BLOCKED/NOT_RUN`，待对应代码和接口明确后接入。

**Hive 对应代码就绪后**：填 §4，优先实现 T01 丢 ACK 的真实 owner 纵向切片，再按依赖接入 Bee 生命周期、快回/Host、交互、外部工具、Memory/Artifact。每个切片明确“新增诊断代码、兜底代码、测试代码”分别在哪里，确认已有机制后只补缺口。不能合法接入时等待 producer，继续独立工作。

**组合与迁移**：HIVE1/HIVE2 在各自实际组合上复用 #1314 入口，不将替身结果升级为真实 Host/模型/设备 PASS；随后在真实产品入口、安装 wheel 和适用 HAP 中复跑。按 producer/consumer 就绪逐分区迁往 v3.1，执行原用例和旧数据/旧执行器反例，删除对应适配及登记。运行资源和真实服务故障演练须协调 owner。

单个测试交付记录：`Case ID + I编号 + H-C/SC映射；base/head SHA；真实入口/符号；owner；fixture与fault计划；认证scope；真实参与者与替身；权威状态/外部账本/用户可见oracle；命令、环境、退出、结果；诊断引用、预算、限制、反例与迁移触发`。每个测试至少证明一个反例能使其失败；如 T01 故意改投递 ID 应能被 receipt/效果次数抓住。精确命令由实施时仓库版本的 CI/runner 文档确定，不虚构现存命令。

发布指标先基线后签收：失败归因率、unknown 收敛率/时长、任务误归属率、未授权或重复效果数、轨迹关联完整性、用户可见状态和语义评测质量；规定窗口、分母、采样和未观测缺失。零容忍安全测试目标不能证明受控外部供应商以外的全球 exactly-once。

## 11. 方法来源与适用限制

* [Datadog Agent Observability Trace RCA](https://github.com/datadog-labs/agent-skills/blob/main/agent-observability/agent-observability-trace-rca/SKILL.md)：按评测、错误和结构异常找样本，再按 span 因果树定位；本方案不假定安装 Datadog 或执行过线上分析。
* [Agent Harness Fault Injection](https://github.com/sickn33/agentic-awesome-skills/blob/main/plugins/aasb-aas-agent-mcp-builder/skills/agent-harness-fault-injection/SKILL.md)：隔离环境中的确定性故障计划、剩余预算、恢复结论和证据；替身不能证明线上。
* [Sentry Fix Issues](https://github.com/getsentry/sentry-agent-skills/blob/main/skills/sentry-fix-issues/SKILL.md)：症状、直接原因、根因假设、反证、源码核对和回归分开；外部事件不可信；不假定已接入 Sentry。
* [Circuit Breaker Pattern](https://github.com/pjt222/agent-almanac/blob/main/skills/circuit-breaker-pattern/SKILL.md)：依赖能力地图、熔断状态、有限探测和诚实降级；阈值和作用域由实际 owner 依据测量选择。
* [Reliability](https://github.com/alo-labs/codex-plugins/blob/main/skills/reliability/SKILL.md)：外部调用的期限、按契约重试、失败恢复、数据完整性和观测；不直接套用通用固定阈值或将所有 4xx 一概处理。

待 owner 签收的 H-C 接口、交互轮换、Inbox 去重游标、Memory 原件与保留、外部 provider 幂等/查询、观测隐私、breaker 政策及各分区迁移条件，以最新 owner 记录为准。本文档没有运行产品测试或修改生产代码。


### Involved Public APIs

不预设新增或修改公共接口。实施前核对实际 Gateway、Beebou、Delivery、Session Manager/Store、Host、Memory、Artifact 与测试入口的已签收 proxy；确需调整共享类型、持久记录、授权或生命周期时，由对应 owner 按 change-control 单独评审。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

对齐 #1268、#1309、#1310、#1311、#1312、#1223、#1242、#1243、#1244 和 #1314；由 #1316 汇总进度与跨工包依赖。场景实现复用已有 runner 和对应 owner 的测试，真实参与方、受控替身和未运行项分开留证。

### Test Design and Test Plan

以上 T01–T80、C01–C24 和 D01–D05 是预设异常场景，按真实参与方准备状态实施；优先选择 T01 受理提交后丢 ACK，以及 T10 明确引用任务时焦点切换的可复现切片。每项记录固定 SHA、实际入口、故障注入点、认证 scope、权威状态与外部账本、用户可见结果、真实参与方和替身、命令及退出状态；使用 PASS / FAIL / BLOCKED / NOT_RUN。关键不变量需具备能够使测试失败的反例。隔离测试先运行受控合成数据，真实设备、模型和部署另留证；未就绪的 Hive 环节不得报 PASS。

closed_recent.body: ### 🚀 Background Description 父 RFC #1228。发布决定见 [#1316](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1316)。A10、A01/A14 及各调用方 owner 按 H-R1–H-R16 替换或退役旧调用并完全删除旧 Router。 ### Design Ideas 普通 Home 由可信入口定向到 Beebou。Hive 执行的引用、问题卡与 Stop 走 Hive 的定向入口。历史由 History/Store 提供只读访问，获权内容进入 #1312 的 Global Memory 回填。 **下个版本发布决定（2026-11-15）**。先用 HarmonyOS 原生 Home 在真实 Hive 候选上验收 Beebou 回复、Bee 任务、真实网页搜索以及 PPTX、PDF 的生成、预览和下载。通过后彻底删除旧 Router。发布时重启并从新的 Hive 执行状态开始，所有新的普通 Home 消息由 Beebou 受理。旧 Router 的在途任务、队列和待答在重启时终止，取消其跨版本迁移、续跑、回退方案及相关演练。 [Hive [自然快回与平滑升级修订](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/1228#issuecomment-6852965471) #### 现状与目标路径 ```mermaid flowchart LR subgraph OLD["现状：managed Home 与旧入口"] H0["Mobile Home / managed task.create"] --> ES["EngineService._submit_managed"] ES --> SS["dm_sessions SessionManager.submit_message"] SS --> CR["ConversationRouter.route（A10 语义选路）"] T0["非 managed task.create / 显式 agent"] --> ER["EngineRouter.decide"] HB["Hosted / policy / Store"] -.->|"ExecutionPath、RouteSelection 类型"| SR["server/router 包"] end subgraph NEW["Hive：可信入口定向受理"] H1["普通 Home"] --> MG["Mobile Gateway"] MG --> DL["Agent Service 命名接收"] DL --> SM["Session Manager / Store"] SM --> BB["Beebou 正常轮：直答、澄清或选 Bee"] Q1["精确引用、问题卡、Stop"] --> MG MG -->|"原 interaction_ref、Run、task_ref"| SM end CR -.->|"H-R1–H-R4 迁移"| SM ER -.->|"H-R5–H-R13 迁移"| DL SR -.->|"H-R14–H-R16 迁移后删除"| X["删除旧选路与 server/router"] ``` **退场清单。** H-R1 验证 Home 全部进入 Beebou。H-R2–H-R16 核对仍受支持的调用已迁至各自 owner，或随旧路径退役，最后删除旧选路与 `server/router` 包。 ####
