- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/backend/host_api/operations.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/backend/host_api/operations.py) — `RunOperations`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [server/agent_service/backend/execution.py](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/server/agent_service/backend/execution.py) — `AgentServiceBackend`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Architecture reference [docs/specs/host-operation-lifecycle.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/specs/host-operation-lifecycle.md) — `Verification obligations`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Unknown outcomes and authoritative committed terminal behavior

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Additional dispatch after revoked authority
- Duplicate execution on replay

**Writable boundary:**
- tests/server/st/test_runtime_negative.py

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-G03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/767), [DM31-G07](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/770)

**Blocks:** [DM31-A25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/820), [DM31-M25](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/821), [DM31-Q08](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/825)

**May proceed in parallel:** [DM31-G05](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/768), [DM31-G06](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/769), [DM31-Q03](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/772), [DM31-Q04](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/773)

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

### Test Design and Test Plan

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**
- Retained handles after completion/failure/cancel dispatch zero new operations
- Queued Stop winner prevents provider entry; already-dispatched case preserves truthful unknown/final outcome
- Forged admission and duplicate M/R mismatch rejected
- Final-write failure and lost receipt do not create successful duplicate work

**Existing tests, new UT/ST, participants and substitutes:**
**Planned Command:** python3 scripts/ci/server-tests.py --suite runtime-negative --require-tests --fail-on-skip

**Assertions:** - server-tests.py --suite runtime-negative --require-tests --fail-on-skip (proposed)

**Participants:** Actual scanner and legal/violating fixtures; runtime suites use real owning public components/SQLite with controlled providers. G05 physically omits Core in its isolated installation. No phone/device claim.


**Architecture and E2E obligations:** Run the relevant AR01–AR10 checks against the migrated module, with both legal and deliberately violating fixtures. Owner-boundary ST uses real public proxies and real temporary persistence; providers may be controlled and must be named. Independent QA runs affected unchanged-client scenarios when this capability enters the candidate assembly. No device pass is inferred from UT/ST.

**Required evidence:** exact base/head; source/target symbol diff; public API and state-owner map; command and exit status; distinct test count and skips; fixture inputs and expected/actual outcomes; real participants versus substitutes; before/after production dispatch trace; retained original failures; planned/unrun/blocked gates. For a migration, include M→S/R→Host operation→authoritative record identity and a negative bypass/reconnection result. No credentials or raw user content.

**Completion checklist:**
- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** controlled-provider-barriers, approved-concurrency-contract. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** AR09.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

<!-- DM31:CURRENT-STATUS:771 -->
#### 当前实施与验证

G08 **OPEN**。[#1713 `bcb05eb2`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1713) 的真实临时 SQLite trigger 在插入结果后触发约束失败，事务回滚结果/notice/report，不发帧，原 Run 恢复一次；15 项 scoped 用例 PASS，独审原错误变异被新断言拒绝。 WorkSwarm wire 与 Host 终态见证受控，配置态 SC03-D1 和受保护组合未运行。原生前置 [#767](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/767)、[#770](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/770) 保留。

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

实际主线 b9e61e8e 合入 #1142 后，使用现有服务入口 `room.create` → `task.create` 创建一个普通任务，会把 `chat_context: null` 写入现有 SQLite 的任务记录，即使没有启用飞书。新版能重新打开工作区并读取该任务。直接回退到上一个实际主线 734305b2 后，旧版在打开同一个工作区时失败。堆栈经过 `EngineStore.__init__` → `settle_detached_work` → `list("task", Task)`，报错为 `extra_forbidden chat_context`。旧版创建的对照任务无该字段，在两个版本均可打开并读取，且原始记录摘要一致。

在已有服务端 Python 依赖的环境中，使用两个精确源码版本和新的临时目录，执行下列源码探针。用仓库中的实际 EngineService、EngineStore 和 SQLite，执行器返回固定结果，使用合成工作区，无外部请求。

```sh
python -I -B task.py /path/to/734305b2 write /tmp/dm-task-before
python -I -B task.py /path/to/734305b2 read /tmp/dm-task-before
python -I -B task.py /path/to/b9e61e8e read /tmp/dm-task-before
python -I -B task.py /path/to/b9e61e8e write /tmp/dm-task-after
python -I -B task.py /path/to/b9e61e8e read /tmp/dm-task-after
python -I -B task.py /path/to/734305b2 read /tmp/dm-task-after
```

最后一步报告 `actual EngineStore startup rejected extra_forbidden chat_context` 并退出 3。预期在受支持的回退流程中，旧版可以打开包含普通任务的工作区，或在产生不兼容写入前有经过评审的兼容或受控恢复机制。

实际探针如下。它在两个版本中调用原服务。

```python
import asyncio
import hashlib
import json
import sys
from pathlib import Path

source, command, workspace = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2], Path(sys.argv[3])
bridge = source / "harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src"
sys.path[:0] = [str(bridge), str(source / "temp/connection-foundation/src"), str(source / "temp/feishu-connector/src"), str(source)]
from pydantic import ValidationError
from server_engine import engine_service, engine_workspace
from server_engine.engine_connectors import ConnectorConfig, Connectors
from server_engine.engine_router import register
from server_engine.engine_runtimes.registry import RuntimeRegistry
from server_engine.memory.catalog import EngineMemory, SQLiteContentStore

assert Path(engine_service.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(bridge)
assert Path(engine_workspace.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(bridge)
Task = engine_workspace.Task

async def write():
    workspace.mkdir()
    async def execute(task, evidence):
        return engine_service.ExecutionResult(status="completed", output="synthetic")
    memory = EngineMemory(workspace / "catalog.db", SQLiteContentStore(workspace / "content.db"))
    service = engine_service.EngineService(workspace, "synthetic", memory, Connectors(ConnectorConfig()), execute)
    try:
        env = {"MODEL_NAME": "fixture", "API_KEY": "synthetic", "API_BASE": "http://127.0.0.1:9/v1"}
        register(service, RuntimeRegistry(env, service, execute, lambda: True), env, jev=None)
        room = await service.request(engine_service.EngineRequest(action="room.create", title="Rollback fixture"))
        created = await service.request(engine_service.EngineRequest(action="task.create", room_id=str(room["room_id"]), title="Ordinary task", agent_id="digitalmate"))
        assert service.task(str(created["task_id"])).title == "Ordinary task"
        print("actual EngineService.request task.create and same-source Store read accepted")
    finally:
        await service.close()

if command == "write":
    asyncio.run(write())
else:
    try:
        store = engine_workspace.EngineStore(workspace / "digitalmate.db")
    except ValidationError as error:
        details = [(e["loc"], e["type"]) for e in error.errors()]
        assert details == [(("chat_context",), "extra_forbidden")], details
        assert "settle_detached_work" in [entry.name for entry in __import__("traceback").extract_tb(error.__traceback__)]
        print("actual EngineStore startup rejected extra_forbidden chat_context")
        raise SystemExit(3)
    try:
        rows = store.connection.execute("SELECT id,payload FROM records WHERE kind='task'").fetchall()
        assert len(rows) == 1
        identity, payload = rows[0]
        print("persisted chat_context", json.loads(payload).get("chat_context", "absent"), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(payload.encode()).hexdigest())
        errors = []
        for name, load in (("get", lambda: store.get("task", identity, Task)), ("list", lambda: store.list("task", Task))):
            try:
                assert load()
            except ValidationError as error:
                details = [(e["loc"], e["type"]) for e in error.errors()]
                assert details == [(("chat_context",), "extra_forbidden")], details
                errors.append(name)
                print("actual Store", name, "rejected extra_forbidden chat_context")
            else:
                print("actual Store", name, "accepted")
        if errors:
            assert errors == ["get", "list"]
            raise SystemExit(3)
    finally:
        store.close()
```

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS 26.6.2 arm64，CPython 3.13.13，SQLite 3.50.4，Pydantic 2.14.3。网络禁用。实际服务入口与文件型 SQLite，固定结果的执行器，无设备或部署。

### Additional Information

请由当前任务持久化、会话准入和 Feishu owner 一起确认已有任务、非空会话准入上下文与原回退范围的持久化契约。#1283 是较早版本不能读取连接记录，本问题出现在 #1142 后的任务记录，并在旧 Store 启动时触发。

### Version Information

当前实际主线 `b9e61e8e5ebd5f094536bef48cb39aad6984b4db`，与已合入 #1142 的头 `8053155b2b5849261ac53e247642d5d1c30b5b5e` 同树。受影响的上一实际主线 `734305b2a9ab672b23223aceb5022ead579a858d`。

### Screenshots / Recordings

![实际旧 Store 启动拒绝普通任务记录](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/5c5ccb25105f95a23f81759db324bcd1c7ee1996/actual-task-rollback.png?raw=true)

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

The ordinary server-contracts fixture reconstructs the exact historical Root Writer policy boundary from current production roots and fixed historical overlays. Independent actual `b9e61e8e` scanner output contains eight AR10 findings: the intended one for the Root Writer, plus the two Connection Foundation and five Feishu adapters. The previous `734305b2` independently errors for the same reason. The existing exact isolated Linux `128503/1` also records this error.

### Detailed Environment Information Description

Raw Git source, CPython 3.13.13 and the existing declared PyYAML dependency. The test invokes the actual checker on its own temporary fixture without devices, deployment, production data or external services.

### Additional Information

Repair only the historical fixture staging so the old policy yields the original single Writer AR10 and still detects the independent extra AR10 and AR01 counterexamples. Preserve the pinned historical files, hashes, existing assertions and production checker. Signals changed ordinary architecture fixtures tracked separately in #1299, while this owner-local `server-contracts` fixture remains its own entry.

### Version Information

Reproduced on actual `734305b2a9ab672b23223aceb5022ead579a858d` and `b9e61e8e5ebd5f094536bef48cb39aad6984b4db`. Latest observed `84aff23e175ece1dbb578abeaffd1bd038a06a79` has no changes to this test or Root Writer bootstrap helper. Its current scanner evidence will be captured separately.

### Screenshots / Recordings

![Actual b9e61e8e old Writer fixture and checker diagnostics](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/2b2fc71a0a28fae949961031ec91b8741f884dfe/historical-writer-b9-actual.png?raw=true)

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

普通 `server-contracts` 选集的 `RecallTokenizerShutdownTests.test_closing_one_real_engine_does_not_close_shared_tokenizer` 使用 `python -I` 启动一个真实子进程，按父进程的 Bridge 来源和已声明依赖目录重建导入路径。子进程随后导入 `EngineService`。当前 Bridge 配置已依赖 `dm_connection_foundation`，而现有子进程只携带 Bridge、已安装 Root 和第三方依赖。导入在创建实际 EngineService 和 SQLite tokenizer 之前失败。

在已经具备 Python 依赖的工作区复现。保留实际 Root 安装目录中的 `server` 包及其 `*.dist-info`，使原夹具按正常方式选中它。

```sh
export DM_ROOT="$PWD"
export DM_ROOT_SITE=/absolute/path/to/root-wheel-site
export DM_DEPS=/absolute/path/to/declared/site-packages
python3 -I -B - <<'PY'
import os
import sys
import unittest

root, owner, deps = map(os.environ.__getitem__, ("DM_ROOT", "DM_ROOT_SITE", "DM_DEPS"))
sys.path[:0] = [
    owner, f"{root}/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src",
    f"{root}/tests/server", f"{root}/temp/connection-foundation/src", deps,
]
suite = unittest.defaultTestLoader.loadTestsFromName(
    "test_recall_tokenizer_shutdown.RecallTokenizerShutdownTests"
)
result = unittest.TextTestRunner(verbosity=2).run(suite)
raise SystemExit(not result.wasSuccessful())
PY
```

三个原测试中两项通过。共享 tokenizer 用例的子进程因 `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'dm_connection_foundation'` 退出 1。期望子进程验证两个真实 EngineService 先后关闭时共享 tokenizer 仍可用，随后验证解释器正常退出时 tokenizer 关闭，且 stderr 为空。保留原 `-I`、源文件身份、禁止 provider 调用、真实 SQLite 和最终化断言。

```text

  File "repo/tests/server/test_recall_tokenizer_shutdown.py", line 69, in test_closing_one_real_engine_does_not_close_shared_tokenizer
    output = self.child("""
        import asyncio
    ...<33 lines>...
        print("INSTANCES_CLOSED_SHARED_STILL_OPEN")
    """)
  File "repo/tests/server/test_recall_tokenizer_shutdown.py", line 51, in child
    self.assertEqual(0, result.returncode, result.stderr)
    ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
AssertionError: 0 != 1 : Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 26, in <module>
    from server_engine.engine_service import EngineService
  File "repo/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py", line 70, in <module>
    from .engine_direct import DirectReplyFailure, failed_note
  File "repo/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_direct.py", line 19, in <module>
    from .engine_config import assistant_name, assistant_profile, task_language, with_reply_note
  File "repo/harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_config.py", line 33, in <module>
    from dm_connection_foundation.configuration.commit import ConfigurationCommitPort
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'dm_connection_foundation'
```

### Detailed Environment Information Description

实际主线 Git 源码、macOS arm64、CPython 3.13.13。本机验证用逐字节比对的 Root 源码副本和显式 dist-info 目录模拟固定 Root 安装入口，并使用兼容的声明依赖。真实子进程、Bridge 源码、临时文件和 SQLite。历史候选的隔离 Linux `128503/1` 也在完全相同的导入处失败，且其固定 Root wheel 安装和来源验证已完成。没有模型、设备、外部网络调用或共享部署。

### Additional Information

仅把实际 Root 源码路径留在父进程而没有提供已声明的 Root 安装形状，会让三项子进程更早因找不到 `server` 失败。那次试验是本机夹具的环境差异。上述 2/3 和 Linux 收据均保留 Root 的正常角色，观察到的是独立的缺少 Connection Foundation 源码问题。#1301 的 SessionProximity 复制源码子进程是另一个测试入口。

### Version Information

实际主线 `84aff23e175ece1dbb578abeaffd1bd038a06a79`，树 `8c6b0cb73a66fea19f92eaecc634c356be2ccba7`。 [原隔离子进程回归](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/84aff23e175ece1dbb578abeaffd1bd038a06a79/tests/server/test_recall_tokenizer_shutdown.py#L14-L105)

### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

The canonical `connection-transition` suite is enrolled by #1176. Its original boundary test replaces the child’s `PYTHONPATH` with the transition source directory. The regular isolated server profile publishes its declared dependencies separately at `/deps`; those packages are not globally installed. The test child therefore cannot import the real Connection Foundation configuration module before it reaches the intended legacy-import check. Developer environments that have portalocker on interpreter site can hide this wiring defect.

From the latest main checkout with Python 3.13, this reproduces the fixture’s discarded dependency closure without a wheel download or service:

```sh
PYTHONPATH="$PWD/temp/connection-foundation/src" python3.13 -S -B -c   'from dm_connection_foundation.configuration import crypto, commit; from dm_connection_foundation.connections import accounts, authorization'
```

```text
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "<string>", line 1, in <module>
    from dm_connection_foundation.configuration import crypto, commit; from dm_connection_foundation.connections import accounts, authorization
  File "temp/connection-foundation/src/dm_connection_foundation/configuration/crypto.py", line 7, in <module>
    import portalocker
ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'portalocker'
```

### Detailed Environment Information Description

Actual main `4fb8488be793fe95adc81fe5271a76ac93fff76e`. The package, boundary test and registry bytes are unchanged since #1176 merged as `5d5339eba820e656a11d1d339fee83f6a3aeb2e6`. The reproducer used macOS arm64 CPython 3.13.13 with site disabled to match the canonical child's absence of system-installed test dependencies. The normal isolated Linux test runtime uses CPython 3.13.13 and an explicit separate `/deps`. No device, external provider or production data was involved.

### Additional Information

Keep the boundary source root exact and preserve the original two assertions. The clean implementation must import through the real owner and must reject the reintroduced legacy implementation. Preserve only the dependency target already declared by the canonical profile for the subprocess, with an exact source path that excludes Bridge and ordinary checkout/test roots. A control using the same source bytes plus a separately supplied dependency target passed and the observed configuration source remained the transition package. #1285 tracks the earlier profile/manifest/worker defect, while this Issue tracks the exact enrolled test’s independent child setup.

### Version Information

DigitalMate v3.1 migration, actual main `4fb8488b` and #1176 `5d5339eb`, CPython 3.13.13.

### Screenshots / Recordings

![实际主线过渡测试子进程失败](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/4524d36adb0a703cf4c49cd5f8fb6049a54830b7/G01-canonical-child-redacted.png?raw=true)

items.body:
# 🚀 [Roadmap] 项目核心能力演进与 Demo 演示追踪

> **Issue 类型:** Feature / Roadmap  
> **当前状态:** 持续更新中 (Active)  
> **说明:** 本 Issue 用于统一追踪 Agent 核心能力的开发进度及 Demo 演示状态。按周（Weekly）粒度持续更新，请在完成特性与 Demo 验证后更新对应的复选框。

## 11.30 会议报告 Demo：工作量与端到端验收计划

关联路线图：#147。**演示日期：2026年11月30日。**

需要交付围绕“完成会议报告”持续推进的 DigitalMate Demo：

> 收到报告邀请邮件 → 主动形成报告准备目标 → 生成可交互简报并讨论方向、内容和篇幅 → 生成初版 PPT → 持续读取邮件 → 发现影响报告的新信息并建议调整 → 生成、修订 PPT → 报告完成后总结复盘。

简报以 **Intelligent UI** 呈现，支持点击卡片翻到背面，查看实际处理的关键推理步骤和关键材料。

Bot 支持先给出简短、有用的回答，再补充详细回答；用户可以持续插话追问，系统自动关联对应会话和上下文。

**已有基础与估算前提：**

- 飞书接入与持续读取已完成，本期保留集成回归。
- 邮件采用 **Composio 接入 Outlook **，首期使用托管授权。
- 复用已有 Agent 执行、来源、文件产物及调度基础。
- 各项工作量包含实现和开发者自测；人日表示合计投入，不等于日历工期。

### Design Ideas

**11月15日前完整跑通一次流程，最后2周以联调和缺陷修复为主。**

#### 📅 第一周：11.09～11.15｜21人日

- [ ] **1. 邮件接入与持续读取，飞书链路回归｜5人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 基于 Composio 接入 Outlook ，完成账号映射、手机授权、连接状态、重新授权与断开。
    - 读取邀请邮件、newsletter，保存正文、链接、时间和来源。
    - 接收新邮件事件，处理去重，完成邮件云侧推送
    - 回归已有飞书链路。
  - **工作量拆分：** Composio接入0.5；授权与连接状态1.5；正文与来源解析1；持续接收1；自测及飞书回归1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 手机授权 → 收到邀请邮件和 newsletter → 查看正文与来源 → 离开聊天页后发送新邮件 → 检查后台接收 → 验证重复投递、重启和断开连接。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 邮件读取完整、来源正确；后台发现不依赖再次提问；重复信息不重复处理，APP退出后仍支持推送；飞书既有能力正常。

- [ ] **2. 报告目标初版生成、新信息获取与修改｜5人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 从邀约识别报告需求，提取主题、听众、日期、时长及提交要求。
    - 建议方向、大纲、篇幅和时间分配，支持讨论修改。
    - 保存目标、要求、方案及准备状态。
    - 根据新的输入，生成 PPT 调整计划，提出方向、大纲、篇幅、时间分配、受众等方面的建议，支持讨论修改定稿
  - **工作量拆分：** 邀约识别1；PPT 编写计划生成2；讨论修改1；增量邮件识别，PPT 修改计划生成；讨论修改后定稿。
  - **验收 Demo：** 收到二十分钟报告邀约 → 生成目标及方案 → 用户要求“十五分钟，更偏实践” → 切换话题后恢复报告 → 重新进入继续修改 → 收到日程和受众调整邮件 → 生成修改目标及方案 → 继续与用户交互修改 → 定稿。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 邮件事实与助手建议区分清楚；修改后保留其他约束；恢复最新方案；同一邀约不重复建目标，支持报告邀约更新。

- [ ] **3. PPT 产物管理与查看｜3人日**
  - **开发内容：** 根据已确认方案生成的 PPT 在产物中心中支持按会话组织和展示，并支持下载、打开。
  - **验收 Demo：** 进入产物中心查看PPT → 选择某个会话 → 查看PPT保留历史版本 → 支持下载
  - **关键观察与结果：** 文件可打开；主题、结构及页数符合确认方案；产物会话归属和生成状态正确。

- [ ] **4. Bot体验改进：快速回答与持续插话追问｜8人日**
  - **开发内容：**
    - 先给出简短、有用的回答，再自动补充详细分析、方案和依据。
    - 回答过程中持续接收补充、修改条件和追问。
    - 识别输入属于当前任务、此前话题还是新话题，关联正确会话与上下文。
    - 将新增条件用于后续回答，保持回复与提问的绑定关系。
  - **工作量拆分：** 简答与详答衔接2；连续输入及会话归属3；上下文更新与回复一致性2；自测及性能核对1。
  - **验收 Demo：** 请求二十分钟报告大纲 → 收到简答后，在详答过程中连续输入“改成十五分钟”“听众都是研发” → 切换到周末出行清单 → 再要求“刚才报告的背景部分少一点”。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 首段包含实质性回答；无需等待即可继续输入；报告吸收新增条件，出行使用独立上下文；返回报告后要求仍被保留。记录首段可见时延。

#### 📅 第二周：11.16～11.22｜21人日

- [ ] **1. 报告生成、新信息与报告目标主动关联、报告修改调整全流程 Intelligent UI 效果调优｜5人日**    @庞俊飞@杜杰贵
  - **开发内容：**
    - 实现报告邀约简报、方向选择、要求补充等。
    - 实现内容修改简报卡、调整方向选择、要求补充等。
    - 选项卡包含标题、来源（上下文）、时间、关键内容和原文入口。
  - **验收 Demo：** 查看简报 → 通过对话继续修改 → 查看信息更新简报 → 通过对话继续修改，确保简报卡按钮可点按。

- [ ] **2. PPT 产物管理与查看｜3人日**   @李雯琳
  - **开发内容：** 根据已确认方案生成的 PPT 在产物中心中支持按会话组织和展示，并支持下载、打开。
  - **验收 Demo：** 进入产物中心查看PPT → 选择某个会话 → 查看PPT历史版本 → 选择一个支持下载
  - **关键观察与结果：** 文件可打开；主题、结构及页数符合确认方案；产物会话归属和生成状态正确。

- [ ] **3. 导航栏“计划”标签：报告后复盘｜6人日**  @姜成林
  - **开发内容：** 汇总已经推进完成的各项步骤、结果、交互强度，按照 UI 进行展示，用户确认报告结束后，依据实际反馈生成总结卡。
  - **验收 Demo：** 点击进入计划标签，目标选项卡可查看目标、产物、关键推进等信息；进入成就选项卡，可以看到热力图等信息；完成目标后出现成就分享页。

- [ ] **4. Intelligent UI （背面 UI）｜5人日**  @雷辉
  - **开发内容：** 点击卡片翻到背面，展示关键推理步骤及其关联材料。
  - **验收 Demo：** 打开调整卡并支持翻面翻回查看，按钮、列表支持点按、滑动、查看内容

- [ ] **5. 端到端性能优化｜5人日**  @李天舒
  - **开发内容：** 监控性能看板，针对慢请求定位性能问题并修复
---

## 📅 每周 Roadmap 与进度追踪

### 📅 10.19 ~ 10.25

- [x] **Bot 主对话与话题自动管理**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **自然语言发起任务：** 用户在 Bot 主对话中直接提出需求，无需手动创建会话、选择 Agent 或 Skill。
    - **话题切换与续接：** 根据输入自动创建或接续话题，支持在多个任务之间切换，并回到已有话题继续交流。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **跨话题连续对话：** 输入“帮我找找上海的篮球场” $\rightarrow$ 输入“帮我计划一个去南京的旅游” $\rightarrow$ 输入“浦东新区的球场呢” $\rightarrow$ 输入“南京有啥好吃的”。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 对话中出现新建或续接话题提示；最后一轮接续“南京三日游行程规划”，返回南京美食建议，内容不与篮球场任务混淆。

- [x] **主动澄清与需求收集**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **主动补全需求：** 面对范围、偏好等信息不完整的请求，Agent 通过交互卡片向用户提问。
    - **反馈驱动执行：** 用户选择并提交回答后，Agent 依据补充条件继续任务，回答记录保留在对话中。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **篮球场需求澄清：** 输入“帮我找找上海的篮球场” $\rightarrow$ 选择“徐汇/静安一带（推荐）”和“免费室外场” $\rightarrow$ 提交回答 $\rightarrow$ 获取场地推荐。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 卡片支持问题切换和发送回答，提交后显示“已回答”；结果体现所选区域和免费室外偏好，并说明未核实的开放、收费或预约信息。

- [x] **多任务后台执行与进展通知**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **后台持续执行：** 用户切换话题或离开聊天页面后，已发起的任务继续运行。
    - **多入口跟踪：** 通过聊天状态、实时活动面板、负一屏卡片和完成通知查看任务进展与结果。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **切换页面跟踪任务：** 发起上海篮球场和南京旅游任务 $\rightarrow$ 查看实时活动面板及负一屏卡片 $\rightarrow$ 返回聊天继续询问浦东球场 $\rightarrow$ 查看此前任务的完成通知。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 不同任务分别显示名称、进度和摘要；切换后仍能看到原任务状态更新，完成通知能够对应到具体任务。

- [x] **结构化结果呈现与异常降级**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **结构化交付：** 将复杂需求整理为文字结论、表格、清单和预算，方便用户阅读与继续追问。
    - **异常降级交付：** 当网页获取或交互式产物生成受阻时，说明限制，并提供可用的文字或表格结果。

  - **验收 Demo：** 手机创建测试会议 → 授权连接 → 在对话查询明天安排并查看来源 → 修改会议后再次查询 → 撤销权限后重试。

- [ ] **定位读取与对话接入｜0.5人日**
  - **开发内容：** 复用定位授权和当前位置读取，返回位置、时间及精度信息，供对话或目标任务使用；处理定位关闭、拒绝和撤销。
  - **工作量依据：** 复用已有定位实现，统一入口、结果包装、调用衔接及异常自测计入本项。
  - **验收 Demo：** 在对话请求当前位置 → 核对读取结果 → 关闭定位或撤销权限 → 返回应用检查状态 → 重新开启后再次读取。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 位置和读取时间有实际依据；关闭或拒绝时明确提示，恢复后可重新读取，其他已授权能力正常。

- [ ] **系统待办读取与对话接入｜暂估2.5人日**
  - **开发内容：** 优先验证手机自带待办的真实读取通路；读取事项、截止时间和完成状态，统一来源并接入对话和目标任务；处理修改、完成、无数据和读取失败。
  - **工作量依据：** 原读取、适配及自测暂估2人日（含约0.5人日真机通路验证）；并入对话调用、来源衔接和联通验证0.5人日。通路确认后校准。
  - **验收 Demo：** 在手机自带待办中创建任务 → 在DigitalMate查询未完成事项 → 修改截止时间、标记完成 → 再次查询 → 与日历一起查询“明天有哪些会议和待办”。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 读取和回答对应手机自带待办中的真实任务，变更及时反映；与日历信息的来源区分清楚；无数据与读取失败分别提示。

#### 随后开展｜暂估4.5人日

- [ ] **通讯录读取与对话接入｜1人日**
  - **开发内容：** 支持用户选择或查询联系人，读取姓名和联系方式，区分重名联系人；统一结果和来源，供对话或目标任务使用，处理空数据和访问状态变化。
  - **工作量依据：** 以系统接口可用于联系人选择或查询为前提，读取、格式适配、调用接入及自测合并计入本项。
  - **验收 Demo：** 添加测试联系人 → 授权或选择后查询 → 核对姓名和号码 → 验证重名联系人 → 修改信息后再次读取。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 联系人与号码正确，重名不混淆，修改可反映；未授权、无匹配和读取失败有明确提示，其他能力正常。

- [ ] **华为健康读取与对话接入｜暂估3人日**
  - **开发内容：** 验证手机本地健康数据读取通路，完成对应授权，首期读取睡眠记录；统一来源、时间和数据格式，供对话及目标任务使用，处理无记录、授权变化和读取失败。
  - **工作量依据：** 含约0.5人日真机通路验证，健康专项接入、授权、读取、结果适配、调用接入和自测均计入本项；通路确认后校准。
  - **验收 Demo：** 手机存在真实睡眠记录 → 完成授权 → 在DigitalMate读取近期记录并查询 → 与华为健康中的时间、时长核对 → 验证无记录或授权失效时的提示。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 回答依据手机真实记录，时间与来源可核对；无数据和失败不产生虚构记录。

- [ ] **照片读取与对话引用｜0.5人日**
  - **开发内容：** 复用已有本地照片选择能力，读取用户选定照片并接入对话或任务引用；处理取消选择、页面切换和读取失败。
  - **工作量依据：** 选择、引用衔接及回归合并在本项，复用现有照片选择和附件通道。
  - **验收 Demo：** 选择两张本地照片 → 在对话中查看并引用 → 核对内容与选择范围 → 取消选择或切换页面后返回。
  - **关键观察与结果：** 读取与引用对应用户选定照片，内容正确；取消不影响原对话，错误和状态变化可见。

---

### 📌 后续候选（可后置）


- [ ] **独立插件：Agent DM 加好友（撞上即可开聊）**
  - **特性描述 (Feature Description):**
    - **独立插件边界：** 相对九问核心、Orbit 主线与名片/身份柜（#190）单独交付；装上即可用，不绑定 Orbit 宿主。
    - **DM 撞上加好友：** 用户在 DM 场景直接加对方 handle / agent，发出请求；对方同意后建立私聊，无需 invite link / grant 流程作为唯一入口。
    - **私聊开聊：** 加好友成功后可双向私信；默认不开放发现广场、不支持随便加陌生 agent 的公开社交图。
    - **与身份柜协作：** 发送时可选名片/身份（#190）；本项只管「跟谁建立 DM」，不管密钥保管。
  - **Demo 演示 (Demo Showcase):**
    - **撞上加好友：** 在九问 DM 输入对方 handle → 发送好友请求 → 对方同意 → 进入私聊并发一条消息。
    - **关键观察与结果：** 好友关系可复用；拒绝/未同意时不能开聊；不出现公开广场或跨 harness 随意加好友；与 #190 选身份发送可同屏演示但不混为同一需求。


---

## 📌 更新规范 (Update Protocol)

1. 每周任务或 Demo 完成后，将对应的 `- [ ]` 更新为 `- [x]`。
2. 可在具体项下补充对应的 PR 链接、测试用例脚本或 Demo 演示链接。

items.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

为会议报告 Demo 的 Intelligent UI 补齐卡片背面交互：用户从卡片正面进入背面，查看本次任务实际处理的关键步骤及关联材料，浏览材料详情后能够平滑返回正面。该任务细化 #918 中的卡片翻面与依据查看，并与报告流程 #1376 协同。

需求表负责人：需辉（仅记录需求表中的姓名，不自动指定 GitHub 账号）。设计依据为需求方提供的 `DM1114规范包.zip`，重点参考 `data/exports/03.卡片背面@2x.png` 和 `data/22-5.png`；用户提供的验收截图列出了翻面、翻回、列表滚动和条目详情的检查步骤。规范文件尚未作为附件上传到本 Issue，下面列出可执行的设计要点。

### Design Ideas

#### 主分支核查结论（静态检查基于 `498bc351`）

- 已有基础：#1269 已合入原生邀约卡和方向卡的翻面、背面弹层、摘要“更多”、分类切换和可滚动内容；#1463 补充了点击外部遮罩返回。当前 [DigitalMateHome 已调用这些卡片并映射报告快照](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets#L4667-L4678)，因此不应再将其描述为仅有独立预览页。
- 材料详情未贯通：生产会话中 [`sourcesAvailable` 固定为 `false`](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets#L4842-L4854)，所以现有来源入口不会显示；即使调用回调，[详情请求的返回字符串目前也没有呈现到界面](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/pages/DigitalMateHome/Index.ets#L4735-L4742)。应核对并正确使用 `source_ref`、`detail_ref`、`source_url` 的各自语义，不能只把开关改成 `true`。
- 真实数据映射与规范存在差异：[分类的标题和来源标签被映射为空](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/cloud/digitalmate/report/ReportCardMapping.ets#L36-L49)；[面板仅保留上下文、知识、技能](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/cloud/digitalmate/report/ReportEvidencePanel.ets#L18-L23)，技能图标使用兜底样式。规范包还展示了“记忆”分类；而 #1269 曾明确只提供三类，**需要产品确认本次四类规范是否覆盖此前决策**，不应伪造不存在的数据。
- 处理步骤和状态需按真实契约核对：当前服务端 [依据视图组装邮件事实、规划 Skill 和传入依据](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/temp/report-goals/src/dm_report_goals/service.py#L371-L395)；`cited`、`loaded`、`planned` 等状态与[客户端状态文案映射](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4/digitalmate/entry/src/main/ets/cloud/digitalmate/report/ReportCardModel.ets#L192-L201)并不一致。还需验证目标 `version` 与依据 `plan_version` 不同、以及历史卡片重开时的匹配逻辑，避免当前依据消失或旧依据被误标为当前版本。

以上是代码核查，不代表设备上的最终效果或真实链路已经验收。

#### 需求范围

1. 基于已有报告卡片，保留正面翻面入口、分段动画、背面翻回按钮及外部遮罩返回；卡片内部点击和滚动不得误触关闭，快速重复点击、切换会话及页面销毁时状态正确。
2. 按规范展示背面摘要、分类与内容区域。摘要较长时最多展示四行并提供“更多”，展开后展示全文且不显示“收起”；翻回后再次进入的展开状态与最终规范对齐。分类采用选中态和相邻项的视觉层级，内容滚动时分类区按设计吸顶。
3. 依据最新规范与产品确认后的分类范围，支持“上下文 / 知识 / 记忆 / 技能”的显示及切换；每类只展示真实可用数据。缺失、加载中、无权限、失败等情况明确提示，不把无效入口显示为可点击。
4. 背面展示有真实记录支持的关键处理步骤或决策说明及其关联材料，不把示例数据当作真实记录。材料有数据时展示标题、来源、时间、关键内容及可用的原文 / 详情入口；不可用的字段如实缺省。摘要内关联标签与列表项应定位或打开对应材料，并支持返回原背面上下文。
5. 文本段落、结构化信息及报告产物按现有来源和文件能力展示；邮件正文、来源和 PPT 的读取均遵循原有权限与归属。关联关系必须属于当前账号、目标、阶段及方案版本，历史卡片应保留对应历史依据。
6. 实现前对齐版本化设计稿与三类/四类决策；在不改变原有选题确认、补充要求和邮件查看行为的前提下复用已合并的组件。依据应是可对用户解释、可验证的处理记录，不暴露模型内部隐式思维链。

### Involved Public APIs

优先复用现有报告快照、`evidence_views`、`report.goal.detail`、邮件和文件入口。由报告服务与客户端共同确认步骤、材料、来源引用、可访问状态及版本字段的契约；如需扩展协议，单独说明兼容和权限边界，避免把来源标识当成可直接读取的详情引用。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

涉及报告目标/处理记录、邮件与其他材料来源、文件/PPT 预览、会话快照和历史卡片，以及卡片 UI。与 #918、#1376 保持范围衔接；已有预览基础见 #1267 / #1269，外部遮罩返回见 #1461 / #1463。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- 对照规范包和用户验收截图：从正面翻到背面，检查关键步骤与材料无缺失、无错位；在背面切换分类、展开摘要、滚动列表、点击材料并返回，最后翻回正面，确认动画与状态正确。
- 覆盖真实快照的分类名称、`cited` / `loaded` / `planned` 等状态、不同来源引用、详情结果及空/无权限/失败状态；覆盖摘要标签定位、列表项点击和真实版本变化，验证不可访问材料不会误开或显示虚假内容。
- 验证同一目标多轮邮件、方案更新、旧卡片、账号/会话切换、刷新及重启，确保数据和链接不串用；回归确认/补充、原邮件打开、遮罩返回和文件查看。
- 自动化覆盖映射、面板交互及客户端与报告服务的契约；随后在真机或可用模拟器使用独立测试数据做端到端验证，记录安装版本、结果、规范对照截图或录屏。检查窄屏、大字体、读屏和长内容滚动。

本次核查已运行现有 `digitalmate-report-cards` 与 `digitalmate-report-card-mapping` 两组 Node 测试，共 20 项通过；它们使用测试替身，不能作为真机及真实材料链路验收。

### Additional Information

本 Issue 负责细化背面 UI 和依据查看，不表示 #918 / #1376 的完整报告流程已经完成。请在实施设计阶段补充团队可访问的规范包或设计稿链接，并保存实际验收截图。

items.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

实际主线合入 #1176 后，用现有连接保存入口新建普通本地 Slack 连接，或重新保存从旧版继承的同一连接，都会写入带新增字段的 `connection` 记录。回退至 #1176 之前的主线后，旧 `EngineStore.get/list` 都在解析该记录时拒绝。只启动新版、读取旧记录时，同一行原始 payload 的摘要保持一致，旧版仍能正常读取。最早复现于新版首次成功保存普通原生连接，无需启用远端配置、托管账户、订阅或 OAuth。

旧 `Record` 拒绝额外字段。新版通用 Store serializer 会写出八个新字段，普通 `ConnectionRegistry.save` 将授权代次增至 1。期望是在原支持的回退路径保留普通连接的可读取性，并保持已经存在的授权代次、回执和不确定结果，或在不兼容写入前由经审定的原 Store 路径明确拒绝旧版接管并提供已验证的恢复路径。

把以下脚本保存为 `probe.py`，在已有服务端 Python 依赖的环境中运行。用两个实际源码版本和全新的临时目录。第一次写入后，新版和同版本均能读旧记录。第二次写入后，旧版两条读取都报 `extra_forbidden`，脚本退出 3。脚本仅打印拒绝字段名。传输替身会拒绝任何供应商调用。

```sh
python -I -B probe.py <12891830-source> write <temp>/old
python -I -B probe.py <5d5339eb-source> read <temp>/old
python -I -B probe.py <5d5339eb-source> write <temp>/new
python -I -B probe.py <12891830-source> read <temp>/new
```

```python
"""Exercise normal native Registry save and an actual older Store's readback."""
from pathlib import Path
import argparse
import hashlib
import sqlite3
import sys

parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
parser.add_argument("source", type=Path)
parser.add_argument("command", choices=["write", "read", "inspect", "update"])
parser.add_argument("workspace", type=Path)
args = parser.parse_args()
bridge = args.source / "harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src"
sys.path[:0] = [str(bridge), str(args.source / "temp/connection-foundation/src"), str(args.source)]
from pydantic import ValidationError
from server_engine import engine_workspace, engine_config
from server_engine.engine_connectors import registry as implementation

for module in [engine_workspace, engine_config, implementation]:
    assert Path(module.__file__).resolve().is_relative_to(bridge)
class NoProvider:
    async def request(self, *args, **kwargs):
        raise AssertionError("local connection settings unexpectedly called a provider")

args.workspace.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
store = engine_workspace.EngineStore(args.workspace / "digitalmate.db")
try:
    connection_model = engine_workspace.Connection
    print("CPython",sys.version.split()[0],"SQLite",sqlite3.sqlite_version)
    if args.command in {"write", "update"}:
        config = engine_config.EngineConfiguration(args.workspace, {"DIGITALMATE_SECRET_STORE": "file"})
        registry = implementation.ConnectionRegistry(store, config, NoProvider())
        records = store.list("connection", connection_model)
        assert len(records) == (1 if args.command == "update" else 0)
        saved = registry.save("slack", "Synthetic rollback fixture", "user", {"user_token": "xoxp-synthetic"},
                              records[0].id if records else "")
        assert store.get("connection", saved.id, connection_model).id == saved.id
        assert len(store.list("connection", connection_model)) == 1
        print("actual Registry save and same-source Store read PASS",
              "generation",getattr(saved,"authorization_generation", "absent"))
    elif args.command == "inspect":
        rows = store.connection.execute("SELECT payload FROM records WHERE kind='connection'").fetchall()
        assert len(rows) == 1
        assert len(store.list("connection", connection_model)) == 1
        print("unchanged stored payload SHA256",hashlib.sha256(rows[0][0].encode()).hexdigest())
    else:
        row = store.connection.execute("SELECT id FROM records WHERE kind='connection'").fetchall()
        assert len(row) == 1
        probes = (("get", lambda: store.get("connection",row[0][0],connection_model)),
                  ("list", lambda: store.list("connection",connection_model)))
        errors = []
        for name, read in probes:
            try:
                read()
            except ValidationError as exc:
                fields = sorted(error["loc"][0] for error in exc.errors() if error["type"] == "extra_forbidden")
                assert len(fields) == len(exc.errors()) == 8
                errors.append(fields)
                print("actual Store",name,"rejected fields",",".join(fields))
            else:
                print("actual Store",name,"accepted")
        if errors:
            assert len(errors) == 2 and errors[0] == errors[1]
            raise SystemExit(3)
finally:
    store.close()
```

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS 26.6.2（arm64）、CPython 3.13.13、SQLite 3.50.4。使用实际 ConnectionRegistry、EngineConfiguration 与真实文件 SQLite 的 EngineStore，网络出站禁止，文件写入限定私有临时目录。输入为本地 file mode 与合成连接记录，未调用供应商、真实账户、客户端、共享设备或部署。

### Additional Information

现有物理写入方是 EngineStore，Registry 执行原连接保存。修复范围由 Store、配置、M43 身份授权与 M44 连接源 owner 协调，保留 #1176 已有记录、回执、授权代次与未知结果。关联 #1176、#833、#834。#1271 处理同版本保存失败时配置文件字节恢复，已有实际 Main 回执通过，和本 Issue 的跨版本记录读取是不同故障。真实部署遇到该故障的频率未知。

### Version Information

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

#1176 合入后的实际 `main` `5d5339eba820e656a11d1d339fee83f6a3aeb2e6` 把 Connection Foundation 的仓库源码与测试路径登记进现有服务器选集，并给 Bridge 新增固定 Hatch wheel 映射。标准安装门禁在构建前拒绝这份实际主线源码。普通 CI 中的远程服务端作业仍是跳过，因而需要标准本地路径提供完整验收。

在该提交的干净源码根目录分别执行下面两次，命令只调用已提交的实际 manifest 入口，无依赖下载、网络或容器。将最后的 `contracts` 替换为 `bridge` 运行第二次。

from pathlib import Path

source = Path.cwd()
profile = runpy.run_path(str(source / "scripts/ci/server_contract_package.py"))
print(len(profile[sys.argv[1] + "_manifest"](source).files))
PY
```

同一脚本分别从两个精确源码导出运行。为避免公开本机路径，以下将真实前缀替换为 `<repo>` 和 `<probe>`。

    raise PackageProofError("bridge resource mapping needs independent review")

两个实际 Main 入口均退出 2。上一实际主线 `12891830c1e65b3a31bfada15547180755f88b15` 的同一入口分别返回 Root34 和 Bridge287，退出 0。当前 `server-tests.py` 可解析新的 13 分组登记和新增 Connection Foundation 包根。

配置源码验收另有两个精确输入缺口。旧依赖回执拒绝当前 Bridge 元数据，新增的直接依赖是 `portalocker>=3.2,<4`，旧 SDK 目标已间接含 portalocker，但仍需按当前元数据重新形成回执。配置 worker 原入口未声明新包根。单独提供真实包源码后，其原始来源检查仍拒绝 `dm_connection_foundation`，报 `candidate module bypassed declared source or dependency owner`。这是对精确来源检查的窄探针。完整配置组、安装及 Linux 全量未执行。两份 vendored SDK 的原始源码身份核验已通过。

期望当前实际主线可通过普通可信路径建立明确的安装与配置源码证据。保留原 Root 固定生产源码、owner 测试、旧分组和拒绝断言。Bridge 校验应精确允许已声明的固定 force-include、来源文件及包内容，继续拒绝任意映射、路径逃逸、软链接和未登记文件。配置 worker 须证明新包、原真实调用方、依赖与现有固定 7/55 选集的来源。

### Detailed Environment Information Description

macOS 26.6.2 arm64，CPython 3.13.13。Git raw-tree 源码导出、清空环境、禁止网络、仅允许临时目录写入。真实仓库 manifest、来源检查和固定 SDK 元数据。两个 manifest 入口在构建前停止，Linux 容器、安装、客户端和部署未启动。

### Additional Information

关联 #1176、#1280、#1279、#737。#1176 的原生 Node、Hypium、架构、ArkTS、设备 ST 与 `pr-ready` 是独立证据。该问题只跟踪实际主线 canonical server 安装、选集和配置来源的配套接入。修复宜按可信门禁变更流程做独立审阅及定向正反对照。

<!-- DM31:POST-HIVE-20261116 -->
**2026-11-16 post-Hive 重定基。** 基线 [498bc351](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/commit/498bc351b3a5dc1c1b982171aa4111ac298914c4)，#1605 已合入，#1313 / #1316 已关闭。架构重构的当前总计划为 #737，里程碑为 #963。本段取代下方与旧 Router/Hosted 默认执行装配相冲突的实施指令，历史来源、原通过/失败和未运行证据仍归原 SHA。

保留本 Issue 原 owner、支持行为、单 writer、真实调用、权限/Stop/ACK/UNKNOWN 及独立 QA 要求。Hive 合入不代表本项原范围完成。#1665 的具体缺陷、新增能力与体验改进由原产品工作线交付，本任务不复制修复，也不把 #1665 整单关闭作为依赖。若其缺陷阻断本项原验收，记录精确场景及 owner，保持该项 FAIL/BLOCKED，其他独立切片继续。

**当前实施与验收方向**

最终独立验收保留 #827/#746/#845/#848 全部原硬依赖。单列 Hive 切流回执、源码边界/目录完成、生产装配、客户端 A/B、性能、数据恢复和差异处置。A10 #760 关闭按 superseded/not_planned 计，不能计 completed；原 103 分母保留。12/07 legacy_inventory 退场是必要架构关口，不能替代整体产品/生产/独立 QA 完成。

<!-- /DM31:POST-HIVE-20261116 -->

### 📚 Documentation Issue Description

<!-- DM31:Q11 -->

Parent: [DigitalMate v3.1 production server migration](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/737). Stable task ID: `DM31-Q11`.

**Outcome:** Release/parity claims match actual unchanged-client and authoritative backend evidence with every open difference visible.

**Owner:** Independent QA reviewer. **Batch:** P4: independent integration and cutover evidence. **Size:** 0.5 working day; existing leaves reused, prerequisites excluded.

**Not responsible for:**
- Reviewer is not corresponding implementation author
- No reinterpretation of BLOCKED as PASS

**Frozen main:** `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`. **Architecture reference:** `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`. Implementation PR base: current `main`; reconcile intervening changes against the source map. No validation-branch merge or implementation claimed here.

### Improvement and Fix Suggestions

**Concrete transfer / deliverable:** Produce the stated contract, inventory, checker or independent evidence artifact using `architecture@f7dd:docs/procedures/verification.md::Architecture review before merging an implementation` as the concrete source. Preserve the accepted owner and scope; this preparation/verification task does not claim code migration.

**Target component / proposed path / published interface:** docs/verification/v31-migration-independent-verdict.md (planned artifacts; retain existing shared drivers/assertions)

**Source evidence:**
- Architecture reference [docs/procedures/verification.md](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4/docs/procedures/verification.md) — `Architecture review before merging an implementation`; SHA `f7dd5aa09403db165820158c14bc90f0906d1fb4`.
- Frozen main [tests/e2e/workflow/evidence-integrity.mjs](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea/tests/e2e/workflow/evidence-integrity.mjs) — `evidence integrity module`; SHA `1b67babf3b5c7571c25920876fa3f62b0c9cf8ea`.

**Reuse classification:** Selective adaptation of named behavior and tests; new owner/contract implementation where legacy authority cannot be retained. Reference implementations are review inputs, not a whole-directory copy.

**Preserve:**
- Original attempts, failures, metadata and independent scoring

**Remove or redirect authority / I/O:**
- Fake/component/history evidence substituted for device acceptance

**Writable boundary:**
- docs/verification/v31-migration-independent-verdict.md

**Read-only sources:** the source list above until an explicitly listed compatibility delegate is changed in this PR. Other owners' public interfaces are dependencies, not permission to edit their private modules. Original user checkout and other session worktrees remain read-only.

**Shared-type and state owners:** A01 owns core M/S/R/error public types; A14 owns hook/attempt/reservation contract coordination; Session Store owner exclusively serializes schema, admission, context, receipt and accounting records; Host lifecycle owner serializes dispatch/Stop/finalization. Request changes through their owning issues. This task owns only its declared module and tests.

**Hard blocked-by:** [DM31-Q10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/827), [DM31-G10](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/issues/746)

**Blocks:** No direct implementation blocker; consumed by the final integration gate.

**May proceed in parallel:** Disjoint owner modules and fixture preparation once their public contracts exist; no concurrent edit to this task’s writable files.

**Integration gate (not a blocker on independent preparation):** Run affected cross-component UT/ST on the combined main head after each batch; independent QA proves the default public path and relevant unchanged-phone cases. A fake may not replace the owner whose behavior is under test.

**Rollback / persisted-format impact:** Keep compatibility reads and stable identities. For new persisted fields, declare the encoding/version and old-reader behavior with the Store owner before activation; unsupported downgrade fails closed. Before switching traffic, fence old writers and prove compatible readers. Rolling back new admissions never replays an unknown effect, restores legacy execution, changes a committed terminal, or discards unsettled accounting.

**Accepted scope and unresolved decisions:** No new authority or product semantic is accepted by this task. Any listed proposed interface is an implementation proposal under the frozen contracts.

**Verification and evidence**

All commands below are **planned acceptance**, except explicitly identified existing characterization commands. None was run as product verification by the planning session.

**Inputs and observable assertions:**

- [ ] The observable result above is demonstrated by its normal and meaningful failure/concurrency cases.
- [ ] For migrated behavior, the default configured production call path now reaches the new owner. A preparation/contract/QA task instead delivers its exact stated artifact and does not claim a production switch.
- [ ] The old entry is removed or delegates only through published proxies; no duplicate authority, dual write or silent old-executor fallback remains for this migrated capability.
- [ ] Reintroducing direct provider/storage calls or reconnecting the old executor makes the appropriate gate fail; the legal fixture still passes.
- [ ] The extension interface, owner, exact test command and migration inventory are updated for subsequent feature developers.
- [ ] Independent integration evidence is linked; task closure alone does not close the master architecture or main-behavior gate.

**Coverage:** mobile protocol, idempotency, attachments, references. **Architecture rules / accepted contracts:** ADR-0001, ADR-0004, AR01, AR04, AR06, AR09.

Research: [main capabilities](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/main-capabilities.md), [architecture evidence](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/architecture-evidence.md), [CI and QA](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/research/gates-qa.md), [migration developer guide](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/codex/v31-server-migration-plan/docs/plans/v31-server-migration/developer-guide.md).

items.author: Evelynn-V
items.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

PR #1601 added the Hive trustworthiness "startup batch": the `temp/hive-trust/` diagnostics partition
(correlated events with evidence kinds, a conservative no-reply investigator), emitters at the real
Beebou owner boundaries, and the packaging/ownership declarations that make the package buildable and
visible to the architecture gates.

#1601 was merged into `hive/hive3-integration` at 14:38 CST on 2026-11-16 (`e3bcc0c3`) and reverted two
minutes later (`47e5a102`) because the v3.1 lead had frozen scope for the Router-retirement cutover
(#1605), and that day's G5/G6 runs, behaviour QA and device receipt did not cover the Beebou turn-path
changes. The branch `feat/hive-trust-hardening` was left untouched. #1605 is now merged into `main`
(`498bc351`), so this issue tracks re-landing the same change on `main`.

Tracked under #1344 and the post-HIVE collection #1665.

### Design Ideas

- Re-land by reverting the revert (`47e5a102`) on a branch from `main`, rather than re-opening #1601:
  git already records those commits as merged, so the original branch has an empty diff against `main`.
- Behavior stays opt-in: `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_DIAGNOSTICS` absent or `off` installs no recorder; an
  unknown value refuses startup instead of silently disabling evidence.
- The partition stays read-only and temporary until the observability owner publishes the event schema;
  emitters stay at commit/observation boundaries only.
- Not included here (separate follow-ups): a `CLIENT_DISPLAY` producer from the client, and a reader that
  parses `hive_diag` log lines back into events.

### Involved Public APIs

- New package `dm_hive_trust.diagnostics`: `DiagnosticEvent`, `EventLog`, `Stage`, `EvidenceKind`,
  `DiagnosticRecorder`, `DiagnosticReceiver`, `NoReplyInvestigator`, `investigate_message`,
  `investigate_delivery`, `configured_recorder`, `SETTING`.
- `investigate_message` / `investigate_delivery` require a `scope_token` keyword.
- No existing public interface changes; the Bridge imports the package only when the setting is `log`.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- Bridge Beebou turn path: `server_engine/hive_turn_startup.py`, `hive_beebou_model.py`,
  `hive_beebou_tools.py`, `server_engine/server.py` (assembly).
- Ownership/architecture: `temp/hive-beebou/ownership.json` (`hive-trust-diagnostics` in `allowed`,
  `legacy-mobile-gateway` admitted as caller) and `temp/hive-trust/ownership.json`.
- Packaging/CI: Bridge `pyproject.toml` wheel force-include, `.github/ci-gates.json`
  (`sourcePaths` / `sourcePackages`), `scripts/ci/server_context_source.py`,
  `tests/server/test_installed_package_proof.py`.

### Test Design and Test Plan

Local, executed on the re-land branch before the PR:

- `pytest temp/hive-trust/tests -q` -> 52 passed.
- `pytest temp/hive-beebou/tests tests/architecture/test_import_gate.py -q` -> 111 passed, 29 subtests.
- `tools/architecture/transition.py --check docs/implementations/migration/module-ownership.json --root .`
  -> exit 0.

Covered by this batch: owner-boundary emitters over real owners (real `deliver` with
`SQLiteSessionRepository`, real `HiveTurnStartup.accept`, controlled model gateway, faulting tool
provider, failing and succeeding push callables); lost ACK, deadline-cut commit, receipt mismatch,
malformed tool call, concurrent turns, unsafe identifiers, failing sink.

Not covered and not to be reported as passed: T02, T04-T80, C01-C24, H01-H08; the `telethon`-dependent
Bridge scenario tests; real device display (`CLIENT_DISPLAY` has no producer yet); any cloud deployment.

Planned end-to-end verification for this re-land:

1. `python3.13 tests/scenarios/run_hive.py --gate G1 --report hive-g1.json --markdown hive-g1.md --prepare-deps .hive-deps-venv`.
2. One test-environment deployment with `DIGITALMATE_HIVE_DIAGNOSTICS=log` driving the four fault cases
   (lost ACK, accepted but unclaimed, model/tool start without terminal, committed but undisplayed) and
   reading the emitted `hive_diag` lines.

### Additional Information

- Merge commit `e3bcc0c3`, revert `47e5a102`, cutover `#1605`, original branch
  `feat/hive-trust-hardening` at `d5d338e4`. Re-land branch `feat/hive-trust-reland`.
- Review findings F1-F8 and R1-R8, each with its test, are recorded in `temp/hive-trust/TRACEABILITY.md`.

### Related trust items collected in #1665

These post-cutover items are the symptoms this diagnostics layer is meant to make provable. This
re-land does not fix them; it supplies the correlated evidence and the conservative "where did it
stop" answer they need:

- #1637 (STEER-01): a reply says a steer was added while its receipt is still pending and unconsumed.
  The evidence rules here are exactly what separates "the owner admitted it" from "a reply claims it".
- #1650: the Home transcript never shows Beebou's relays of Bee results. Display is only proven by a
  `CLIENT_DISPLAY` event, which has no producer yet (listed as a follow-up above).
- #1653: after an accepted dispatch, the turn settles as a generic failure although the Bee got the
  task. The investigator reports `UNKNOWN` with the missing fact and next owner instead of a generic
  failure.
- #1655: orphaned `RUNNING` Bee Runs after restart or a missing terminal. Correlation by
  message/delivery/task ref is what a recovery walk needs to find them.
- #1663: the device receipt runner should enforce each row's required step list. The same rule applies
  here: a row without its named evidence is `NOT_RUN`, not a pass.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

运行本机托管 WorkSwarm 的正常 `serve --hosted-sessions` 路径（不选择 `--hosted-context`）时，Bridge 会在 Gateway 已就绪后因工厂观察不可用而退出。当前 CLI 提前启动 launcher，但当时 adapter 的 `factory_profiles` 仍为 false。随后实际 Bridge 才把该属性设为 true，adapter 发现已有子进程便跳过带本地控制 socket 和 generation 的启动步骤。初始启动前没有任何 Registry 工厂准备调用。

隔离复现使用仓库已安装的服务端 Python 依赖和可写临时工作区。调用 `engine_cli.serve(workspace, env, "127.0.0.1", 0, hosted_sessions=True)`，环境用合成 API_KEY、API_BASE 和 MODEL_NAME 配置本机 launcher。两侧均以实际 aiohttp 启动回调运行 `Bridge.start`，保留真实 Bridge、Registry、Store、adapter 与 Unix FactoryControl。仅将 Gateway 就绪传输和 launcher 的工作负载换成本地受控实现，提供可观察的进程与 socket/generation；两个源版本应用同一替身。

- `fcb6480c`：唯一子进程缺两项工厂参数，Gateway 就绪一次，工厂准备调用为零，Bridge 启动失败，随后真实清理回收此受控子进程。

```

预期是已选择 Hosted sessions 的本机托管 launcher 以完整工厂参数启动一次，随后 Bridge 正常完成其拥有者的就绪检查。保留未选 Hosted、选 Hosted context 以及外部管理 WorkSwarm 的既有分支。

实际主线 `fcb6480c9b5456ae3090d2c228b5e79e14acd37b`，对照其第一父提交 `1f807a79962bea8959f5dfa4d54dda42cc6338c2`。生产启动变更随 [#1068](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/pull/1068) 合入。

items.body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed in the latest version.
- [x] Please note that if your bug description lacks corresponding environment information and a minimal reproducible demo, it will be difficult for us to reproduce and resolve the issue, which will reduce the possibility of receiving feedback, or even lead to the issue being closed.

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

配置了 Hosted Context 的 Workspace 在启动初期会先打开原生 SQLite 数据库，随后检查资源并登记 Store。如果 SQLite 初始化失败，且关闭原生句柄也在实际关闭前失败，启动错误返回后，租约的资源登记仍为空。实际 `WorkspaceAuthority.close()` 因此可以释放原租约，而原生工作区数据库句柄仍未关闭。SQLite 初始化抛出 `OperationalError` 时，关闭异常还会成为向外抛出的异常，原始错误只留在异常上下文中。

在仓库现有 Python 环境中，用全新的临时 Workspace、真实 `WorkspaceAuthority` 和 `EngineStore(hosted_sessions=True, hosted_context=True)` 复核。只在该临时 `digitalmate.db` 的 SQLite 初始化与原生关闭前注入故障。观察启动异常、登记数量、租约关闭结果与测试持有的原生句柄状态。两组故障都得到「登记 0、租约已关闭、原生句柄仍打开」。测试清理阶段关闭了两个原生句柄。未打开第二个 Workspace，未使用真实工作区数据。

预期行为是原租约持续持有未关闭的原生资源，直至原持有者确认关闭，且启动错误保留为主异常，清理失败保留为次要诊断。正常启动及正常关闭仍由现有所有者完成。

SQLite 初始化错误路径的合成堆栈（路径已脱敏）：

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
### What happens

`HiveStore.read_beebou_history` (SC05-M2 contract v1, #1608) sets the `hive-beebou-v1` watermark to the lowest unconsumed Beebou `user` input seq minus one. If a user input is left unconsumed on a Beebou session that no consumer can ever claim again, the watermark stops there for good. That covers a retired Bot Session, a session generation that was replaced, or an evicted binding. `LiveIngestion` then holds that source's cursor: later Beebou turns are recorded early, but only within one page (`[pages] size`), and nothing past that page is ingested.

Turns are delayed, not lost, but on a long-lived workspace the delay has no end.

### Decision (Phase 3 coordinator, 2026-11-16)

The cursor skips, with an audit record, any input whose Beebou session is RETIRED or evicted, since no consumer can take it. Scheduled for v3.5; the v1 limit is accepted for this release.

### Sketch

- `read_beebou_history` excludes from the watermark any unconsumed input whose target session is retired (`dm_hive_bot_sessions.retired = 1`) or whose binding generation no longer matches. It returns those inputs separately as `unclaimable`.
- `LiveIngestion` records each one in `hl_items` with outcome `skipped`, how `unclaimable_session`, carrying the session ref and seq, so Ops can see it. The cursor moves past it in the same transaction.
- Tests: an input stranded on a retired session no longer holds the cursor; it is recorded `unclaimable_session` exactly once; a live session's in-flight input still holds the cursor.

Refs #1312, #1608.
items.title: hive-memory: skip Beebou inputs stranded on a retired session so they don't stall the live-ingestion cursor

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

#1242 SC04-A5 (PR #1606) erases a withdrawn artifact's bytes from DM-managed storage:
- the WorkSwarm artifact directory;
- for private Hive documents, HiveDocumentBytes via `HiveDocumentErasure`;
- the engine Store, with SQLite `secure_delete` on and a WAL checkpoint after erasure.

**v3.1 decision (§7a):** erasure means absence from managed storage. Backup retention follows Ops policy. Withdrawn bytes and rows may therefore still exist in workspace backups, snapshots or replicas until those age out.

### Design Ideas
- Inventory every place a workspace's data is copied: volume snapshots, image or volume backups, the nightly HK pipeline, exports and replicas.
- Choose one of the following.
  - **Crypto-shredding:** a per-artifact or per-workspace data key, so erasing the key makes backup copies unreadable.
  - **Replay on restore:** keep the erasure intents and tombstones outside the backup scope, and run them again against any restored data before it serves.
  - **Bounded retention:** a documented maximum backup age, after which no withdrawn bytes remain.
- Add a restore test: restore a backup taken before an erasure and confirm the withdrawn bytes are never served and are erased again.

### Involved Public APIs
- The erasure intent ledger (#1606), for replay on restore.
- Ops backup and restore runbooks.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules
#1242 / #1606 (erasure intents and worker), #1596 (`HiveDocumentErasure`), Store owner question 7, and the Ops backup policy.

### Test Design and Test Plan
A backup taken before the withdrawal, restored after the erasure: the withdrawn bytes are refused at serve time and erased again before serving.

### Additional Information
Planned for v3.5. Out of scope for v3.1 by coordinator decision (§7a).
items.title: [Hive] Erasure of withdrawn artifacts does not reach backups (v3.5)

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

On the Router-free build (`hive/router-free-916ad25`, `277c008a`), Bees have two model-bound document-text read tools:
- `read_own_pdf`: `OwnHivePdfReader`, `temp/bee-artifacts/src/dm_bee_artifacts/artifacts/hive_pdf.py`.
- `read_home_input_pdf`: `BeeInputPdfReader`, `temp/hive-runtime/src/dm_hive_runtime/assembly/bee_input_pdf.py`.

Each call is fenced when it is made. The grant or hold is re-checked before and after text extraction (`hive_pdf.py:41-52`, `engine_attachments.py:466-481`, `bee_effects.py:316-333`), and nothing caches extracted text. A read made after a withdrawal is refused.

Withdrawal does **not** fence text that has already been read. `withdraw_hive_document` (`session_proximity/hive_busy.py:2866-2877`) only writes a tombstone, and revoking a Home attachment hold only changes the source state:
- **Leak A: Bee Session tool results.** The text returned by a read becomes a tool result in the WorkSwarm Bee Session's conversation. Bee Sessions persist across turns, so that text is sent to the model again on every later step of the Run and on later turns of the same Session.
- **Leak B: Beebou context heads.** A Bee answer that quotes the document text is committed and enters Beebou's context head (`dm_hive_beebou_context_heads`). That context is sent to Beebou's model on every later turn.

**v3.1 decision (§7a):**
- Withdrawal blocks every new model-bound read when the call is made, and the byte owner's worker erases the stored bytes.
- Text that a conversation has already received leaves only through scoped reset, Bee Session eviction, or deleting the conversation.
- Model reads therefore ship off by default (`[documents] model_reads = false`, the gate PR into `hive/router-free-916ad25`) until this fence exists.

### Design Ideas

1. **Session rotation plus Beebou redaction.**
   - Record each document read: document operation or source, Bee Session, Run.
   - On withdrawal, end every Bee Session that read the document (scheme two: a new incarnation with a new Session and empty Local Memory).
   - Redact the Beebou context-head messages derived from those Runs. Messages must be linked by Run or task ref, not matched by text.
   - Pending or queued turns of a rotated Session follow the eviction rules.
2. **Runtime-side redaction of tool results.**
   - The runtime marks document-read tool results as revocable, keyed by document identity.
   - On withdrawal, the Host asks the runtime to drop or replace those results in the Session's persisted conversation and checkpointer.
   - This needs a runtime API (pinned WorkSwarm), plus the same Beebou redaction as option 1.

Either option needs a proof that a later model call contains none of the withdrawn text. Example: a canary string in the document is absent from every later model request.

### Involved Public APIs
- Store (#1311): a document-read ledger, and possibly a redaction or rotation record.
- Host (#1309): the withdrawal handler fans out to Session rotation or runtime redaction.
- Runtime: a tool-result redaction API (option 2 only).
- `hive_busy` Beebou context heads: redaction by Run.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules
- #1309 Host Bee execution, #1311 Store, #1242 artifacts (SC04-A3/A5).
- #1268 / #1478 eviction (scheme two).
- The `model_reads` gate PR on `hive/router-free-916ad25`.

### Test Design and Test Plan
- A canary document is read by a Bee and quoted to Beebou, then withdrawn.
- No later Bee model request (same Run, later turns) and no later Beebou model request contains the canary.
- Replays and restarts keep that property.
- The pinned-runtime test needs coordinator approval for a Mac Bee runtime slot.

### Additional Information
- Planned for v3.5 unless it turns out to be small.
- Until it lands, `model_reads` stays off by default.
items.title: [Hive] Withdrawal does not fence document text already read into a Bee Session or Beebou context

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
### What is missing

Once a backfill identity spends `budget.judge_calls_per_run` (`temp/hive-memory/src/dm_hive_memory/config/backfill.toml`), every later ambiguous turn is ingested as an unclassified fragment (`how='ambiguous'`). Nothing can re-judge those turns today:

- `BackfillRunner.begin` keeps one identity per scope: `hb_runs` is keyed by (workspace, principal), and a repeat returns the stored identity.
- A unit the provider already holds is never judged again. `_item` takes the `held` branch, because the unit key (`source_key + source_rev + locator + registry_version`) is unchanged.
- Clearing the `hb_*` tables by hand does not help, as #1487 review F3 checked: the re-walk records every turn `ingested/held` with 0 judge calls.

### Decision until this exists

Phase 3 delivery §7a: the judge budget is a permanent cap per backfill identity. Turns that ran out of budget stay `ambiguous` and are not judged again. `backfill.toml` and the `temp/hive-memory` README say so, as of #1487 at 0531d9e6.

### What the tooling needs

A Runtime / Ops entry that re-classifies the `how='ambiguous'` items of an identity under a fresh judge budget, without re-reading history. For example:
- re-ingest those turns under a bumped `registry_version`, so they get new unit keys and the provider replaces the earlier revision; or
- add an explicit re-classify pass over `hb_items`.

Its spend must stay in the `hb_judge_calls` ledger and stay bounded by config. Acceptance: an identity whose budget ran out can have its ambiguous turns classified by an Ops action, and each turn is still published once.

Refs #1312, #1487 (review F2 / F3).
items.title: hive-memory: Ops entry to re-classify backfill turns left ambiguous by the judge budget

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**现象：** 之前发出去的任务，重新打开会话后接收不到回答；App 界面显示红色「回复失败：本次执行因云端执行服务不可用而中断，请稍后重试；如持续出现，请联系服务管理员」，无法确认云端是否执行成功。看起来是传输/回传侧的问题。

**已核对的事实（以 issue #1581 为例）：**
- 之前那条「在 #1581 补充 App 版本号 0.1.11 + 贴图」的任务，界面提示「两件事都已完成」，经核对 GitHub 侧确实已落盘：Version Information 已填为 0.1.11，Screenshots / Recordings 已内嵌截图。→ 说明该任务云端实际执行成功、结果完整，只是回复没能回传到客户端。
- 随后一条「请查看附件：IMG_20261115_175443 / 175439 / 175426 / 175418 / 175403 …这个讲了什么」的任务，界面出现上述「回复失败」红色提示，且在 #1581 中找不到这 5 张图或对应分析结果，说明该任务大概率未跑完。

**复现步骤：**
1. 在 DigitalMate App 中发起一个任务（会调用工具/产生较长回复），等待执行。
2. 任务进行中或完成后把 App 切走，之后重新打开该会话。
3. 观察：接收不到回答，出现「回复失败：本次执行因云端执行服务不可用而中断」的红色提示；无法确认云端任务是否执行成功。

**期望结果：** 任务在云端执行完成后，重新打开会话应能取回并显示结果；若回复在传输/回传环节失败，应给出可重试、可查询执行状态的明确入口，而不是只提示「云端执行服务不可用」而丢失结果。

**实际结果：** 重新打开接收不到回答，无法确认云端是否执行成功；至少有一条任务（#1581 更新）实际已在云端成功，却仍提示回复失败，说明「结果已生成」与「结果已回传」不一致。

**影响：** 用户无法判断任务是否真正执行，也无法取回已生成的结果，容易导致重复提交，或误以为数据未写入。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- App：DigitalMate（Jiuwen DigitalMate，Android 客户端）
- 平台：Android
- 网络：移动数据 / 5G
- 场景：多轮对话；任务执行时间较长、或在执行过程中切换 / 重开会话时触发

### Additional Information
- 该问题疑似为「传输 / 回传侧」缺陷：云端结果可能已生成，但客户端未能取回。
- 供对照的已执行成功案例：openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate#1581（版本号 0.1.11 与截图均已写入）。
- 附两张截图：一张为出现「回复失败：云端执行服务不可用」的会话（06:31），另一张为同一会话中任务显示「两件事都已完成」并开始核对新发送结果的界面（06:30）。

### Version Information
- App 版本号：0.1.11
- 平台：Android

### Screenshots / Recordings

![transport-reply-failed-20261115.jpg](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/transport-reply-failed-20261115.jpg?raw=true)

![transport-reopen-no-reply-20261115.jpg](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/issue-screenshots/issue-assets/transport-reopen-no-reply-20261115.jpg?raw=true)

items.author: lh913137941
items.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

近期鸿蒙端日历权限调整（见 #1460、#1556）和应用市场的权限声明提示表明，端侧权限变更需要在 PR 阶段被清楚地识别和审阅。当前 `tests/unit/brand-identity.test.mjs` 对声明清单有固定值校验，但测试可与清单同时调整，CI 没有单独展示权限的新增、删除及用途变化，审阅者也无法仅凭它核对发布侧的隐私声明。

希望增加端侧权限变更 CI，在现有功能保持不变的前提下，帮助开发者和审阅者及时发现权限变化、理解原因，并完成发布前检查。

### Design Ideas

**[设计草案（可编辑 PPTX，待设计评审）](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/fabd550da573275b80b4a5df4ceb70741ae68bfb/docs/assets/feature-design/issue-1584-permission-ci-design-draft.pptx)**

1. 在 PR CI 中以实际目标分支的基线和 PR 版本为输入，使用 JSON5 解析器读取鸿蒙端各模块 `module.json5` 的 `requestPermissions`，语义化比较权限声明。报告每项新增、删除或变更的权限、模块路径，以及用途说明引用、适用场景（如 `usedScene`）等前后差异；资源值发生变化时也应能提示。格式、注释和列表顺序变化不应产生伪差异。
2. 除清单外，识别涉及运行时申请权限的代码改动并提示审阅，以免只关注声明而遗漏使用方式的改变。静态检查存在动态路径限制，报告应说明覆盖范围，不能将未发现变更描述为权限使用已全面验证。
3. 在 CI 检查摘要中展示结果，并为权限变更提供明确的原因说明和审阅入口。权限变更是否需要强制人工批准、在哪个环节阻断，由项目维护者在设计评审中确定。无权限变化的正常 PR 应通过；基线不可获取、解析失败、重复或无效声明等异常应明确失败，不能静默跳过。
4. 校验逻辑应有可信基线，避免 PR 同时修改权限和检查脚本而绕过检查；考虑 fork PR 场景，并避免在有写权限或密钥的上下文执行不可信 PR 代码。
5. 若构建任务产生安装包，可补充安装包权限与源码声明的一致性检查。开发者中心的隐私政策属于外部配置：没有可用的机器可读输入和授权时，CI 无法证明二者一致，应将发布侧核对列为明确的人工检查，避免给出误导性的通过结论。

范围先覆盖仓库现有鸿蒙端权限声明与申请入口，并为未来其他端预留扩展方式；此需求仅改 CI、检查工具和测试，不改变端侧运行时功能或云侧服务。设计草案基于[可编辑的 Feature 设计模板](https://github.com/openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate/blob/main/docs/assets/feature-design/feature-design-template.pptx)，须完成评审后再合并实现 PR。

### Involved Public APIs

预计无需新增或修改产品公开 API。CI 结果的形式、权限变更审批方式及包内清单来源待设计评审确定。

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

影响 PR CI、鸿蒙模块权限声明及权限申请相关检查；如接入构建产物，还涉及端侧打包任务。开发者中心隐私声明需另行核对，不依赖云侧运行时服务。

### Test Design and Test Plan

- [ ] 无权限变化、仅格式/注释/顺序变化时，不报语义变更。
- [ ] 新增、删除权限，或变更用途说明引用、资源文本、适用场景时，报告准确区分前后内容和所属模块。
- [ ] 多模块、重复声明、缺失文件、非法 JSON5、无法取得基线等情况有明确结果；异常不得静默通过。
- [ ] 运行时权限申请代码变化时给出审阅提示，并说明静态检查无法覆盖的动态情况。
- [ ] 验证 PR 同时修改权限和校验代码时的防绕过措施，覆盖 fork PR 的安全执行路径。
- [ ] 如果启用包内清单比对，验证一致和不一致两种情况；外部隐私政策不可用时，明确提示人工核对而不宣称自动验证通过。
- [ ] 使用包含真实权限变更的 PR 场景验证 CI 摘要和审核流程，并确认现有端侧权限相关测试继续通过。

### Additional Information

参考：#1460、#1556。验收应提供 CI 输出或检查页面截图，并记录设计评审结论。

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
### 🚀 Background Description

#1557 (for #1496) gives each queued turn of a Bee whose Session binding conflicts with the registered exact WorkSwarm Bee Harness an **unavailable** terminal and one user notice: `digitalmate.task.text` with `state: "unavailable"`.

Beebou does not learn about this. Its roster still lists the Bee as available, so it keeps dispatching to it. Each new dispatch is accepted, queued, and then ends unavailable at the next scheduler pass. The user gets a terminal per turn, but Beebou never routes around the Bee.

### Design Ideas

- **Host (#1309) / Store (#1311):** expose a read of Bees whose Session binding conflicts with the registered exact profile. Use the same check the Store applies in `commit_unavailable_result`: the ACTIVE incarnation's recorded runtime binding is not byte-equal to the registered one. A transient "not ready" factory is not "unavailable", so it must not appear in this read.
- **Beebou roster (#1310):** show such a Bee as `unavailable`, with the reason `implementation_unavailable` and no internal refs. Beebou's dispatch tool refuses a new dispatch to it with a correctable tool error, for example `TARGET_UNAVAILABLE`. Beebou can then pick another Bee or tell the user. Steer for an existing task follows the same rule.
- **Recovery:** the only documented recovery is still an operator rollback to the original exact implementation (#1473 option a). Once the binding matches again, the Bee drops off the unavailable read and becomes dispatchable. No binding migration (option c, out of scope).

### Involved Public APIs

- A Host/Store read of unavailable Bees.
- The Beebou roster entry state.
- The dispatch tool's refusal code.

### Description of Relevance to Other Modules

- #1496 / #1557: the unavailable terminal and notice.
- #1309 Bee Host execution (`ready_for` → `BindingConflict`), #1311 Store, #1310 Beebou roster and dispatch tools.
- #1521 / #1558: the pre-effect `BAD_PARAMS` path a dispatch refusal should reuse.

### Test Design and Test Plan

**Real Store and roster:**
- With version 1 recorded and version 2 registered, the roster shows the Bee as unavailable.
- A dispatch to it is refused before effect entry. No task, input or plan is left unknown.
- After a rollback to version 1, the Bee is dispatchable again.
- An unready factory with a matching binding is not shown as unavailable.

**Product entry on the pinned runtime:** after a restart with a changed `harness_version`, Beebou stops dispatching to that Bee. This needs coordinator approval before any Mac Bee-runtime or real-model run.

### Additional Information

Hive Phase 3 · G5. A follow-up the Phase 3 coordinator requested when accepting #1557. Links: #1496, #1557, #1316.
items.title: [Hive Phase 3 · G5] Beebou roster: show a Bee with a changed implementation binding as unavailable and stop dispatching to it

items.author: hsliuustc0106
items.body:
## Background and Goal Description

我们在评估 Agent 架构时，对照了 Anthropic「Always-on Agent（常驻个人助手）」的五大原语——Event Inbox、Timers、Memory、Permissions、Outbox，外加 Dreaming 后台复盘——把它逐项与 DigitalMate 现状比对，识别出一批能力缺口。

本 RFC 的目的：**只提出"要补什么"，不预设实现方案**。每一项只描述目标能力与待讨论的开放问题，具体设计与优先级请团队讨论后决定。

观察来源：用户上传的「Always-on Agent」架构文章截图（五大原语 + 休眠—唤醒 + Dreaming），以及此前 LobeHub 三层架构长文对照。二者均随对话提供。

总体目标：让 DigitalMate 从"被动响应每一条消息"逐步具备"常驻、主动、可连续"的助手特征，为后续自动化与多任务打底。

## Proposed Solution

本 RFC 刻意不给出确定实现，仅列需求方向与开放问题，供团队讨论取舍。

- **R1 Timers 主动性与自我跟进**
  目标能力：除周期计划（Schedules，如每天的定时汇总）外，支持"自我跟进"（Follow-ups）——完成一件有外部后果的事后能自设一个到期跟进闹钟，到期无回应则主动跟进或起草催办。
  开放问题：跟进事件如何与现有定时任务/心跳机制复用？由谁触发、保存多久、如何避免重复打扰？

- **R2 Memory 四类分层与索引**
  目标能力：把持久记忆按职责显式分为四类——用户死规矩（instructions）、用户画像笔记（notes）、历史沟通记录（reported）、任务进度（progress）；每次唤醒加载索引，按需读取具体内容；并遵循"优先保存无法从外部系统重新查回的信息，可查回的只存引用"的取舍原则。
  开放问题：现有长期记忆如何映射到这四类？索引与按需读取的边界如何定？迁移成本如何？

- **R3 Dreaming 后台复盘**
  目标能力：后台定期回顾历史会话，更新过时信息、纠正错误记忆、提炼只有在跨多次任务后才显现的长期规律。
  开放问题：复盘频率、触发方式、与人工确认的边界（哪些更新可自动、哪些需用户拍板）？

- **R4 Permissions 三道防线**
  目标能力：①凭证存储与代理（真实密码/Token 不交给模型，由运行时安全代理在受控接口注入，并限制可访问目标与操作范围）；②Auto Mode 分类器审查高风险工具调用；③Deferred Tool Calls（发钱、删库、对外发重要合同等必须人工拍板的操作，挂起当前调用、保存会话状态、推交互审批卡后再恢复）。
  开放问题：作为个人助手会接触账号与文件，三道防线的落地顺序与最小可行范围？现有"敏感操作先请示"如何演进为可审计的审批链？

- **R5 Event Inbox 去重与幂等**
  目标能力：事件收件箱记录事件状态，并按来源事件 ID 去重，保证 Worker 崩溃后可安全重试；对带外部副作用的工具设计幂等，避免重复执行。
  开放问题：去重键如何定义？哪些工具需要幂等封装？重试与补偿策略？

- **R6 Outbox 发件箱与投递节奏**
  目标能力：按需引入发件箱与分发器，克制打扰——只交付结果与必要细节，控制发送节奏，并具备投递回执与失败重试。
  开放问题：单工具直发与发件箱分发器的取舍？节奏控制与故障恢复做到什么程度？

> 以上均不构成既定方案；团队可整体采纳、拆分或只取其中若干项。

## Involved Public APIs

待评估：Timers/Follow-up、记忆分层、Deferred Tool Calls 审批、Event Inbox 去重、Outbox 分发器都可能涉及新增或调整公共接口，请在方案阶段明确。

## Test Verification

需求级验收建议（具体测试待方案确定后补充）：

- Timers：周期计划按时触发；Follow-up 能按到期条件自主触发且不重复。
- Memory：四类记忆可分别存取并按索引按需加载；可查回信息只存引用。
- Dreaming：后台复盘可运行并产出更新，且不越权改动需确认的内容。
- Permissions：高风险调用被拦截或挂起待审批，审批后能恢复执行。
- Event Inbox：同一来源事件重复投递只处理一次；崩溃重试不产生重复副作用。
- Outbox：结果按节奏投递、有回执、失败可重试。

## Expected Feedback Deadline

建议不少于一周（具体截止由团队确定）。

## CC List

（待定）

## Additional Supplementary Information

参考来源：Anthropic「Always-on Agent」架构文章（Event Inbox / Timers / Memory / Permissions / Outbox 五原语 + Dreaming 后台复盘），以及 LobeHub「Super-agent / Agent 平台」三层架构长文；均为用户在对话中提供的截图。本 RFC 为借鉴性质，是否采用及如何实现由团队讨论决定。
items.title: [RFC]: 借鉴 Always-on Agent 架构补齐 DigitalMate 六项能力——需求征集，不预设方案

items.author: hsliuustc0106
items.body:
## 🚀 Background Description
我们在使用 WorkBuddy 时观察到其产品结构对 DigitalMate 有直接借鉴价值，现提出一组能力需求。本 issue 只描述"要什么"，不预设实现方案，具体方案与优先级请团队讨论后决定。

观察来源：WorkBuddy 客户端截图两张（「专家/技能/连接器」三级入口与专家市场；「我的」页面：记忆库、积分、会员、存储、偏好设置）。

需求清单（Requirement）：
- R1 三级能力架构：提供「专家 / 技能 / 连接器」三级一级入口，把「人设（专家）—能力（技能）—数据/外部系统（连接器）」解耦，并与现有 skill 与 MCP 连接器体系对齐命名与入口层级。
- R2 专家市场：把专家做成可陈列、可筛选、可选择的卡片（头像、名称、一句话简介、能力标签），支持按垂直场景/行业分类与专题（专家团）运营，降低用户选择成本。
- R3 任务式工作台：以「派任务、看结果」为主界面，提供新建任务、任务历史列表（状态、分类、时间），并支持定时任务作为自动化抓手。
- R4 记忆库：把长期记忆做成用户可见、可管理的独立入口（查看/增删）。
- R5 账号与个性化：偏好设置、主题色（跟随系统）、存储空间、登录态与昵称。
- R6 商业化（后置）：积分计量与余额、会员分层（体验版/升级套餐）、版本检测。

## Design Ideas
本 issue 不指定实现方案，交由团队讨论。可讨论的方向与约束：
- 三级架构的入口组织，以及如何与现有 skill / MCP 命名统一；
- 专家是否需要打包「角色 + 提示词 + 绑定技能/连接器」；
- 任务模型与现有会话 / 定时 / 心跳能力的复用关系；
- 记忆库与现有长期记忆存储的对接方式；
- 商业化能力的取舍与上线节奏（建议后置）。

## Involved Public APIs
待评估：三级入口、专家与技能/连接器的绑定、任务列表与记忆库可能涉及新增或调整公共接口，请在方案阶段明确。

## Description of Relevance to Other Modules
涉及「专家 / 技能 / 连接器」「任务与定时」「记忆」「账号与设置」「计费」等多个模块，需协同验证。

## Test Design and Test Plan
需求级验收建议（具体测试待方案确定后补充）：
- 三级入口可正确展示并进入对应分类；
- 专家卡片字段完整，筛选与搜索可用；
- 任务创建、历史列表与定时任务可正常工作；
- 记忆库可查看/增删且与对话记忆一致；
- 账号设置、主题、存储展示正常。

## Additional Information
参考截图：WorkBuddy 专家页与「我的」页面（已随对话提供）。本需求为借鉴性质，是否采用及如何实现由团队讨论决定。
items.title: [Feature]: 借鉴 WorkBuddy 的产品能力需求（专家/技能/连接器三层、任务式工作台、记忆库、专家市场）

items.body:
### Checklist
- [x] I have searched for related issues but did not get the expected help.
- [x] This bug has not been fixed on `origin/main` (checked `e3e64066`).
- [x] Repro and environment below; the visual-evidence field explains why no screenshot applies (server-side protocol defect).

### 🐞 Detailed Description of the Problem

**结论**：服务端 `task.answer` 对 `permission_interrupt` 类审批卡**永远无法批准**——批准帧要求携带与该卡一致的 `prepared_action_hash`，但该类卡本身不含 hash；绕过 hash 只发 `answers` 时，等待中的 `pending.future` 不会被 resolve，回合只能按“拒绝”继续。

**两处定位**
1. `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_service.py:2596-2600`
   `approved` 帧必须带 `prepared_action_hash` 且与卡上值相等，否则返回 `bad params`。而 `permission_interrupt` 卡在构造时不写 hash → 该卡不存在可用的批准路径。
2. `harness/personal-agent/services/agent_bridge/src/server_engine/engine_runtimes/execution.py:90-99`
   当 `request.approved is None`（即只发 `answers` map）时整段被跳过，`pending.future` 保持未完成 → 调用方一直等到超时，或按拒绝语义继续。

**最小复现**
1. 以 `DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_PERMISSIONS_ENABLED=true` 启动后端（bench 容器默认 false，因此生产跑分不受影响）。
2. 提一个会触发授权确认的动作（例如写外部消息 / 访问账户）。
3. 客户端收到卡后发 `task.answer`：
   - 带 `approved` 但不带 hash → 返回 `BAD_PARAMS`（即使把卡上的空串当 hash 也失败）；
   - 只发 `answers` map → 服务端静默跳过，任务悬挂到超时。

**修复选项**
- **A（推荐）**：`permission_interrupt` 卡在构造时生成并返回 `prepared_action_hash`（与其它可批准卡一致），批准路径保持强校验不变。改动集中在卡构造与客户端取值，安全性不降级。
- **B（仅作降级说明）**：允许 `answers`-only 帧 resolve `pending.future`，不再要求 `approved`。改动小，但削弱“批准必须绑定具体动作”的校验强度，建议只作为 A 上线前的临时兼容，并保留告警日志。

**影响面（请勿误读）**
- 仅影响“**无人值守自动审批**”这条路（bench harness 与其它 headless 客户端）。
- `DIGITALMATE_WORKSWARM_PERMISSIONS_ENABLED=false`（当前五个 bench 后端全部为 false，且源码默认值也是 false）时**不出卡**，因此**不挡任何跑分**。
- **优先级低于出分线**：不影响 bench 数据采集，只影响“权限开启场景下的自动应答”。

**验收标准**
1. 开启 permissions 后触发 `permission_interrupt` 卡，客户端带 hash 批准 → 任务继续执行并产出结果，不再是 `BAD_PARAMS`。
2. 只发 `answers` 的场景要么被明确拒绝并返回可读错误，要么（选 B 时）被唤醒并继续，二者都不允许悬挂。
3. 单测覆盖：卡构造含 hash、hash 不匹配被拒、answers-only 的两种处置。

### Detailed Environment Information Description
- 仓库 `openJiuwen-ai/DigitalMate`，`origin/main` = `e3e64066`。
- 服务端镜像：`swr.../digitalmate@sha256:0808957191dc…300442`（kubernetes `digitalmate-nightly` namespace）。
- 复现路径：headless 客户端 `scripts/gaia/digitalmate_headless_client.py` 以 `--auto-answer` 应答；也可手工发帧复现。

### Additional Information
该缺陷是在 bench 适配中发现的：客户端已能自动应答并回传 hash，但在 `permission_interrupt` 卡上无论怎么发都无法生效。相关分支上曾有“允许无 hash 应答”的补丁（`8c69f76c`），**不建议以此方式合入主线**，因为它会让“批准”与“具体动作”解绑。

### Version Information
- main `e3e64066`；服务端镜像 `08089571…`；客户端为 bench 仓 `scripts/gaia/digitalmate_headless_client.py`（2026-11-10 版本）。

### Screenshots / Recordings
无法提供 UI 截图：缺陷发生在**服务端协议层**（`task.answer` 帧校验与等待唤醒），界面上没有可截取的审批面板。证据为上面的行号与以下服务端返回：

```
BAD_PARAMS: prepared_action_hash mismatch
# 或（只发 answers 时）
# 任务一直等到超时，pending.future 未 resolve
```
items.title: [Bug]: permission_interrupt 审批卡不含 prepared_action_hash，该类卡永不可批准；answers-only 应答不唤醒等待中的任务

## 问题描述
DigitalMate 手机端耗电偏高：在华为「小艺」的耗电全面检测中，高耗电应用里 DigitalMate 以 56 分钟耗电 21% 居首，单位时间耗电明显高于同类应用（微信 65 分钟仅 11%）。

## 数据来源
华为「小艺」— 耗电全面检测 · 高耗电应用检测结果（2026-11-15 10:19 截图，手机电量 41%）：

| 应用名 | 使用时长 | 耗电量 |
|---|---|---|
| DigitalMate | 56分钟 | 21% |
| 微信 | 65分钟 | 11% |
| 换机无忧 | 74分钟 | 8% |
| 主屏幕与桌面 | 31分钟 | 6% |
| 图库 | 9分钟 | 4% |

- 另注：9 个低耗电应用未展示；「电池健康检测结果」一节在截图中被截断，未显示具体数据。

## 期望行为
DigitalMate 单位时间耗电应与常规社交/工具类应用相当；在使用时长更短的前提下，不应成为耗电最高的应用。

## 实际行为
DigitalMate 折算约 0.37%/分钟，微信约 0.17%/分钟。DigitalMate 使用 56 分钟耗电 21%，超过使用 65 分钟的微信（11%），单位时间耗电约为微信的 2 倍。

## 环境信息
- 机型：HUAWEI Pura X Max（HOP-AL00）

- App：com.jiuwen.digitalmate 0.1.11

## 补充说明
- 复现频率、具体使用场景（前台/后台、是否语音/联网）待补充。

items.author: Jianyu010
items.body:
Found while wiring the client's Hive cards on the real Phase 2 server (#1554).

**Problem.** The client can't learn the `task_ref` of an in-flight Hive task, so the Home page can't open a Bee question card or show Stop for a running Bee task:
- A question card is readable only through `hive.result.get {task_ref}`.
- When a question opens, the push is a bare `{"event":"digitalmate.changed"}` with no task_ref.
- The snapshot has no Hive tasks.
- When the user triggers `hive.beebou.reply`, its `task_ref` is empty.

The client already has the models, requests and mapping (#1554); only the server source of task_ref is missing.

**Decision (Phase 3 coordinator, design §7a delegation).** The server is the source:
1. The snapshot lists the principal's active Hive tasks: `task_ref`, `bee_id`, `state`, whether a question is open, and the result `version`. It's scoped to the authorized principal under the same rules as `hive.result.get` (ADR-0023 D8 in gateway mode).
2. A Hive-caused `digitalmate.changed` push carries `{"hive": {"task_ref", "change": "question_open"|"terminal"|"state"}}`, so the client refreshes that one task.
3. `hive.beebou.reply`, or its follow-up result, carries the `task_ref` of each task Beebou dispatched in that turn.

Done means a client fixture captured from the real server shows a question card and a Stop entry for a running Bee task.
items.title: [Hive Phase 3 · G5] Client cannot learn in-flight Hive task_ref: no question card or Stop entry on Home
